Tozzi", "content": "OPINION:
Taiwan is an important partner for the
United States
.
It is working to reindustrialize and onshore drone, robotics and advanced-manufacturing supply chains. It also supplies the U.S. with the advanced chips necessary for maintaining our frontier lead in artificial intelligence over China.
Taiwan is investing unprecedented amounts of money to help restore American chip fabrication capacity.
In July,
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.
committed to investing an additional $100 billion for the construction of several advanced fabs and advanced packaging facilities in Phoenix.
These facilities would allow the U.S. to produce chips with 2-nanometer process nodes and below, as well as packaging technologies necessary for AI computing. They bring TSMC’s total investment in the U.S. to $265 billion.
The Trump administration is focused on onshoring critical industries, and with good reason, but Mr. Trump’s contentious claim that Taiwan “stole” America’s chip industry and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s statement that the concentration of advanced chip production in Taiwan represents the “single greatest point of failure for the world economy” position Taiwan as a competitor in semiconductor manufacturing, not a partner.
Although these statements are often taken out of context, they amplify fears among the Taiwanese that the U.S. seeks to “hollow out” Taiwan’s advanced semiconductor industry.
By feeding into the “hollowing out” narrative, the administration is arming Taiwan’s political opposition and other skeptics with rhetorical ammunition to resist deeper U.S.-Taiwan economic cooperation.
It is also providing cannon fodder for China to undermine Taiwan’s trust in the U.S. through ongoing cognitive warfare campaigns. China began spreading the story in Taiwan’s information ecosystem as early as 2021.
The narrative is part of a broader “America skepticism” refrain, which posits that the U.S. is an unreliable partner and will ultimately abandon Taiwan should China attempt to take it by force.
There is a perception that by onshoring advanced semiconductor production, America would undermine the so-called silicon shield, which proposes that Taiwan’s chip industry secure an American commitment to Taiwan’s defense and deter Chinese aggression.
Kuomintang party leader Cheng Li-wun remarked that the Trump administration’s aim to significantly increase domestic chip production by 2028 is tantamount to “completely relocating and hollowing out” Taiwan’s “family fortune and sacred mountain.”
This skepticism is making its way into policy. KMT legislators plan to advance a bill to grant Taiwan’s legislature unprecedented authority to restrict the outbound investments of Taiwanese semiconductor companies.
If passed, the measure could directly affect TSMC’s ability to build fabs in the U.S., Japan and Germany.
The “America skepticism” narrative polarizes the Taiwanese. Opposition supporters are more likely to believe that TSMC’s investments in the U.S. erode the silicon shield, according to a survey of Taiwan’s political opposition by Academia Sinica. Conversely, those who support the ruling Democratic Progressive Party are more inclined to view these investments as a sign of deepening U.S.-Taiwan economic interdependence.
Taiwan should recognize the strategic opportunity in deepening its economic ties with America. Rather than a “hollowing out,” TSMC’s investments represent an expansion of Taiwan’s footprint on the global economy.
They mark the next phase of a derisked, “non-China-centered” globalization in which deeper interdependence between Taiwan, America and allies strengthens supply chain resilience.
Because of the surge in demand for AI chips, the U.S. is also a major contributor to Taiwan’s economic growth. Therefore, Taiwan will be a key player in the global economy for decades to come, and its continued leadership in advanced semiconductors is aligned with American interests.
Taiwan did not “steal” the American chip industry. It supplies American firms. During the 1990s, the American semiconductor industry shifted toward the “fabless-foundry” business model, resulting in a division of labor where American firms specializing in chip design outsourced chip production to foundries in Taiwan and other East Asian countries.
The model allows chip designers to focus their capital on innovation and marketing.
Taiwan is the single greatest point of productivity — not failure — for the global economy. TSMC produces more than 90% of the world’s most advanced semiconductors. More than one-fifth of global maritime trade transits through the Taiwan Strait.
These are assets, not vulnerabilities.
Taiwan is not a competitor to the
United States
; it is an indispensable partner. Unfairly characterizing the island nation gives credence to narratives that erode a strategic relationship forged by shared interests and values.
The U.S. and Taiwan stand to gain if they recognize that the partnership is deepening, not diminishing. We should keep the money flowing and the fabs humming.
• Peter V. Tozzi is a policy analyst at the Research Institute for Democracy, Society and Emerging Technology, a Taipei-based think tank.

_source.trans_cont:
意见：
台湾是中国的重要合作伙伴。
美国
.
它正致力于再工业化和陆上无人机、机器人和先进制造业供应链。它还为美国提供了先进的芯片，以保持我们在人工智能领域对中国的领先地位。
台湾正投入前所未有的巨额资金，帮助恢复美国的芯片制造能力。
7月，台湾积体电路制造股份有限公司（TSMC）
承诺额外投资1000亿美元，用于在凤凰城建设几个先进的晶圆厂和先进的封装设施。
这些设施将允许美国生产2纳米及以下工艺节点的芯片，以及人工智能计算所需的封装技术。它们使台积电在美国的总投资达到2650亿美元。
特朗普政府专注于关键行业的外包，这是有充分理由的，但特朗普关于台湾“窃取”的有争议的说法美国的晶片产业，以及财政部长贝森特所说，先进晶片生产集中在台湾，是「世界经济唯一最大的失败点」，将台湾定位为半导体制造业的竞争者，而非伙伴。
尽管这些声明经常被断章取义，但它们加剧了台湾人对美国寻求“掏空”的担忧。台湾先进的半导体产业。
通过注入“空洞化”的叙述，美国政府正在用修辞弹药武装台湾的政治反对派和其他怀疑者，以抵制更深入的美台经济合作。
它还为中国提供炮灰，通过正在进行的认知战活动破坏台湾对美国的信任。早在2021年，中国就开始在台湾的信息生态系统中传播这个故事。
这种说法是更广泛的“美国怀疑论”的一部分，它认为美国是一个不可靠的伙伴，如果中国试图用武力夺取台湾，美国最终将放弃台湾。
有一种观点认为，通过将先进半导体生产转移到国内，美国将破坏所谓的“硅盾”（Silicon Shield），该计划旨在让台湾的芯片产业确保美国对台湾防御的承诺，并阻止中国的侵略。
国民党领导人郑丽文表示，特朗普政府的目标是在2028年之前大幅增加国内芯片产量，这无异于“完全搬迁和掏空”。台湾的“家福神山”。
这种怀疑正在影响政策。国民党立法委员计划提出一项法案，授予台湾立法机构前所未有的权力，以限制台湾半导体公司的对外投资。
如果获得通过，这项措施可能会直接影响台积电在美国、日本和德国建造晶圆厂的能力。
“美国怀疑论”的叙述使台湾人两极分化。根据中央研究院（Academia Sinica）对台湾政治反对派的调查，反对派支持者更有可能认为台积电在美国的投资侵蚀了硅盾。相反，那些支持执政的民进党的人更倾向于将这些投资视为美台经济相互依存加深的标志。
台湾应该认识到深化与美国经济关系的战略机遇。台积电的投资不是“掏空”，而是扩大台湾在全球经济中的足迹。
它们标志着一个不存在风险的、“不以中国为中心”的全球化的下一个阶段，在这个阶段中，台湾、美国和盟友之间更深层次的相互依赖加强了供应链的弹性。
由于对人工智能芯片的需求激增，美国也是台湾经济增长的主要贡献者。因此，未来几十年，台湾将在全球经济中扮演重要角色，其在先进半导体领域的持续领导地位符合美国的利益。
台湾并没有“窃取”美国的芯片产业。它为美国公司供货。20世纪90年代，美国半导体行业转向“无晶圆代工”的商业模式，形成了一种分工模式，即专门从事芯片设计的美国公司将芯片生产外包给台湾和其他东亚国家的代工厂。
这种模式允许芯片设计者将资金集中在创新和市场营销上。
台湾是全球经济最大的生产点，而不是失败点。台积电生产了世界上90%以上最先进的半导体。全球超过五分之一的海上贸易通过台湾海峡。
这些是资产，而不是漏洞。
台湾不是美国的竞争对手
美国
;是不可或缺的合作伙伴。不公平地描述这个岛国，让人们相信，这种说法侵蚀了由共同利益和价值观形成的战略关系。
如果美国和台湾认识到双方的伙伴关系正在深化，而不是削弱，他们将从中受益。我们应该保持资金的流动和工厂的运转。
•Peter V.Tozzi是台北智库民主、社会和新兴技术研究所的政策分析师。

_source.content:
The Pakistan Air Force (PAF) has published a new animation propaganda video of a massive missile and drone strike on Indian cities including New Delhi, the Indian Navy’s aircraft carrier INS Vikrant and the port of Kandla. The video was uploaded by the PAF’s Directorate General Public Relations (DGPR) on X with the caption “Fizaon K Pasbaan”.
Among the most noticeable sequences is the launch of two JF-17 Thunder fighter aircraft with what looks like CM-400AKG anti-ship missiles. The missile appears to penetrate INS Vikrant’s defence and hit the flight deck directly in the line of fire, as the vessel is being attacked by a missile in the animation.
The decision to showcase ‘INS Vikrant’ is also crucial, as India’s indigenous-built aircraft carrier is among the nation’s most crucial symbols of the Indian Navy’s growing blue-water capability. The missile shown in the picture of “INS Vikrant” looks like the Chinese origin air-launched missile called the CM-400AKG, which is linked to the JF-17 fighters.
The video doesn’t focus on naval targets alone: it paints a broader picture of a Pakistani offensive against India. It shows missile and drone attacks on targets around New Delhi including Indian Parliament and the port of Kandla both with Turkish YIHA-III Suicide drones also being attacked and damaged. Even though Turkish YIHA-III in reality was getting shot downed with help from Bofors L70, ZU-23-2 twin guns.
India last year had showcased one of the YIHA-III Suicide drone for display that flew from from Lahore International Airport and was shot downed and was put together and was later showcased at Indian Army Chief residence to Media.
The new PAF video seem to be more of a message or psychological warfare than an operational evaluation. It aims to show the technology’s ability to destroy targeted Indian assets, its precision and capability of simultaneous attacks across various domains.
Edited by Raunak Kunde
_source.movement_title: 巴基斯坦空军发布动画视频展示对印关键目标打击能力
_source.movement_abstract: 巴基斯坦空军公共关系总局在社交平台X发布名为'Fizaon K Pasbaan'的动画宣传视频，模拟对印度实施大规模导弹与无人机打击。视频画面显示两架JF-17'雷电'战斗机发射疑似中国产CM-400AKG反舰导弹，直接命中印度海军'维克兰特'号航空母舰飞行甲板。此外，视频还描绘了对印度首都新德里（含议会大厦）及坎德拉港的联合攻击场景，其中包含土耳其产YIHA-III自杀式无人机。该视频旨在展示巴方跨域同时打击能力、武器精度及摧毁关键资产的技术水平，具有明显的心理战与威慑意图。值得注意的是，现实中印度曾展示过从拉合尔起飞并被击落的YIHA-III无人机残骸，而视频中呈现的打击效果与实战情况存在差异，主要侧重于战略信号传递而非作战评估。

_source.trans_cont:
巴基斯坦空军（PAF）发布了一段新的动画宣传视频，内容是大规模导弹和无人机袭击印度城市，包括新德里、印度海军航空母舰“维克兰特”号和坎德拉港。该视频由巴基斯坦空军公共关系总局（DGPR）在X上传，标题为“ Fizaon K Pasbaan ”。
其中最引人注目的是两架JF-17 “雷电”战斗机发射了CM-400AKG反舰导弹。这枚导弹似乎穿透了维克兰特的防御系统，并直接击中了飞行甲板的火线，因为在动画中，这艘船正受到导弹的攻击。
展示“维克兰特”号的决定也至关重要，因为印度本土建造的航空母舰是印度海军不断增长的蓝水能力的最重要象征之一。“ INS Vikrant ”图片中显示的导弹看起来像中国的空射导弹，称为CM-400AKG，与JF-17战斗机相连。
这段视频并不只关注海军目标：它描绘了巴基斯坦对印度发动进攻的更广泛的画面。它显示了对新德里周围目标的导弹和无人机袭击，包括印度议会和坎德拉港，土耳其Yiha-III自杀式无人机也遭到袭击和破坏。尽管土耳其的Yiha-III实际上是在博福斯L70，Zu-23-2双炮的帮助下被击落的。
印度去年展示了一架Yiha-III自杀式无人机，该无人机从拉合尔国际机场起飞，被击落并组装，随后在印度陆军司令官邸向媒体展示。
巴基斯坦空军新视频似乎更像是一种信息或心理战，而不是作战评估。它旨在展示该技术摧毁目标印度资产的能力，其精确度和跨多个领域同时攻击的能力。
编辑：劳纳克·昆德

Iran said on Sunday that it struck an unmanned US vessel trying to enter the Strait of Hormuz; however, the US military has denied these claims as a “total lie.” This attack comes just a day after the US military said it struck three Iranian oil tankers in response to Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) firing ballistic missiles at two US Navy warships patrolling the region.
“The report came from Iranian state media, and it’s a total lie,” said Captain Tim Hawkins, spokesman for US Central Command.
Meanwhile, Iranian media reported that at least three tankers and energy carriers, VELOS AMBER, BRAVO, and AL SHEEHANIYA, travelling through the southern route of the Strait of Hormuz, changed course and turned back after receiving a warning from the IRGC Navy that the route was closed.
Also Read: India backs UN ‘Correct the Map’ resolution, draws red line on J&K, Ladakh
The US-Iran exchange of attacks resumed last week following a period of relative calm, with the Strait of Hormuz and areas along Iran’s southern coast again being targeted. At the same time, the US is also targeting Iranian economic interests globally. The Trump administration appears to have adopted a dual-pronged approach: military attack at the Hormuz alongside economic pressure by going after foreign financial institutions that handle Iran’s money.
However, Iran maintains that it will not surrender to US pressure. Major General Ali Abdollahi, Chief of Staff of Iran’s Armed Forces, said the US and Israel were seeking to make up for their military and strategic setbacks in confrontations with Iran and regional resistance groups through economic pressure, media warfare and cognitive operations.

_source.movement_abstract: 伊朗方面于周日宣称，其击沉了一艘试图进入霍尔木兹海峡的美国无人舰艇。美国中央司令部发言人蒂姆·霍金斯上校对此予以否认，称该报道源自伊朗国家媒体，完全是谎言。此前一天，美军表示已击沉三艘伊朗油轮，以回应伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队向两艘在该区域巡逻的美国海军军舰发射弹道导弹。伊朗媒体报道，至少三艘油轮和能源运输船（VELOS AMBER、BRAVO、AL SHEEHANIYA）在霍尔木兹海峡南部航线收到伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队海军警告称航线关闭后，改变航向并折返。美伊袭击交换在经历相对平静期后于上周重启，霍尔木兹海峡及伊朗南部沿海地区再次成为目标。同时，美国正针对伊朗全球经济利益采取行动，特朗普政府似乎采取双管齐下策略：在霍尔木兹海峡实施军事打击，并对处理伊朗资金的外国金融机构施加经济压力。伊朗武装部队参谋长阿里·阿卜杜拉希少将表示，伊朗不会屈服于美国压力，称美国和以色列正试图通过经济施压、媒体战和认知行动，弥补在与伊朗及地区抵抗组织对抗中的军事和战略挫折。

_source.movement_abstract: 伊朗将领阿卜杜拉希在软战专家专题会议上发表讲话，强调伊朗绝不会投降，敌对势力无法在软战领域战胜强大的伊朗。他指出，霸权政权正对伊朗发动全方位的综合软战与认知战，试图通过叙事战争取代硬战。阿卜杜拉希表示，美国在入侵伊朗前曾幻想伊朗无条件投降，但这将是无法实现的错误预期。针对美国及其盟友在地区军事冲突中遭受的挫败，阿卜杜拉希称，敌对势力正试图利用软战、认知战及经济施压来弥补战略缺口，但在伊朗民众的勇气及官员的审慎下，这些企图注定失败，并将增加其军事对抗的失败记录。此外，他赞扬了伊朗伊斯兰革命作为地区及全球抵抗模式的典范作用，认为伊朗凭借对神圣及民族价值的坚定信念，向世界展示了新的抵抗模式。阿卜杜拉希还指出，未来世界格局将发生根本性变化，这将有利于伊朗民族，并伴随美国国际权力的决定性衰退。他同时肯定了媒体及软战战线负责人的努力，赞赏其在阐明事实及应对敌方综合认知侵略方面的贡献。

Ghalibaf warns any aggression against Iran will draw a ‘faster, heavier, more painful’ response
TEHRAN: Iran’s army chief, Major General Ali Abdollahi, said on Sunday that Tehran would not yield to pressure from the United States, and that Washington’s turn to "economic, psychological and cognitive warfare" would fail just as its "military aggression" had, according to Press TV.
Press TV reported that Abdollahi said the US was trying to offset its "strategic shortfalls and battlefield setbacks" by shifting the fight onto other fronts.
Abdollahi underlined that Iran would not surrender, and that the enemy would not prevail in a "combined campaign of economic pressure, media operations and cognitive warfare against a nation that stands on divine and national foundations".
He further described Washington’s expectation of Iranian capitulation as a “false illusion” that would never be realised.
Abdollahi noted that for more than 80 years, the United States had grown used to facing no refusal from other countries, adding that its assumption before moving against Iran, that the "Iranian people would submit unconditionally", was therefore a "false dream".
Iran’s army chief stated that American and Israeli enemies were now attempting to close the gap left by their military and regional defeats through "soft war, cognitive operations and economic coercion", according to Press TV.
“The world of the future will be different from that of the past,” Abdollahi said, adding that this shift would inevitably mean a decline in US power.
Ghalibaf warns any aggression against Iran will draw a ‘faster, heavier, more painful’ response
Iranian parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf on Sunday said the United States had realised that the era of “proportionate responses” had come to an end, the ISNA news agency posted on X.
“From now on, any aggression against Iran's interests and security will receive a ‘faster, heavier, and more painful’ response,” Ghalibaf said.
He said powerful strikes by Iranian military forces against US bases had left American leaders “in a state of utter helplessness”, IRNA news agency wrote on X.
Iran’s Revolutionary Guards say missiles struck US aircraft carrier, destroyer
Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said on early Sunday that it targeted a US aircraft carrier and a navy destroyer with ballistic missiles, claiming both were damaged and withdrew from the area.
The IRGC said in a statement published by IRNA news agency that its Aerospace Force launched the missiles at the two warships.
It claimed the vessels had harassed Iranian ships and were taking part in a maritime blockade, adding that both warships left the “engagement area” after sustaining damage.
The IRGC said the US military’s Central Command (CENTCOM) acknowledged that two navy warships were targeted, describing its statement as confirmation of the operation.
It also warned that continued US military action would draw “heavier” responses from Iran’s armed forces.
In a separate statement early Sunday, the IRGC said its navy attacked a remotely operated US military vessel that it claimed was attempting to enter a protected area of the Strait of Hormuz.
The IRGC did not provide details about the type of attack or whether the vessel was damaged.
The Guards also reiterated Tehran’s position that the Strait of Hormuz is under Iranian management and said the US should leave the region.
Earlier on Saturday, the IRGC Navy said it targeted three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and three US-linked vessels elsewhere in response to American attacks on Iranian tankers.
CENTCOM said Iran launched ballistic missiles toward two US Navy warships patrolling regional waters, and that both vessels evaded the attacks, with no American personnel harmed.
It said US forces subsequently struck three Iranian crude oil tankers.
Lebanese president condemns renewed Israeli strikes on Nabatieh, urges international action
Lebanese President Joseph Aoun on Sunday condemned renewed Israeli attacks on the southern city of Nabatieh and surrounding towns, saying the targeting of state institutions and health facilities marked a “dangerous escalation.”
In a statement posted by the Lebanese presidency on X, Aoun said the attacks caused civilian casualties, severely damaged a finance ministry building and destroyed Ghandour Hospital.
He said the attacks went beyond repeated violations of the cessation-of-hostilities arrangement and the framework agreement by attacking Lebanese state institutions, public service facilities, a hospital and health centers.
Aoun said the attack on the finance ministry building, following an earlier strike on a State Security centre that caused fatalities, demonstrated “a continuing pattern” of attacks extending beyond alleged military targets to civilian government and health facilities.
He accused Israel of seeking to disrupt the functioning of Lebanese institutions and services provided to the public.
The Lebanese president held Israel fully responsible for the continuing escalation and called on the US and the international community to act urgently to halt the attacks and hold those responsible accountable.
He said Lebanon remained committed to measures aimed at preserving its sovereignty, stability in the south and the safety of its citizens.
US forces redirect 92 vessels amid maritime blockade against Iran
US forces redirected 92 commercial vessels while enforcing a maritime blockade against Iran, the US military's Central Command said on Sunday.
"As of Sept. 6, US forces have redirected 92 commercial vessels, disabled 3 and boarded 2 to ensure strict compliance," Central Command said on X.
The command also said a US Air Force F-35A stealth fighter jet was patrolling regional waters.
Turkish, Iranian FMs discuss developments on negotiation with US
Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan and his Iranian counterpart, Abbas Araghchi, discussed regional developments on a telephonic conversation, Anadolu Agency reported according to Al Jazeera.
The two ministers discussed “comprehensively” the latest developments in the ongoing negotiations with the United States, the agency reported.
IRGC says US economic blockade could cost Washington more than Tehran
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said on Sunday that the US economic and maritime blockade against Tehran could cost Washington several times more than Iran.
"If the US wants to inflict one dollar of economic damage on Iran, it may face several dollars in costs and losses itself," IRGC spokesman Brig. Gen. Hossein Mohibi told Mehr News Agency.
He asserted that Iran would not surrender to sanctions and pressure.
Mohibi claimed US President Donald Trump had believed Washington could force Iran to retreat by relying on its military power, naval fleet and aircraft carriers. However, he added, recent developments have shown those calculations to be wrong.
Mohibi argued that the US, already facing heavy debt and economic competition with China and other countries, would struggle to prevail in what he described as an economic war against Iran.
He also claimed that regional developments have put pressure on US strategic reserves and affected access to some raw materials, including through disruptions to aluminum production and exports in the region.
Mohibi said the developments showed that economic pressure and a blockade did not necessarily guarantee victory and could impose high costs on the country enforcing them.
US Centcom says it sank oil tanker in Gulf of Oman
US Central Command (Centcom) said it had sunk an oil tanker in the Gulf of Oman, according to a post on X.
“Thanks to the precision and professionalism of American service members, the M/T Kylo sank in the Gulf of Oman today and joined Iran’s navy at the bottom of the sea,” CENTCOM said.
_source.movement_title: 伊朗强硬回应美国封锁并宣称击伤美军舰艇
_source.movement_abstract: 【伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队、美国中央司令部、伊朗议会、土耳其安纳多卢通讯社等9月7日报道】9月7日，伊朗与美军在波斯湾及霍尔木兹海峡海域爆发激烈对抗。伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）宣称其航天部队向一艘美国航空母舰和一艘驱逐舰发射弹道导弹，造成两舰受损并撤离交战区域，同时攻击了一艘试图进入霍尔木兹海峡保护区的无人美军舰艇。针对伊朗行动，美国中央司令部（CENTCOM）证实两艘美军舰艇遭遇导弹袭击但成功规避，未造成人员伤亡，并宣布已击沉一艘名为“基洛”号的伊朗油轮。美军方面称，截至9月6日，为执行对伊海上封锁，已重新引导92艘商船，瘫痪3艘并登临检查2艘。伊朗方面，陆军总司令阿里·阿卜杜拉希警告美国的经济、心理及认知战将失败，强调伊朗不会屈服。议长穆罕默德·巴格尔·加利巴夫表示，针对伊朗利益的任何侵略将招致“更快、更重、更痛苦”的报复。IRGC发言人霍赛因·莫希比指出，美国封锁伊朗的代价将远高于伊朗自身损失。此外，黎巴嫩总统奥恩谴责以色列对纳巴蒂耶的袭击升级，称其针对政府机构及医院，呼吁国际社会介入。土耳其与伊朗外长通电话，讨论与美国的谈判进展。

加利巴夫警告说，对伊朗的任何侵略都将招致“更快、更重、更痛苦”的回应
德黑兰：据伊朗新闻电视台（Press TV）报道，伊朗陆军参谋长阿里·阿卜杜拉希少将（Ali Abdollahi）周日表示，德黑兰不会屈服于美国的压力，华盛顿转向“经济、心理和认知战争”的做法将会失败，就像其“军事侵略”一样。
新闻电视台报道称，阿卜杜拉希表示，美国正试图通过将战斗转移到其他战线来抵消其“战略缺陷和战场挫折”。
阿卜杜拉希强调，伊朗不会投降，敌人不会在“经济压力、媒体行动和认知战的联合行动中战胜一个建立在神圣和民族基础上的国家”。
他进一步将华盛顿对伊朗投降的期望描述为永远不会实现的“虚假幻想”。
阿卜杜拉希指出，80多年来，美国已经习惯于不面对其他国家的拒绝，并补充说，美国在对伊朗采取行动之前的假设，即“伊朗人民将无条件屈服”，因此是一个“虚假的梦想”。
据伊朗新闻电视台（Press TV）报道，伊朗陆军参谋长表示，美国和以色列的敌人现在正试图通过“软战争、认知行动和经济胁迫”来缩小军事和地区失败留下的差距。
“未来的世界将与过去不同，”阿卜杜拉希说，并补充说，这一转变将不可避免地意味着美国实力的下降。
加利巴夫警告说，对伊朗的任何侵略都将招致“更快、更重、更痛苦”的回应
伊朗学生通讯社（ISNA）在X上发布消息称，伊朗议会议长穆罕默德·巴盖尔·加利巴夫（Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf）周日表示，美国已经意识到“适度反应”的时代已经结束。
加利巴夫说：“从现在开始，任何针对伊朗利益和安全的侵略都将得到'更快、更重、更痛苦'的回应。”
伊朗伊斯兰共和国通讯社在X上写道，他表示，伊朗军队对美国基地的强大打击使美国领导人“处于完全无助的状态”。
伊朗革命卫队称导弹袭击了美国航空母舰和驱逐舰
伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）周日早些时候表示，他们用弹道导弹袭击了一艘美国航空母舰和一艘海军驱逐舰，声称两艘航母都受损，并从该地区撤出。
伊斯兰革命卫队在伊朗伊斯兰共和国通讯社发表的一份声明中说，其航空航天部队向两艘军舰发射了导弹。
它声称，这些军舰骚扰了伊朗船只，并参与了海上封锁，并补充说，两艘军舰在遭受损坏后离开了“交战区域”。
伊斯兰革命卫队表示，美军中央司令部（CENTCOM）承认两艘海军军舰成为袭击目标，并称其声明证实了此次行动。
它还警告说，美国继续采取军事行动将招致伊朗武装部队“更严厉”的回应。
在周日早些时候的另一份声明中，伊斯兰革命卫队表示，其海军袭击了一艘远程操作的美国军舰，声称其试图进入霍尔木兹海峡的保护区。
伊斯兰革命卫队没有提供有关袭击类型或船只是否受损的细节。
警卫还重申了德黑兰的立场，即霍尔木兹海峡在伊朗的管理之下，并表示美国应该离开该地区。
周六早些时候，伊斯兰革命卫队海军表示，他们在霍尔木兹海峡袭击了三艘油轮，并在其他地方袭击了三艘与美国有关的船只，以回应美国对伊朗油轮的袭击。
中央司令部表示，伊朗向两艘在该地区水域巡逻的美国海军军舰发射了弹道导弹，两艘军舰都躲过了袭击，没有美国人员受伤。
报道称，美军随后袭击了三艘伊朗原油油轮。
黎巴嫩总统谴责以色列再次袭击纳巴蒂亚，敦促国际社会采取行动
黎巴嫩总统约瑟夫·奥恩（Joseph Aoun）周日谴责以色列再次袭击南部城市纳巴蒂亚（Nabatieh）及周边城镇，称针对国家机构和卫生设施的袭击标志着“危险的升级”。
在黎巴嫩总统发布的一份声明中，奥恩说，袭击造成了平民伤亡，严重损坏了财政部大楼，并摧毁了甘杜尔医院。
他说，这些袭击袭击了黎巴嫩国家机构、公共服务设施、一家医院和保健中心，不仅一再违反停止敌对行动安排和框架协议。
奥恩表示，继早些时候对国家安全中心的袭击造成人员伤亡后，对财政部大楼的袭击表明，袭击的“持续模式”超出了所谓的军事目标，延伸到了文职政府和卫生设施。
他指责以色列试图破坏黎巴嫩机构的运作和向公众提供的服务。
黎巴嫩总统认为以色列对持续升级负有全部责任，并呼吁美国和国际社会采取紧急行动制止袭击，并追究肇事者的责任。
他说，黎巴嫩仍然致力于采取旨在维护其主权、南部稳定和公民安全的措施。
美国军队在对伊朗的海上封锁中改变了92艘船只的方向
美军中央司令部周日表示，美军在对伊朗实施海上封锁时，改变了92艘商船的航向。
截至9月中央司令部在X上说，美军已经重新安排了92艘商船，3艘被禁用，2艘被登船，以确保严格遵守。
该司令部还表示，一架美国空军F-35A隐形战斗机正在该地区水域巡逻。
土耳其和伊朗外长讨论与美国谈判的进展
据半岛电视台报道，阿纳多卢通讯社（Anadolu Agency）报道，土耳其外长哈坎·菲丹（Hakan Fidan）和伊朗外长阿巴斯·阿拉格齐（Abbas Araghchi）在电话交谈中讨论了地区事态发展。
据报道，两位部长“全面”讨论了与美国正在进行的谈判的最新进展。
伊斯兰革命卫队称美国经济封锁可能使华盛顿付出比德黑兰更多的代价
伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）周日表示，美国对德黑兰的经济和海上封锁可能使华盛顿付出比伊朗多几倍的代价。
伊斯兰革命卫队发言人布里格说：“如果美国想给伊朗造成一美元的经济损失，它自己就可能面临几美元的成本和损失。”侯赛因·莫希比将军告诉迈赫尔通讯社。
他断言，伊朗不会屈服于制裁和压力。
莫希比声称，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普认为华盛顿可以依靠其军事力量、海军舰队和航空母舰迫使伊朗撤退。然而，他补充说，最近的事态发展表明，这些计算是错误的。
莫希比认为，美国已经面临着沉重的债务以及与中国和其他国家的经济竞争，将很难在他所说的针对伊朗的经济战争中获胜。
他还声称，该地区的事态发展给美国的战略储备带来了压力，并影响了一些原材料的获取，包括该地区铝生产和出口的中断。
莫希比说，事态发展表明，经济压力和封锁并不一定能保证胜利，而且可能会给执行这些措施的国家带来高昂的成本。
美国中央司令部称其在阿曼湾击沉了一艘油轮
根据X上的一篇帖子，美国中央司令部（CENTCOM）表示，他们在阿曼湾击沉了一艘油轮。
中央司令部说：“由于美国军人的精确和专业精神，M/T Kylo今天在阿曼湾沉没，并在海底加入了伊朗海军。”

_source.content:
A new study
by researchers at the NATO Cooperative Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence, in collaboration with Ukrainian researchers in the field of security science, presents a fundamental reconceptualisation of cognitive warfare.
Existing approaches typically describe the effects, actors, or technological dimensions of cognitive influence, yet leave a more fundamental question unanswered: what exactly makes a socio-technical system vulnerable to cognitive attack? Why do some societies destabilise under cognitive operations while others maintain resilience?
This study offers an answer. The analysis centres not on individual types of informational or psychological influence, but on the ontological foundations of any social system – so-called systemic invariants: stable linkages and structures that determine how a system interprets reality, establishes trust, makes decisions, and coordinates action. Such invariants include epistemic frameworks (what the system holds to be true), value systems, elements of collective identity, trust architectures, and visions of the future. It is these that sustain a system’s coherence and its capacity to act as an integrated whole, to adapt, and to develop.
From this perspective, cognitive warfare is understood not as a contest over information, but as a contest over the structures of its interpretation and decision-making. Influence operates through the inter-layer linkages of a system’s multiplex architecture. The disruption of these linkages produces cognitive decoherence – a condition in which the system continues to function formally, yet loses its capacity for coordinated action.
The practical significance of this approach lies in its capacity to reframe both attack mechanisms and the logic of defence. Cognitive security is not merely about countering disinformation or propaganda; it is fundamentally about maintaining the coherence of a system’s core structures: trust, identity, epistemic standards, and strategic orientation.
The study further demonstrates that the logic of cognitive attack differs according to system type. In authoritarian regimes, influence targets the dominant narrative through the amplification of uncertainty. In democratic systems, it targets the inter-layer linkages, inducing polarisation and eroding the capacity for coordination.
By distinguishing cognitive from information warfare at the ontological level, the authors establish a foundation for shifting from reactive countermeasures to proactive vulnerability diagnostics and the strengthening of cognitive resilience as a strategic societal asset.
Read the full article in CCDCOE Library
here
.

_source.movement_abstract: 【北约合作网络防御卓越中心网站报道】北约合作网络防御卓越中心研究人员联合乌克兰安全科学领域学者发布研究报告，对认知战进行根本性重构。研究指出，现有方法多关注认知影响的效果、行为体或技术维度，未解答社会技术系统为何易受攻击的核心问题。该研究提出'系统不变量'概念，即决定系统如何解释现实、建立信任、做出决策及协调行动的稳固联系与结构，包括认识论框架、价值体系、集体身份要素、信任架构及未来愿景。研究认为，认知战本质是争夺解释与决策结构的斗争，而非单纯信息争夺。攻击通过破坏系统多层架构的互连产生'认知退相干'，导致系统形式上运行但丧失协调行动能力。研究区分了不同政体下的攻击逻辑：威权体制针对主导叙事放大不确定性，民主体制则针对层间联系诱导极化并削弱协调能力。该理论框架旨在推动防御逻辑从被动反制转向主动脆弱性诊断，将认知韧性确立为关键战略社会资产。

_source.title: New CCDCOE research reconceptualises cognitive warfare
_source.trans_cont:
一项新研究
北约合作网络防御卓越中心（NATO Cooperative Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence）的研究人员与乌克兰安全科学领域的研究人员合作，提出了认知战争的基本概念。
现有的方法通常描述认知影响的效果、参与者或技术维度，但却没有回答一个更基本的问题：究竟是什么使社会技术系统容易受到认知攻击？为什么一些社会在认知运作下不稳定，而另一些社会却保持着弹性？
这项研究提供了一个答案。分析的中心不是个别类型的信息或心理影响，而是任何社会系统的本体论基础——所谓的系统不变量：决定系统如何解释现实、建立信任、做出决定和协调行动的稳定联系和结构。这些不变量包括认知框架（系统认为什么是真的）、价值体系、集体身份的要素、信任架构和未来愿景。正是这些因素维持了一个系统的一致性及其作为一个整体采取行动、适应和发展的能力。
从这个角度来看，认知战不是对信息的争夺，而是对其解释和决策结构的争夺。影响通过系统的多路复用体系结构的层间链接进行操作。这些联系的中断产生了认知退相干——在这种情况下，系统继续正常运作，但失去了协调行动的能力。
这种方法的实际意义在于它能够重新构建攻击机制和防御逻辑。认知安全不仅仅是对抗虚假信息或宣传；从根本上说，它是关于保持系统核心结构的一致性：信任、身份、认知标准和战略导向。
研究进一步表明，认知攻击的逻辑因系统类型而异。在威权政权中，影响力通过放大不确定性来瞄准主导叙事。在民主制度中，它以层间联系为目标，导致两极分化，削弱协调能力。
通过在本体论层面上区分认知战和信息战，作者为从被动对策转变为主动脆弱性诊断和加强作为战略社会资产的认知弹性奠定了基础。

在这里
.

_source.content:
Military operations, public governance, and strategic decision-making increasingly face a threat that conventional means struggle to detect. A kinetic attack leaves destruction. A cyberattack sooner or later reveals itself through disruption, data exfiltration, or infrastructure failure. A cognitive attack is different: its aim is that the targeted system should not recognise the attack as an attack, but should experience the imposed change as the natural evolution of its own views.
The new article “
A Structural Model of the Human Agent in Cognitive Warfare
” continues the research line opened by the same Ukrainian scholars in “
Ontological Foundations of Cognitive Warfare
”, prepared for the NATO Cooperative Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence (CCDCOE). If the first study explained cognitive warfare at the level of socio-technical systems – states, organisations, alliances, and institutions – the new article takes the next step: it shows how such attacks operate at the level of the human agent, that is, the person who makes decisions within these systems.
The central idea of the study is that cognitive warfare is directed not only at what a person thinks, but at how they think. Modern defensive systems work well against information threats: they detect disinformation, verify facts, counter hostile narratives, and analyse data flows. All these are instruments of information warfare: they operate at the level of content, at the level of what is being communicated. Work with narratives is often equated with cognitive warfare; yet narrative remains an element of information confrontation. Cognitive warfare begins one level deeper – where the target is not the message and not the narrative, but the very structure through which a person perceives, evaluates, and makes decisions. That structure cannot be refuted by fact-checking.
The authors propose that the human being should be understood not as a unified “node” in a network, but as a complex multiplex structure. The same officer, analyst, or leader acts in different contexts: at headquarters, within a professional community, in a political environment, and among family or friends. In each context, different ways of assessing data, different levels of responsibility, and different regimes of trust and risk are activated. Yet all this remains one person because of deeper stable structures – personal invariants. These are values, habits of judgement, models of the future, and ways of interpreting the world that allow a person to change without losing inner integrity.
A cognitive attack exploits the natural asymmetries of this structure. Cognitive biases are treated not as defects of thought, but as normal mechanisms of rapid information processing. Under ordinary conditions, they help decisions to be made under pressure, with limited time and incomplete data. But an adversary may direct influence precisely into such a “zone of reduced resistance”, gradually widening the gap between reality and the way it is interpreted. At a certain point, the person is no longer merely mistaken in a particular judgement: the connection between the contexts in which they act – the coherence of their own decisions across different roles – begins to break down, and the very integrity of decision-making comes under threat. The study distinguishes three structurally different forms of such influence: from disorientation, to the gradual rewriting of the criteria of judgement themselves, and finally to the destruction of the stable core of personality.
The systemic conclusion of the article is especially important. Institutions, headquarters, organisations, and states are held together not only by procedures and infrastructure. Their coherence depends on the compatibility of the invariants of key people – on the extent to which they share basic orientations, trust, criteria of acceptable risk, and an understanding of the final aim. If a cognitive attack destroys this compatibility among several structurally significant participants, a system may begin to disintegrate even while its formal features remain unchanged: the same posts, the same procedures, the same channels of communication – but the capacity to reach a common decision has been lost.
This is why the authors propose a transition from the defence of content to topological defence. Its task is to protect not individual messages, but the structure of decision-making: the connections between contexts, the coherence of action, the compatibility of key orientations, and the points of crystallisation – the key people and relations around which an organisation has formed into a whole. Such defence does not replace information security, cybersecurity, or counter-disinformation. It adds a new layer: the early detection of cognitive decoherence before it manifests itself as institutional failure. In its most advanced form, it also permits the logic of attack to be turned back against the attacker: the adversary’s confidence in the picture imposed upon them becomes an instrument of their own disintegration.
The practical result of the study is that cognitive security must include early-warning circuits. Changes in coordination, divergence of assessments, growing mutual inconsistency, and the loss of the capacity to interpret data within a shared purpose may all become indicators of an approaching cognitive vulnerability within the system. At the same time, the authors emphasise that this is not about surveillance of people’s thoughts or psychometric profiling of personnel. The object of analysis should be the structural coherence of decision-making processes, not the private life of the individual.
The mathematical apparatus of the model is developed in a separate mathematical companion paper, where the human agent is described as a multiplex structure stabilised by personal invariants, and cognitive influence is formalised as a perturbation of the connection between contexts. This makes it possible to connect the philosophical depth of the problem with a formal language suitable for the further development of metrics, indicators, and early-warning systems.
Much of the existing literature describes cognitive attacks only after their consequences have become visible. A unified formalism allows a more demanding question to be asked: which structures are vulnerable, which are approaching failure, and which are likely to hold. The vulnerability this model teaches us to recognise lies not in the message, but in the one who receives it.
_source.movement_title: 乌克兰学者为北约构建认知战人类代理结构模型
_source.movement_abstract: 乌克兰学者为北约合作网络防御卓越中心（CCDCOE）撰写研究报告，提出认知战人类代理结构模型。该研究指出，认知战不同于信息战，其目标并非内容或叙事，而是决策者感知、评估及决策的深层结构。研究将人类视为由个人不变量（价值观、判断习惯等）稳定的复杂多重结构，认知攻击利用认知偏差作为低阻力区，破坏不同情境下的决策连贯性，导致系统解体。报告建议从内容防御转向拓扑防御，保护决策结构、情境连接及关键人员关系，而非监控个人思想。研究提出建立早期预警机制，通过监测协调变化、评估分歧及数据解读能力丧失等指标，识别认知失相干。该模型通过数学形式化描述人类代理结构，旨在在机构功能失效前识别脆弱性，将防御重点从信息内容转移至接收者结构完整性。

认知战争的本体论基础
为北约合作网络防御卓越中心（CCDCOE）准备。如果说第一项研究在社会技术系统——国家、组织、联盟和机构——的层面上解释了认知战，那么新的文章则迈出了下一步：它展示了这种攻击如何在人类主体（即在这些系统中做出决策的人）的层面上运作。
这项研究的中心思想是，认知战不仅针对一个人的想法，而且针对他们的思维方式。现代防御系统可以很好地抵御信息威胁：它们可以发现虚假信息，核实事实，反击敌对言论，并分析数据流。所有这些都是信息战的工具：它们在内容层面上运作，在传播内容的层面上运作。与叙事有关的工作通常等同于认知战争；然而，叙事仍然是信息对抗的一个要素。认知战开始于更深的层次——目标不是信息，也不是叙述，而是一个人感知、评估和决策的结构。这种结构不能通过事实核查来反驳。
作者提出，人类不应被理解为网络中的一个统一的“节点”，而应被理解为一个复杂的多重结构。同一个官员、分析师或领导者在不同的环境中行事：在总部、在专业团体中、在政治环境中以及在家人或朋友之间。在每一种情况下，都会激活不同的数据评估方式、不同的责任级别以及不同的信任和风险机制。然而，由于更深层次的稳定结构——个人不变量，这一切仍然是一个人。这些是价值观、判断习惯、未来模式和解释世界的方式，它们允许一个人在不失去内在完整性的情况下做出改变。
认知攻击利用了这种结构的自然不对称性。认知偏差不被视为思维缺陷，而是被视为快速信息处理的正常机制。在通常情况下，它们有助于在时间有限和数据不完整的压力下做出决策。但对手可能会将影响力准确地引导到这样一个“阻力减少的区域”，逐渐扩大现实与其解释方式之间的差距。在某一点上，这个人不再仅仅是在某一特定判断上犯了错误：他们行动的背景之间的联系——他们自己的决定在不同角色之间的一致性——开始崩溃，决策的完整性受到威胁。该研究区分了这种影响的三种结构上不同的形式：从迷失方向，到判断标准本身的逐渐改写，最后到人格稳定核心的破坏。
本文的系统性结论尤为重要。机构、总部、组织和国家不仅通过程序和基础设施联系在一起。他们的一致性取决于关键人物的不变量的兼容性——取决于他们在多大程度上共享基本方向、信任、可接受风险的标准以及对最终目标的理解。如果认知攻击破坏了几个结构上重要的参与者之间的这种兼容性，那么一个系统可能会开始瓦解，即使其形式特征保持不变：相同的职位、相同的程序、相同的沟通渠道——但达成共同决定的能力已经丧失。
这就是为什么作者建议从内容防御过渡到拓扑防御。它的任务不是保护个别信息，而是保护决策的结构：背景之间的联系、行动的一致性、关键方向的兼容性，以及结晶点——一个组织形成一个整体所围绕的关键人物和关系。这种防御不能取代信息安全、网络安全或反假情报。它增加了一个新的层面：在认知退相干表现为制度失败之前对其进行早期检测。在其最高级的形式中，它还允许攻击的逻辑被转回到攻击者身上：对手对强加给他们的画面的信心成为他们自己瓦解的工具。
研究的实际结果是，认知安全必须包括预警电路。协调的变化、评估的分歧、相互不一致的增加以及在共同目的范围内解释数据的能力的丧失，都可能成为系统内认知脆弱性逼近的指标。同时，作者强调，这并不是对人们思想的监视，也不是对人员的心理测量。分析的对象应该是决策过程的结构一致性，而不是个人的私生活。
该模型的数学装置是在一篇单独的数学同伴论文中开发的，其中人类主体被描述为由个人不变量稳定的多重结构，认知影响被形式化为上下文之间连接的扰动。这使得将问题的哲学深度与适合进一步开发度量、指标和预警系统的正式语言联系起来成为可能。
许多现有文献仅在认知攻击的后果变得明显之后才对其进行描述。一个统一的形式主义允许提出一个更苛刻的问题：哪些结构是脆弱的，哪些结构正在接近失败，哪些结构可能保持不变。这个模型教我们认识到的弱点不在于信息本身，而在于接收信息的人。

WASHINGTON (Gray DC) - The House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence has released a new report reviewing the evolution of U.S. intelligence since the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks, warning that the threat landscape has changed and more work is needed to keep the country safe.
The 9/11 Commission released its final report three years after the attacks, including recommendations for the future. Twenty-five years later, experts say the country is not prepared for what could come next.
Rep. Rick Crawford (R-Ark.) said today’s threat environment calls for the same degree of reform and improved integration realized after 9/11.
Every lawmaker in the committee room said they remembered where they were on the morning of the attacks.
Rep. Jim Himes (D-Conn.) said he was in lower Manhattan that day. His office was about 200 yards from the point of impact of the two planes.
Committee members spent the last year reviewing the 9/11 Commission’s 2004 final report, grading progress made on the original recommendations and examining new and emerging threats facing the United States.
Dr. Seth Jones of the Center for Strategic and International Studies said the international landscape, the threats to the United States and the intelligence challenges have evolved in ways the country is not fully prepared to deal with.
Dr. Benjamin Buchanan of Johns Hopkins Advanced International Studies said the Sept. 11 attacks revealed a failure of imagination, and 25 years later, artificial intelligence presents a similar kind of challenge.
Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, former U.S. national security adviser, said the development and proliferation of disruptive technologies, along with political subversion and cognitive warfare, are threats the intelligence community is aware of.
The committee released a new report with 20 recommendations, 22 years after the first report. The findings indicate a changing U.S. intelligence community that learned from the aftermath of 9/11 but has yet to adapt to an environment of cyberattacks, information manipulation and economic espionage.
Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-N.Y.) said the country needs to take preemptive moves to thwart its adversaries.
One key takeaway from the original 2004 report was a lack of coordination in communication and intelligence. Committee members said their focus remained on intelligence, recommending better integration and the adaptation of emerging technologies to match those of U.S. adversaries.
The House Intel Committee’s 9/11 Commission Review Report and the original 2004 9/11 Commission Report are available online.

_source.movement_abstract: 【美国Gray DC报道】美国众议院常设情报委员会发布新报告，回顾自2001年9月11日恐怖袭击以来美国情报体系的演变。报告指出，尽管情报界从9/11事件后吸取了教训，但面对网络攻击、信息操纵和经济间谍活动等新兴威胁，尚未完成适应。报告包含20项建议，强调需加强情报整合与新兴技术应用。战略与国际研究中心专家塞思·琼斯指出，国际局势与威胁环境已发生演变，美国尚未做好充分准备。约翰斯·霍普金斯大学高级国际研究学院本杰明·布坎南表示，人工智能带来的挑战类似于9/11事件暴露的想象力缺失。前国家安全顾问H.R.麦克马斯特中将警告，颠覆性技术扩散、政治颠覆及认知战构成重大威胁。众议员里克·克劳福德和吉姆·海姆斯等委员强调，当前威胁环境需要与9/11后同等程度的改革与整合。报告呼吁采取先发制人措施应对对手，并解决2004年原报告中指出的沟通与情报协调不足问题。

_source.trans_cont:
华盛顿（格雷特区）-众议院常设情报特别委员会发布了一份新的报告，回顾了自“ 9？11 ”事件以来美国情报部门的演变。11，2001，袭击，警告说威胁形势已经改变，需要做更多的工作来维护国家安全。
9/11委员会在袭击发生三年后发布了最终报告，其中包括对未来的建议。25年后，专家们说，这个国家还没有为接下来可能发生的事情做好准备。
众议员Rick Crawford（R-Ark.）说，今天的威胁环境要求在9/11之后实现同样程度的改革和改进整合。
委员会会议室里的每一位议员都说，他们记得袭击发生的那天早上他们在哪里。
康涅狄格州民主党众议员吉姆·希梅斯（Jim Himes）说，他那天在曼哈顿下城。他的办公室距离两架飞机的撞击点大约200码。
委员会成员去年审查了9/11委员会2004年的最终报告，对最初建议的进展情况进行了评级，并审查了美国面临的新威胁和正在出现的威胁。
战略与国际研究中心的塞思·琼斯博士说，国际形势、对美国的威胁和情报挑战已经发生变化，美国还没有完全准备好应对。
约翰霍普金斯大学高级国际研究的本杰明·布坎南博士说，11次攻击揭示了想象力的失败，25年后，人工智能提出了类似的挑战。
前美国国家安全顾问、退役中将麦克马斯特（H.R.McMaster）说，颠覆性技术的发展和扩散，以及政治颠覆和认知战争，是情报部门意识到的威胁。
在第一份报告发布22年后，该委员会发布了一份包含20项建议的新报告。调查结果表明，美国情报界正在发生变化，他们从9/11事件中吸取了教训，但尚未适应网络攻击、信息操纵和经济间谍活动的环境。
纽约州共和党众议员埃莉斯·斯特凡尼克（Elise Stefanik）说，美国需要采取先发制人的行动来挫败对手。
从2004年的原始报告中得出的一个关键结论是在沟通和情报方面缺乏协调。委员会成员说，他们的重点仍然是情报，建议更好地整合和适应新兴技术，以与美国对手的技术相匹配。
众议院情报委员会的9/11委员会审查报告和2004年9/11委员会的原始报告可在网上查阅。

华盛顿（格雷特区）-众议院常设情报特别委员会发布了一份新的报告，回顾了自“ 9？11 ”事件以来美国情报部门的演变。11，2001，袭击，警告说威胁形势已经改变，需要做更多的工作来维护国家安全。
9/11委员会在袭击发生三年后发布了最终报告，其中包括对未来的建议。25年后，专家们说，这个国家还没有为接下来可能发生的事情做好准备。
众议员Rick Crawford（R-Ark.）说，今天的威胁环境要求在9/11之后实现同样程度的改革和改进整合。
委员会会议室里的每一位议员都说，他们记得袭击发生的那天早上他们在哪里。
康涅狄格州民主党众议员吉姆·希梅斯（Jim Himes）说，他那天在曼哈顿下城。他的办公室距离两架飞机的撞击点大约200码。
委员会成员去年审查了9/11委员会2004年的最终报告，对最初建议的进展情况进行了评级，并审查了美国面临的新威胁和正在出现的威胁。
战略与国际研究中心的塞思·琼斯博士说，国际形势、对美国的威胁和情报挑战已经发生变化，美国还没有完全准备好应对。
约翰霍普金斯大学高级国际研究的本杰明·布坎南博士说，11次攻击揭示了想象力的失败，25年后，人工智能提出了类似的挑战。
前美国国家安全顾问、退役中将麦克马斯特（H.R.McMaster）说，颠覆性技术的发展和扩散，以及政治颠覆和认知战争，是情报部门意识到的威胁。
在第一份报告发布22年后，该委员会发布了一份包含20项建议的新报告。调查结果表明，美国情报界正在发生变化，他们从9/11事件中吸取了教训，但尚未适应网络攻击、信息操纵和经济间谍活动的环境。
纽约州共和党众议员埃莉斯·斯特凡尼克（Elise Stefanik）说，美国需要采取先发制人的行动来挫败对手。
从2004年的原始报告中得出的一个关键结论是在沟通和情报方面缺乏协调。委员会成员说，他们的重点仍然是情报，建议更好地整合和适应新兴技术，以与美国对手的技术相匹配。
众议院情报委员会的9/11委员会审查报告和2004年9/11委员会的原始报告可在网上查阅。

WASHINGTON (Gray DC) - The House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence has released a new report reviewing the evolution of U.S. intelligence since the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks, warning that the threat landscape has changed and more work is needed to keep the country safe.
The 9/11 Commission released its final report three years after the attacks, including recommendations for the future. Twenty-five years later, experts say the country is not prepared for what could come next.
Rep. Rick Crawford (R-Ark.) said today’s threat environment calls for the same degree of reform and improved integration realized after 9/11.
Every lawmaker in the committee room said they remembered where they were on the morning of the attacks.
Rep. Jim Himes (D-Conn.) said he was in lower Manhattan that day. His office was about 200 yards from the point of impact of the two planes.
Committee members spent the last year reviewing the 9/11 Commission’s 2004 final report, grading progress made on the original recommendations and examining new and emerging threats facing the United States.
Dr. Seth Jones of the Center for Strategic and International Studies said the international landscape, the threats to the United States and the intelligence challenges have evolved in ways the country is not fully prepared to deal with.
Dr. Benjamin Buchanan of Johns Hopkins Advanced International Studies said the Sept. 11 attacks revealed a failure of imagination, and 25 years later, artificial intelligence presents a similar kind of challenge.
Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, former U.S. national security adviser, said the development and proliferation of disruptive technologies, along with political subversion and cognitive warfare, are threats the intelligence community is aware of.
The committee released a new report with 20 recommendations, 22 years after the first report. The findings indicate a changing U.S. intelligence community that learned from the aftermath of 9/11 but has yet to adapt to an environment of cyberattacks, information manipulation and economic espionage.
Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-N.Y.) said the country needs to take preemptive moves to thwart its adversaries.
One key takeaway from the original 2004 report was a lack of coordination in communication and intelligence. Committee members said their focus remained on intelligence, recommending better integration and the adaptation of emerging technologies to match those of U.S. adversaries.
The House Intel Committee’s 9/11 Commission Review Report and the original 2004 9/11 Commission Report are available online.

_source.title: House Intel panel: Intel agencies lag on evolving threats
_source.trans_cont:
华盛顿（格雷特区）-众议院常设情报特别委员会发布了一份新的报告，回顾了自“ 9？11 ”事件以来美国情报部门的演变。11，2001，袭击，警告说威胁形势已经改变，需要做更多的工作来维护国家安全。
9/11委员会在袭击发生三年后发布了最终报告，其中包括对未来的建议。25年后，专家们说，这个国家还没有为接下来可能发生的事情做好准备。
众议员Rick Crawford（R-Ark.）说，今天的威胁环境要求在9/11之后实现同样程度的改革和改进整合。
委员会会议室里的每一位议员都说，他们记得袭击发生的那天早上他们在哪里。
康涅狄格州民主党众议员吉姆·希梅斯（Jim Himes）说，他那天在曼哈顿下城。他的办公室距离两架飞机的撞击点大约200码。
委员会成员去年审查了9/11委员会2004年的最终报告，对最初建议的进展情况进行了评级，并审查了美国面临的新威胁和正在出现的威胁。
战略与国际研究中心的塞思·琼斯博士说，国际形势、对美国的威胁和情报挑战已经发生变化，美国还没有完全准备好应对。
约翰霍普金斯大学高级国际研究的本杰明·布坎南博士说，11次攻击揭示了想象力的失败，25年后，人工智能提出了类似的挑战。
前美国国家安全顾问、退役中将麦克马斯特（H.R.McMaster）说，颠覆性技术的发展和扩散，以及政治颠覆和认知战争，是情报部门意识到的威胁。
在第一份报告发布22年后，该委员会发布了一份包含20项建议的新报告。调查结果表明，美国情报界正在发生变化，他们从9/11事件中吸取了教训，但尚未适应网络攻击、信息操纵和经济间谍活动的环境。
纽约州共和党众议员埃莉斯·斯特凡尼克（Elise Stefanik）说，美国需要采取先发制人的行动来挫败对手。
从2004年的原始报告中得出的一个关键结论是在沟通和情报方面缺乏协调。委员会成员说，他们的重点仍然是情报，建议更好地整合和适应新兴技术，以与美国对手的技术相匹配。

_source.content:
WASHINGTON (Gray DC) - The House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence has released a new report reviewing the evolution of U.S. intelligence since the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks, warning that the threat landscape has changed and more work is needed to keep the country safe.
The 9/11 Commission released its final report three years after the attacks, including recommendations for the future. Twenty-five years later, experts say the country is not prepared for what could come next.
Rep. Rick Crawford (R-Ark.) said today’s threat environment calls for the same degree of reform and improved integration realized after 9/11.
Every lawmaker in the committee room said they remembered where they were on the morning of the attacks.
Rep. Jim Himes (D-Conn.) said he was in lower Manhattan that day. His office was about 200 yards from the point of impact of the two planes.
Committee members spent the last year reviewing the 9/11 Commission’s 2004 final report, grading progress made on the original recommendations and examining new and emerging threats facing the United States.
Dr. Seth Jones of the Center for Strategic and International Studies said the international landscape, the threats to the United States and the intelligence challenges have evolved in ways the country is not fully prepared to deal with.
Dr. Benjamin Buchanan of Johns Hopkins Advanced International Studies said the Sept. 11 attacks revealed a failure of imagination, and 25 years later, artificial intelligence presents a similar kind of challenge.
Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, former U.S. national security adviser, said the development and proliferation of disruptive technologies, along with political subversion and cognitive warfare, are threats the intelligence community is aware of.
The committee released a new report with 20 recommendations, 22 years after the first report. The findings indicate a changing U.S. intelligence community that learned from the aftermath of 9/11 but has yet to adapt to an environment of cyberattacks, information manipulation and economic espionage.
Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-N.Y.) said the country needs to take preemptive moves to thwart its adversaries.
One key takeaway from the original 2004 report was a lack of coordination in communication and intelligence. Committee members said their focus remained on intelligence, recommending better integration and the adaptation of emerging technologies to match those of U.S. adversaries.
The
House Intel Committee’s 9/11 Commission Review Report
and the
original 2004 9/11 Commission Report
are available online.

_source.title: House Intel panel: Intel agencies lag on evolving threats
_source.trans_cont:
华盛顿（格雷特区）-众议院常设情报特别委员会发布了一份新的报告，回顾了自“ 9？11 ”事件以来美国情报部门的演变。11，2001，袭击，警告说威胁形势已经改变，需要做更多的工作来维护国家安全。
9/11委员会在袭击发生三年后发布了最终报告，其中包括对未来的建议。25年后，专家们说，这个国家还没有为接下来可能发生的事情做好准备。
众议员Rick Crawford（R-Ark.）说，今天的威胁环境要求在9/11之后实现同样程度的改革和改进整合。
委员会会议室里的每一位议员都说，他们记得袭击发生的那天早上他们在哪里。
康涅狄格州民主党众议员吉姆·希梅斯（Jim Himes）说，他那天在曼哈顿下城。他的办公室距离两架飞机的撞击点大约200码。
委员会成员去年审查了9/11委员会2004年的最终报告，对最初建议的进展情况进行了评级，并审查了美国面临的新威胁和正在出现的威胁。
战略与国际研究中心的塞思·琼斯博士说，国际形势、对美国的威胁和情报挑战已经发生变化，美国还没有完全准备好应对。
约翰霍普金斯大学高级国际研究的本杰明·布坎南博士说，11次攻击揭示了想象力的失败，25年后，人工智能提出了类似的挑战。
前美国国家安全顾问、退役中将麦克马斯特（H.R.McMaster）说，颠覆性技术的发展和扩散，以及政治颠覆和认知战争，是情报部门意识到的威胁。
在第一份报告发布22年后，该委员会发布了一份包含20项建议的新报告。调查结果表明，美国情报界正在发生变化，他们从9/11事件中吸取了教训，但尚未适应网络攻击、信息操纵和经济间谍活动的环境。
纽约州共和党众议员埃莉斯·斯特凡尼克（Elise Stefanik）说，美国需要采取先发制人的行动来挫败对手。
从2004年的原始报告中得出的一个关键结论是在沟通和情报方面缺乏协调。委员会成员说，他们的重点仍然是情报，建议更好地整合和适应新兴技术，以与美国对手的技术相匹配。

_source.content:
WASHINGTON (Gray DC) - The House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence has released a new report reviewing the evolution of U.S. intelligence since the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks, warning that the threat landscape has changed and more work is needed to keep the country safe.
The 9/11 Commission released its final report three years after the attacks, including recommendations for the future. Twenty-five years later, experts say the country is not prepared for what could come next.
Rep. Rick Crawford (R-Ark.) said today’s threat environment calls for the same degree of reform and improved integration realized after 9/11.
Every lawmaker in the committee room said they remembered where they were on the morning of the attacks.
Rep. Jim Himes (D-Conn.) said he was in lower Manhattan that day. His office was about 200 yards from the point of impact of the two planes.
Committee members spent the last year reviewing the 9/11 Commission’s 2004 final report, grading progress made on the original recommendations and examining new and emerging threats facing the United States.
Dr. Seth Jones of the Center for Strategic and International Studies said the international landscape, the threats to the United States and the intelligence challenges have evolved in ways the country is not fully prepared to deal with.
Dr. Benjamin Buchanan of Johns Hopkins Advanced International Studies said the Sept. 11 attacks revealed a failure of imagination, and 25 years later, artificial intelligence presents a similar kind of challenge.
Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, former U.S. national security adviser, said the development and proliferation of disruptive technologies, along with political subversion and cognitive warfare, are threats the intelligence community is aware of.
The committee released a new report with 20 recommendations, 22 years after the first report. The findings indicate a changing U.S. intelligence community that learned from the aftermath of 9/11 but has yet to adapt to an environment of cyberattacks, information manipulation and economic espionage.
Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-N.Y.) said the country needs to take preemptive moves to thwart its adversaries.
One key takeaway from the original 2004 report was a lack of coordination in communication and intelligence. Committee members said their focus remained on intelligence, recommending better integration and the adaptation of emerging technologies to match those of U.S. adversaries.
The
House Intel Committee’s 9/11 Commission Review Report
and the
original 2004 9/11 Commission Report
are available online.

华盛顿（格雷特区）-众议院常设情报特别委员会发布了一份新的报告，回顾了自“ 9？11 ”事件以来美国情报部门的演变。11，2001，袭击，警告说威胁形势已经改变，需要做更多的工作来维护国家安全。
9/11委员会在袭击发生三年后发布了最终报告，其中包括对未来的建议。25年后，专家们说，这个国家还没有为接下来可能发生的事情做好准备。
众议员Rick Crawford（R-Ark.）说，今天的威胁环境要求在9/11之后实现同样程度的改革和改进整合。
委员会会议室里的每一位议员都说，他们记得袭击发生的那天早上他们在哪里。
康涅狄格州民主党众议员吉姆·希梅斯（Jim Himes）说，他那天在曼哈顿下城。他的办公室距离两架飞机的撞击点大约200码。
委员会成员去年审查了9/11委员会2004年的最终报告，对最初建议的进展情况进行了评级，并审查了美国面临的新威胁和正在出现的威胁。
战略与国际研究中心的塞思·琼斯博士说，国际形势、对美国的威胁和情报挑战已经发生变化，美国还没有完全准备好应对。
约翰霍普金斯大学高级国际研究的本杰明·布坎南博士说，11次攻击揭示了想象力的失败，25年后，人工智能提出了类似的挑战。
前美国国家安全顾问、退役中将麦克马斯特（H.R.McMaster）说，颠覆性技术的发展和扩散，以及政治颠覆和认知战争，是情报部门意识到的威胁。
在第一份报告发布22年后，该委员会发布了一份包含20项建议的新报告。调查结果表明，美国情报界正在发生变化，他们从9/11事件中吸取了教训，但尚未适应网络攻击、信息操纵和经济间谍活动的环境。

_source.content:
WASHINGTON (Gray DC) - The House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence has released a new report reviewing the evolution of U.S. intelligence since the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks, warning that the threat landscape has changed and more work is needed to keep the country safe.
The 9/11 Commission released its final report three years after the attacks, including recommendations for the future. Twenty-five years later, experts say the country is not prepared for what could come next.
Rep. Rick Crawford (R-Ark.) said today’s threat environment calls for the same degree of reform and improved integration realized after 9/11.
Every lawmaker in the committee room said they remembered where they were on the morning of the attacks.
Rep. Jim Himes (D-Conn.) said he was in lower Manhattan that day. His office was about 200 yards from the point of impact of the two planes.
Committee members spent the last year reviewing the 9/11 Commission’s 2004 final report, grading progress made on the original recommendations and examining new and emerging threats facing the United States.
Dr. Seth Jones of the Center for Strategic and International Studies said the international landscape, the threats to the United States and the intelligence challenges have evolved in ways the country is not fully prepared to deal with.
Dr. Benjamin Buchanan of Johns Hopkins Advanced International Studies said the Sept. 11 attacks revealed a failure of imagination, and 25 years later, artificial intelligence presents a similar kind of challenge.
Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, former U.S. national security adviser, said the development and proliferation of disruptive technologies, along with political subversion and cognitive warfare, are threats the intelligence community is aware of.
The committee released a new report with 20 recommendations, 22 years after the first report. The findings indicate a changing U.S. intelligence community that learned from the aftermath of 9/11 but has yet to adapt to an environment of cyberattacks, information manipulation and economic espionage.
Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-N.Y.) said the country needs to take preemptive moves to thwart its adversaries.
One key takeaway from the original 2004 report was a lack of coordination in communication and intelligence. Committee members said their focus remained on intelligence, recommending better integration and the adaptation of emerging technologies to match those of U.S. adversaries.
The
House Intel Committee’s 9/11 Commission Review Report
and the
original 2004 9/11 Commission Report
are available online.

华盛顿（格雷特区）-众议院常设情报特别委员会发布了一份新的报告，回顾了自“ 9？11 ”事件以来美国情报部门的演变。11，2001，袭击，警告说威胁形势已经改变，需要做更多的工作来维护国家安全。
9/11委员会在袭击发生三年后发布了最终报告，其中包括对未来的建议。25年后，专家们说，这个国家还没有为接下来可能发生的事情做好准备。
众议员Rick Crawford（R-Ark.）说，今天的威胁环境要求在9/11之后实现同样程度的改革和改进整合。
委员会会议室里的每一位议员都说，他们记得袭击发生的那天早上他们在哪里。
康涅狄格州民主党众议员吉姆·希梅斯（Jim Himes）说，他那天在曼哈顿下城。他的办公室距离两架飞机的撞击点大约200码。
委员会成员去年审查了9/11委员会2004年的最终报告，对最初建议的进展情况进行了评级，并审查了美国面临的新威胁和正在出现的威胁。
战略与国际研究中心的塞思·琼斯博士说，国际形势、对美国的威胁和情报挑战已经发生变化，美国还没有完全准备好应对。
约翰霍普金斯大学高级国际研究的本杰明·布坎南博士说，11次攻击揭示了想象力的失败，25年后，人工智能提出了类似的挑战。
前美国国家安全顾问、退役中将麦克马斯特（H.R.McMaster）说，颠覆性技术的发展和扩散，以及政治颠覆和认知战争，是情报部门意识到的威胁。
在第一份报告发布22年后，该委员会发布了一份包含20项建议的新报告。调查结果表明，美国情报界正在发生变化，他们从9/11事件中吸取了教训，但尚未适应网络攻击、信息操纵和经济间谍活动的环境。
纽约州共和党众议员埃莉斯·斯特凡尼克（Elise Stefanik）说，美国需要采取先发制人的行动来挫败对手。
从2004年的原始报告中得出的一个关键结论是在沟通和情报方面缺乏协调。委员会成员说，他们的重点仍然是情报，建议更好地整合和适应新兴技术，以与美国对手的技术相匹配。

_source.content:
WASHINGTON (Gray DC) - The House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence has released a new report reviewing the evolution of U.S. intelligence since the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks, warning that the threat landscape has changed and more work is needed to keep the country safe.
The 9/11 Commission released its final report three years after the attacks, including recommendations for the future. Twenty-five years later, experts say the country is not prepared for what could come next.
Rep. Rick Crawford (R-Ark.) said today’s threat environment calls for the same degree of reform and improved integration realized after 9/11.
Every lawmaker in the committee room said they remembered where they were on the morning of the attacks.
Rep. Jim Himes (D-Conn.) said he was in lower Manhattan that day. His office was about 200 yards from the point of impact of the two planes.
Committee members spent the last year reviewing the 9/11 Commission’s 2004 final report, grading progress made on the original recommendations and examining new and emerging threats facing the United States.
Dr. Seth Jones of the Center for Strategic and International Studies said the international landscape, the threats to the United States and the intelligence challenges have evolved in ways the country is not fully prepared to deal with.
Dr. Benjamin Buchanan of Johns Hopkins Advanced International Studies said the Sept. 11 attacks revealed a failure of imagination, and 25 years later, artificial intelligence presents a similar kind of challenge.
Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, former U.S. national security adviser, said the development and proliferation of disruptive technologies, along with political subversion and cognitive warfare, are threats the intelligence community is aware of.
The committee released a new report with 20 recommendations, 22 years after the first report. The findings indicate a changing U.S. intelligence community that learned from the aftermath of 9/11 but has yet to adapt to an environment of cyberattacks, information manipulation and economic espionage.
Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-N.Y.) said the country needs to take preemptive moves to thwart its adversaries.
One key takeaway from the original 2004 report was a lack of coordination in communication and intelligence. Committee members said their focus remained on intelligence, recommending better integration and the adaptation of emerging technologies to match those of U.S. adversaries.
The House Intel Committee’s 9/11 Commission Review Report and the original 2004 9/11 Commission Report are available online.

_source.title: House Intel panel: Intel agencies lag on evolving threats
_source.trans_cont:
华盛顿（格雷特区）-众议院常设情报特别委员会发布了一份新的报告，回顾了自“ 9？11 ”事件以来美国情报部门的演变。11，2001，袭击，警告说威胁形势已经改变，需要做更多的工作来维护国家安全。
9/11委员会在袭击发生三年后发布了最终报告，其中包括对未来的建议。25年后，专家们说，这个国家还没有为接下来可能发生的事情做好准备。
众议员Rick Crawford（R-Ark.）说，今天的威胁环境要求在9/11之后实现同样程度的改革和改进整合。
委员会会议室里的每一位议员都说，他们记得袭击发生的那天早上他们在哪里。
康涅狄格州民主党众议员吉姆·希梅斯（Jim Himes）说，他那天在曼哈顿下城。他的办公室距离两架飞机的撞击点大约200码。
委员会成员去年审查了9/11委员会2004年的最终报告，对最初建议的进展情况进行了评级，并审查了美国面临的新威胁和正在出现的威胁。
战略与国际研究中心的塞思·琼斯博士说，国际形势、对美国的威胁和情报挑战已经发生变化，美国还没有完全准备好应对。
约翰霍普金斯大学高级国际研究的本杰明·布坎南博士说，11次攻击揭示了想象力的失败，25年后，人工智能提出了类似的挑战。
前美国国家安全顾问、退役中将麦克马斯特（H.R.McMaster）说，颠覆性技术的发展和扩散，以及政治颠覆和认知战争，是情报部门意识到的威胁。
在第一份报告发布22年后，该委员会发布了一份包含20项建议的新报告。调查结果表明，美国情报界正在发生变化，他们从9/11事件中吸取了教训，但尚未适应网络攻击、信息操纵和经济间谍活动的环境。
纽约州共和党众议员埃莉斯·斯特凡尼克（Elise Stefanik）说，美国需要采取先发制人的行动来挫败对手。
从2004年的原始报告中得出的一个关键结论是在沟通和情报方面缺乏协调。委员会成员说，他们的重点仍然是情报，建议更好地整合和适应新兴技术，以与美国对手的技术相匹配。

_source.movement_title: 台湾清大餐厅播放浙江卫视节目引发统战疑虑
_source.movement_abstract: 【台湾联合新闻网报道】台湾清华大学校内餐厅被指播放中国浙江卫视歌唱节目，引发舆论关于大陆对台‘统战’及‘认知作战’的疑虑。文章指出，尽管台湾本地娱乐资源丰富，但校方公共空间播放带有强烈政治符号的中国官方卫视内容，可能涉及透过娱乐产品进行软性政治植入。分析认为，此类行为虽可能为无心之过，但反映了大陆利用网络算法与全球化娱乐平台，将政治意象与科技、娱乐绑定的渗透策略。文章批评校方在公共空间管理上存在疏漏，建议校方不应仅将责任推给承包商，而应在承包契约中明确校内公共空间播放规范及违约罚则。此外，文章提及清华大学此前曾发生校长争议，此次事件进一步凸显校方在提升校务治理能力方面的迫切需求。

_source.content:
WASHINGTON (Gray DC) - The House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence has released a new report reviewing the evolution of U.S. intelligence since the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks, warning that the threat landscape has changed and more work is needed to keep the country safe.
The 9/11 Commission released its final report three years after the attacks, including recommendations for the future. Twenty-five years later, experts say the country is not prepared for what could come next.
Rep. Rick Crawford (R-Ark.) said today’s threat environment calls for the same degree of reform and improved integration realized after 9/11.
Every lawmaker in the committee room said they remembered where they were on the morning of the attacks.
Rep. Jim Himes (D-Conn.) said he was in lower Manhattan that day. His office was about 200 yards from the point of impact of the two planes.
Committee members spent the last year reviewing the 9/11 Commission’s 2004 final report, grading progress made on the original recommendations and examining new and emerging threats facing the United States.
Dr. Seth Jones of the Center for Strategic and International Studies said the international landscape, the threats to the United States and the intelligence challenges have evolved in ways the country is not fully prepared to deal with.
Dr. Benjamin Buchanan of Johns Hopkins Advanced International Studies said the Sept. 11 attacks revealed a failure of imagination, and 25 years later, artificial intelligence presents a similar kind of challenge.
Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, former U.S. national security adviser, said the development and proliferation of disruptive technologies, along with political subversion and cognitive warfare, are threats the intelligence community is aware of.
The committee released a new report with 20 recommendations, 22 years after the first report. The findings indicate a changing U.S. intelligence community that learned from the aftermath of 9/11 but has yet to adapt to an environment of cyberattacks, information manipulation and economic espionage.
Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-N.Y.) said the country needs to take preemptive moves to thwart its adversaries.
One key takeaway from the original 2004 report was a lack of coordination in communication and intelligence. Committee members said their focus remained on intelligence, recommending better integration and the adaptation of emerging technologies to match those of U.S. adversaries.
The
House Intel Committee’s 9/11 Commission Review Report
and the
original 2004 9/11 Commission Report
are available online.

_source.trans_cont:
华盛顿（格雷特区）-众议院常设情报特别委员会发布了一份新的报告，回顾了自“ 9？11 ”事件以来美国情报部门的演变。11，2001，袭击，警告说威胁形势已经改变，需要做更多的工作来维护国家安全。
9/11委员会在袭击发生三年后发布了最终报告，其中包括对未来的建议。25年后，专家们说，这个国家还没有为接下来可能发生的事情做好准备。
众议员Rick Crawford（R-Ark.）说，今天的威胁环境要求在9/11之后实现同样程度的改革和改进整合。
委员会会议室里的每一位议员都说，他们记得袭击发生的那天早上他们在哪里。
康涅狄格州民主党众议员吉姆·希梅斯（Jim Himes）说，他那天在曼哈顿下城。他的办公室距离两架飞机的撞击点大约200码。
委员会成员去年审查了9/11委员会2004年的最终报告，对最初建议的进展情况进行了评级，并审查了美国面临的新威胁和正在出现的威胁。
战略与国际研究中心的塞思·琼斯博士说，国际形势、对美国的威胁和情报挑战已经发生变化，美国还没有完全准备好应对。
约翰霍普金斯大学高级国际研究的本杰明·布坎南博士说，11次攻击揭示了想象力的失败，25年后，人工智能提出了类似的挑战。
前美国国家安全顾问、退役中将麦克马斯特（H.R.McMaster）说，颠覆性技术的发展和扩散，以及政治颠覆和认知战争，是情报部门意识到的威胁。
在第一份报告发布22年后，该委员会发布了一份包含20项建议的新报告。调查结果表明，美国情报界正在发生变化，他们从9/11事件中吸取了教训，但尚未适应网络攻击、信息操纵和经济间谍活动的环境。
纽约州共和党众议员埃莉斯·斯特凡尼克（Elise Stefanik）说，美国需要采取先发制人的行动来挫败对手。
从2004年的原始报告中得出的一个关键结论是在沟通和情报方面缺乏协调。委员会成员说，他们的重点仍然是情报，建议更好地整合和适应新兴技术，以与美国对手的技术相匹配。

_source.content:
WASHINGTON (Gray DC) - The House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence has released a new report reviewing the evolution of U.S. intelligence since the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks, warning that the threat landscape has changed and more work is needed to keep the country safe.
The 9/11 Commission released its final report three years after the attacks, including recommendations for the future. Twenty-five years later, experts say the country is not prepared for what could come next.
Rep. Rick Crawford (R-Ark.) said today’s threat environment calls for the same degree of reform and improved integration realized after 9/11.
Every lawmaker in the committee room said they remembered where they were on the morning of the attacks.
Rep. Jim Himes (D-Conn.) said he was in lower Manhattan that day. His office was about 200 yards from the point of impact of the two planes.
Committee members spent the last year reviewing the 9/11 Commission’s 2004 final report, grading progress made on the original recommendations and examining new and emerging threats facing the United States.
Dr. Seth Jones of the Center for Strategic and International Studies said the international landscape, the threats to the United States and the intelligence challenges have evolved in ways the country is not fully prepared to deal with.
Dr. Benjamin Buchanan of Johns Hopkins Advanced International Studies said the Sept. 11 attacks revealed a failure of imagination, and 25 years later, artificial intelligence presents a similar kind of challenge.
Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, former U.S. national security adviser, said the development and proliferation of disruptive technologies, along with political subversion and cognitive warfare, are threats the intelligence community is aware of.
The committee released a new report with 20 recommendations, 22 years after the first report. The findings indicate a changing U.S. intelligence community that learned from the aftermath of 9/11 but has yet to adapt to an environment of cyberattacks, information manipulation and economic espionage.
Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-N.Y.) said the country needs to take preemptive moves to thwart its adversaries.
One key takeaway from the original 2004 report was a lack of coordination in communication and intelligence. Committee members said their focus remained on intelligence, recommending better integration and the adaptation of emerging technologies to match those of U.S. adversaries.
The
House Intel Committee’s 9/11 Commission Review Report
and the
original 2004 9/11 Commission Report
are available online.

华盛顿（格雷特区）-众议院常设情报特别委员会发布了一份新的报告，回顾了自“ 9？11 ”事件以来美国情报部门的演变。11，2001，袭击，警告说威胁形势已经改变，需要做更多的工作来维护国家安全。
9/11委员会在袭击发生三年后发布了最终报告，其中包括对未来的建议。25年后，专家们说，这个国家还没有为接下来可能发生的事情做好准备。
众议员Rick Crawford（R-Ark.）说，今天的威胁环境要求在9/11之后实现同样程度的改革和改进整合。
委员会会议室里的每一位议员都说，他们记得袭击发生的那天早上他们在哪里。
康涅狄格州民主党众议员吉姆·希梅斯（Jim Himes）说，他那天在曼哈顿下城。他的办公室距离两架飞机的撞击点大约200码。
委员会成员去年审查了9/11委员会2004年的最终报告，对最初建议的进展情况进行了评级，并审查了美国面临的新威胁和正在出现的威胁。
战略与国际研究中心的塞思·琼斯博士说，国际形势、对美国的威胁和情报挑战已经发生变化，美国还没有完全准备好应对。
约翰霍普金斯大学高级国际研究的本杰明·布坎南博士说，11次攻击揭示了想象力的失败，25年后，人工智能提出了类似的挑战。
前美国国家安全顾问、退役中将麦克马斯特（H.R.McMaster）说，颠覆性技术的发展和扩散，以及政治颠覆和认知战争，是情报部门意识到的威胁。
在第一份报告发布22年后，该委员会发布了一份包含20项建议的新报告。调查结果表明，美国情报界正在发生变化，他们从9/11事件中吸取了教训，但尚未适应网络攻击、信息操纵和经济间谍活动的环境。
纽约州共和党众议员埃莉斯·斯特凡尼克（Elise Stefanik）说，美国需要采取先发制人的行动来挫败对手。
从2004年的原始报告中得出的一个关键结论是在沟通和情报方面缺乏协调。委员会成员说，他们的重点仍然是情报，建议更好地整合和适应新兴技术，以与美国对手的技术相匹配。

More than 7,000 Kashmir Pandits in Kashmir Valley are on the radar of terrorist networks, with the United Liberation Council (ULC), an proxy of the Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) terror outfit, leaking their personal information online.
According to reports, the ULC has issued a terror threat against more than 7,000 Kashmiri Pandit workers deployed in the Valley under Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s special package, prompting a high alert across Jammu and Kashmir.
The Lashkar proxy, has also leaked personal information of some of the Kashmiri Pandit employees, including their names, home addresses, and vehicle numbers, increasing the severity of the threat, and fermenting an atmosphere of fear among the workers and increased pressure on the administration regarding their safety.
In its message, the ULC has opposed arming Kashmir Pandits working the Valley, claiming such measures could make these workers soft targets.
Security sources believe the public threats aim to drive a wedge between Kashmir’s local and expatriate communities, particularly Kashmiri Pandits who have returned to the Valley and are employed under government schemes, News18 reported.
Further, the public threats issued by proxy groups like the ULC and The Resistance Front (TRF) are believed to be part of a broader psychological warfare strategy by Pakistan’s ISI to distract security forces from protecting personnel, allowing terrorists to establish and activate their secondary networks, they said.
As per the report, Pakistan and its terrorist proxies are using diversionary tactics to conceal the activities of around 1,000 terrorists stationed at launchpads near the Line of Control (LoC), who seek to infiltrate into the densely forested areas of Jammu and Kashmir.
The terrorists are also attempting to establish a network with their handlers across the border in Pakistan, to leak confidential administrative information, and to carry out lone-wolf attacks against religious minorities and workers from outside the country, the report added.

_source.movement_abstract: 【印度News18报道】印度新闻18日报道，克什米尔山谷地区超过7000名克什米尔班迪特（Kashmir Pandits）成为恐怖网络目标。作为虔诚军（LeT）代理组织的联合解放委员会（ULC）在线泄露了这些在莫迪总理特别计划下部署的班迪特工人的姓名、家庭住址及车牌号等个人信息，引发当地高度警戒。ULC在声明中反对武装在谷地工作的班迪特，声称此举将使其成为软目标。安全部门分析认为，此类公开威胁旨在制造克什米尔本地社区与返乡班迪特群体间的裂痕，属于巴基斯坦三军情报局（ISI）心理战战略的一部分，意在分散印方安全部队对人员保护的注意力，以便恐怖分子建立并激活二级网络。报告指出，巴基斯坦及其代理组织正利用声东击西战术，掩护约1000名部署在实际控制线（LoC）附近发射点的恐怖分子，企图渗透至查谟和克什米尔茂密林区。此外，恐怖分子正试图与巴基斯坦境内的联络人建立网络，以泄露机密行政信息，并针对宗教少数群体及外籍工人发动独狼式袭击。

WASHINGTON (Gray DC) - The House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence has released a new report reviewing the evolution of U.S. intelligence since the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks, warning that the threat landscape has changed and more work is needed to keep the country safe.
The 9/11 Commission released its final report three years after the attacks, including recommendations for the future. Twenty-five years later, experts say the country is not prepared for what could come next.
Rep. Rick Crawford (R-Ark.) said today’s threat environment calls for the same degree of reform and improved integration realized after 9/11.
Every lawmaker in the committee room said they remembered where they were on the morning of the attacks.
Rep. Jim Himes (D-Conn.) said he was in lower Manhattan that day. His office was about 200 yards from the point of impact of the two planes.
Committee members spent the last year reviewing the 9/11 Commission’s 2004 final report, grading progress made on the original recommendations and examining new and emerging threats facing the United States.
Dr. Seth Jones of the Center for Strategic and International Studies said the international landscape, the threats to the United States and the intelligence challenges have evolved in ways the country is not fully prepared to deal with.
Dr. Benjamin Buchanan of Johns Hopkins Advanced International Studies said the Sept. 11 attacks revealed a failure of imagination, and 25 years later, artificial intelligence presents a similar kind of challenge.
Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, former U.S. national security adviser, said the development and proliferation of disruptive technologies, along with political subversion and cognitive warfare, are threats the intelligence community is aware of.
The committee released a new report with 20 recommendations, 22 years after the first report. The findings indicate a changing U.S. intelligence community that learned from the aftermath of 9/11 but has yet to adapt to an environment of cyberattacks, information manipulation and economic espionage.
Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-N.Y.) said the country needs to take preemptive moves to thwart its adversaries.
One key takeaway from the original 2004 report was a lack of coordination in communication and intelligence. Committee members said their focus remained on intelligence, recommending better integration and the adaptation of emerging technologies to match those of U.S. adversaries.

_source.title: House Intel Committee says intelligence community not fully prepared for evolving threats
_source.trans_cont:
华盛顿（格雷特区）-众议院常设情报特别委员会发布了一份新的报告，回顾了自“ 9？11 ”事件以来美国情报部门的演变。11，2001，袭击，警告说威胁形势已经改变，需要做更多的工作来维护国家安全。
9/11委员会在袭击发生三年后发布了最终报告，其中包括对未来的建议。25年后，专家们说，这个国家还没有为接下来可能发生的事情做好准备。
众议员Rick Crawford（R-Ark.）说，今天的威胁环境要求在9/11之后实现同样程度的改革和改进整合。
委员会会议室里的每一位议员都说，他们记得袭击发生的那天早上他们在哪里。
康涅狄格州民主党众议员吉姆·希梅斯（Jim Himes）说，他那天在曼哈顿下城。他的办公室距离两架飞机的撞击点大约200码。
委员会成员去年审查了9/11委员会2004年的最终报告，对最初建议的进展情况进行了评级，并审查了美国面临的新威胁和正在出现的威胁。
战略与国际研究中心的塞思·琼斯博士说，国际形势、对美国的威胁和情报挑战已经发生变化，美国还没有完全准备好应对。
约翰霍普金斯大学高级国际研究的本杰明·布坎南博士说，11次攻击揭示了想象力的失败，25年后，人工智能提出了类似的挑战。
前美国国家安全顾问、退役中将麦克马斯特（H.R.McMaster）说，颠覆性技术的发展和扩散，以及政治颠覆和认知战争，是情报部门意识到的威胁。
在第一份报告发布22年后，该委员会发布了一份包含20项建议的新报告。调查结果表明，美国情报界正在发生变化，他们从9/11事件中吸取了教训，但尚未适应网络攻击、信息操纵和经济间谍活动的环境。
纽约州共和党众议员埃莉斯·斯特凡尼克（Elise Stefanik）说，美国需要采取先发制人的行动来挫败对手。
从2004年的原始报告中得出的一个关键结论是在沟通和情报方面缺乏协调。委员会成员说，他们的重点仍然是情报，建议更好地整合和适应新兴技术，以与美国对手的技术相匹配。
这个
众议院情报委员会的9/11委员会审查报告
还有
2004年9/11委员会报告原件
都可以在网上找到。
_source.trans_title: 众议院情报委员会称情报部门对不断变化的威胁准备不足

Security agencies in Jammu and Kashmir have been put on high alert following a fresh threat letter issued by the United Liberation Council (ULC), an online proxy front for the banned terror outfit Lashkar-e-Taiba. The public warning directly targets over 7,000 migrant Kashmiri Pandit employees posted in the Valley under the Prime Minister’s Special Package, escalating security concerns across government departments.
In a serious breach of confidentiality,the terror outfit released sensitive personal details
—including full names, residential addresses, and vehicle registration numbers—to intimidate employees and instil widespread panic. The ULC’s communication explicitly opposes administrative considerations to equip migrant Kashmiri Pandits with light weapons, claiming such measures turn the community into targetable counter-insurgency tools.
Furthermore, the outfit attempted to manufacture an ideological divide between non-migrant residents and returning migrant Pandits employed through government schemes, labelling the latter as white-collar operatives serving an external political agenda.
Top intelligence sources reveal that the publicised online threats by proxy groups like the ULC and The Resistance Front (TRF) form part of a calculated psychological warfare campaign. Security analysts indicate that Pakistan’s Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI) is leveraging these high-profile digital hit-lists to distract law enforcement, forcing security forces to divert personnel towards static protection duties while terror handlers attempt to rebuild ground networks.
The diversion tactic is designed to cover the movements of nearly 1,000 terrorists currently stationed across launchpads along the Line of Control, waiting for opportunities to infiltrate dense forest sectors in
Jammu and Kashmir
. Simultaneously, cross-border handlers are attempting to establish fresh networks of Over Ground Workers (OGWs) to leak confidential administrative data and incite lone-actor targeted strikes against religious minorities and non-local workers.
_source.movement_title: 印控克什米尔安全部门应对恐怖组织针对移民雇员威胁
_source.movement_abstract: 印度查谟和克什米尔地区安全部门因收到联合解放委员会（ULC）发出的新威胁信而进入高度戒备状态。ULC是被禁恐怖组织虔诚军（LeT）的在线代理组织，其威胁直接针对在总理特别计划下派驻该地区的7000多名克什米尔潘迪特移民雇员。该组织泄露了包括全名、家庭住址和车辆注册号在内的敏感个人信息，旨在制造恐慌并恐吓雇员。ULC明确反对为移民潘迪特配备轻武器的行政措施，称此举将使该社区成为反叛乱行动的目标。此外，该组织试图在本地居民与通过政府计划返回的移民潘迪特之间制造意识形态分裂，将后者污蔑为服务于外部政治议程的白领特工。情报来源显示，ULC和抵抗阵线（TRF）等代理组织的公开网络威胁是精心策划的心理战的一部分。安全分析人士指出，巴基斯坦三军情报局（ISI）利用这些高调的数字暗杀名单分散执法部门注意力，迫使安全部队将人员调往静态保护任务，同时恐怖头目试图重建地面网络。该 diversion 战术旨在掩护约1000名恐怖分子在控制线沿线发射台的行动，等待机会渗透至查谟和克什米尔的茂密森林区域。同时，跨境头目正试图建立新的地面工作人员网络，以泄露机密行政数据并煽动针对宗教少数群体和非本地工人的单独袭击。

Nurul Arifin: Spionase Modern Berubah Wujud, Indonesia Butuh 3 Pilar Hukum Antispionase
Rabu, 02 September 2026 - 17:18 WIB
Anggota Komisi I DPR RI dari Fraksi Partai Golkar Nurul Arifin mendorong RUU Antispionase segera ditempatkan sebagai salah satu prioritas dalam Program Legislasi Nasional (Prolegnas).Foto/Tangkapan layar IG @na_nurularifin
JAKARTA
 - Ancaman terhadap kedaulatan Indonesia telah berpindah bentuk secara fundamental, dari 
spionase
 konvensional-militeristik menjadi ancaman digital, asimetris, dan multidimensi yang bekerja di area grey zone. Di tengah pergeseran itu, instrumen hukum nasional dinilai masih tersebar, sektoral, dan belum memadai, sehingga Indonesia mendesak untuk membangun satu kerangka hukum terpadu guna menghadapi spionase dan intervensi asing di era digital.Hal itu ditegaskan anggota Komisi I DPR RI dari Fraksi Partai Golkar 
Nurul Arifin
 , yang mendorong agar Rancangan Undang-Undang (RUU) Antispionase segera ditempatkan sebagai salah satu prioritas dalam Program Legislasi Nasional ( 
Prolegnas
 )."Indonesia membutuhkan kerangka hukum yang modern untuk melindungi kedaulatan nasional dari spionase dan intervensi atau pengaruh asing, dengan tetap menjaga demokrasi, HAM, kebebasan pers, kebebasan akademik, dan due process of law," ujar Nurul Arifin dalam keterangannya di Jakarta, Rabu (2/9/2026).Nurul menjelaskan, spionase hari ini tidak lagi terbatas pada pencurian dokumen fisik atau operasi agen rahasia secara langsung. Ancaman kini bergerak sebagai satu spektrum utuh, mulai dari pengumpulan informasi, penetrasi dan perekrutan sumber, pencurian data hilirisasi dan teknologi strategis, hingga operasi pengaruh (foreign interference) dan perang hibrida.
Baca Juga: 
Mengenal Ikan Robot, Spionase Terbaru Militer Dunia
Yang membuatnya lebih berbahaya, kata Nurul, adalah karakternya yang nyaris tak kasat mata. Serangan Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) terhadap Pusat Data Nasional, infrastruktur energi, dan sistem keuangan, hingga operasi cognitive warfare berbasis kecerdasan buatan dan deepfake yang merekayasa opini publik, kini menjadi instrumen yang lazim digunakan aktor asing untuk menembus jantung kedaulatan politik, stabilitas ekonomi, dan kohesi sosial Indonesia. "Ancaman yang paling berbahaya justru yang tidak lagi kita kenali sebagai ancaman," ujarnya. Nurul menambahkan, "Ketika infiltrasi kepentingan asing berulang kali terjadi dan diterima sebagai hal yang lumrah, di situlah kita kehilangan lapis pertahanan paling mendasar."Di sisi lain, perangkat hukum Indonesia, mulai dari KUHP, UU Nomor 17 Tahun 2011 tentang Intelijen Negara, UU ITE, hingga UU Pelindungan Data Pribadi, masih bekerja secara sektoral dan belum memberikan definisi terpadu atas delik spionase modern maupun intervensi asing.
HUT ke-81, Puan: Sepanjang 2025-2026 DPR Telah Selesaikan 16 RUU
_source.movement_title: 印尼议员推动反间谍法优先立法应对数字时代威胁
_source.movement_abstract: 【印度尼西亚雅加达媒体9月2日报道】2026年9月2日，印度尼西亚众议院第一委员会成员、戈尔卡党党团成员努鲁尔·阿里芬在雅加达发表声明，呼吁将《反间谍法》草案（RUU Antispionase）列为国家立法规划（Prolegnas）的优先事项。阿里芬指出，针对印尼主权的威胁已从传统军事间谍活动转变为数字化、非对称及多维度的灰色地带威胁。现代间谍活动涵盖信息收集、战略技术与数据窃取、外国干预及混合战争，包括针对国家数据中心、能源基础设施和金融系统的先进持续性威胁（APT），以及利用人工智能和深度伪造技术进行的认知战。阿里芬强调，印尼现行法律体系（包括刑法典、2011年第17号国家情报法、信息电子交易法及个人数据保护法）呈碎片化状态，缺乏对现代间谍行为和外国干预的统一法律定义。他主张建立现代法律框架，在保护国家主权的同时，兼顾民主、人权、新闻自由、学术自由及正当法律程序，以应对日益隐蔽且难以识别的外国渗透风险。

TEHRAN — Iran’s Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf has warned that the United States has resorted to a “hybrid war” against the Islamic Republic in an attempt to compensate for its military and diplomatic failures.
“The enemy has shown us that, after suffering setbacks on the military and diplomatic fronts, it has added an extensive economic and cognitive warfare campaign to its operations,” Qalibaf said in a video address.
He added, “In other words, we are now facing a hybrid war where the naval blockade itself constitutes a form of military warfare. Economic warfare remains their primary focus, reinforced by sophisticated psychological operations.”
The Parliament speaker touched upon Washington’s broader objectives behind this strategy, stating: “The enemy’s goal in this hybrid war is to incite domestic unrest and chaos—that is their sinister intention—and in some instances, carry out targeted assassinations. They may even attempt short, limited military strikes to weaken our resolve or compel us to capitulate at the negotiating table.”
Qalibaf also warned that Iran will respond militarily if the US intensifies its blockade of Iranian ports.

Qalibaf’s remarks come amid escalating rhetoric from Washington. President Donald Trump recently threatened an unprecedented multi-front campaign against Tehran, warning of potential military strikes against Iranian strategic assets and infrastructure if key demands are not met.
The military threats coincide with what Trump described as an all-out “crushing economic D-Day” campaign against Tehran. Under the sweeping economic measures, Washington warned international banks, companies, and governments that maintaining trade ties, processing transactions, or facilitating Iranian oil exports would trigger severe secondary sanctions and financial isolation.
The US and Israel initiated another round of unprovoked aggression against Iran on February 28, coming approximately eight months after their previous unlawful attacks on Iranian territory in June 2025. However, Iran’s strong military response against Israel and American bases in the region forced Trump to call for a ceasefire, which went into effect on April 8. Despite the truce and a Pakistani-mediated memorandum of understanding on June 17, the US has violated its commitments with new strikes against Iran and the continuation of its naval blockade.
_source.movement_title: 伊朗议长警告美国发动混合战争并威胁军事反制
_source.movement_abstract: 伊朗议长穆罕默德·巴克尔·加利巴夫发表视频讲话，警告美国因军事和外交受挫，已对伊朗发动包含经济封锁、认知战及心理战的混合战争。加利巴夫指出，美国旨在通过混合战争煽动伊朗国内动荡、实施定点清除，并可能发动有限军事打击以迫使伊朗在谈判中屈服。针对美国可能加剧的港口封锁，加利巴夫明确表示伊朗将采取军事回应，并警告若阻止伊朗石油出口，将导致波斯湾地区无人能出口石油。背景显示，美国总统特朗普近期威胁对伊朗战略资产发动多战线军事打击，并实施所谓“经济D日”全面制裁，警告国际实体若与伊朗保持贸易或协助石油出口将面临二级制裁。此前，美以于2月28日对伊朗发动新一轮袭击，距2025年6月袭击已过去约八个月。尽管伊朗军事反击迫使特朗普于4月8日呼吁停火，且6月17日达成巴基斯坦调解的谅解备忘录，但美国被指违反承诺，继续实施空袭及海军封锁。
