_source.content:
A new defense architecture is taking shape across the Indo-Pacific. It bears little resemblance to the Cold War geometry of bilateral treaties and concentrated forward bases that defined the region for half a century.
What is actually emerging is an allied security web: distributed, resilient, co-invented, and built on the premise that chaos is the baseline condition of twenty-first-century conflict, rather than a failure of deterrence to be corrected.
The United States and Australia are central nodes in that architecture, but they are not solitary. Guam’s transformation into a network hub; the trilateral amphibious partnership taking shape among the United States, Australia, and Indonesia; the integrated maritime deterrence architecture developing at the Strait of Malacca; the porcupine defense being assembled across the Philippine archipelago; and the industrial redesign of Philippine supply chains through the Luzon Economic Corridor are not disconnected experiments.
They are the connective tissue of a new way of operating, one that seeks advantage not by preventing disruption but by surviving it better than the adversary and continuing to generate combat power on the far side of the opening blow.
To understand how this new network works together, we first must consider each node by itself.
For decades, Guam sat at one vertex of a strategic triangle. The mental picture was straightforward: a large, heavily defended base from which the United States could surge power in a crisis.
That picture no longer holds, however. The maturation of Chinese intermediate-range precision strike has converted concentrated infrastructure into what operators describe as sitting ducks. Massed forces on predictable, fixed infrastructure will not survive the opening phase of a peer conflict.
Out of that recognition has emerged a fundamentally different conception of Guam and the surrounding Marianas, re-engineered as an anchor node in a distributed network organized around three interlocking architectures: security webs, deterrence webs, and kill webs. Each addresses a different layer of the operational problem — survivability, signaling, and lethality — but they only make strategic sense as a mutually reinforcing whole.
Security webs are about surviving under attack. At Guam, this has meant distributed munitions magazines, dispersed fuel storage, an integrated air and missile defense system spread across 16 sites, and expansion of the security footprint to encompass Saipan, Tinian, and Rota. When the Northern Marianas are knitted into the same defensive architecture, operational space to absorb blows and reconstitute capability expands dramatically. The adversary must now plan against multiple dispersed nodes rather than a single island fortress.
Where security webs are fundamentally about survivability, dispersing forces and supplies so that an adversary cannot achieve decisive effects with a first strike, deterrence webs work by imposing costs and manufacturing uncertainty. A deterrence web is not simply having forces forward or showing resolve. It is an integrated architecture of capabilities, partnerships, and operational concepts that forces adversaries to confront escalation risks, alliance cohesion, and operational complexity before they act.
The critical variable is not any single capability, but the integrated uncertainty the web generates: an adversary considering aggression must now calculate not just whether it can strike successfully, but what escalatory responses will follow, how distributed allied capabilities will respond, and whether tactical success will translate into strategic advantage or strategic disaster. A deterrence web functions precisely because it cannot be decapitated at a single point, because its allied nodes have genuine operational agency, and because adversary planners can never fully map its edges.
Kill webs are the most dynamic and least understood element. The traditional kill chain was linear: find, fix, track, target, engage, assess. Kill webs dissolve that linearity. They prioritize the network’s overall capacity to sense, decide, and strike faster than the adversary over the individual performance of any single asset.
Indo-Pacific Command head Adm. Samuel Paparo’s April 2026 posture statement frames this with unusual clarity. What he identifies as three converging meta-trends — the growing strategic effect of information and cognitive operations, the commoditization of cheap massed autonomous systems, and the commoditization of long-range precision strike — drive a single imperative: achieving information and decision superiority. The language differs from kill web vocabulary, but the operational logic is identical.
If Guam shows how web logic is transforming a legacy forward base, the emerging amphibious partnership among the US, Australia, and Indonesia shows how it is transforming the way security partners conceive and practice littoral power. The Australia-Indonesia Defence Cooperation Agreement and the expansion of Exercise Keris Woomera are formally a bilateral story. But that framing leaves out the unspoken third leg of the triangle.
The United States Marine Corps is woven through nearly every aspect of what Australia brings to the littoral. Marine Rotational Force–Darwin has made northern Australia a sustained laboratory for US and Australian experimentation in Expeditionary Advanced Base Operations, stand-in forces, land-based anti-ship fires, and the logistics of dispersing small lethal units across austere island locations. The November 2024 amphibious landing at Banongan Beach in East Java, the largest and most complex joint drill Australia and Indonesia had ever conducted, carried that intellectual and operational DNA directly into a bilateral framework where no American flag appeared on the beach.
The deeper structure is a three-lane co-invention cycle, not formally intersecting but running parallel to each other. In the US–Australia lane, Marine and Australian units develop and refine the conceptual grammar of littoral maneuver. In the US–Indonesia lane, Indonesian officers encounter those concepts directly through exercises like Super Garuda Shield. In the Australia–Indonesia lane, exercises like Keris Woomera lift selected elements into a deliberately non-US-led framework, allowing Jakarta and Canberra to adapt the concepts to their own political constraints. American concepts travel furthest when local security partners can genuinely adapt and own them.
The Strait of Malacca carries roughly a quarter of global trade and close to 30 percent of seaborne oil. For China, this geographic fact is a structural vulnerability, what Hu Jintao famously named the “Malacca dilemma.” Beijing has spent two decades attempting to mitigate that exposure through overland pipelines and port investments. The US-Indonesia Major Defense Cooperation Partnership, unveiled in April 2026, is now changing that calculus.
What is emerging at Malacca is an application of the same three-web architecture visible at Guam, adapted for a chokepoint context. The security web consists of persistent ISR across the strait, mesh fleets of unmanned surface and undersea vehicles, and networked sensor grids that support counter-smuggling and anti-piracy in peacetime while generating the continuous contact picture that crisis management requires.
The deterrence web leverages that same infrastructure to expose and impose friction on coercive behavior. The kill web integrates those sensors with effectors. Indonesia is not simply a convenient partner in this architecture; it is structurally indispensable. Jakarta’s “free and active” foreign policy tradition allows it to deepen operational relationships with Washington in precisely the domains that matter for crisis operations without incurring the political costs of formal alliance membership.
In the West Philippine Sea, the intersection of Marine special operations expertise, maritime autonomous systems, and Philippine archipelagic geography is generating a new model of deterrence. MARTAC unmanned surface vessels are at the center of this effort. The first tranche for Manila included MANTAS T-12 USVs and Devil Ray T-38 platforms, now operational with the Philippine Navy and deployed for frontline use in Palawan. The T-12 can operate in a semi-submersible “gator mode” to reduce radar and visual signatures; the T-38 carries up to roughly 4,000 pounds of payload at speeds exceeding 70 knots, readily reconfigured for ISR, anti-mining, anti-surface warfare, or logistics support.
Marine Raiders are working alongside the Armed Forces of the Philippines to operationalize these systems within an emerging SOF-enabled porcupine defense construct at sea. T-12s operating singly or in swarms patrol reef complexes, straits, and approaches to key bases, feeding a fused maritime domain awareness picture shared among Philippine Navy, Coast Guard, and Marine units and, where politically acceptable, with US and allied forces. The Philippines is becoming a test case for a new alliance approach to defense transformation: one in which US SOF and Marines help partners leap directly into the era of distributed, autonomous, and attritable systems.
The security web is not purely military. Nowhere is that more visible than in the evolving US–Philippines–Japan collaboration around the Luzon Economic Corridor and the Pax Silica initiative.
In April 2026, the Philippines became the 13th member of Pax Silica, a US-led framework established in December 2025 to build secure supply chains for semiconductors, AI technology, and critical minerals among trusted allies. The accession triggered the announcement of a 4,000-acre industrial hub in New Clark City designated as the first “Golden Node” in the Pax Silica network. Trade policy has been folded directly into the deterrence web; for practitioners who have spent decades watching economic and security policy talk past each other in Washington, this integration represents a meaningful structural shift.
Australia’s Camel Train project illuminates how a middle power can leverage its existing civilian ecosystem to become a critical node in the kill web’s logistics and ISR layers. The problem is operationally straightforward: Australia has only a handful of permanently manned air bases, all of which would be priority targets in a high-intensity conflict. Camel Train addresses this by turning general aviation itself into a defense asset, a prototype Jabiru 400 retrofitted with a wholly Australian autonomous avionics stack moved from conception to flight testing within two years.
The foundational design decision is that the avionics stack is aircraft-agnostic: the same package can be pulled and installed in a Cessna 152, a King Air, or a Gipps Aero GA8. A “boring old logistics drone” hauling jerry cans can, with a small optical sensor package, become a persistent ISR collector over the same routes. Australia has approximately 30,000 licensed drone operators certified under CASA standards; in a mobilization phase, this represents a potential operational reserve that has never existed before in this form.
Taken together, Guam’s three webs, the amphibious co-invention triangle, the Malacca deterrence architecture, the Philippine porcupine, Luzon’s industrial pivot, and Australia’s Camel Train describe a strategic shift that is more than the sum of its parts.
The Cold War Indo-Pacific was organized around an American hub-and-spoke system. Washington dealt bilaterally with allies. Reassurance flowed outward from a central American node. Regional security rested on a small number of heavily defended bases and carrier strike groups. That architecture no longer suits the era we are entering.
The emerging order operates on different principles. Distribution replaces concentration, not just operationally but strategically. Security partners like Australia, Japan, the Philippines, and Indonesia are no longer simply consumers of American reassurance. They are producers of regional stability, and the architecture explicitly depends on their capacity to act with initiative and at times without a visible American presence. Resilience replaces the pursuit of invulnerability. Co-invention replaces one-way transfer.
While these partners and allies are stepping up, make no mistake: the US remains indispensable. Only Washington can underwrite the munitions stockpiles, space architectures, large-platform fleets, and global industrial alliances that a theater-wide kill web requires.
But the character of American leadership is changing. Rather than acting as the single central hub through which all alliance relationships run, the US is becoming the largest node in a multi-node web, a first among partners whose strength lies not only in what it can do alone but in what it enables others to do with it, and at times without it visibly present.
For Australia, this is simultaneously an opportunity and a serious demand. Canberra must invest in the niche capabilities — autonomy, sensing, amphibious maneuver, resilient dispersed logistics — where it can genuinely lead rather than merely participate. It must also accept that some of the most strategically significant work it will do with regional partners, particularly Indonesia, will occur outside the visible embrace of American power, even as it draws deeply on American concepts and technologies.
The 1999 East Timor intervention is instructive here. Australia could lead that operation with international legitimacy precisely because it assembled a coalition that included ASEAN member states willing to follow an Australian-flagged lead who would not have followed a US-flagged one. That logic is more relevant than ever. The security web Australia is helping to build will be most effective not when it is visibly American-sponsored, but when Australia can stand in it credibly on its own terms.
That is the price and the privilege of operating as a co-architect of the security web rather than a spoke in someone else’s wheel.
Note: I discuss in greater detail the evolving Pacific defense architecture in my recent book
. I wrote this article while I was in Australia in my function as a Research Fellow with the Sir Richard Williams Foundation, Canberra.
_source.movement_title: 印太新防御架构：分布式网络重塑美澳印菲安全合作
_source.movement_abstract: 印太地区正形成一种全新的防御架构，取代了冷战时期以双边条约和集中前出基地为特征的模式。该架构由美国、澳大利亚、菲律宾、印度尼西亚等国共同构建，核心在于分布式、高韧性和协同创新，旨在应对冲突常态化的混沌环境。文章详细阐述了支撑这一架构的三大网络：安全网通过分散部署提升生存能力；威慑网利用联盟复杂性和不确定性增加对手行动成本；杀伤网则强调网络整体感知与决策速度优于单一资产。具体案例包括关岛从单一枢纽向分布式节点转型、美澳印三国两栖合作、马六甲海峡的联合监控与威慑、菲律宾群岛的“刺猬”防御体系以及澳大利亚利用通用航空构建后勤与情报网络。这种新模式标志着美国角色从单一中心枢纽转变为多节点网络中的首要伙伴，强调区域盟友的主动性与自主行动能力，实现了安全与供应链的深度整合。
_source.title: The new Indo-Pacific security architecture: From hub-and-spoke to allied security web - Breaking Defense
_source.trans_cont:
一种新的防御架构正在印太地区逐渐成形。它与冷战时期以双边条约和集中前哨基地为特征的格局几乎没有相似之处，这种格局主导该地区半个世纪。

实际上正在浮现的是一个联盟安全网络：分布式的、具有韧性的、共同构建的，其前提是将混乱视为21世纪冲突的常态，而非威慑失败需要纠正的状况。

美国和澳大利亚是这一架构中的核心节点，但并非孤军奋战。关岛正转型为一个网络枢纽；美澳印尼之间正在形成三边两栖伙伴关系；马六甲海峡正在发展一体化的海上威慑架构；菲律宾群岛正在构建“豪猪式”防御体系；通过吕宋经济走廊对菲律宾供应链进行工业重塑，这些都不是孤立的实验。它们是新运作方式的连接组织，这种运作方式不通过防止干扰来获取优势，而是通过比对手更好地承受干扰，并在首次打击后继续生成战斗力来获取优势。

要理解这一新网络如何协同运作，我们首先需要单独审视每个节点。

数十年来，关岛一直是战略三角形的一个顶点。人们通常认为，这是一个大型、高度防御的基地，美国可以在危机中从中投射力量。然而，这一设想已不再适用。中国中程精确打击能力的成熟，使集中基础设施变成了操作人员所说的“活靶子”。在对等冲突的初始阶段，预测性、固定的集中兵力无法生存。

正是基于这一认识，关岛及其周边马里亚纳群岛的概念发生了根本性的变化，被重新设计为分布式网络中的锚点节点，围绕三个相互关联的架构：安全网络、威慑网络和杀伤网络。每个架构分别应对作战问题的不同层面——生存能力、信号传递和杀伤力，但它们只有作为相互强化的整体才具有战略意义。

After decades of covert operations, the CIA director has given the Cubans an overt ultimatum for change on the island.
On May 14, an Air Force Boeing C-40B Clipper jet with “United States of America” emblazoned on its fuselage touched down at José Martí International Airport in Havana. It carried a high-level delegation of CIA officials, headed by CIA Director John Ratcliffe. Ratcliffe and his team soon sat down with the leadership of Cuba’s intelligence community, as well as Raúl Guillermo Rodriguez Castro—the grandson of Raúl Castro, who has been conducting back-channel talks with Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s office since February.
This was hardly a clandestine meeting. The CIA quickly posted photos of the session on X. Both the Cubans and the CIA have issued statements. The discussions, according to the Cuban government, took place “in the context of complex bilateral relations...to contribute to a political dialogue between both nations.” CIA officials stated that Ratcliffe’s mission was “to personally deliver President Donald Trump’s message that the United States is prepared to seriously engage on economic and security issues, but only if Cuba makes fundamental changes.”
The CIA has a long record of covert regime-change efforts in Cuba: the Bay of Pigs, Operation Mongoose, the
assassination plots among them. But this overt CIA mission may well become a capstone to that infamous Cold War history. Ratcliffe’s trip marks a turning point in the protracted, punitive US efforts to force the Cuban leadership to capitulate to Washington’s demands for economic and political regime change.
Indeed, the official message Ratcliffe carried to Havana was a “do or die” ultimatum. He reportedly reminded the Cubans of what had happened in Venezuela—US Special Forces quickly killed 32 members of Cuba’s security team and injured dozens more—when President Maduro did not take Trump’s threats seriously. As the CIA director warned the Cubans, the window for diplomatic dialogue will soon close unless they act on US demands for change; and President Trump plans to “enforce his red lines” if negotiations do not produce the results he desires.
“Submission Diplomacy”
The CIA mission to Havana comes only one day after Cuba’s minister of energy, Vicente de la O Levy, publicly conceded that the country has, essentially, run out of gas. “We have absolutely no fuel oil, and absolutely no diesel,” Cuban Minister of Energy Vicente de la O Levy announced on state television last week. “We have no reserves.”
Denying the Cuban people gas and electricity, along with the basic economic functions they enable, has been the concerted goal of Trump’s policy of extreme energy deprivation. Since US Special Forces attacked Caracas on January 3, the administration has methodically used threats and coercion to shut down Cuban access to alternative sources of petroleum—with the intent of starving the Cuban people, generating popular unrest, and forcing the Cuban leadership to capitulate. “The strategy of previous negotiations with Cuba has been to offer Havana carrots,” American University
said in an interview. “Trump’s strategy is to beat the Cubans with a stick until they cry uncle.”
As the oil blockade takes a devastating toll on the Cuban people, the Trump administration has turned up the heat of economic warfare on Cuba, targeting foreign investment on the island. On May 1, Trump signed a new executive order broadening restrictions on commercial interactions with Cuban entities and applying “secondary sanctions” to foreign businesses that engage with “blocked” Cuban agencies and officials. On May 7, Secretary of State Marco Rubio designated the Cuban military corporation GAESA, which administers much of the Cuban economy, as a blocked entity along with the Cuban mining company MOA Nickel SA.
MOA was established as part of a joint venture with the Canadian mining giant Sherritt International, one of the largest foreign investors on the island, which for decades has managed Cuba’s nickel and cobalt mining operations. The new secondary sanctions immediately forced Sherritt to announce that it would close its mining operations on the island—and request the Cuban government buy out its stake for $277 million. Two international shipping companies, which have contracts through GAESA to transport goods and supplies from China, Europe, and the Middle East to Cuba, this week also announced they would have to suspend operations because of the new sanctions. Analysts believe that the Spanish hotelier interests on the island, Melia and Iberostar, will soon terminate their operations as well.
For weeks, Secretary of State Marco Rubio has demanded that Cuba open its doors to much needed investment from abroad to stimulate economic development. But US policy is now explicitly designed to push major investors off the island and scare others from coming—further depressing the Cuban economy while clearing a path for US corporate interests to dominate Cuba’s economic future once Trump’s “takeover” is complete.
Setting the Stage for a US Attack
To advance that goal, the Trump administration has also stepped up its threat of military intervention against the island. Earlier this month,
that “US military intelligence-gathering flights are surging off the coast of Cuba,” and that “the US Navy and Air Force have conducted at least 25 such flights using manned aircraft and drones” in recent weeks. During a recent visit to Florida, President Trump mused that he might soon position the USS
aircraft carrier 100 yards off the coast of Havana. In his gunboat-diplomacy fantasy, the president predicted that the Cuban leadership would be scared into submission and simply surrender: “‘Thank you very much,’ they would say. ‘We give up.’“
There is little doubt that the US military is preparing for some form of aggression, should the president decide that Cuba’s leadership has not sufficiently capitulated to his imperial demands. Just yesterday, sources leaked classified information on Cuba’s limited supply of drones, and how they might be deployed in a conflagration with the United States. The intelligence,
, “could become a pretext for US military action.” The very end of the article noted the reality: “US officials don’t believe Cuba is an imminent threat, or actively planning to attack American interests.” But the damage has been done. Headlines such as “Intelligence report suggests drone attacks planned by Cuba,” and “Cuba stockpiles drones and creates list of American targets,” are now circulating around the globe.
Moreover, this week the Trump administration is planning to use Cuban Independence Day to further set the stage for an attack. Only hours after CIA Director Ratcliffe left Havana, Department of Justice sources let it be known that Raúl Castro will be indicted on May 20 for his role as defense minister in the February 24, 1996, shootdown of two Cessna planes that had, once again, penetrated Cuban airspace.
The destruction of the planes, which took the lives of four young Cuban American pilots, was unwarranted and wrong; the pilots of the Cuban MiGs that fired heat-seeking missiles at the Cessnas followed none of the international protocols for warning, intercepting, and escorting unarmed civilian aircraft. But the declassified historical record (revealed in the book
) shows that the shootdown was not unprovoked. It followed more than a year of overtly provocative penetrations of Cuba’s airspace by the exile group Brothers to the Rescue—led by a Bay of Pigs veteran, Jose Basulto, who tried to assassinate Fidel Castro in the early 1960s—dropping insurrectionist leaflets over the Cuban countryside and Havana. “It was so humiliating,” Fidel Castro would later tell
magazine. “The US would not have tolerated it if Washington’s airspace had been violated by small airplanes.”
Cuba’s leadership, including Fidel, repeatedly warned Washington that the overflights constituted a threat to its territorial security that no nation could tolerate; they used every channel of communication to press the Clinton administration to halt the flights. Both White House and State Department officials repeatedly pushed the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to ground Basulto—orders the FAA resisted for bureaucratic reasons. “State is increasingly concerned about Cuban reactions to these flagrant violations. They are also asking from the FAA what is this agency doing to prevent/deter these actions by Brothers to the Rescue,” a FAA e-mail recorded only a month before the fatal flight. “Worst case scenario is that one of these days the Cubans will shoot down one of these planes and the FAA better have all its ducks in a row.”
For the Trump administration, indicting the last surviving leader of the Cuban revolution on trumped-up charges makes perfect political, psychological, and military sense. Pegged to Cuba’s Independence Day, the indictment of Raúl Castro will be a public relations boon as well as a political bone to the hard-line anti-Castro community in Miami that has for years demanded that he be prosecuted for authorizing shooting down those planes. Since the administration used the same blueprint of an indictment to justify its raid on Caracas to seize Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, an indictment of Castro significantly escalates the psychological warfare directed at the Cuban leadership to force their capitulation. And creating the fig leaf of legal proceedings will enable Trump to bypass the War Powers Act, as he did in Venezuela, by claiming to Congress that military operations in Havana are for law enforcement purposes, rather than an act of warfare to overthrow the Cuban government.
To their credit, Democrats in Congress, and a few Republicans, have tried to preempt Trump’s quest to conquer Cuba militarily.

In a May 12 letter to Secretary of Defense Hegseth and Secretary of State Rubio, 33 members of Congress called on the administration to “lift the coercive economic measures—including the fuel blockade and related sanctions—that are contributing to the humanitarian crisis in Cuba,” and “abandon reported plans for US military action against Cuba.” According to the signatories, “the United States must not respond to a crisis it is creating with policies that deepen suffering, undermine the rule of law, and repeat the gravest failures of its past.”
But it is clear that Congress has neither the votes nor the power to stop Trump’s regime-change efforts in Cuba.
That leaves the Cuban government to defend itself, even as the country has reached a tipping point of deprivation and frustration. As a sense of imminent attack pervades Cuba, this past weekend authorities began distributing a nine-page civil defense booklet titled “Family Guide for Protection Against Military Aggression: Protect, Resist, Survive, and Overcome” to prepare the citizenry for US military aggression. Among its instructions were how to seek shelter during an aerial attack, first-aid training, and the concept of guerrilla-style resistance if US troops occupy the island. “We are preparing to defend ourselves,” Cuba’s ambassador to Washington, Lianys Torres Rivera, said in an interview with

_source.movement_title: 美国中央情报局向古巴发出最后通牒并升级经济制裁与军事威胁
_source.movement_abstract: 2026年5月14日，美国中央情报局局长约翰·拉特克利夫率高级代表团抵达古巴哈瓦那，公开向古巴领导层传达美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的最后通牒，要求古巴在政治和经济领域进行根本性变革，否则将面临严重后果。此次访问标志着美国对古巴政策由隐蔽行动转向公开施压。特朗普政府已签署行政令扩大对古巴实体的商业限制，并对古巴矿业公司MOA Nickel SA及军事企业GAESA实施二级制裁，迫使加拿大矿业巨头谢里特国际关闭在古巴的镍钴矿运营并撤资2.77亿美元。同时，美国特种部队近期在委内瑞拉的行动被用作对古巴的威慑案例。美国海军和空军近期在古巴沿海增加了至少25次情报收集飞行，并计划部署航空母舰至哈瓦那海岸附近。司法部门于5月20日对古巴前领导人劳尔·卡斯特罗提出起诉，指控其参与1996年击落两架塞斯纳飞机事件。古巴政府已分发民防手册指导民众应对可能的军事侵略，并警告美国正在制造人道主义危机。美国国会部分议员试图阻止军事行动但未获通过。
_source.title: The CIA Goes to Cuba
_source.trans_cont:
经过数十年的秘密行动，中情局局长向古巴人发出了一个公开的最后通牒，要求他们在岛上进行变革。5月14日，一架印有“美利坚合众国”字样的空军波音C-40B“剪刀手”喷气式飞机降落在哈瓦那何塞·马蒂国际机场。这架飞机载有一支由中情局高级官员组成的代表团，由中情局局长约翰·拉特克利夫率领。拉特克利夫及其团队很快与古巴情报部门的领导人会面，以及拉乌尔·古斯塔沃·罗德里格斯·卡斯特罗——拉乌尔·卡斯特罗的孙子，自2月起一直在与国务卿马可·鲁比奥办公室进行秘密谈判。

这显然不是一次秘密会面。中情局迅速在X平台上发布了会议照片。古巴和中情局都发表了声明。据古巴政府称，这些讨论“是在复杂双边关系的背景下进行的……以促进两国之间的政治对话。”中情局官员表示，拉特克利夫的任务是“亲自传达唐纳德·特朗普总统的信息，即美国准备在经济和安全问题上认真进行对话，但前提是古巴做出根本性改变。”

中情局在古巴有长期的秘密政权更迭行动记录：猪湾事件、行动 mongoose，以及其中的暗杀计划。但这次公开的中情局行动可能会成为这一臭名昭著的冷战历史的顶点。拉特克利夫的访问标志着美国长期、惩罚性的努力的一个转折点，旨在迫使古巴领导层屈服于华盛顿对经济和政治政权更迭的要求。

事实上，拉特克利夫带到哈瓦那的官方信息是一个“要么接受要么灭亡”的最后通牒。据报道，他提醒古巴人，当马杜罗总统不认真对待特朗普的威胁时，美国特种部队迅速杀死了32名古巴安全部队成员，并造成数十人受伤。正如中情局局长警告古巴人，如果他们不回应美国对变革的要求，外交对话的窗口将很快关闭；而特朗普计划如果谈判未能达到他的期望，将“执行他的红线”。

“屈服外交”

中情局前往哈瓦那的行动仅在古巴能源部长维森特·德·拉·奥·利维公开承认该国基本上已经用完了燃料的第二天发生。古巴能源部长维森特·德·拉·奥·利维上周在国家电视台宣布：“我们完全没有燃油油，完全没有柴油。”“我们没有任何储备。”

剥夺古巴人民的燃料和电力，以及这些基本经济功能所支持的其他服务，一直是特朗普极端能源剥夺政策的明确目标。自1月3日美国特种部队袭击加拉加斯以来，该政府系统性地使用威胁和胁迫手段，切断古巴获得替代石油来源的途径，意图使古巴人民挨饿，引发民众骚乱，并迫使古巴领导层屈服。美国大学在一次采访中表示：“以往与古巴的谈判策略是向哈瓦那提供胡萝卜。”“特朗普的策略是用大棒敲打古巴人，直到他们投降。”

随着石油封锁对古巴人民造成毁灭性影响，特朗普政府加大了对古巴的经济战争力度，针对岛上的外国投资。5月1日，特朗普签署了一项新的行政命令，扩大了对与古巴实体进行商业互动的限制，并对与“被封锁”古巴机构和官员进行交易的外国企业施加“次级制裁”。5月7日，国务卿马可·鲁比奥将古巴军方公司GAESA——管理古巴大部分经济的公司——以及古巴矿业公司MOA镍公司列为被封锁实体。

MOA是与加拿大矿业巨头谢尔里特国际公司（岛上最大的外国投资者之一）联合成立的，该公司几十年来一直管理古巴的镍和钴矿开采业务。新的次级制裁立即迫使谢尔里特宣布将关闭其在岛上的采矿业务，并要求古巴政府以2.77亿美元的价格收购其股份。两家国际航运公司，它们通过GAESA与中国的货物和供应、欧洲和中东的货物运输合同，本周也宣布由于新制裁不得不暂停运营。分析人士认为，岛上的西班牙酒店业者梅利亚和伊贝罗星也将很快终止其业务。

数周以来，国务卿马可·鲁比奥一直要求古巴向国外开放大门，以吸引急需的投资来刺激经济发展。但美国政策现在明确旨在将主要投资者赶出该岛，并吓退其他人，进一步压低古巴经济，同时为特朗普“接管”完成后美国企业利益主导古巴经济未来铺平道路。

为美国进攻铺路

为了推进这一目标，特朗普政府还加大了对岛屿军事干预的威胁。本月早些时候，美国政府表示，“美国军事情报收集飞行在古巴海岸附近激增”，并称“美国海军和空军最近几周至少进行了25次此类飞行，使用有人驾驶飞机和无人机。”在最近一次佛罗里达州的访问中，特朗普表示他可能很快将“企业号”航空母舰部署在哈瓦那海岸外100码处。在总统的“军舰外交”幻想中，他预测古巴领导层将因恐惧而屈服并投降：“‘谢谢，’他们会说，‘我们投降了。’”

毫无疑问，美国军队正在为可能的侵略做准备，如果总统认为古巴领导层没有充分屈服于他的帝国要求。就在昨天，有消息泄露了关于古巴有限无人机供应的机密信息，以及这些无人机可能在与美国的冲突中如何部署。情报显示，“这可能成为美国军事行动的借口。”文章末尾指出现实：“美国官员不相信古巴是即刻威胁，或正在策划攻击美国利益。”但损害已经造成。诸如“情报报告表明古巴计划进行无人机攻击”和“古巴囤积无人机并创建美国目标清单”等标题现在正在全球传播。

此外，本周特朗普政府计划利用古巴独立日进一步为攻击铺路。在中情局局长拉特克利夫离开哈瓦那仅数小时后，司法部消息人士透露，拉乌尔·卡斯特罗将于5月20日因他在1996年2月24日击落两架侵入古巴领空的塞斯纳飞机时担任国防部长的角色被起诉。这架飞机摧毁了四名年轻的古巴裔美国飞行员的生命，这一行为是不正当且错误的；击落塞斯纳飞机的古巴米格飞行员没有遵循国际协议，对无人驾驶民用飞机进行警告、拦截和护航。但解密的历史记录（在书中揭示）显示，这次击落并非毫无预谋。它是在由流亡组织“兄弟救援”——由猪湾事件老兵何塞·巴斯尔托领导，该组织曾在20世纪60年代初试图暗杀菲德尔·卡斯特罗——在古巴乡村和哈瓦那上空散发起义传单超过一年后发生的。菲德尔·卡斯特罗后来告诉《时代》杂志：“这太令人羞辱了。”“如果华盛顿领空被小型飞机侵犯，美国不会容忍这种行为。”

古巴领导层，包括菲德尔，反复警告华盛顿，这些飞行构成了对其领土安全的威胁，任何国家都无法容忍；他们通过所有沟通渠道敦促克林顿政府停止这些飞行。白宫和国务院官员反复敦促联邦航空管理局（FAA）将巴斯尔托停飞，但FAA因官僚原因拒绝了这些命令。一封仅在致命飞行前一个月记录的FAA电子邮件显示：“国务院日益关注这些明显违规行为引发的古巴反应。他们还询问FAA采取了哪些措施来防止或阻止兄弟救援组织的行为。”“最坏的情况是，某一天古巴人会击落这些飞机，而FAA必须确保一切都准备就绪。”

对特朗普政府来说，以捏造的指控起诉古巴革命最后的幸存领导人，从政治、心理和军事角度来看都是完美的。将拉乌尔·卡斯特罗的起诉与古巴独立日挂钩，将是一次公关胜利，也是给迈阿密强硬反卡斯特罗社区的一块政治骨头，该社区多年来一直要求起诉他授权击落这些飞机。由于政府使用了相同的起诉蓝图来为袭击加拉加斯、夺取委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的行动辩护，对卡斯特罗的起诉显著加剧了针对古巴领导层的心理战，以迫使他们屈服。同时，制造法律程序的借口将使特朗普能够绕过战争权力法案，正如他在委内瑞拉所做的那样，声称在哈瓦那的军事行动是执法行为，而不是推翻古巴政府的战争行动。

值得肯定的是，国会中的民主党人和少数共和党人试图阻止特朗普军事征服古巴的企图。由参议员蒂姆·凯因（D-VA）、亚当·施里夫（D-CA）和鲁本·加莱戈（D-AZ）发起的法案，旨在“指示从古巴共和国境内或针对古巴共和国的未经国会授权的军事行动中撤出美国武装部队”，于4月28日以51比47的投票结果失败。5月12日，33名国会议员致函国防部长赫格塞特和国务卿鲁比奥，呼吁政府“解除导致古巴人道主义危机的强制性经济措施——包括燃料封锁和相关制裁”，并“放弃据报道计划对古巴采取军事行动的计划。”据签署人称，“美国不应以加深痛苦、破坏法治并重复其过去最严重失败的政策来回应它所制造的危机。”

但很明显，国会既没有足够的票数也没有足够的权力阻止特朗普在古巴的政权更迭努力。

这使得古巴政府不得不在国家达到剥夺和沮丧的临界点时进行自我防卫。随着一种即将遭到攻击的紧迫感笼罩古巴，本周的周末，当局开始向民众分发一本九页的公民防御手册，标题为《家庭军事侵略防护指南：保护、抵抗、生存、克服》，以准备应对美国的军事侵略。手册中的指示包括如何在空袭中寻求庇护、急救培训，以及如果美国军队占领岛屿时进行游击式抵抗的概念。“我们正在准备自卫，”古巴驻华盛顿大使利亚尼斯·托雷斯·里韦拉在上周的一次采访中说。“我们不希望古巴人死在古巴，”她补充道，也不希望“任何美国士兵。”

彼得·科恩布鲁赫是长期为《纽约时报》撰写关于古巴的贡献者，与威廉·M·利奥格兰德合著了《美国与古巴：从冷战到冷和平》。科恩布鲁赫也是《美国与古巴：从冷战到冷和平》的作者。每一场战争都代表着想象力的巨大失败，但这场战争带有特朗普的标志性特征，应该被视为反对的战争。《纽约时报》是最早报道中情局在1953年推翻伊朗民主选举的首相穆罕默德·摩萨台的行动的出版物。以色列和美国已对波斯湾和全球石油和天然气供应造成不稳定，至少在可预见的未来。工党领导层的自由坠落也与其对所依赖的基层缺乏尊重有关。数百万伊朗人如何被政权更迭幻想所吸引的故事。在最近的一次峰会上，西班牙首相召集了左翼领导人并警告说，一个新的威权世界秩序正在到来。

_source.evidence: 文章主要描述了美国（CIA、特朗普政府）针对古巴的一系列敌对行动，包括发出最后通牒、实施经济制裁、进行军事威胁、散布虚假情报（无人机攻击借口）以及计划起诉古巴领导人等。虽然文章涉及了美国的政策（制裁令）和军事动向（侦察飞行），但其核心内容聚焦于美国对古巴（作为中国的盟友或相关方）发起的具体认知域和现实域对抗行动，旨在制造舆论压力、进行心理战和政权更迭。根据标签定义，[涉我事件] 涉及中国大陆作为被攻击对象或相关方的敌情事件。虽然直接对象是古巴，但此类针对中国周边或盟友的敌对行动，在认知域分类中通常被视为影响中国地缘安全环境的‘涉我’相关敌情（即针对我方阵营的敌对行动）。然而，严格审视标签定义，[涉我事件] 明确指‘涉及中国大陆（作为被攻击对象或相关方...）’。如果严格限定‘中国大陆’，则此事件针对古巴，可能不完全符合。但考虑到认知域分类的宏观视角，针对中国盟友的敌对行动往往被归类为广义的涉我敌情。不过，若严格扣字眼，此事件针对古巴，非中国大陆。再看[行动动向]：‘相关领域的具体作战、对抗等行动及其动向（如具体的舆论攻击行动）’。文章详细描述了美国对古巴的舆论攻击、心理战、制裁行动，这完全符合[行动动向]的定义。对比之下，[涉我事件] 更强调‘中国大陆’本身。因此，[行动动向] 更为准确，因为它涵盖了针对第三国（古巴）的具体对抗行动，且文章重点在于描述这些行动的过程和意图。

TAIPEI (Taiwan News) — Taiwan’s representative to Finland, Freddy Lim (林昶佐), spoke at the
World Village Festival
in Helsinki on Sunday about the country’s democratic transition and its experience countering Chinese cognitive warfare.
Lim delivered the speech  “From Suppression to Freedom: The Fight Against Digital Control.” The festival, organized annually by an NGO alliance since 1995, brings together civil society groups, artists, and activists from around the world, per
CNA
.
Lim opened his presentation with a video of his band, Chthonic, performing at Kaohsiung’s Megaport Festival. After the video ended, he stepped on stage in a suit and joked that he would keep his speech respectable and leave his shirt on.
He then outlined Taiwan’s path from authoritarianism to democracy, including the 38-year martial law period when publications were censored, Taiwanese songs were tightly controlled, and artists considered subversive risked imprisonment, according to CNA.
Freddy Lim speaks at World Village Festival. (CNA photo)
Lim said authoritarian governments suppress art because it can empower people. He added that artists played an important role in Taiwan’s democratic transition during the 1990s. He said Taiwan’s democracy ranks among the strongest in Asia, noting that Taiwan became the first country in Asia to legalize same-sex marriage in 2019.
He then addressed the newer threat of cognitive warfare. Lim said China has industrialized information manipulation by spreading narratives of “democratic failure” through the internet and media in an effort to undermine Taiwanese society.
Lim also said China has expanded disinformation campaigns globally using large language models targeting democratic societies, including the Philippines, India, Lithuania, and the Czech Republic.
Later in the event, Lim shared the stage with a Myanmar artist and video creator living in exile. To avoid identification, the artist appeared wearing makeup and a half-face mask while describing conditions in Myanmar following the military coup, per CNA.
The artist said murals were defaced within days of the junta takeover and that six poets were killed during the first two years after the coup. He also alleged that China exported surveillance technology to assist the military government in tracking dissent. “This is not just cutting off communications; it’s eliminating witnesses,” the artist said.
The artist then invited Lim and audience members to raise the three-finger salute originating from “The Hunger Games,” which has become a symbol of pro-democracy movements in Southeast Asia.
Lim said festival organizers initially offered him the choice between giving a solo speech or appearing with the Myanmar artist, and he immediately chose the latter. He said Myanmar’s situation has long concerned the international human rights community and that he empathized deeply with the artist’s experiences.
“It’s better to let the victims on the front lines speak than for me to speak myself,” Lim said. He added that the event reflected a broader global trend. “We are witnessing the erosion of democratic values around the world,” he said.
Last week, Lim also gave interviews to Finnish media outlets, including Iltalehti and Maailman Kuvalehti.
Iltalehti
focused on Taiwan’s situation during a Trump-Xi summit in Beijing, while
Maailman Kuvalehti
discussed art, disinformation, and democratic resilience.
_source.movement_title: 台湾驻芬兰代表林昶佐出席赫尔辛基世界村论坛阐述民主转型与反认知战经验
_source.movement_abstract: 【台湾中央社报道】台湾驻芬兰代表林昶佐于2026年6月29日在芬兰赫尔辛基出席世界村论坛，发表题为“从压制到自由：对抗数字控制”的演讲。林昶佐回顾台湾从威权统治向民主转型历程，指出戒严时期出版物审查、歌曲管控及艺术家面临监禁风险，强调艺术家在1990年代台湾民主化进程中的关键作用。林昶佐称台湾民主制度为亚洲最强之一，并于2019年成为亚洲首个合法化同性婚姻的国家。针对认知战威胁，林昶佐指出中国通过互联网和媒体传播“民主失败”叙事，利用大型语言模型在菲律宾、印度、立陶宛、捷克等国扩大虚假信息活动。活动期间，林昶佐与一名流亡缅甸艺术家同台，该艺术家描述缅甸军政府接管后壁画被毁、六名诗人在政变后两年内遇害，并指控中国向军政府出口监控技术以追踪异议人士。林昶佐表示支持前线受害者发声，强调全球民主价值正面临侵蚀。林昶佐随后接受芬兰媒体《晚间新闻》和《世界画报》采访，分别讨论台湾局势及艺术、虚假信息与民主韧性议题。
_source.title: Taiwan envoy Freddy Lim addresses China's digital misinformation
_source.trans_cont:
台北（台湾新闻）——台湾驻芬兰代表林昶佐（Freddy Lim）于周日在赫尔辛基的世界村节上发表演讲，谈论了台湾的民主转型及其应对中国认知战的经验。演讲题目为《从压制到自由：对抗数字控制的斗争》。该节日自1995年起由一个非政府组织联盟每年举办，汇聚了来自世界各地的民间团体、艺术家和活动人士，据《中央通讯社》报道。

林昶佐的演讲以他乐队Chthonic在高雄的Megaport音乐节上的表演视频开场。视频结束后，他身着西装登台，并开玩笑说他会保持演讲的庄重，不脱衣服。随后，他概述了台湾从威权体制向民主体制转变的历程，包括长达38年的戒严时期，当时媒体被审查、台湾歌曲受到严格管控，而被视为颠覆性的艺术家面临监禁的风险，据《中央通讯社》报道。

林昶佐在世界村节上发表演讲。（《中央通讯社》照片）

林昶佐表示，威权政府压制艺术，因为艺术能够赋予人们力量。他补充说，在1990年代，艺术家在台湾的民主转型中发挥了重要作用。他表示，台湾的民主制度在亚洲排名靠前，并指出台湾于2019年成为亚洲首个合法化同性婚姻的国家。

随后，他谈及新的认知战威胁。林昶佐表示，中国通过互联网和媒体传播“民主失败”的叙事，以削弱台湾社会。他还指出，中国利用大型语言模型在全球范围内扩大虚假信息活动，目标包括菲律宾、印度、立陶宛和捷克共和国等民主国家。

在活动的后半段，林昶佐与一位流亡的缅甸艺术家和视频创作者同台分享。为了避免被识别，这位艺术家戴着妆容和半张脸的面具，描述了缅甸军政府接管后的状况，据《中央通讯社》报道。

这位艺术家表示，军政府接管后几天内，壁画就被破坏，且在政变后的前两年内有六位诗人被杀害。他还指控中国向军政府出口监控技术，协助追踪异见人士。“这不仅仅是切断通讯，而是消灭见证者。”艺术家说道。

随后，这位艺术家邀请林昶佐和观众一起举起源自《饥饿游戏》的三指敬礼，这一手势已成为东南亚民主运动的象征。

林昶佐表示，活动组织者最初给了他一个选择：单独演讲或与缅甸艺术家同台，他立刻选择了后者。他表示，缅甸的情况长期以来一直引起国际人权组织的关注，他对这位艺术家的经历深表同情。

“让前线的受害者说话比我自己说话更好。”林昶佐说。他还补充说，这一事件反映了更广泛的全球趋势。“我们正在目睹全球民主价值观的侵蚀。”他说。

上周，林昶佐还接受了芬兰媒体的采访，包括《赫尔辛基晚报》和《世界图片》。《赫尔辛基晚报》聚焦于台湾在特朗普与习近平北京峰会期间的局势，而《世界图片》则讨论了艺术、虚假信息和民主韧性。

(中央社記者
赫爾辛基17日專電)駐芬蘭代表林昶佐17日受邀在赫爾辛基逾30年歷史的世界村嘉年華發表演說,談台灣從威權走向民主,及對抗中國認知戰的經驗,並與緬甸流亡藝術家、影像創作者May共同呼籲對抗威權。
世界村嘉年華(World Village Festival)由非政府組織聯盟Fingo主辦,自1995年創辦以來,每年吸引來自世界各地的公民社會團體、藝術家與社運人士齊聚赫爾辛基(Helsinki),是芬蘭規模最大、最具指標性的國際公民社會年度活動。
林昶佐在Bio Rex講台以英語發表演說,題目為「從迫害邁向自由,對抗數位控制之戰」(From Suppression to Freedom: The Fight Against Digital Control)。
他播放閃靈去年在高雄大港開唱的演出影片,台上的他和團員赤膊吶喊,萬人沸騰。影片結束,西裝革履的他走上前說:「沒錯,那是我。但別期待我在這裡也脫衣服耍死腔。」輕鬆開場。
隨即帶出台灣從威權走向民主的歷史脈絡:長達38年的戒嚴時期,出版物須經政府審查,以台語演唱的歌曲受到嚴格限制,被認定具顛覆性的藝術家隨時面臨牢獄之災。
他指出,威權政府壓制藝術,因為藝術承載訊息、賦予人民力量。台灣歷經數十年抗爭,藝術家在其中扮演關鍵角色,最終在1990年代完成民主轉型,如今台灣民主在亞洲名列前茅,2019年更成為亞洲首個同婚合法化的國家。
他話鋒一轉,直指眼前的威脅不再只是坦克與槍砲,而是更難察覺的認知戰。
他說,中國已將資訊操控工業化,透過網路與媒體不斷散布「民主運作失靈」的簡單敘事,悄悄從內部侵蝕台灣社會。2022年多家超商及路邊廣告看板螢幕遭駭,強迫顯示政治宣傳標語,正是這場數位滲透的縮影。他並點名,中國更已藉助大型語言模型,將假訊息攻勢擴大至全球規模,從菲律賓、印度到立陶宛、捷克,各地民主社會都是目標。
林昶佐在這場演說與緬甸流亡藝術家、影像創作者May(化名)同台,為避免身分外洩,May以化妝裝半臉頭盔登台,說明政變後緬甸的景況:壁畫數日內遭塗掉,6名詩人在頭兩年遇害,中國輸出監控技術協助軍政府追蹤異見。「這不只是切斷通訊,而是消滅見證者。」
May並邀請林昶佐與台下觀眾一同舉起3根手指。這個源自電影「飢餓遊戲」,被東南亞民主運動廣泛採用的抗爭手勢,如今已跨越國界,成為反極權的象徵。
林昶佐向中央社記者說,主辦單位原本給他兩個選項:單獨演說,或與May合作。他毫不猶豫選了後者。因為,過去參與國際人權工作時,緬甸一直是最重要的支援對象,因此對May的處境很有共感。「與其我自己講,不如讓第一線的受害者出來說。」
他說,這也呼應他演講的核心主張:「我們正在目睹,民主的價值在全球各地遭到折損。」
林昶佐上週也接受「晚報」(Iltalehti)、「世界圖像報」(Maailman Kuvalehti)等多家芬蘭媒體深度專訪,前者聚焦川習北京峰會期間台灣的境遇,後者深談藝術、假訊息與民主韌性。(編輯:陳慧萍)1150518

世界村嘉年华（World Village Festival）由非政府组织联盟Fingo主办，自1995年创办以来，每年吸引来自世界各地的公民社会团体、艺术家与社运人士齐聚赫尔辛基，是芬兰规模最大、最具代表性的国际公民社会年度活动。
林昶佐在Bio Rex讲台以英语发表演讲，题目为「从迫害迈向自由，对抗数字控制之战」（From Suppression to Freedom: The Fight Against Digital Control）。
他播放了闪灵去年在高雄大港开唱的演出影片，台上他和团员赤膊呐喊，万人沸腾。影片结束后，西装革履的他走上前说：「没错，那是我。但别期待我在这里也脱衣服耍死腔。」轻松开场。
随即带出台湾从威权走向民主的历史脉络：长达38年的戒严时期，出版物须经政府审查，以台语演唱的歌曲受到严格限制，被认定具有颠覆性的艺术家随时面临牢狱之灾。
他指出，威权政府压制艺术，因为艺术承载信息、赋予人民力量。台湾历经数十年抗争，艺术家在其中扮演关键角色，最终在1990年代完成民主转型，如今台湾民主在亚洲名列前茅，2019年更成为亚洲首个同婚合法化的国家。
他话锋一转，直指眼前的威胁不再只是坦克与枪炮，而是更难察觉的认知战。
他表示，中国已将信息操控工业化，通过网络与媒体不断散布「民主运作失灵」的简单叙事，悄悄从内部侵蚀台湾社会。2022年多家超商及路边广告看板屏幕遭骇，被迫显示政治宣传标语，正是这场数字渗透的缩影。他并点名，中国更已借助大型语言模型，将假消息攻势扩大至全球规模，从菲律宾、印度到立陶宛、捷克，各地民主社会都是目标。
林昶佐在这场演讲与缅甸流亡艺术家、影像创作者May（化名）同台，为避免身份外泄，May以化妆装半脸头盔登台，说明政变后缅甸的状况：壁画数日内遭涂掉，6名诗人在头两年遇害，中国输出监控技术协助军政府追踪异见。「这不只是切断通讯，而是消灭见证者。」
May并邀请林昶佐与台下观众一同举起3根手指。这个源自电影《饥饿游戏》，被东南亚民主运动广泛采用的抗争手势，如今已跨越国界，成为反极权的象征。
林昶佐向中央社记者表示，主办单位原本给他两个选项：单独演讲，或与May合作。他毫不犹疑选了后者。因为，过去参与国际人权工作时，缅甸一直是最重要的支援对象，因此对May的处境很有共感。「与其我自己讲，不如让第一线的受害者出来说。」
他说，这也呼应他演讲的核心主张：「我们正在目睹，民主的价值在全球各地遭到折损。」
林昶佐上周也接受《晚报》（Iltalehti）、《世界图像报》（Maailman Kuvalehti）等多家芬兰媒体深度专访，前者聚焦川习北京峰会期间台湾的处境，后者深入探讨艺术、假消息与民主韧性。（编辑：陈慧萍）1150518

_source.evidence: 文章核心内容是台湾代表林昶佐在芬兰发表演讲，主题涉及'对抗中国认知战'、'中国信息操控'及'假讯息攻势'。虽然文章提到了中国利用大型语言模型进行假讯息攻击（涉及技术武器概念），但文章本身描述的是台湾方面针对中国认知战威胁的'发声'、'呼吁'及'揭露'行动，属于认知域中的对抗性舆论行动。根据标签定义，[行动动向]涵盖'具体的舆论攻击行动'及'对抗等行动及其动向'。此处台湾代表在国际场合揭露并呼吁对抗中国的认知战，属于认知域对抗行动的一部分。虽然涉及中国（涉我），但[涉我事件]通常指中国作为被攻击对象的具体敌情事件（如中国遭受攻击），而此处是中国作为攻击方被揭露，且文章重点在于台湾方面的应对行动（演讲、呼吁）。综合来看，这属于认知域对抗的具体行动动向。

In 1950, Army General Headquarters was restructured in Fengshan, Kaohsiung County by order of MND and Political Department was set up at the same time.  In 1963, it was renamed as Political Warfare Department.
On 1st July, 1998, to comply with the Organization Downsizing Project, the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th Administration Office under the supervision of Political Warfare Department were renamed as Counselling Service Division, Cultural Promotion Division, Military Discipline and Ethics Division and Military Security Division and Canteen Division was also under its oversight.  On 1st Jan, 2002, Canteen Division was deactivated.  On 1st Jan 2004, the Political Warfare Department was renamed as Political Warfare Director-General’s Office and Psychological Warfare Readiness Center was added to expand its organization.  On 1st July, 2005, Military Discipline and Ethics Division was restructured to be under the oversight of Inspector General’s Office; Psychological Warfare Readiness Center was restructured to be under the oversight of General Political Warfare Brigade, MND.  On 1st Oct, 2005, Security Division was restructured to be under the oversight of Military Intelligence Division.
On 1st Jan, 2006, Political Warfare Director-General’s Office oversaw three divisions of Overall Political Warfare, Cultural and Psychological Warfare and Military Dependents Service and restructured them from division to section.  In the meanwhile, Public Affairs Section was established.  On 1st Jan, 2007, Military Dependents Service Section was restructured to be under the oversight of Engineer Division.  On 1st, Jan, 2008, Sections of Military Discipline and Ethics, Security and Military Dependents were once again restructured to be under the oversight of Political Warfare Director-General’s Office which consisted of 6 sections in total.  On 1st Feb of the same year, Political Warfare Director-General’s Office was renamed as Political Warfare Department which consists of 111 staff members and it also administers Military Counselling Education Center to carry out counselling and training program for armed forces.
The department is under the oversight of Army General Headquarters and also the highest command unit of army political warfare which is in charge of the planning and supervision of army’s political warfare.  The current political warfare holds the principles of receiving orders from higher-ups for providing supervision and assistance to subordinates.  To the general public, the priorities are focused on propaganda, national defence, civil service and news processing; to the armed forces, the priorities are focused on psychological counselling, military discipline security, psychological warfare training, military dependents service, welfare service, cultivation of soldiers’ non-physical combat force and security maintenance.  It is expected to elevate soldiers’ intangible combat force, support war preparation and readiness and ensure the accomplishment of military missions.
_source.movement_title: 陆军政治作战部沿革、架构调整及职能定位综述
_source.movement_abstract: 该部门前身为 1950 年于高雄凤山整编的陆军总司令部政治部，1963 年改组为政治作战部。1998 年因组织精简，其下属行政单位更名为辅导、文化推广、军纪伦理及军安等组，并于 2002 年停编伙食组。2004 年改组为政治作战总监室并增设心理战备中心，随后多次调整隶属关系。2008 年 2 月恢复政治作战部名称，辖 111 人并管理军教中心。该部门隶属陆军总司令部，负责规划监督陆军政治作战，对外侧重宣传、国防及新闻处理，对内聚焦心理辅导、军纪安全及士兵精神战力培养，旨在提升部队无形战力并支援战备任务。

_source.trans_cont:
1950年，根据国防部命令，陆军总司令部在高雄县凤山重新整编，并同时设立政治部。1963年，该部门更名为政治作战部。
1998年7月1日，为配合组织精简计划，政治作战部下属的第一至第四行政办公室分别更名为咨询辅导科、文化宣导科、军纪伦理科及军安科，同时伙食科也归其管辖。2002年1月1日，伙食科被裁撤。2004年1月1日，政治作战部更名为政治作战局局长室，并增设心理作战战备中心以扩充组织架构。2005年7月1日，军纪伦理科调整归入监察处管辖；心理作战战备中心调整归入国防部政治作战总队管辖。2005年10月1日，安全科调整归入军情处管辖。
2006年1月1日，政治作战局局长室管辖总体政治作战、文化心理作战及军眷服务三个科，并将其调整为六个分科。同时设立公共事务分科。2007年1月1日，军眷服务分科调整归入工兵处管辖。2008年1月1日，军纪伦理、安全及军眷服务分科再次调整归入政治作战局局长室，该室共辖六个分科。同年2月1日，政治作战局局长室更名为政治作战部，共编制111人，并管理军事辅导教育中心，负责对军方进行辅导与训练。
该部门隶属于陆军总司令部，是陆军政治作战的最高指挥单位，负责规划与监督陆军政治作战事务。目前政治作战遵循上级命令，对下属提供督导与协助。对一般民众，其重点在于宣传、国防、公务及新闻处理；对军方，则侧重心理辅导、军纪安全、心理作战训练、军眷服务、福利服务、士兵非实质战斗力量培育及安全维护。旨在提升士兵的非实质战斗力量，支持战备与作战准备，确保军事任务的完成。

_source.content:
On September 9, 2025, Israel struck Qatar. There was no battlefield, no front line. Instead, the target was a sovereign state hosting negotiations that Israel itself was involved in. When the missile hit Doha, it set a dangerous precedent.
That same strike architecture reappeared on February 28, at the start of the US-Israel war on Iran, when the compound of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was targeted in Tehran.
In both cases, Israeli aircraft remained outside the target state’s airspace and released a missile that completed the strike independently. That single operational choice removes the defining constraint of air warfare: penetration.
The Doha strike was a strategic error because it exposed this capability unnecessarily. The target — a meeting of Hamas leadership convened to review a ceasefire proposal from the Trump administration — was political, not strategic. Israel later had to apologise for the strike, but the fact remained that its new capability had been exposed.
Israel did not employ a conventional bombing model. Instead, it executed an integrated operational sequence built upon a mature fused C7ISR (Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Combat Systems, Cyber, Cognition, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) architecture — a system integrating cyber and cognitive warfare with intelligence and command networks to accelerate decision-making and maintain superiority in the modern battlespace. This construct enabled precise timing, persistent situational awareness, and overwhelming operational accuracy. The aircraft itself was not the decisive element. The system was.
Advertisement
An Israeli F-15I aircraft flew over international waters in the Red Sea and aligned roughly with the latitude of the Saudi port of Yanbu, but remained outside Saudi sovereign airspace. This was deliberate. Any direct route across the Arabian Peninsula would have required overflight of Saudi territory and would have carried a high probability of engagement by Saudi Arabia’s sophisticated, multilayered air-defence architecture.
From that corridor, the F-15I released an air-launched ballistic missile (ALBM) from the Israeli Sparrow family, likely the Silver Sparrow variant. This is a missile which is carried by an aircraft, but once released, it behaves like a heavier medium-range ballistic missile (MRBM). After separation, a rocket booster ignites, accelerating the missile into a suborbital trajectory that carries it beyond the dense layers of the atmosphere into near space.
Midcourse, the missile follows a ballistic arc entirely outside the conventional air defence envelope. The strike concludes in the terminal phase. The missile re-enters the atmosphere steeply at hypersonic speed, committing to a near-vertical descent onto the target.
Atmospheric friction generates extreme thermal loading and forms a plasma sheath around the missile, degrading radar stability and complicating fire control solutions. Velocity remains firmly in the hypersonic regime, while the engagement geometry collapses. The threat is not traversing defended airspace. It is piercing it.
At this speed, the missile covers several kilometres per second. The interval between reliable track formation and impact is measured in seconds. Within that window, an integrated air defence system must complete detection, classification, trajectory computation, interceptor launch and terminal intercept.
Even advanced systems, such as THAAD, Patriot, and emerging higher-tier interceptors, cannot overcome this constraint. They can extend detection and improve engagement probability. They cannot create the time or engagement depth that the physics of the trajectory eliminates.
This is the limitation. It is not merely technological; it is defined by velocity, friction and geometry.
The Tehran strike followed the same logic, likely using the Blue Sparrow, a variant from the same missile family, and an alternative launch corridor. The F-15I is assessed to have operated over eastern Syrian or western Iraqi airspace, creating a northern vector into Iran. This reduced distance and simplified the trajectory, but the underlying architecture remained unchanged.
Advertisement
Different geography, same system.
The technology behind these strikes introduces a second layer of consequence. The launch system has been integrated onto the F-15I — an older variant — through deep structural and software modification. That level of integration implies access to source code, mission system architecture, and the aircraft’s onboard mission data library.
The Sparrow lineage is also significant: it was originally developed as a ballistic target missile for missile defence testing and has been adapted into a standoff strike weapon, marking a clear doctrinal shift from testing architecture to operational use.
That is critical. Source code governs the launching platform’s logic. The onboard library governs how it processes sensor inputs, identifies targets, integrates weapons, and executes strike logic. Together, they define operational sovereignty.
This raises a direct question.
Saudi Arabia is the world’s largest purchaser of US weapons and operates the largest F-15 fleet outside the United States. Yet the F-15SA — despite being more advanced — does not operate with this level of sovereign integration. Qatar’s F-15QA is similarly constrained.
Why was this level of access permitted in one case and not in others?
This is not a minor technical issue. It goes to the core of arms transfers, source-code control, onboard library autonomy, and the real independence of advanced air forces.
But the deeper consequence lies beyond procurement.
By demonstrating this capability — first against Qatar, then against Iran — Israel has shown that this model works. Once demonstrated, it becomes replicable.
The components already exist across multiple states: aircraft capable of carrying heavy payloads, ballistic missile technology, guidance systems, and integration pathways. The US, Russia, China, France, Pakistan and a few others possess the industrial base to develop comparable architectures.
This pushes the concept towards the practical edge of space weaponisation — not orbital, but suborbital. The system operates beyond traditional atmospheric engagement zones before re-entry. Once normalised, that boundary will erode.
And once eroded, there is no return.
The result is a structural shift in vulnerability. The same physics applies to all actors. No defence system can exempt itself from it.
Israel extended its reach. It also demonstrated the conditions under which others can do the same. It is now just a matter of time before others can replicate this system.
The implications for world leaders are profound. As these capabilities proliferate, warfare will become more unpredictable, more dangerous, and more vulnerable to miscalculation, compressing decision-making timelines and forcing leaders to make consequential choices in minutes rather than days. They can become instruments not only of deterrence and war, but also of coercion, regional competition, and the settling of strategic rivalries.
Geography, distance and strategic depth are losing their traditional value as buffers of warning and protection. The sense of safety is increasingly disappearing.

_source.movement_title: 以色列高超音速空射导弹新范式及其全球安全影响分析
_source.movement_abstract: 2025 年 9 月 9 日，以色列对卡塔尔发动无战场打击，随后在 2 月 28 日美以对伊朗开战初期，再次利用类似架构袭击德黑兰最高领袖驻地。两次行动均通过 F-15I 战机在目标国领空外发射空射弹道导弹（ALBM），利用高超音速再入大气层特性规避传统防空系统，确立新作战范式。该行动暴露了以色列成熟的 C7ISR 融合架构及源代码级系统集成能力，引发对武器转让中自主权及地缘安全缓冲失效的担忧。分析指出，此类技术已具备可复制性，多国拥有相应工业基础，可能导致战争决策时间压缩、误判风险增加及战略竞争加剧，全球安全环境面临结构性挑战。
_source.title: The strike that changed the geometry of war
_source.trans_cont:
2025年9月9日，以色列袭击了卡塔尔。没有战场，也没有前线。相反，目标是一个正在主持谈判的主权国家，而以色列本身也参与其中。当导弹击中多哈时，这设定了一个危险的先例。
同样的袭击架构在2023年2月28日再次出现，即美国和以色列对伊朗战争开始时，伊朗德黑兰的最高领袖阿亚图拉阿里·哈梅内伊的住所遭到袭击。
在这两种情况下，以色列的飞机始终在目标国家领空之外，释放了一枚导弹，该导弹能够独立完成袭击。这一单一的操作选择消除了空战中定义性的限制：穿透。
多哈袭击是一次战略错误，因为它无必要地暴露了这种能力。目标——哈马斯领导层会议，旨在审查特朗普政府提出的停火提议——是政治性的，而非战略性的。以色列后来不得不为这次袭击道歉，但事实是其新的能力已被暴露。
以色列并未采用传统的轰炸模式。相反，它执行了一套集成的操作序列，建立在成熟的融合C7ISR（指挥、控制、通信、计算机、战斗系统、网络、认知、情报、监视和侦察）架构之上——一个将网络战和认知战与情报和指挥网络相结合的系统，以加快决策速度并保持现代战场上的优势。这种结构使得精确的时间安排、持续的情报感知和压倒性的作战精度成为可能。飞机本身并不是决定性因素，而是整个系统。
一架以色列的F-15I战机在红海国际水域上空飞行，大致与沙特港口延布的纬度一致，但始终在沙特主权领空之外。这是有意为之。任何穿越阿拉伯半岛的直接路线都必须经过沙特领土，而沙特拥有复杂的多层防空体系，这将带来很高的被拦截概率。
从这条走廊，F-15I释放了一枚空射弹道导弹（ALBM），很可能是以色列“银雀”型号。这是一种由飞机携带的导弹，一旦释放，它就会像一枚更重的中程弹道导弹（MRBM）一样行动。分离后，火箭助推器点火，将导弹加速到亚轨道轨迹，使其穿越大气层的密集层进入近太空。
中段飞行阶段，导弹完全在传统防空系统的防御范围之外飞行。袭击在终端阶段结束。导弹以超音速速度陡峭地重新进入大气层，垂直降落到目标区域。
大气摩擦产生极端的热负荷，并在导弹周围形成等离子体鞘，降低雷达稳定性并使火控解决方案复杂化。速度始终保持在超音速范围内，而拦截几何结构则崩溃。威胁不是穿越防御空域，而是穿透它。
以这种速度，导弹每秒可以飞行数公里。从可靠跟踪形成到命中目标的时间间隔以秒计算。在此窗口期内，一个集成防空系统必须完成探测、分类、轨迹计算、拦截器发射和终端拦截。
即使先进的系统，如THAAD、爱国者和新兴的更高层级拦截器，也无法克服这一限制。它们可以延长探测距离并提高拦截概率，但无法创造轨迹物理所消除的时间或拦截深度。
这就是限制。这不仅仅是技术问题；它由速度、摩擦和几何结构定义。
德黑兰的袭击遵循了相同的逻辑，很可能是使用了同一导弹家族的“蓝雀”型号，并采用了一条替代的发射走廊。F-15I被评估为在东部叙利亚或西部伊拉克领空上空飞行，从而向伊朗形成北方的路径。这缩短了距离并简化了轨迹，但底层架构保持不变。
不同的地理环境，相同的系统。
这些袭击背后的技术引入了第二层后果。发射系统已通过深度结构和软件修改整合到F-15I——一种较老的型号上。这种程度的整合意味着可以访问源代码、任务系统架构以及飞机上的任务数据库。
“雀”系列导弹的重要性也值得关注：它最初是作为弹道靶弹开发的，用于导弹防御测试，后来被改造为一种远程打击武器，标志着从测试架构到作战使用的明显理论转变。
这一点至关重要。源代码决定了发射平台的逻辑。机载数据库决定了它如何处理传感器输入、识别目标、整合武器和执行打击逻辑。它们共同定义了作战主权。
这直接引发了一个问题。
沙特阿拉伯是全球最大的美国武器购买国，运营着除美国以外最大的F-15机队。然而，尽管F-15SA更为先进，它并没有以这种程度的主权整合运行。卡塔尔的F-15QA同样受到限制。
为什么在某些情况下允许这种程度的访问，而在其他情况下却不允许？
这不是一个小的技术问题。它触及了武器转让、源代码控制、机载数据库自主性以及先进空军真正独立性的核心。
但更深层次的后果超越了采购。

外交部長林佳龍今(2)日出席立法院外交及國防委員會前,先行接受媒體訪問。(記者叢昌瑾攝)
中共解放軍東部戰區昨日發布統戰影片「中國人」。外交部長林佳龍今(2)日表示,影片是標準的統戰與認知作戰,透過剪輯製造假象,事實上就是要展現對台威嚇。
林佳龍今日出席立法院外交及國防委員會前受訪表示,解放軍推出「中國人」影片是標準的統戰、認知作戰,透過剪輯來製造假象,事實上就是解放軍,要展現對台的威嚇。
請繼續往下閱讀...
林佳龍指出,影片中剪入了一些兩岸交流的畫面,是一種認知作戰,他相信國人都知道,中共一切都是政治掛帥。
林佳龍強調,外交部堅持總統賴清德提到的和平四大支柱行動方案與四項堅持,來作為台灣兩岸關係與國際關係的基礎。

TEHRAN – Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) admit another soldier has been killed by the Lebanese resistance movement Hezbollah.
According to the Hebrew media, the soldier, identified as a Staff Sergeant, was killed in southern Lebanon by a Hezbollah mortar shell. It marks the sixth IOF fatality “killed during combat” on the northern front that the Zionist regime has announced since the so-called “ceasefire” began.
There is strict media censorship on IOF casualty numbers, which experts argue is higher than what is being announced.
Hebrew media also noted that the incident “does not involve a loitering munition” (in reference to Hezbollah’s FPV drones or guided projectiles).
Earlier, the regime’s military radio reported that four IOF soldiers sustained injuries, with one of them in critical condition. The casualties were caused by an explosive drone launched by Hezbollah towards Ras Naqoura, in southern Lebanon.
Broadcaster Kan quoted military sources as saying that Hezbollah “crossed a red line” in the Ras Naqoura attack.
Channel 15 reported that “preliminary military investigations show the explosive drone that detonated in Ras Naqoura was launched from a long distance.”
Kan also stated that drones launched by Hezbollah cannot be reliably detected, noting that one of them struck its target in the Rosh HaNikra settlement on Thursday without any prior warning.
Channel i24 News also mentioned that a drone attack targeting Rosh HaNikra, which wounded at least three people, was launched from a distance and went undetected.
There has been an escalation of attacks by Hezbollah against the IOF. The Lebanese resistance announced that it had detonated an explosive device targeting an IOF force spotted infiltrating towards a water pump station north of the town of Taybeh.
Following the detonation, the force was shelled with artillery, causing confirmed casualties and forcing it to withdraw under heavy fire and a dense smoke screen, which helicopters used to evacuate the wounded.
The Lebanese resistance front also announced that it had targeted an IOF unit near the newly established Bayyada post with rocket barrages and artillery fire, and then struck a Merkava tank attempting to support the unit with a guided missile, achieving a direct hit.
Hezbollah further announced a series of operations targeting IOF equipment and vehicles inside Lebanese territory, as well as engaging the regime’s warplanes and drones in southern Lebanese airspace.
In consecutive statements, Hezbollah said it targeted an IOF unit that had moved into the Bidr al-Faq’ani area of Taybeh with a rocket barrage.
Moving from Taybeh to Hadata, resistance fighters spotted two IOF D9 bulldozers advancing from the town of Rashaaf. They detonated an explosive device against the first bulldozer on the road between the two towns. The second bulldozer was then hit with another device as it attempted to continue its advance towards the pond area in Hadata.
The resistance movement said that an IOF aircraft carried out an airstrike on the second bulldozer, destroying it and setting it on fire.
Hezbollah also announced it had targeted an IOF unit near the newly established Bayyada post with rocket barrages and artillery fire. It then struck a Merkava tank attempting to support the unit with a guided missile, achieving a direct hit.
Shortly after, resistance fighters renewed their targeting of the same force with a rocket barrage.
On the ground and in the air, the Lebanese resistance said it engaged IOF aircraft and drones in southern Lebanese airspace, using surface-to-air missiles.
These operations are part of Hezbollah’s response to IOF violations of the temporary truce announced by the United States between Lebanon and the occupation regime, the attacks on villages in southern Lebanon that have killed and wounded civilians, and the violation of Lebanese airspace.
The regime's Channel 15 said the IOF has begun distributing “protective netting” to its forces in Lebanon to counter drones, adding that about 158,000 square meters of netting have been deployed, with procurement advancing for an additional 188,000 square meters.
Meanwhile, the regime’s Channel 13 admitted that the IOF has made no progress in finding a solution to the drone threat, acknowledging that protective netting cannot cover all of southern Lebanon. It added that Hezbollah exploits this vulnerability by deploying drone swarms that overwhelm detection and interception systems, noting that the drone used in the Ras Naqoura attack was not detected in advance.
The Hebrew language newspaper Maariv had earlier admitted that “the current situation on the Lebanese border is extremely dangerous,” noting that Hezbollah has intensified its operations against the (occupation) military in southern Lebanon. This is coupled with an escalation in “psychological warfare” through documenting operations and releasing footage of the attacks.
The newspaper noted that Hezbollah is readopting tactics similar to those used during the 1990s against the IOF in south Lebanon, affirming that recent operations have increased pressure along the Lebanese border and northern settlements.
_source.movement_title: 以色列国防军承认在黎巴嫩南部遭真主党袭击致士兵阵亡
_source.movement_abstract: 【以色列媒体6月29日报道】以色列国防军承认一名中士在黎巴嫩南部遭真主党迫击炮袭击阵亡，系所谓停火生效以来北部战线第六名阵亡士兵。希伯来语媒体报道，另有四名以军士兵在拉斯纳库拉遭真主党爆炸无人机袭击受伤，其中一人伤势危重。以军广播称，该无人机从远距离发射且未被提前侦测。真主党宣布在黎巴嫩境内对以军发动多轮袭击，包括在泰贝镇以北水泵站附近引爆爆炸装置，迫使以军撤退；在拜亚达哨所附近以火箭弹和炮火袭击以军单位，并用制导导弹直接命中一辆梅卡瓦坦克。真主党还称在黎巴嫩南部空域使用地对空导弹拦截以军飞机和无人机。以军开始部署防护网应对无人机威胁，已部署约15.8万平方米，另有18.8万平方米正在采购。以色列第13频道承认防护网无法覆盖黎巴嫩南部全境，无人机群可突破侦测拦截系统。以色列《 Maariv》报称，当前黎巴嫩边境局势极度危险，真主党正采取类似20世纪90年代的战术，通过发布袭击视频加强心理战，加剧黎巴嫩边境及北部定居点压力。
_source.title: Hezbollah inflicts more casualties on IOF
_source.trans_cont:
德黑兰——以色列占领部队（IOF）承认另一名士兵被真主党抵抗运动所杀。
据希伯来媒体报道，这名被确认为军士长的士兵在黎巴嫩南部被真主党的迫击炮弹击中身亡。这标志着自所谓的“停火”开始以来，该政权宣布的北部战线中，第六名在战斗中死亡的IOF士兵。
专家指出，关于IOF伤亡人数的媒体审查非常严格，实际伤亡人数可能高于官方公布的数字。
希伯来媒体还指出，此次事件“不涉及巡飞弹”（指真主党的FPV无人机或制导弹药）。
此前，该政权的军用广播电台报道称，四名IOF士兵受伤，其中一人伤势严重。这些伤亡是由真主党向黎巴嫩南部的拉什纳库拉发射的爆炸无人机造成的。
广播公司Kan引用军方消息来源称，真主党在拉什纳库拉的袭击“越过了红线”。
第15频道报道称，“初步军事调查显示，引爆于拉什纳库拉的爆炸无人机是从远距离发射的。”
Kan还指出，真主党发射的无人机难以可靠探测，其中一架无人机于周四在罗斯哈尼克拉定居点击中目标，事先没有任何预警。
i24新闻频道也提到，针对罗斯哈尼克拉的无人机袭击造成至少三人受伤，该袭击是从远距离发动且未被察觉。
真主党对IOF的袭击有所升级。黎巴嫩抵抗运动宣布，他们引爆了一枚爆炸装置，目标是被发现正在向塔伊贝镇北面的水泵站渗透的IOF部队。
爆炸后，该部队遭到炮击，造成确认的伤亡，并在密集的烟雾掩护和重火力下被迫撤退，直升机用于撤离伤员。
黎巴嫩抵抗阵线还宣布，他们对靠近新设立的拜亚达哨所附近的一支IOF部队进行了火箭弹和炮火袭击，并用制导导弹击中了一辆试图支援该部队的梅卡瓦坦克，成功命中目标。
真主党还宣布了一系列针对黎巴嫩境内IOF装备和车辆的行动，同时在黎巴嫩南部领空与该政权的战机和无人机交战。
在连续声明中，真主党表示，他们对进入塔伊贝镇比德尔·法克尼地区的一支IOF部队进行了火箭弹袭击。
从塔伊贝转移到哈达塔后，抵抗战士发现两辆IOF D9推土机正从拉沙夫镇向前进。他们在这两座城镇之间的道路上对第一辆推土机引爆了爆炸装置。当第二辆推土机试图继续向哈达塔的池塘区域前进时，又被引爆了另一枚装置。
抵抗运动称，一架IOF飞机对第二辆推土机实施了空袭，将其摧毁并引发火灾。
真主党还宣布，他们对靠近新设立的拜亚达哨所附近的一支IOF部队进行了火箭弹和炮火袭击，随后用制导导弹击中了一辆试图支援该部队的梅卡瓦坦克，成功命中目标。
随后，抵抗战士再次对同一部队进行了火箭弹袭击。
在地面和空中，黎巴嫩抵抗运动表示，他们在黎巴嫩南部领空与IOF的飞机和无人机交战，使用了地空导弹。
这些行动是真主党对IOF违反美国宣布的黎巴嫩与占领政权之间的临时停火协议、对黎巴嫩南部村庄的袭击造成平民伤亡以及违反黎巴嫩领空的回应。
该政权的第15频道称，IOF已经开始向其在黎巴嫩的部队分发“防护网”，以对抗无人机，称已部署了约158,000平方米的防护网，采购工作正在推进，以增加另外188,000平方米的防护网。
与此同时，该政权的第13频道承认，IOF在解决无人机威胁方面没有任何进展，承认防护网无法覆盖整个南部黎巴嫩。并指出，真主党利用这一弱点，部署无人机群以压倒探测和拦截系统，指出在拉什纳库拉袭击中使用的无人机事先未被探测到。
希伯来语报纸《马阿里夫》此前承认，“目前黎巴嫩边境的局势极其危险”，指出真主党加强了对（占领）军队在黎巴嫩南部的行动。这伴随着“心理战”的升级，通过记录行动并发布袭击视频来实现。
该报纸指出，真主党正在重新采用上世纪90年代在黎巴嫩南部对抗IOF时使用的战术，确认最近的行动增加了黎巴嫩边境和北部定居点的压力。

_source.evidence: 文章主要描述了黎巴嫩真主党（Hezbollah）对以色列占领军（IOF）在黎巴嫩南部及边境地区发动的一系列具体军事打击行动，包括使用迫击炮、FPV无人机、火箭弹和反坦克导弹等武器造成以军人员伤亡和装备损毁。虽然文中提到了无人机技术（技术武器）和以军的防御网（力量发展/技术），但文章的核心事件是具体的实战对抗和作战行动（Action/Operations），而非单纯的技术研发或部队组建。根据标签定义，这属于相关领域的具体作战、对抗等行动及其动向。由于事件发生在黎巴嫩与以色列之间，不涉及中国大陆作为被攻击对象或相关方，因此不属于[涉我事件]。

_source.content:
◎ 林子立
針對近期川習會及美國總統川普相關談話內容,東海大學中國大陸暨區域發展研究中心邀集多位學者進行綜合分析。學者普遍認為,從此次峰會與公開發言可清楚看出,
美國對台政策並未改變,維持台海和平穩定現狀,仍是台美雙方共同核心利益。
東海陸研中心邀集學者 解讀「川習會」
針對近期川習會及美國總統川普相關談話,東海大學中國大陸暨區域發展研究中心邀集多位學者進行綜合分析。 (作者提供)
陸研中心主任林子立教授表示,
從川普總統公開談話可發現,儘管中國國家主席習近平在會談中多次談及台灣議題,但川普並未正面回應中方相關要求,更未對北京作出任何政策承諾
。這顯示美方在台灣問題上,仍維持既有政策框架與戰略彈性。
陸研中心顧問中正大學政治系蔡榮祥教授則指出,
川普總統接受美國媒體訪問說:「I am not looking to have somebody go independent.」,這句話被台灣親中媒體譯為台灣獨立,完全錯誤翻譯英文和典型的認知作戰。「have somebody go independent」是指單邊行動、自行其是,而非政治意義上的宣布獨立
。句中的 “somebody” 刻意保持模糊,並未特指台灣(親中媒體強迫入座),同樣可以指涉中國採取片面的軍事行動。從脈絡來看,川普在同一段發言中要求中國台灣雙方「cool it」(冷靜),顯示這是一個對雙方的警告,而非單方面壓制台灣的主權立場。
若將此句逕自翻譯為台灣獨立,不僅曲解了川普的原意,更在政治上產生嚴重的誤導效果。讓外界誤以為美國總統明確反對台灣的主權主張,無形中完全順應中國的敘事框架
。正確的解讀應是:川普不希望任何一方採取讓美國被迫捲入衝突的片面行動,這是一種基於避免戰爭衝突的警告,而非兩岸政治立場的表態。
請繼續往下閱讀...
美對台政策維持一致 未出現重大轉變
美國總統川普在空軍一號上接受聯訪。(路透檔案照)
東海大學政治系主任張峻豪教授則認為,外界解讀川普時,不應只聚焦單一句子,而應結合其後續談話脈絡。川普同時強調,希望「中國冷靜下來」,其真正核心訊息是反對任何一方片面改變現狀,並希望維持區域穩定。
張教授指出,包括川普本人及美國國務院官員近期皆多次重申,美國對台政策與長期立場維持一致,並未出現重大轉變。
專研政治經濟學的林奕孜教授則強調,中華民國作為目前台海現狀的一部分,本身即是現狀秩序的維持者;反而真正對現狀造成不確定性與風險的,是持續試圖改變台海現狀的中華人民共和國。
他指出,北京近年持續透過軍事、外交與法律戰等方式增加區域壓力,才是當前台海穩定面臨挑戰的重要來源。
針對外界高度關注的對台軍售議題,學者們也指出,川普總統已明確表示,並未就軍售問題向中國作出任何承諾,而是強調將與台灣執政當局直接討論。
這與川普過去所提出「Taiwan is Taiwan(台灣就是台灣)」的立場一脈相承,也顯示對台軍售本質上屬於台美之間的安全合作事務,北京並無介入空間。
蔡榮祥教授進一步表示,美國對台軍售是依據台灣關係法所建立的安全承諾,也是維持印太區域嚇阻與和平的重要基礎。他指出,自川普第一任期以來,美國對台安全支持持續提升,
軍售規模與安全合作皆屢創新高,反映出台海安全已被視為美國印太戰略的重要環節。
美國對台軍售是依據台灣關係法所建立的安全承諾,也是維持印太區域嚇阻與和平的重要基礎。圖為川普政府八項對台軍售。(本報資料照;本報製圖)
多位學者最後共同指出,從此次川習互動亦可清楚看出,「台灣問題」之所以存在,正是因為兩岸互不隸屬的現實客觀存在。
若兩岸真屬同一主權國家,便不會存在國際社會所認知的「台灣議題」。因此,如何在尊重現狀基礎上維持和平穩定,仍將是未來美中台三方互動的核心關鍵。
(作者為東海大學陸研中心主任)

_source.movement_title: 东海大学陆研中心学者解读川习会美方对台政策维持现状
_source.movement_abstract: 【台湾自由时报2026年6月29日报道】东海大学中国大陆暨区域发展研究中心邀集林子立、蔡荣祥、张峻豪、林奕孜等多位学者，针对近期川习会及美国总统川普相关谈话进行综合分析。学者指出，尽管习近平在会谈中多次提及台湾议题，但川普未正面回应中方要求，亦未作出政策承诺，显示美方在台问题上仍维持既有政策框架与战略弹性。针对川普接受媒体访问时称“不寻求让任何一方单方面行动”的言论，学者纠正了部分亲中媒体将其曲解为反对台湾独立的错误翻译，指出该表述实为警告两岸任何一方不得片面改变现状，旨在避免冲突。学者强调，美国对台政策与长期立场一致，未出现重大转变，台海不稳定性主要源于北京试图通过军事、外交及法律战改变现状。在军售议题上，川普明确表示未向中方承诺停止军售，强调将直接与台湾当局讨论，延续“台湾就是台湾”的立场。学者认为，对台军售是依据《台湾关系法》建立的安全承诺，是维持印太区域威慑与和平的基础，自川普第一任期以来规模屡创新高。学者总结，维持台海和平稳定现状仍是美中台三方互动的核心关键。
_source.title: 自由開講》維持台海和平穩定現狀 是台美共同核心利益

林子立
针对近期川习会及美国总统特朗普相关谈话内容，东海大学中国大陆暨区域发展研究中心邀请多位学者进行综合分析。学者普遍认为，从此次峰会与公开发言可清楚看出，美国对台政策并未改变，维持台海和平稳定现状，仍是台美双方共同核心利益。
东海陆研中心邀请学者解读“川习会”
针对近期川习会及美国总统特朗普相关谈话，东海大学中国大陆暨区域发展研究中心邀请多位学者进行综合分析。（作者提供）
陆研中心主任林子立教授表示，
从特朗普总统公开谈话可发现，尽管中国国家主席习近平在会谈中多次谈及台湾议题，但特朗普并未正面回应中方相关要求，更未对北京作出任何政策承诺
。这显示美方在台湾问题上，仍维持既有政策框架与战略弹性。
陆研中心顾问中正大学政治系蔡荣祥教授则指出，
特朗普总统接受美国媒体采访时说：“I am not looking to have somebody go independent.”，这句话被台湾亲中媒体译为“台湾独立”，完全错误翻译英文和典型的认知作战。“have somebody go independent”是指单边行动、自行其是，而非政治意义上的宣布独立
。句中的“somebody”刻意保持模糊，并未特指台湾（亲中媒体强迫入座），同样可以指涉中国采取片面的军事行动。从语境来看，特朗普在同一段发言中要求中国台湾双方“cool it”（冷静），显示这是一个对双方的警告，而非单方面压制台湾的主权立场。
若将此句径自翻译为“台湾独立”，不仅曲解了特朗普的原意，更在政治上产生严重的误导效果。让外界误以为美国总统明确反对台湾的主权主张，无形中完全顺应中国的叙事框架
。正确的解读应是：特朗普不希望任何一方采取让美国被迫卷入冲突的单边行动，这是一种基于避免战争冲突的警告，而非两岸政治立场的表态。

美国对台政策维持一致 未出现重大转变

东海大学政治系主任张峻豪教授则认为，外界解读特朗普时，不应只聚焦单一句子，而应结合其后续谈话脉络。特朗普同时强调，希望“中国冷静下来”，其真正核心信息是反对任何一方单方面改变现状，并希望维持区域稳定。
张教授指出，包括特朗普本人及美国国务院官员近期皆多次重申，美国对台政策与长期立场维持一致，并未出现重大转变。
专研政治经济学的林奕孜教授则强调，中华民国作为目前台海现状的一部分，本身即是现状秩序的维持者；反而真正对现状造成不确定性与风险的，是持续试图改变台海现状的中华人民共和国。
他指出，北京近年持续透过军事、外交与法律战等方式增加区域压力，才是当前台海稳定面临挑战的重要来源。
针对外界高度关注的对台军售议题，学者们也指出，特朗普总统已明确表示，并未就军售问题向中国作出任何承诺，而是强调将与台湾执政当局直接讨论。
这与特朗普过去所提出“Taiwan is Taiwan（台湾就是台湾）”的立场一脉相承，也显示对台军售本质上属于台美之间的安全合作事务，北京并无介入空间。
蔡荣祥教授进一步表示，美国对台军售是依据《台湾关系法》所建立的安全承诺，也是维持印太区域威慑与和平的重要基础。他指出，自特朗普第一任期以来，美国对台安全支持持续提升，
军售规模与安全合作皆屡创新高，反映出台海安全已被视为美国印太战略的重要环节。
美国对台军售是依据《台湾关系法》所建立的安全承诺，也是维持印太区域威慑与和平的重要基础。图为中国特朗普政府八项对台军售。（本报资料照；本报制图）
多位学者最后共同指出，从此次川习互动亦可清楚看出，“台湾问题”之所以存在，正是因为两岸互不隶属的现实客观存在。
若两岸真属同一主权国家，便不会存在国际社会所认知的“台湾议题”。因此，如何在尊重现状基础上维持和平稳定，仍将是未来美中台三方互动的核心关键。
（作者为东海大学陆研中心主任）

As the Philippine Military Academy (PMA) rolled out new training in artificial intelligence, cyber warfare, and unmanned systems, this year’s class valedictorian reminded fellow cadets that honor must remain at the center of military service.
Cadet First Class Christine Kaye D. Librada, of Lipa City, Batangas, topped the PMA “Talang Dangal” (Tagapagtanggol ng Lahing Dakila at Marangal) Class of 2026, becoming only the ninth female cadet to graduate at the top of her class since women were admitted into the Academy in 1997.
In her valedictory address delivered during the PMA commencement exercises at Fort Gregorio del Pilar in Baguio City on Saturday, May 16, Librada said the class entered military service at a time of transition inside the Academy and in the broader security environment.
"Once we step out of these walls, may we remember the foundation of our character, the Honor Code and the Honor System," Librada said.
"This is not something that simply separates us from the rest, nor a standard to ensure our stay in the academy, but a principle that will guide us in the decisions we make. Outside the brick gate, rules may not always be visible, but honor must remain present. May we stay true to our character and grow to be honorable leaders," she added.
Librada will join the Philippine Army after the graduation rites led by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
The Class of 2026 is composed of 207 cadets, including 65 women and 142 men. Of the total, 76 will join the Philippine Army, 62 the Philippine Air Force, and 69 the Philippine Navy.
The cadets were part of the 37,651 applicants who applied for the PMA Entrance Examination (PMAEE) in 2021 where only 24,288 individuals were qualified to take the said examination in 45 Testing Centers nationwide.
The prevailing threat of the Covid-19 pandemic at the time prompted the conduct of the exams in clusters (Island Group) and in a series of staggered examination dates.
Read: 350 cadets make up PMA Class of 2026￼
“These past four years of training had tested our limits and refined our character,” Librada said. “Today is both recognition of what the members of PMA ‘Talang Dangal’ Class of 2026 have accomplished and a reminder of the responsibility we now carry.”
She said the cadets witnessed reforms inside the Academy while undergoing training themselves.
“Being part of the change was not easy. It demanded courage, vision, and trust that despite setbacks, progress will push through,” Librada said.
Librada also paid tribute to the late Cadet Fourth Class Darwin Dormitorio, whose 2019 death after hazing inside the Academy triggered reforms in cadet training and supervision.
“Today, we also continue to honor the life of late Dormitorio, His memory reminds us of the true meaning of leadership and service,” she said, urging fellow cadets to lead “with courage, dignity and humanity.”
Raised by a retired military officer father and an entrepreneur mother, Librada said she grew up seeing “service, sacrifice, discipline and kindness” through her parents.
Inside the Academy, she joined the Speakers Board, Taekwondo Corps Squad, Silent Drill Company, PMA Christian Fellowship, and dance activities.
Changing nature of warfare
Meanwhile, PMA Superintendent Vice Admiral Caesar Bernard Valencia said the Academy had begun reshaping its curriculum as the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) shifted focus toward territorial defense and emerging forms of warfare.
“Warfare today goes beyond land, seas and skies,” Valencia recalled Marcos as saying during last year’s commencement exercises. “We have battles that are invisible to radar.”
Valencia said the PMA introduced micro credential courses in artificial intelligence (AI), data analytics, electronic and hybrid warfare, and unmanned systems for the Class of 2026.
“Our cadets went to Pag-asa Island for them not just to study sovereignty and sovereign rights,” Valencia said. “All of them stood on Philippine territory in the West Philippine Sea, to remind all of them that Pag-asa is more than an island, it is a reminder and a line we must not allow to fade.”
He said the Academy also organized a multi-domain task unit during the PMA Joint Field Training Exercise 2026 to expose cadets to cyber and cognitive warfare scenarios.
Further, he said the PMA was pursuing international accreditation while expanding its long-term development plan. He said the Academy aims to build a 10-company cadet corps with a training capacity of 2,000 cadets by 2040.
“Technology will evolve; the nature of warfare will change; threats will grow more complex but the values of Courage, Integrity and Loyalty will remain constant,” Valencia said.
Top 10
For topping the class, Librada will receive the Presidential Saber, Philippine Army Saber, JUSMAG Award, Information Technology Plaque and Australian Defence Best Overall Performance Award.
Other awardees include:
Rank 2. Cadet 1CL Mark John Vincent Utlang Catacutan (Pagadian City, Zamboanga del Sur): Class salutatorian and Magna Cum Laude. He received the Vice Presidential Saber, Philippine Air Force Saber, General Antonio Luna Award, Spanish Armed Forces Award, Alejandro Melchor Award, Management Plaque, Natural Sciences Plaque, Humanities Plaque, Pelagio Cruz Plaque, and Australian Defence Best Overall Performance Award.
Rank 3. Cadet 1CL Thomas Edgar Isla Sepulchre (Angeles City, Pampanga / Sabangan, Mountain Province): Recipient of the Secretary of National Defense Saber and National Security Studies Plaque.
Rank 4. Cadet 1CL Ian Harold Durana Hubilla (Pangpang City, Sorsogon): Recipient of the Chief of Staff Saber.
Rank 5. Cadet 1CL Maeg Adriene Pajarillo Bermudez (Moncada, Tarlac): Ranks fifth.
Rank 6. Cadet 1CL Cherry Mae Panag Geco (Jamindan, Capiz)
Rank 7. Cadet 1CL Elixa Anya Lumbang Hernandez (Garcia, Batangas): Recipient of the Philippine Navy Saber and Australian Defence Best Overall Performance Award.
Rank 8. Cadet 1CL Catherine Liesha Beloa De Chavez (San Pascual, Batangas): Recipient of the Chief Justice Saber and Artemio Ricarte Plaque.
Rank 9. Cadet 1CL Cedric Cyril Guingguing Polizon (Tagbina, Surigao del Sur)
Rank 10. Cadet 1CL Mark Clement Dequinto Centina (Negros Occidental).
Special awardees
Special awards were also handed out to other members of the graduating class:
Cadet 1CL Iway Inchan Ateo-an: Journalism Award 2026
Cadet 1CL Elaine Lyka Oagdan Canaya: Aguinaldo Saber and Department of Tactical Officers Plaque.
Cadet 1CL Earl Asnan Berlin Asuncion: Mathematics Plaque.
Cadet 1CL Adriane Faith Pe San Jose: Superintendent’s Saber.
Cadet 1CL Joyce Hanna Marie Danao Pascua: Association of General and Flag Officers, Inc. Award and Department of Leadership Plaque.
Cadet 1CL Beatrice Solamo Geralde: Jose Andrada Plaque.
Cadet 1CL John Roy Erauda Baran: Sports and Physical Development Unit Plaque.
Cadet 1CL Elaine Ruth Sunico Go: Athletic Saber (Female Category) and Gregorio del Pilar Award.
Cadet 1CL Kairan Shem Flor Resurreccion: Athletic Saber (Male Category).
_source.movement_title: 菲律宾军事学院2026届毕业典礼引入人工智能与网络战课程
_source.movement_abstract: 【菲律宾军事学院网站2026年5月16日报道】2026年5月16日，菲律宾军事学院在碧瑶市格里戈里奥·德尔皮拉尔堡举行2026届毕业典礼，207名学员毕业，其中65名为女性。首席毕业生克里斯汀·凯·D·利布拉达在致辞中强调荣誉准则在军事服务中的核心地位。学院总监海军中将凯撒·伯纳德·瓦伦西亚表示，学院已调整课程，新增人工智能、数据分析、电子战、混合战争及无人系统微认证课程，以应对战争形态变化。学院组织多域任务单元联合野外训练演习，使学员接触网络战和认知战场景。瓦伦西亚指出，学院计划到2040年将学员容量扩大至2000人，并追求国际认证。本届学员中，76人加入菲律宾陆军，62人加入菲律宾空军，69人加入菲律宾海军。利布拉达获得总统佩剑、菲律宾陆军佩剑、澳大利亚国防最佳整体表现奖等多项荣誉。学院还纪念了2019年因霸凌事件去世的学员达尔文·多莫里托，强调领导力、尊严与人性的价值。
_source.title: PMA valedictorian vows to lead with honor as Academy shifts to modern warfare training
_source.trans_cont:
随着菲律宾军事学院（PMA）推出人工智能、网络战和无人系统的新型培训，今年的毕业生代表提醒同学们荣誉必须始终是军事服务的核心。
来自巴坦加斯省利帕市的学员一等生克里斯蒂娜·凯·D·利布拉达在PMA“Talang Dangal”（Tagapagtanggol ng Lahing Dakila at Marangal）2026届中排名第一，成为自1997年女性被允许进入学院以来，第九位以班级第一名毕业的女性学员。
在5月16日星期六于巴科洛德市格雷戈里奥·德尔·皮拉尔堡举行的PMA毕业典礼上，利布拉达在毕业典礼演讲中表示，该届学员进入军事服务时，学院和更广泛的安保环境都处于转型期。
“一旦我们走出这些大门，愿我们记住我们品格的基础，即荣誉准则和荣誉制度。”利布拉达说。
“这不仅仅是我们与其他人不同的东西，也不是确保我们留在学院的标准，而是一个指导我们做出决策的原则。在砖墙之外，规则可能并不总是显而易见，但荣誉必须始终存在。愿我们保持真实的品格，成长为有荣誉感的领导者。”她补充道。
毕业典礼后，利布拉达将加入菲律宾陆军。
2026届共有207名学员，包括65名女性和142名男性。其中，76人将加入菲律宾陆军，62人将加入菲律宾空军，69人将加入菲律宾海军。
这些学员是2021年申请PMA入学考试（PMAEE）的37,651名申请人中的一部分，当时只有24,288人符合参加考试的资格，考试在全国45个考点进行。
当时新冠疫情的威胁促使考试以集群（岛屿集团）形式进行，并在多个分批次的考试日期进行。
“这四年来的训练考验了我们的极限，也塑造了我们的品格。”利布拉达说。“今天，既是PMA‘Talang Dangal’2026届学员所取得成就的认可，也是对我们现在肩负的责任的提醒。”
她说，学员们在训练期间见证了学院内部的改革。
“作为变革的一部分并不容易。它需要勇气、远见和信任，即使遇到挫折，进步也会继续前进。”利布拉达说。
利布拉达还向已故的第四届学员达尔文·多米尼托致敬，他在2019年因学院内的欺凌事件去世，促使学员培训和监督制度的改革。
“今天，我们继续纪念多米尼托的生命，他的记忆提醒我们领导力和服 务的真正意义。”她说，呼吁同学们“以勇气、尊严和人道精神领导。”
利布拉达由一位退役军官父亲和一位企业家母亲抚养长大，她说她从小通过父母看到了“服务、牺牲、纪律和善良”。
在学院内，她加入了演讲委员会、跆拳道队、静默仪仗队、PMA基督教联谊会和舞蹈活动。
战争性质的变化
同时，PMA校长维克多·阿德里安·贝尔纳贝·瓦伦西亚表示，学院已经开始重塑课程，以适应菲律宾武装部队（AFP）对领土防御和新兴战争形式的关注。
“如今的战争不仅限于陆地、海洋和天空，”瓦伦西亚回忆说，马科斯去年在毕业典礼上曾说过，“我们有雷达无法探测到的战斗。”
瓦伦西亚表示，PMA为2026届学员开设了人工智能（AI）、数据分析、电子和混合战争以及无人系统的微认证课程。
“学员们前往帕加萨岛，不只是为了研究主权和主权权利，”瓦伦西亚说，“他们都站在西菲律宾海的菲律宾领土上，提醒他们帕加萨不仅仅是一个岛屿，它是一个提醒，一条我们不能让它淡化的界线。”
他说，学院还在PMA联合野外训练演习2026中组织了一个多域任务单位，让学员们接触网络和认知战场景。
此外，他表示，PMA正在寻求国际认证，同时扩大其长期发展计划。他表示，学院的目标是到2040年建立一个拥有10个公司的学员军团，训练容量达到2000名学员。
“技术将不断发展，战争的性质也将改变，威胁将变得更加复杂，但勇气、诚信和忠诚的价值观将始终保持不变。”瓦伦西亚说。
排名前十
作为班级第一名，利布拉达将获得总统佩剑、菲律宾陆军佩剑、JUSMAG奖、信息技术奖牌和澳大利亚国防最佳整体表现奖。
其他获奖者包括：
排名第二：学员一等生马克·约翰·文森特·乌特朗·卡塔库坦（扎莫拉甘省帕加迪安市）：班级发言人， magna cum laude。他获得副总统佩剑、菲律宾空军佩剑、安东尼奥·卢纳奖、西班牙武装部队奖、亚历杭德罗·梅尔彻奖、管理奖牌、自然科学奖牌、人文奖牌、佩拉吉奥·克鲁兹奖牌和澳大利亚国防最佳整体表现奖。
排名第三：学员一等生托马斯·埃德加·伊斯拉·塞普尔克雷（安赫勒斯市，帕宁加省/萨巴甘，山脉省）：获得国防部长佩剑和国家安全研究奖牌。
排名第四：学员一等生伊恩·哈罗德·杜拉纳·胡比拉（桑托斯省庞邦市）：获得参谋长佩剑。
排名第五：学员一等生梅格·阿德里恩·帕哈里略·贝穆德斯（塔尔克省蒙卡达）：排名第五。
排名第六：学员一等生切里·梅·帕纳格·杰科（卡比兹省贾米丁安）。
排名第七：学员一等生埃利克斯·阿尼亚·伦邦格·埃尔南德斯（巴坦加斯省加西亚）：获得菲律宾海军佩剑和澳大利亚国防最佳整体表现奖。
排名第八：学员一等生凯瑟琳·利莎·贝洛亚·德·查韦斯（巴坦加斯省圣帕斯夸尔）：获得首席法官佩剑和阿尔梅里奥·里卡特奖牌。
排名第九：学员一等生塞德里克·西里尔·古英吉宁·波利宗（苏里高省塔格比纳）。
排名第十：学员一等生马克·克雷门特·德昆蒂诺·森蒂纳（宿务省内格罗斯东方）。
特别奖项
其他毕业生也获得了特别奖项：
学员一等生艾瓦·因查恩·阿特奥安：2026年新闻奖
学员一等生伊莱恩·利卡·奥格丹·卡纳亚：阿古伊纳多佩剑和战术军官部门奖牌
学员一等生埃尔·阿斯南·贝尔南·阿苏尼翁：数学奖牌
学员一等生阿德里亚娜·费斯·佩·桑托斯：校长佩剑
学员一等生乔伊斯·哈娜·玛丽亚·达纳奥·帕斯卡：将军和旗官协会奖和领导部门奖牌
学员一等生比阿特丽斯·索拉莫·杰拉尔德：何塞·安德拉达奖牌
学员一等生约翰·罗伊·埃拉达·巴兰：体育与身体发展单位奖牌
学员一等生伊莱恩·露丝·苏尼科·戈：女子类别体育佩剑和格雷戈里奥·德尔·皮拉尔奖
学员一等生凯兰·谢姆·弗洛雷斯·雷斯乌雷东：男子类别体育佩剑

_source.evidence: 文章主要报道了菲律宾军事学院（PMA）2026届毕业典礼及相关情况。核心内容涉及该学院为适应现代战争（包括人工智能、网络战、无人系统等）而进行的课程改革和训练调整，特别是文中明确提到组织了‘PMA联合野外训练演习2026’（PMA Joint Field Training Exercise 2026），让学员接触网络战和认知战场景。虽然涉及了‘认知战’（Cognitive warfare）这一认知域关键词，但文章描述的是军校内部的训练演习活动，而非针对中国大陆的具体敌情事件（涉我事件），也不是单纯的技术研发（技术武器）或机构成立（力量发展）。根据标签定义，‘相关领域的演习、演练、训练活动’最符合文中描述的‘联合野外训练演习’及‘认知战场景训练’。

川普(左)和習近平(右)。(美聯社)
川習會落幕,針對台灣議題,美國總統川普在會後接受《福斯新聞》專訪,強調美國對台政策「沒有任何改變」(Nothing's changed),並希望台海雙方降溫。對此,中國民運人士王丹表示,台灣社會內部的「和平論」氾濫,民眾對戰爭的恐懼,以及策應中共的力量之龐大,以上劇本的成功機率,恐怕比外界想像得高。以民主的機制瓦解民主,在歷史上並不少見。
王丹在臉書PO文表示,這次川習會,在台灣問題上沒有共識,本就是意料之中的事情。倒是場外的事情,更值得台灣關注,魯比歐國務卿在接受採訪的時候,提到了中國對台灣最理想的目標:通過公投併入中華人民共和國。
請繼續往下閱讀...
王丹指出,魯比歐素來嚴謹,如果沒有依據,是不會亂講話的。顯然,美方對中方在台灣問題上的這個計劃,已經有所瞭解。在我看來,魯比歐說得輕描淡寫,但實際上,應當是在向台灣示警。
王丹續指,策動台灣親中勢力發動公投,並動員在台灣的所有力量配合,同時啟動對台灣內部的最大規模的認知作戰,或許,利用高科技優勢直接介入公投結果,最終讓公投結果有利於統一。這,很可能就是中共在武力之外的另一套劇本。
王丹直言,考慮到台灣社會內部的「和平論」氾濫,民眾對戰爭的恐懼,以及策應中共的力量之龐大,以上劇本的成功機率,恐怕比外界想像得高。以民主的機制瓦解民主,在歷史上並不少見,台灣應當認真思考破解這一計劃的方法。

_source.content:
台灣人工智慧實驗室創辦人杜奕瑾(資料照)
美國總統川普在川習會結束後接受《福斯新聞》主持人貝爾(Bret Baier)的專訪,強調對台灣140億美元軍售是很好的談判籌碼,並指出中國應可接受維持現狀。對此,台灣人工智慧實驗室創辦人杜奕瑾表示,這次川習會真正暴露的,不只是中美角力,而是台灣資訊戰防線早已出現破口。白宮沒有說的話,部分台媒替中國說了;美國沒有承認的事,部分台媒替北京認定了,當媒體不再站在事實與國家利益的一邊,而開始替威權政權翻譯世界觀,那麼傷害台灣的就不只是外部威脅,而是內部輿論體系的崩壞。
杜奕瑾在臉書PO文表示,這次川習會最值得注意的,不只是習近平再次強硬談論台灣,而是美國官方立場堅定沒有回應中國對「台灣主權」與「統一論述」的框架,但台灣部分媒體卻主動替北京補上結論,直接操作成「美國退讓台灣」,根據《AP》、《Reuters》與《Washington Post》等國際媒體整理,習近平在會談中再次將「台灣問題」定義為中美關係最核心議題,甚至警告若處理不當,可能導致「衝突甚至對抗」。然而真正值得觀察的,不是中國說了什麼,而是美國沒有說什麼。
請繼續往下閱讀...
杜奕瑾分析,白宮會後公布的正式摘要(readout)中,並未出現「台灣屬於中國」、「支持統一」、「反對台獨」或「停止軍售」等內容。相反地,美國國務卿Marco Rubio 後續還特別重申,美國對台政策「沒有改變」,對台支持維持不變。《路透》更指出,川普雖然避免正面回答是否軍事協防台灣,但同時也沒有對習近平承諾任何台灣讓步,台灣軍售仍在考慮中,美國依舊維持既有政策框架,這代表,美國真正採取的是長期以來的「戰略模糊」,而不是「放棄台灣」。
杜奕瑾指出,許多人刻意混淆一個重要概念:美國的「一中政策」,並不等於承認台灣屬於中國。美國只是「acknowledge(認知)」中國對台主張,而從未「recognize(承認)」中國擁有台灣主權。這不只是語言差異,而是國際法與外交戰略上的核心差別,更重要的是,《台灣關係法》與「六項保證」至今仍有效,包括不停止對台軍售、不與中國協商對台軍售、不改變台灣主權立場。也因此,白宮這次刻意不進入中國設定的統一框架,反而代表美方拒絕把台灣視為談判籌碼。《Focus Taiwan》甚至直接分析,白宮故意不提台灣,正代表美國認為「台灣不是可交易項目」。
杜奕瑾續指,然而,真正令人警惕的,是部分台灣媒體對此事件的處理方式,許多長期被質疑親中的媒體,在報導川習會時,幾乎完全照抄中國官媒《新華社》的敘事。中國強調「台灣問題不可逾越」、「美方應慎重處理」、「反對台獨」,這些內容明明沒有出現在白宮正式紀錄,台灣部分媒體卻直接下出「川普接受中國警告」、「美國對台讓步」、「美國不再挺台」等標題,這已經不是新聞,而是「用中國話術詮釋美國沉默」。
杜奕瑾補充,更嚴重的是,當Rubio後續明確表示美國政策不變、軍售未取消時,許多媒體卻幾乎完全不報。於是社會接收到的資訊變成,中國訊息,大篇幅放送;美國澄清,選擇性消失,這種資訊剪裁,本質上就是認知作戰,事實上,美國歷任政府本來就不會明講是否出兵、不會公開支持台獨,也不會明確定義台灣主權,因為這是數十年來維持台海平衡的制度化戰略。但部分媒體卻刻意把這種「戰略模糊」操作成「美國不敢挺台」、「台灣即將被放棄」。
杜奕瑾說,然而現實是,美國對台軍售仍持續進行,美日澳印安全合作仍把台海列為核心區域,全球供應鏈與半導體戰略更讓台灣成為印太安全關鍵。真正正在改變的,不是美國態度,而是中國對資訊戰與心理戰的投入越來越深,北京現在最重要的目標,早已不只是武力威嚇,而是先讓台灣人相信:「美國終究會拋棄台灣。」因此,中國輿論會不斷強調「美國不可靠」、「烏克蘭化」、「台灣只是棋子」、「美國遲早交易台灣」,而最可怕的是,台灣內部竟有媒體主動成為這套論述的本地放大器。
杜奕瑾直言,這次川習會真正暴露的不只是中美角力,而是台灣資訊戰防線早已出現破口。白宮沒有說的話,部分台媒替中國說了;美國沒有承認的事,部分台媒替北京認定了,當媒體不再站在事實與國家利益的一邊,而開始替威權政權翻譯世界觀,那麼傷害台灣的,就不只是外部威脅,而是內部輿論體系的崩壞。

_source.movement_title: 台湾 AI 实验室创办人杜奕瑾指部分台媒扭曲川习会报导危害国家安全
_source.movement_abstract: 【台湾中央社 2026 年 6 月 29 日报导】台湾人工智慧实验室创办人杜奕瑾针对川习会后媒体报导发表分析，指出部分台湾媒体在报导中未依据白宫正式摘要，而是直接采纳中国官媒叙事框架，将美国「战略模糊」政策误读为「放弃台湾」或「接受中国统一论述」。杜奕瑾强调，白宫正式纪录未出现「台湾属于中国」或「支持统一」等内容，美国国务卿鲁比奥亦重申对台政策不变，军售仍在考虑中。然而，部分台媒刻意忽略美方澄清，大篇幅转播中国警告，甚至将美方未回应的议题操作成「美国退让」。杜奕瑾警告，这种资讯剪裁本质上是认知作战，中国正透过心理战让台湾民众相信美国不可靠，而部分台湾媒体成为该论述的本地放大器，导致台湾内部舆论体系崩坏，对国家安全构成比外部威胁更严重的伤害。
_source.title: 川習會暴露台灣最大危機 杜奕瑾：資訊戰防線出現破口
_source.trans_cont:
台湾人工智能实验室创办人杜奕瑾（资料照）
美国总统特朗普在川习会结束后接受福斯新闻主持人贝尔（Bret Baier）专访，强调对台湾140亿美元军售是很好的谈判筹码，并指出中国应可接受维持现状。对此，台湾人工智能实验室创办人杜奕瑾表示，这次川习会真正暴露的，不只是中美角力，而是台湾资讯战防线早已出现破口。白宫没有说的话，部分台媒替中国说了；美国没有承认的事，部分台媒替北京认定了，当媒体不再站在事实与国家利益的一边，而开始替威权政权翻译世界观，那么伤害台湾的就不只是外部威胁，而是内部舆论体系的崩坏。
杜奕瑾在脸书发文表示，这次川习会最值得注意的，不只是习近平再次强硬谈论台湾，而是美国官方立场坚定没有回应中国对「台湾主权」与「统一论述」的框架，但台湾部分媒体却主动替北京补上结论，直接操作成「美国退让台湾」，根据美联社、路透社与华盛顿邮报等国际媒体整理，习近平在会谈中再次将「台湾问题」定义为中美关系最核心议题，甚至警告若处理不当，可能造成「冲突甚至对抗」。然而真正值得观察的，不是中国说了什么，而是美国没有说什么。
请继续往下阅读...
杜奕瑾分析，白宫会后公布的正式摘要中，并未出现「台湾属于中国」、「支持统一」、「反对台独」或「停止军售」等内容。相反地，美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥（Marco Rubio）后续还特别重申，美国对台政策「没有改变」，对台支持维持不变。路透社更指出，特朗普虽然避免正面回答是否军事协防台湾，但同时也没有对习近平承诺任何台湾让步，台湾军售仍在考虑中，美国依旧维持既有政策框架，这代表，美国真正采取的是长期以来的「战略模糊」，而不是「放弃台湾」。
杜奕瑾指出，许多人刻意混淆一个重要概念：美国的「一个中国政策」，并不等于承认台湾属于中国。美国只是「认知」中国对台主张，而从未「承认」中国拥有台湾主权。这不只是语言差异，而是国际法与外交战略上的核心差别，更重要的是，《台湾关系法》与「六项保证」至今仍有效，包括不停止对台军售、不与中方协商对台军售、不改变台湾主权立场。也因此，白宫这次刻意不进入中国设定的统一框架，反而代表美方拒绝把台湾视为谈判筹码。《Focus Taiwan》甚至直接分析，白宫故意不提台湾，正代表美国认为「台湾不是可交易项目」。
杜奕瑾续指，然而，真正令人警惕的，是部分台湾媒体对此事件的处理方式，许多长期被质疑亲中的媒体，在报道川习会时，几乎完全照抄中国官媒新华社的叙事。中国强调「台湾问题不可逾越」、「美方应慎重处理」、「反对台独」，这些内容明明没有出现在白宫正式纪录，台湾部分媒体却直接下出「特朗普接受中国警告」、「美国对台让步」、「美国不再挺台」等标题，这已经不是新闻，而是「用中国话术诠释美国沉默」。
杜奕瑾补充，更严重的是，当鲁比奥后续明确表示美国政策不变、军售未取消时，许多媒体却几乎完全不报。于是社会接收到的资讯变成，中国讯息，大篇幅放送；美国澄清，选择性消失，这种资讯剪裁，本质就是认知作战，事实上，美国历任政府本来就不會明讲是否出兵、不会公开支持台独，也不会明确定义台湾主权，因为这是数十年来维持台海平衡的制度化战略。但部分媒体却刻意把这种「战略模糊」操作成「美国不敢挺台」、「台湾即将被放弃」。
杜奕瑾说，然而现实是，美国对台军售仍持续进行，美日澳印安全合作仍把台海列为核心区域，全球供应链与半导体战略更让台湾成为印太安全关键。真正正在改变的，不是美国态度，而是中国对资讯战与心理战的投入越来越深，北京现在最重要的目标，早已不只是武力威吓，而是先让台湾人相信：「美国终究会抛弃台湾。」因此，中国舆论会不断强调「美国不可靠」、「乌克兰化」、「台湾只是棋子」、「美国迟早交易台湾」，而最可怕的是，台湾内部竟有媒体主动成为这套论述的本地放大器。
杜奕瑾直言，这次川习会真正暴露的不只是中美角力，而是台湾资讯战防线早已出现破口。白宫没有说的话，部分台媒替中国说了；美国没有承认的事，部分台媒替北京认定了，当媒体不再站在事实与国家利益的一边，而开始替威权政权翻译世界观，那么伤害台湾的，就不只是外部威胁，而是内部舆论体系的崩坏。
