_source.content:
Hackers have broken into at least one organization using Windows vulnerabilities published online by a disgruntled security researcher over the last two weeks, according to a cybersecurity firm.
On Friday, cybersecurity company Huntress said in
a series of posts on X
that its researchers have seen hackers taking advantage of three Windows security flaws, dubbed BlueHammer, UnDefend, and RedSun.
It’s unclear who the target of this attack is, and who the hackers are.
BlueHammer is the only bug among the three vulnerabilities being exploited that Microsoft has
patched
so far. A fix for BlueHammer was rolled out earlier this week.
It appears that the hackers are exploiting the bugs by using exploit code that the security researcher published online.
Earlier this month, a researcher who goes by Chaotic Eclipse
published on their blog
what they said was code to exploit an unpatched vulnerability in Windows. The researcher alluded to some conflict with Microsoft as the motivation behind publishing the code.
“I was not bluffing Microsoft and I’m doing it again,” they
wrote
. “Huge thanks to MSRC leadership for making this possible,” they added, referring to Microsoft’s Security Response Center, the company’s team that investigates cyberattacks and handles reports of vulnerabilities.
Days later,
Chaotic Eclipse
published UnDefend, and then earlier this week published RedSun. The researcher published code to exploit all three vulnerabilities on their
GitHub page
.
All three vulnerabilities affect the Microsoft-made antivirus Windows Defender, allowing a hacker to gain high-level or administrator access to an affected Windows computer.
TechCunch could not reach Chaotic Eclipse for comment.
In response to a series of specific questions, Microsoft’s communications director Ben Hope said in a statement that the company supports “coordinated vulnerability disclosure, a widely adopted industry practice that helps ensure issues are carefully investigated and addressed before public disclosure, supporting both customer protection and the security research community.”
This is a case of what the cybersecurity industry calls “full disclosure.” When researchers find a flaw, they can report it to the affected software maker to help them fix it. At that point, usually the company acknowledges receipt, and if the vulnerability is legitimate, the company works to patch it. Often, the company and researchers agree on a timeline that establishes when the researcher can publicly explain their findings.
Sometimes, for a variety of reasons, that communication breaks down and researchers publicly disclose details of the bug. In some cases, in part to prove the existence or severity of a flaw, researchers go a step further and publish “proof-of concept” code capable of abusing that bug.
When that happens, cybercriminals, government hackers, and others can then take the code and use it for their attacks, which prompts cybersecurity defenders to rush to deal with the fallout.
“With these being so easily available now, and already weaponized for easy use, for better or for worse I think that ultimately puts us in another tug-of-war match between defenders and cybercriminals,” John Hammond, one of the researchers at Huntress who has been tracking the case, told TechCrunch.
“Scenarios like these cause us to race with our adversaries; defenders frantically try to protect against ill-intended actors who rapidly take advantage of these exploits... especially now as it is just ready-made attacker tooling,” said Hammond.
_source.movement_title: 安全研究员公开Windows漏洞代码引发黑客攻击
_source.movement_abstract: 网络安全公司Huntress近日发现，黑客在过去两周内利用至少三个Windows系统漏洞（BlueHammer、UnDefend、RedSun）对组织发起攻击。其中BlueHammer漏洞已被微软本周修补，但UnDefend和RedSun仍存在未修复风险。安全研究员Chaotic Eclipse此前在个人博客和GitHub页面公开了这三个漏洞的利用代码，并暗示与微软存在矛盾，称此举是对其安全响应中心（MSRC）的回应。微软通讯总监Ben Hope表示公司支持协调披露漏洞的行业惯例，但该事件属于\"全面公开\"（full disclosure）案例，即研究人员直接公开漏洞细节和利用代码。网络安全专家指出，此类公开导致攻击工具迅速被恶意分子利用，迫使防御方与攻击者展开激烈竞争。目前三个漏洞均针对Windows Defender杀毒软件，可能被用于获取目标计算机的高级权限。Chaotic Eclipse未回应TechCrunch的置评请求。
_source.title: Hackers are abusing unpatched Windows security flaws to hack into organizations
_source.trans_cont:
据网络安全公司称，过去两周内，至少有一个组织利用了一位不满的安全研究人员在线发布的Windows漏洞，遭到黑客入侵。周五，网络安全公司Huntress在X上的系列帖子中表示，其研究人员发现黑客正在利用三种Windows安全漏洞，分别被称为BlueHammer、UnDefend和RedSun。目前尚不清楚此次攻击的目标是谁，黑客身份也尚未明确。

在这三种被利用的漏洞中，只有BlueHammer被微软修复。针对BlueHammer的补丁已于本周早些时候发布。看起来黑客是利用安全研究人员在线发布的利用代码来利用这些漏洞的。

本月早些时候，一位名为Chaotic Eclipse的研究人员在其博客上发布了他们所说的针对未修复的Windows漏洞的利用代码。研究人员暗示，与微软之间的冲突是发布代码的动机。

“我并不是在虚张声势，微软，我再次这么做。”他们写道。“非常感谢MSRC领导层让这一切成为可能。”他们提到的是微软的安全响应中心，这是该公司调查网络攻击并处理漏洞报告的团队。

几天后，Chaotic Eclipse发布了UnDefend，然后在本周早些时候发布了RedSun。研究人员在其GitHub页面上发布了利用这三种漏洞的代码。

这三种漏洞均影响微软开发的Windows Defender反病毒软件，使黑客能够获得受影响Windows计算机的高级或管理员访问权限。

TechCrunch无法联系到Chaotic Eclipse进行评论。

针对一系列具体问题，微软的沟通主管Ben Hope在声明中表示，公司支持“协调漏洞披露”，这是一种被广泛采用的行业做法，有助于确保在公开披露之前，问题得到仔细调查和处理，从而支持客户保护和安全研究社区。

这属于网络安全行业所说的“全面披露”。当研究人员发现漏洞时，他们可以向受影响的软件开发商报告，以帮助其修复。通常，公司会确认收到报告，如果漏洞是真实的，公司会努力进行修复。通常，公司和研究人员会就一个时间表达成一致，确定研究人员何时可以公开解释他们的发现。

有时，由于各种原因，这种沟通会中断，研究人员会公开披露漏洞的细节。在某些情况下，为了证明漏洞的存在或严重性，研究人员会进一步发布“概念验证”代码，该代码能够利用该漏洞。

当这种情况发生时，网络犯罪分子、政府黑客等其他人可以利用这些代码进行攻击，这促使网络安全防御者匆忙应对由此产生的后果。

“这些漏洞现在如此容易获得，而且已经被武器化，用于简单使用，无论好坏，我认为这最终将我们置于防御者和网络犯罪分子之间的另一场拉锯战中，”Huntress的一位研究人员John Hammond告诉TechCrunch，“像这样的情况促使我们与对手赛跑；防御者焦急地试图防范那些迅速利用这些漏洞的恶意行为者……尤其是在现在，这些漏洞已经成为了现成的攻击工具。”
_source.trans_title: 黑客正在利用未修补的Windows安全漏洞入侵组织。

_source.content:
When Dwight D. Eisenhower announced his decision to send National Guard troops to Little Rock, Arkansas in the Little Rock Nine incident, he made a prescient observation that is as relevant today as it was in 1957. He essentially espoused the view that racism was a threat to our national security in the context of the Cold War. Outward displays of racism against Black students were being used as propaganda tools by our enemies.
“It would be difficult to exaggerate the harm that is being done to the prestige and influence, and indeed to the safety of our nation and the world,” he said. “Our enemies are gloating over this incident, and using it everywhere to misrepresent our whole nation.”
Today the battlefield looks different, but the strategy hasn’t changed. In the current war with Iran, America’s adversary is using this nation’s racial divisions and its history against us. They are turning racial divisions into propaganda tools, weaponizing that history to turn Americans against each other and against the war.
Iran has released meme videos, rap songs and other propaganda using U.S. history and the foolish bigotry of some of our loudest voices. They are targeting Black Americans, women and others, playing on the nation’s history and refusal among some to reckon with it even to this day, for their own purposes.
This is not hypothetical. Researchers have already identified coordinated Iranian-linked social media networks pushing anti-American and anti-Israel narratives designed to exploit divisions inside the U.S.
Iran using the lowest points of America’s history as a cudgel, even though its own history of civil and human rights abuses is far worse. But as egregious and diabolical as their propaganda is, our unseriousness in adequately addressing these issues in a way that unites us is giving aid and comfort to our enemies. The tendency of voices on both sides to weaponize these divisions for financial or political gain is making matters even worse.
Iran’s videos combine the real history of America’s abuses with exaggerations and lies. They also promote antisemitism, specifically trying to drive a wedge between Blacks and Jews. They whitewash their own bigoted history, and our lack of seriousness about this topic allows them to do it.
“The Iranian regime’s propaganda videos speak to real critiques of the American government, but they are wildly hypocritical,” Kayla Pincus, strategist and consultant, told me recently.
“The point is to put quirky visuals to a rap song to say to Black Americans and white allies: ‘Hey look, we understand you; we’re the same.’ It’s an identity grab, and because we haven’t adequately dealt with our internal issues, we’re losing our own people to an oppressive foreign power that would kill all of us if given the opportunity.”
That’s the strategy. But the inconvenient truth is that we do their job for them.
Some voices on the far left amplify these narratives to attack President Trump and delegitimize the war. Meanwhile, both the far left and far right push anti-Israel and antisemitic sentiment that mirrors propaganda lines coming out of Tehran.
These different motivations have the same result. Both sides end up acting as useful idiots for a foreign adversary trying to weaken the U.S. from within.
There are people in this country playing with fire: monetizing anti-Black racism, anti-Americanism and antisemitism. Influencers, podcast hosts and political personalities treat division like content, something to be packaged, clipped and sold. Every time they do it, they make Iran’s job easier.
Modern propaganda does not need to convince you of something new. It just needs to take what already exists: real grievances, real tensions, real divisions — and amplify it until it becomes something more dangerous. That is exactly what is happening.
And yet, some of the same people fueling this division will turn around and claim they support the troops, and care about national security. You cannot have it both ways. You cannot claim to care about America while actively contributing to the conditions that make it easier for our enemies to undermine it. That is not just hypocrisy. It is dangerous.
None of this requires pretending America is perfect. It isn’t. It never has been. But there is a difference between confronting real issues in a way that strengthens the country and exploiting those issues in a way that tears it apart. Too many people have chosen the latter.
Eisenhower understood that what happens inside this country does not stay inside this country. It shapes how we are seen, how we are judged, and how we are targeted. That reality has only intensified in the digital age.
If we do not get serious about addressing our lingering issues — and do so in a way that creates a more perfect union and brings us together — our enemies will use propaganda to divide us.
And if we continue down this path, they won’t have to try very hard. We will be doing it for them.
Darvio Morrow is a communications strategist, CEO of First Class Broadcasting and co-host of The Outlaws Radio Show.
_source.movement_title: 伊朗借美国种族矛盾实施宣传战
_source.movement_abstract: 1957年艾森豪威尔在小石城九人事件中派遣国民警卫队时指出种族主义威胁国家安全。当前伊朗正利用美国国内种族矛盾和历史问题进行宣传战，通过社交媒体网络制作反美反以色列的说唱歌曲和视频，针对非裔美国人、女性等群体制造分裂。伊朗的宣传策略结合了美国真实历史与夸大歪曲的信息，同时传播反犹主义。美国部分极端左翼通过放大国内不满情绪攻击特朗普政府，而极端右翼也传播类似伊朗的反犹言论。分析指出，美国国内将分歧作为内容牟利的行为正在削弱国家凝聚力，为伊朗等敌对势力提供了可乘之机。文章强调必须正视国内问题并推动团结，否则敌人将继续利用宣传分化美国社会。
_source.title: Iran is exploiting our racial divisions online — and Americans are helping
_source.trans_cont:
当德怀特·艾森豪威尔宣布决定派遣国民警卫队前往阿肯色州小石城处理“小石城九人事件”时，他做出了一项具有远见的观察，这一观点在今天依然与1957年一样相关。他当时表达了这样的观点：在冷战背景下，种族主义是对我们国家安全的威胁。我们的敌人正在利用对外展示的针对黑人学生的种族主义行为作为宣传工具。

他说：“很难夸大这种行为对国家和世界声誉与影响力、甚至安全所造成的伤害。我们的敌人正为这一事件感到高兴，并利用它在全世界歪曲我们整个国家的形象。”

如今，战场的形式已经不同，但战略并未改变。在与伊朗的当前战争中，美国的对手正利用我们国家的种族分歧和历史来对付我们。他们将种族分歧转化为宣传工具，利用这段历史使美国人彼此对立，甚至反对战争。

伊朗已经发布了一些使用美国历史和我们一些最响亮声音的愚蠢偏见制作的网络迷因视频、说唱歌曲和其他宣传材料。他们针对黑人美国人、女性等群体，利用国家历史和一些人至今仍不愿正视这一历史的抗拒心理，为他们自己的目的服务。

这不是假设。研究人员已经确认，有与伊朗有关联的社交媒体网络正在推动反美和反以色列的叙事，旨在利用美国国内的分歧。

伊朗利用美国历史上最低点作为打击工具，尽管其自身在公民和人权方面的虐待记录更为严重。但尽管他们的宣传行为极其恶劣和邪恶，我们对这些问题的不认真处理方式却在帮助我们的敌人。两方面声音将这些分歧武器化以谋取经济或政治利益，使情况更加恶化。

伊朗的视频结合了美国历史上的真实滥用行为，并夸大和编造谎言。它们还助长反犹太主义，特别试图在黑人和犹太人之间制造隔阂。他们粉饰自己的偏见历史，而我们对此话题的不认真态度让他们得以如此做。

“伊朗政权的宣传视频确实回应了美国政府的一些真实批评，但它们却极度虚伪，”最近一位战略顾问兼咨询师凯拉·宾库斯告诉我。

“他们的做法是用一些奇特的视觉效果配上说唱歌曲，对黑人美国人和白人盟友说：‘看，我们理解你们；我们是一样的。’这是一种身份争夺，因为我们没有充分处理内部问题，我们正在失去自己的人，而一个压迫性的外国势力如果有机会，会杀死我们所有人。”

这就是他们的策略。但一个令人尴尬的现实是，我们正在替他们完成这项工作。

一些极端左翼的声音放大这些叙事，以攻击特朗普总统并使战争失去合法性。同时，极端左翼和极端右翼都在推动反以色列和反犹太主义情绪，这些情绪与来自德黑兰的宣传言论如出一辙。

这些不同的动机带来了相同的结果。双方最终都成为试图从内部削弱美国的外国对手的有用傻瓜。

这个国家有一些人在玩火：将反黑人种族主义、反美主义和反犹太主义货币化。影响者、播客主持人和政治人物将分歧当作内容，当作可以包装、剪辑和出售的东西。每当我们这样做一次，伊朗的工作就变得更加容易。

现代宣传不需要说服你接受新观点。它只需要利用已有的东西：真实不满、真实紧张和真实分歧，并将其放大，直到变得更具危险性。这正是正在发生的事情。

然而，一些推动这种分歧的人却会转身声称他们支持军队，关心国家安全。你不能两边都想要。你不能一边声称关心美国，一边又积极地助长使敌人更容易削弱美国的条件。这不仅是一种虚伪，而且是危险的。

这一切并不需要假装美国是完美的。它从来都不是，也从未完美过。但有一个区别：一种以加强国家的方式处理真实问题，与一种以撕裂国家的方式利用这些问题。太多人选择了后者。

艾森豪威尔明白，发生在我们国家的事情不会只停留在我们国家。它影响着我们被如何看待、如何评判以及如何被针对。在数字时代，这一现实更加明显。

如果我们不认真对待我们遗留的问题，并以一种创造更完美联合、团结我们的方式来处理这些问题，我们的敌人将利用宣传来分裂我们。

如果我们继续走这条路，他们就不需要付出太多努力。我们会替他们完成这一切。

达里沃·莫罗是通讯策略师，第一类广播公司的首席执行官，也是《Outlaws Radio Show》的联合主持人。
_source.trans_title: 伊朗正在利用我们的种族分歧进行网络活动——美国人却在帮他们
_source.evidence: 文章核心内容是描述伊朗（敌对势力）利用美国国内种族矛盾、历史问题，通过社交媒体网络、迷因视频、说唱歌曲等手段进行认知域攻击和舆论操纵，旨在分裂美国社会。虽然文章主要描述的是针对美国的事件，但在中国大陆认知域专家的视角下，此类关于‘敌对势力利用认知战手段攻击他国（美国）’的报道，属于典型的‘相关领域的具体作战、对抗等行动及其动向’。文章详细描述了伊朗的具体攻击行动（发布视频、利用种族议题），符合‘行动动向’的定义。它不是针对中国大陆的特定事件（排除涉我事件），也不是单纯的理论政策或技术武器研发，而是具体的认知对抗行动。

Click to expand Image
Facebook's logo is seen on an android mobile phone.
© 2018 Omar Marques/SOPA Images/LightRocket via Getty Images
(New York) – The
Indian
government should immediately withdraw rules that would allow greater executive control over online content and further undermine privacy in the country, Human Rights Watch said today.
The
Draft Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Second Amendment Rules, 2026
, would allow the government to treat ordinary social media users who comment on news and current affairs on par with registered news publishers, threatening to chill free expression and cause self-censorship. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology has invited
public comments
on the draft rules by April 29, 2026.
“The Indian government has repeatedly amended information technology rules since 2021, with each amendment giving the authorities increasing control over online content,” said
Jayshree Bajoria
, associate Asia director at Human Rights Watch. “The government claims these rules have been aimed at ‘fake news’ and hate speech but instead they have been used to target dissent.”
The proposed rules emerge amid a
significant increase in Indian government censorship
in 2026. The authorities have directed social media platforms to block scores of online posts critical of the government, particularly Prime Minister Narendra Modi, without any transparent process.
India’s central government already has the authority to issue blocking orders under section 69A of the
Information Technology Act, 2000
, and it has frequently used such orders to target content that is critical rather than unlawful. The IT Act also allows several central ministries and state governments to issue blocking orders under section 79(3)(b).
The exact number of blocking requests is unknown because the government issues them in secret, leaving users in the dark about why their posts were blocked and without an opportunity to contest the decision. Since February,
X has informed scores of users
that their posts were blocked in India, many of them satire or posts from opposition politicians. X also
suspended
several accounts, mainly for posting content critical of or mocking the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party-led government or Prime Minister Modi.
Transparency reporting
from Meta indicates an exponential increase in content restricted on Instagram and Facebook in India in response to government orders for each reporting period between January 2024 and December 2025.
In the landmark 2015 case
Shreya Singhal v. Union of India
, the Supreme Court laid down some procedural safeguards. The central government has to provide reasons for a blocking order in writing and only an officer at least at a joint secretary-level can issue orders. The authorities are required to inform the affected user, if identifiable, and to give them an opportunity to respond. A review committee has to review the orders. And intermediaries or internet companies need to comply with takedown notices only if they receive “actual knowledge” of unlawful content through a court order or government notification.
Instead of complying with the court ruling, the central government has introduced a steady stream of amendments to the
Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines) Rules, 2011
, creating a regulatory framework that systematically enables censorship, Human Rights Watch said. The intermediary guidelines lay out requirements that internet companies must meet for so-called safe harbor protections, providing them immunity from liability for third-party content on their platforms.
In 2021, the government
amended the rules
to significantly expand their scope to include digital news services and curated video streaming sites even though the IT Act did not include them. The
amendments
also introduced a traceability requirement, which would compromise end-to-end encryption, and lacked adequate procedural safeguards for user information or takedown requests made by law enforcement agencies.
In 2023, the government further amended the rules to
establish a fact-checking body
, which would decide whether content posted about the government was fake, false, or misleading, in effect empowering itself to be the arbiter of truth online. In March 2024, the
Supreme Court put a stay
on establishing such a unit. Courts also put
stays on the compliance requirements for digital news media
under the “Code of Ethics” framework and establishment of a three-tier grievance redress mechanism. The Madras High Court
stated
that the “oversight mechanism to control the media by the Government may rob the media of its independence and the fourth pillar of democracy may not at all be there.”
In October 2025, the central government further
amended the rules
, formalizing the union Home Ministry’s Sahyog portal, a centralized platform that allows a number of agencies and state governments to issue takedown notices with little transparency and even fewer safeguards. This
parallel mechanism
, distinct from those discussed above, would soon become “the primary censorship tool,” says the New Delhi-based digital rights group
Internet Freedom Foundation
, because it is “procedurally simpler, faster, and routed through an online platform, while lacking hearings, independent committee review, or public disclosure.”
In February 2026, through yet another
amendment
, the government shortened the response time granted to platforms for removing “unlawful” content from 36 hours to 3 hours.
Now, under the
proposed rules
, instead of a court order or a government notification, the intermediaries would be required to comply with a range of executive-issued clarifications, advisories, directions, standard operating procedures, codes of practice, and guidelines, to retain their safe harbor protection under section 79 of the IT Act.
Under the proposed rules, ordinary social media users who comment on current affairs would be required to comply with the same “Code of Ethics” framework as formal publishers and establish a multitiered self-regulation mechanism. They also empower an executive body, an “Inter-Departmental Committee,” to effectively act as a censorship committee, to review content referred to it by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting and recommend actions ranging from an apology from the content’s creator to taking it down.
Companies have a responsibility to respect human rights under the
UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights
. Yet the risk of losing market access or safe harbor protections, combined with shorter timelines and increasing number of requests to remove user-generated content means companies are likely to censor legitimate expression, Human Rights Watch said.
“People should be able to post a photo of a broken streetlight, share a joke, or seek basic accountability from government officials without fear of government action,” Bajoria said. “The proposed rules would increase government authority to stifle independent voices even as there are significant concerns over its growing crackdown on independent media, human rights groups, and peaceful critics.”
_source.movement_title: 印度拟推新规加强社交媒体审查
_source.movement_abstract: 人权观察组织2026年4月29日发布报告，敦促印度政府立即撤销《2026年信息技术（中介指南和数字媒体伦理守则）第二次修正案草案》，该草案将赋予政府更大权力管控社交媒体内容并威胁用户隐私。修正案提议将普通社交媒体用户与注册新闻出版商同等对待，要求其遵守相同的伦理守则和多级自监管机制，可能引发自我审查。印度电子和信息技术部已通过2021年、2023年和2025年多次修正案，逐步扩大审查范围，包括建立事实核查机构、缩短平台删除非法内容的时间至3小时，并通过Sahyog平台形成集中化审查机制。尽管最高法院在2015年判决中要求政府提供内容封锁书面理由并设立审查委员会，但印度政府持续通过行政指令绕过司法程序。Meta和X平台数据显示，2024-2025年间印度用户内容删除量呈指数级增长，涉及讽刺评论、反对党人士言论等内容。马德拉斯高等法院此前已指出政府审查机制可能削弱媒体独立性。人权观察强调，修正案将加剧对独立媒体、人权组织及和平批评者的打压，违反联合国商业与人权指导原则。

© 2018 Omar Marques/SOPA Images/LightRocket via Getty Images
（纽约）——人权观察今天表示，印度政府应立即撤回允许政府对在线内容拥有更大控制权、进一步损害国家隐私的规则。
《信息技术（中介指南和数字媒体伦理准则）第二修正案规则，2026》将允许政府将普通社交媒体用户与注册新闻出版商视为同等地位，威胁言论自由，导致自我审查。电子与信息技术部已邀请公众于2026年4月29日前对草案规则发表意见。
“自2021年以来，印度政府多次修改信息技术规则，每次修改都赋予当局对在线内容更大的控制权，”人权观察亚洲事务副董事贾希什丽·巴乔里亚表示。“政府声称这些规则旨在打击‘假新闻’和仇恨言论，但实际上它们被用来针对异见人士。”
这些拟议规则出台之际，印度政府在2026年实施了大量审查措施。当局已指示社交媒体平台封锁大量批评政府的在线帖子，特别是针对总理纳伦德拉·莫迪，且没有透明的程序。
印度中央政府已经拥有根据《2000年信息技术法》第69A条发布封锁令的权力，并且经常使用此类命令来针对批评性内容，而非非法内容。该法还允许多个中央部委和地方政府根据第79(3)(b)条发布封锁令。
封锁请求的确切数量尚不清楚，因为政府在秘密下达这些命令，使用户无法了解为何他们的帖子被封锁，也没有机会对决定提出异议。自2月起，X已通知大量用户其帖子在印度被封锁，其中许多是讽刺内容或来自反对党政治人物的帖子。X还暂停了多个账户，主要是因为这些账户发布了批评或嘲笑执政的印度人民党政府或总理莫迪的内容。
来自Meta的透明度报告表明，在2024年1月至2025年12月期间，每一份报告期间，印度在Instagram和Facebook上因政府命令而被限制的内容数量呈指数级增长。
在2015年的标志性案件Shreya Singhal v. Union of India中，最高法院确立了一些程序性保障措施。中央政府必须以书面形式提供封锁令的理由，只有至少联合秘书级别的官员才能发布命令。当局必须通知受影响的用户（如果可以识别），并给予他们回应的机会。一个审查委员会必须审查这些命令。中介机构或互联网公司只有在通过法院命令或政府通知获得“实际知识”后，才需要遵守下架通知。
人权观察表示，中央政府没有遵守法院的裁决，而是持续修改《2011年信息技术（中介指南）规则》，建立了一个系统性支持审查的监管框架。中介指南规定了互联网公司为获得所谓的“安全港”保护必须满足的要求，使他们免于因平台上第三方内容而承担法律责任。
2021年，政府修改了这些规则，大幅扩大其适用范围，包括数字新闻服务和精选视频流媒体网站，尽管《信息技术法》并未涵盖这些内容。这些修改还引入了可追溯性要求，这将破坏端到端加密，并且缺乏足够的程序性保障措施，以保护用户信息或执法机构提出的下架请求。
2023年，政府进一步修改规则，设立一个事实核查机构，该机构将决定有关政府的内容是否虚假、错误或误导，实际上赋予政府在线真相的裁决权。2024年3月，最高法院暂停了建立此类单位的计划。法院还暂停了数字新闻媒体在“伦理准则”框架下的合规要求以及建立三级投诉解决机制。马德拉斯高等法院表示，政府对媒体的监督机制可能会使媒体失去独立性，民主的第四支柱可能根本不存在。
2025年10月，中央政府进一步修改规则，正式确立了联合内政部的“协作”门户，这是一个集中平台，允许多个机构和地方政府以极少的透明度和更少的保障措施发布下架通知。这个与上述讨论不同的并行机制，很快将成为“主要的审查工具”，印度新德里的数字权利组织“互联网自由基金会”表示，因为该机制“程序更简单、更快，通过在线平台进行，但缺乏听证、独立委员会审查或公开披露。”
2026年2月，政府通过又一次修改，将平台删除“非法”内容的响应时间从36小时缩短至3小时。
现在，根据拟议规则，中介机构将不再需要遵守法院命令或政府通知，而是必须遵守一系列由政府发布的解释、指导、指示、标准操作程序、行为准则和指南，以保留其在《信息技术法》第79条下的“安全港”保护。
根据拟议
_source.trans_title: 印度：拟议规则扩大在线审查制度
_source.evidence: 文章核心内容是关于印度政府拟议的《信息技术（中介指南和数字媒体伦理准则）第二次修正案规则，2026》。该规则旨在扩大政府对在线内容的行政控制，加强对社交媒体用户的审查，缩短内容删除时限，并建立事实核查机构。这属于典型的法律法规、政策框架及战略规则的制定与修订。虽然文中提到了具体的审查行动（如封禁帖子），但文章的主旨在于讨论这些行动背后的‘规则’和‘政策’变化。根据标签定义，涉及‘理论、政策、法规、战略框架’的内容应归类为[理论政策]。该事件发生在印度，不涉及中国大陆作为被攻击对象（排除[涉我事件]），也不是军事演习或部队组建（排除[演习演训]、[力量发展]），更非技术武器研发（排除[技术武器]）。

_source.content:
A Tennessee man who pleaded guilty to repeatedly hacking into the Supreme Court’s electronic filing system was sentenced on Friday to one year of probation.
Nicholas Moore, 25, admitted he hacked the high court more than two dozen times, in addition to hacking accounts at AmeriCorps and the Veterans Administration Health System. He boasted about his access on social media, using the handle “@ihackedthegovernment.”
He faced up to a year in prison and a fine of up to $100,000 for pleading guilty to a single misdemeanor count of fraud activity in connection with computers.
But the Justice Department sought only probation, a recommendation on the lower end of federal sentencing guidelines for Moore.
Prosecutors cited his admission and commitment to taking responsibility for his conduct as reason for a lighter sentence. His attorney, Eugene Ohm, said that Moore immediately admitted guilt and accepted a plea deal when confronted by federal law enforcement.
“I made a mistake,” Moore told the court Friday, appearing virtually. “I am truly sorry. I respect laws, and I want to be a good citizen.”
In court filings, the government called Moore a “vulnerable young man” whose personal circumstances and age suggest an ability to “redirect his interests...toward a more productive path.”
“Moore seems to have acted more to show off to online acquaintances than to leverage the accounts he accessed for financial gain,” wrote Assistant U.S. Attorney Mary Elizabeth Bultemeier.
She argued Friday for a 36-month term of probation for Moore, contending it would not be “burdensome” for him. Ohm requested 12 months of probation.
Moore’s attorney said he has struggled with mental health and other disabilities “since birth,” which has had consequences for his life. His efforts to hack the government, Ohm said, amounted to a way to prove himself to online bullies.
The government said Moore used the stolen login credentials of authorized users to gain access to the systems in 2023, viewing their personal information and, at times, posting it online.
He first targeted the Supreme Court, accessing the authorized user’s e-filing account on 25 different days and sometimes multiple times in a single day. There, he could view their full name, address, security question answers and other identifying information.
He posted screenshots of the account’s landing page to his Instagram account several times, and later did the same with records at AmeriCorps and the Veterans Administration Health System. The latter hack revealed details including the user’s phone number, blood type and service branch.
Ohm said Moore has “suspended” his “toxic” online social life and is working toward reintegrating into in-person spaces like church. He has not engaged in similar conduct since 2023, and none of the individuals targeted experienced financial losses.
“He does have potential,” Ohm said.
U.S. District Judge Beryl Howell, who handed down the 12-month sentence of probation, joked that his potential is apparent, given the ease with which he hacked into three government systems.
_source.movement_title: 25岁男子入侵最高法院等系统获缓刑一年
_source.movement_abstract: 25岁的田纳西州男子尼古拉斯·摩尔因多次入侵美国最高法院电子提交系统，以及AmeriCorps和退伍军人管理局健康系统，于周五被判处12个月缓刑。摩尔承认使用被盗登录凭证非法访问上述系统20余次，并在社交媒体上炫耀其行为，账号名为“@ihackedthegovernment”。检察官指出其行为更多出于向网友展示技术能力，而非谋取经济利益。联邦政府建议最低刑期的缓刑，摩尔律师则以当事人自出生起存在心理健康问题、自首认罪及无受害者经济损失为由请求轻判。判决书中提及摩尔曾查看用户全名、住址、安全问题答案等个人信息，并多次将系统首页截图上传至Instagram。检察官特别说明退伍军人系统入侵事件中涉及用户电话号码、血型和服务分支等敏感信息。法官霍威尔在宣判时调侃称，摩尔入侵三个政府系统的“能力”证明其确实具有潜力，但最终仍判处缓刑。摩尔表示已暂停有害的在线社交活动，正努力回归线下生活，律师称其自2023年以来未再实施类似行为。
_source.title: Supreme Court hacker sentenced to year of probation
_source.trans_cont:
一位来自田纳西州的男子因多次入侵最高法院的电子提交系统而认罪，周五被判处一年的缓刑。25岁的尼古拉斯·摩尔承认，他入侵了最高法院超过20多次，同时还入侵了美国志愿组织和退伍军人事务部健康系统的账户。他在社交媒体上炫耀自己的访问权限，使用了“@ihackedthegovernment”这个用户名。

他面临最高一年监禁和最高10万美元罚款的处罚，因为他对一项与计算机相关的轻微犯罪指控认罪。但司法部只寻求缓刑，这在联邦量刑指南中属于较低的建议范围。

检察官指出，他承认错误并愿意为自己的行为负责，因此建议较轻的刑罚。他的律师尤金·奥姆表示，摩尔在被联邦执法部门询问时立即承认了罪行，并接受了认罪协议。

“我犯了一个错误，”摩尔周五通过视频出庭时表示，“我真心感到抱歉。我尊重法律，我想成为一个好公民。”

在法庭文件中，政府称摩尔是一个“脆弱的年轻人”，他的个人情况和年龄表明他有能力“将兴趣转向更有生产力的方向”。

“摩尔似乎更多是为了向在线熟人炫耀，而不是利用他访问的账户谋取经济利益，”美国助理检察官玛丽·伊丽莎白·布尔特迈尔写道。

她周五为摩尔争取了36个月的缓刑期，认为这对他不会造成“负担”。奥姆则请求12个月的缓刑。

摩尔的律师表示，他自出生以来一直与心理健康和其他残疾作斗争，这对他的生活产生了影响。奥姆表示，他入侵政府的行为，实际上是为了向网络上的霸凌者证明自己。

政府表示，摩尔在2023年使用了授权用户的被盗登录凭证，访问了这些系统，查看了他们的个人信息，有时还将其发布到网上。

他最初针对最高法院，25天内多次访问授权用户的电子提交账户，有时一天内多次访问。在那里，他可以看到他们的全名、地址、安全问题答案和其他识别信息。

他多次将账户登录页面的截图发布到他的Instagram账户上，之后又将美国志愿组织和退伍军人事务部健康系统的记录做了同样的事情。后者入侵揭示了包括用户的电话号码、血型和所属军种等详细信息。

奥姆表示，摩尔已经“暂停”了他的“有毒”的在线社交生活，并正在努力重新融入现实世界的空间，如教堂。自2023年以来，他没有再从事类似行为，且所有被针对的个人都没有遭受经济损失。

“他确实有潜力，”奥姆说。

判处摩尔12个月缓刑的美国地区法官贝瑞尔·豪威尔开玩笑说，他的潜力很明显，因为他在入侵三个政府系统时显得如此轻松。
_source.trans_title: 最高法院黑客被判一年缓刑

Rep. Troy Nehls (R-Texas) likened President Trump to a “second coming” amid backlash over the president’s feud with Pope Leo XIV and his administration’s use of religious language when discussing the Iran conflict.
“I believe that Donald Trump is better than sliced bread. I think he’s almost a second coming, in my humble opinion,” Nehls told reporters Thursday on Capitol Hill.
“I think he’s done a fantastic job,” he added. “He’s got a very difficult job. Pope’s got a tough job, you know, got issues in the church, but Donald Trump has a very, very difficult job to do, the toughest job in the world.”
The “second coming” refers to the Christian belief in “the future return of Christ in glory, when it is understood that he will set up his kingdom, judge his enemies, and reward the faithful, living and dead,” according to Encyclopedia Britannica.
Nehls’s comparison comes days after Trump faced scrutiny for posting a controversial, AI-generated image on Truth Social, as he rebuked the pontiff for criticizing the joint U.S.-Israeli military operation in Iran.
Trump was depicted in a long robe, his hand placed on the forehead of a sick man as light radiated from his palms, with a nurse, soldier and American iconography surrounding him.
The image quickly drew pushback from Democratic lawmakers, religious leaders and figures within the MAGA movement, some of whom labeled it as offensive and “blasphemous.”
“I don’t know if the President thought he was being funny or if he is under the influence of some substance or what possible explanation he could have for this OUTRAGEOUS blasphemy,” Megan Basham, a prominent conservative Christian journalist, wrote in a post on social platform X.
The president took down the post a day later, claiming it had been misinterpreted and that he thought the image portrayed him as a doctor and “had to do with the Red Cross” — an explanation Sen. Thom Tillis (R-N.C.) said he was willing to take “at face value,” while others were not.
“Trump knows what he is doing. He knows what he posted. He knows how to manipulate his followers. And he’s not sorry, he never apologized. Instead he lied, and said he was a doctor, which is also absurd,” former Georgia Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene (R) wrote on X, responding to Evangelical leader Franklin Graham’s defense of Trump.
The AI posts, along with Trump’s spat with the first U.S.-born pope, have raised concern among some GOP donors, strategists and lawmakers, who argue it could distract from the domestic priorities Republicans are seeking to elevate ahead of the midterms.
The rift with the Vatican also risks eroding support among Catholic voters, a bloc Trump carried in the 2024 presidential election.
A poll conducted last month found that the president’s approval rating among Catholic voters stood at 48 percent, with 52 percent of respondents expressing disapproval even before his highly public clash with the pontiff.
_source.movement_title: 众议员将特朗普比作'第二次降临'引争议
_source.movement_abstract: 美国众议员特洛伊·内尔斯（R-德州）在特朗普与教皇利奥十四及其管理的伊朗冲突相关宗教言论引发争议的背景下，称特朗普是'第二次降临'。内尔斯表示，特朗普的执政表现'非常出色'，并强调其工作难度远超教皇。教皇利奥十四近期对美以联合军事行动提出批评后，特朗普在Truth Social平台发布了一张AI生成的争议性图像，画面中他身着长袍、手掌发光为病人治疗，配以护士、士兵和美国标志。该图像遭到民主党议员、宗教领袖及MAGA运动内部人士的谴责，认为其'亵渎'。特朗普随后删除该帖并解释称图像表现的是医生形象与红十字会相关，但前佐治亚州众议员马乔丽·泰勒·格林反驳称这是荒谬的谎言。AI图像风波及特朗普与首位美国籍教皇的公开矛盾，已引发部分共和党捐助者、战略家和议员的担忧，认为这可能分散共和党中期选举前的国内政策关注，并削弱天主教选民的支持。最新民调显示，特朗普在天主教选民中的支持率为48%，不支持者达52%，这一数据在与教皇公开冲突前已形成。
_source.title: House Republican says Trump ‘almost a second coming’ amid backlash over AI Jesus posts
_source.trans_cont:
众议员特洛伊·内尔斯（得克萨斯州共和党）将特朗普比作“第二次降临”，以回应总统与教皇利奥十四世的冲突以及其政府在讨论伊朗问题时使用宗教语言引发的批评。内尔斯周四在国会山对记者说：“我认为唐纳德·特朗普比切片面包还要好。在我看来，他几乎就是第二次降临。”他补充道：“我认为他做得非常出色。他的工作非常困难。教皇的工作也很艰难，教会内部有很多问题，但特朗普的工作是世界上最艰难的。”
“第二次降临”指的是基督教中“基督荣耀地再次降临，届时他将建立他的王国，审判他的敌人，并奖赏忠信的生者与死者”，据《大英百科全书》所述。
内尔斯的这一类比出现在特朗普因在“真相社交平台”上发布了一张有争议的AI生成图像而受到质疑之后。当时他批评教皇对美以联合军事行动在伊朗的批评。图像中，特朗普身穿长袍，一只手放在病人的额头上，手掌发出光芒，周围有护士、士兵和美国象征图案。
该图像迅速遭到民主党议员、宗教领袖以及MAGA运动内部人士的反对，其中一些人称其具有冒犯性并“亵渎”。知名保守派基督教记者梅根·巴沙姆在社交媒体平台X上写道：“我不知道总统是觉得好笑，还是受了某种药物影响，或者有什么可能的解释能为这种荒谬的亵渎行为开脱。”
总统在一天后删除了该帖子，称其被误解，并表示他认为图像将他描绘成医生，与“红十字会”有关——参议员汤姆·蒂利斯
_source.trans_title: 共和党议员称特朗普“几乎第二次降临” 面对AI耶稣帖子的批评 backlash
_source.evidence: 文章主要描述了美国前总统特朗普利用AI生成图像（AI-generated image）进行宗教隐喻宣传，引发舆论争议和宗教界反弹的事件。虽然涉及AI技术，但文章核心并非探讨AI武器化研发或技术突破（排除[技术武器]），也不是关于中国组建机构或发布政策（排除[力量发展]、[理论政策]）。该事件属于美国国内政治舆论斗争，虽然涉及认知战手段（AI图像、宗教符号操纵），但并未直接针对中国大陆发起攻击或涉及中国作为当事方（排除[涉我事件]）。由于该事件属于美国国内政治舆论事件，虽与认知域手段相关，但不符合针对中国的特定标签定义，且不属于中国自身的演习、行动或政策，故归为[其他]。

(中央社記者黃旭昇新北17日電)民眾黨新北市議員陳世軒接獲民眾陳情,網路報案系統疑出現異常,顯示他人報案資料與個資。新北市警察局今晚表示,初查為單一個案,已暫停網路報案並全面檢修,強化資安防護。
新北市議會台灣民眾黨籍市議員陳世軒今天指出,有民眾使用「新北市政府網路報案系統」報案時,送出後頁面異常跳轉,竟顯示其他報案人的姓名、身分證字號、電話、住址及報案事由等個資,疑有外洩風險。
陳世軒表示,網路報案原為便民服務,卻因技術問題讓個資暴露,恐影響市民信任,已要求警察局儘速釐清並修補漏洞,並建議暫停系統,全面檢視資安與穩定性。
新北市政府警察局發布新聞回應,經實測尚未發現系統性異常,初步研判為特定時段技術性錯誤,屬單一個案,並非全面性漏洞或駭客攻擊。對於造成民眾不便與疑慮,表達歉意。
警方指出,已第一時間聯繫110系統建置廠商緊急檢修,並暫停網路報案服務,在官網公告改以撥打110或簡訊報案。另已聯繫陳情民眾說明,並請其刪除相關畫面,以避免擴散他人個資。
警方表示,若此案涉及個資外洩損害,將依「110集中受理民眾報案、e化勤務指揮管制系統及相關資訊設備養護案」契約,向廠商追究責任,並持續監控系統運作,強化資安機制。(編輯:管中維)1150417
_source.movement_title: 新北市网络报案系统异常显示他人个资 警方暂停服务并全面检修
_source.movement_abstract: 民众党新北市议员陈世轩接获民众反映，网络报案系统出现异常情况，导致他人姓名、身份证字号、电话、住址及报案事由等个人资料被错误显示。新北市警察局回应称，初步调查认定为单一个案，已暂停网络报案服务并进行全面检修，同时强化资安防护措施。警方表示，已联系系统建置厂商紧急处理，并通过官网公告建议民众改用拨打110或短信报案方式。对于可能涉及的个资外泄问题，警方承诺将依据相关契约追究厂商责任，并持续监控系统运作。
_source.title: 新北網路報案疑異常 警:單一個案已暫停並檢修
_source.trans_cont:
（中央社记者黄旭昇新北17日电）民众党新北市议员陈世轩接获民众陈情，网络报案系统疑似出现异常，显示他人报案资料与个资。新北市警察局今晚表示，初步调查为单一案例，已暂停网络报案并全面检修，强化资安防护。

新北市议会台湾民众党籍市议员陈世轩今天指出，有民众使用「新北市政府网络报案系统」报案时，送出后页面异常跳转，竟显示其他报案人的姓名、身份证字号、电话、住址及报案事由等个资，疑似有外泄风险。

陈世轩表示，网络报案原为便民服务，却因技术问题导致个资暴露，恐影响市民信任，已要求警察局尽快厘清并修补漏洞，并建议暂停系统，全面检视资安与稳定性。

新北市政府警察局发布新闻回应，经实测尚未发现系统性异常，初步研判为特定时段技术性错误，属单一案例，并非全面性漏洞或骇客攻击。对于造成民众不便与疑虑，表达歉意。

警方指出，已第一时间联系110系统建置厂商紧急检修，并暂停网络报案服务，在官网公告改以拨打110或短信报案。另已联系陈情民众说明，并请其删除相关画面，以避免扩散他人个资。

警方表示，若此案涉及个资外泄损害，将依「110集中受理民众报案、e化勤务指挥管制系统及相关资讯设备养护案」合约，向厂商追究责任，并持续监控系统运作，强化资安机制。（编辑：管中维）1150417
_source.trans_title: 新北网络报案疑异常 警方：单一个案已暂停并检修

_source.content:
Bluesky’s website and app are still
struggling
on Friday after experiencing service interruptions that chief operating officer Rose Wang
attributed
to an ongoing cyberattack.
On Thursday evening, the social media company
confirmed
that a “sophisticated Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attack” was to blame for the issues, which had originally started on April 15 at around 8:40 p.m. ET.
Distributed denial-of-service
attacks often involve pummelling apps or websites with large amounts of junk web traffic aimed at overloading and knocking its servers offline. While these kinds of cyberattacks do not involve intrusions into a company’s systems, these incidents can still be disruptive to both the company and its users.
In a post on the Bluesky account, the company shared the cause of the problem and noted that the attack was “impacting our operations, with users experiencing intermittent interruptions in service for their feeds, notifications, threads, and search.”
Bluesky said that it has not seen any evidence of unauthorized access to private data, however.
When originally reached for comment on Thursday, Bluesky only pointed us to the
status.bsky.app
page and account (@status.bsky.app) for updates. The company did not provide an estimated time for a fix.
The network’s
status page
is currently not working, however.
Bluesky said it will provide another update on the status of the attack and its mitigation by 1 p.m. ET on Friday.
Because the outages are intermittent, the Bluesky site and app will load at times, slowly, and other times will display error messages.
For instance, switching to a particular feed within the app could display a message that says, “This feed is currently receiving high traffic and is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later. Message from server: Rate Limit Exceeded.”
Popular feeds like Discover or the official Bluesky Team’s feed often see this problem, even as users’ own personal feeds are functional.
Other times, like when trying to visit a user’s profile, the site will display an error message, forcing you to refresh and try again.
Bluesky protocol engineer Bryan Newbold remarked
around
3:46 a.m. ET on Wednesday, “oof, our services are getting pretty hard tonight.”
Notably, the service disruptions are impacting Bluesky, but other communities, like
Blacksky
, that run their own infrastructure on the underlying protocol that powers the decentralized social network, are still functioning.
Blacksky’s team told TechCrunch that the Bluesky outage has led to a “significant spike” in
migration requests
from Bluesky users over the past 12 hours, as
users
,
devs
, and other ATmosphere founders like
Sebastian at Eurosky
have been promoting its services.
It was clear that Bluesky’s team was in a hectic state this week while facing these issues, as one message on its status page had a typo: ” investigating an incident with service in one of our reginos [sic].”
_source.movement_title: Bluesky遭DDoS攻击致服务中断 用户迁移至替代平台
_source.movement_abstract: Bluesky的网站和应用程序在周五仍因服务中断问题而运行不稳定，首席运营官Rose Wang将原因归咎于持续的网络攻击。4月15日晚美国东部时间8:40起，该公司遭遇了复杂的分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）攻击，导致用户在动态流、通知、话题讨论和搜索功能上出现间歇性故障。Bluesky表示未发现用户数据被非法访问，但状态页面和官方账号的更新功能暂时失效。攻击期间，用户访问特定动态流或个人资料时会遇到加载缓慢或错误提示，例如“流量过高导致服务暂时不可用”。与此同时，基于相同协议运行的去中心化社交网络社区Blacksky保持正常运营，其团队称过去12小时内收到大量从Bluesky迁移的用户请求。Bluesky工程师Bryan Newbold在周三凌晨曾表示服务压力较大，官方状态页面还曾出现“reginos”等拼写错误，显示团队在处理问题时处于紧张状态。该公司计划于周五美国东部时间下午1点前提供最新进展说明。
_source.title: Bluesky confirms DDoS attack is cause of continued app outages
_source.trans_cont:
Bluesky的网站和应用程序在周五仍然面临服务中断问题，首席运营官王若思（Rose Wang）将此归因于持续的网络攻击。周四晚间，这家社交媒体公司确认，问题是由“一种复杂的分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）攻击”造成的，该攻击最初于4月15日晚上8:40左右（东部时间）开始。

分布式拒绝服务攻击通常涉及用大量垃圾网络流量轰炸应用程序或网站，目的是使其服务器过载并离线。虽然这类网络攻击并不涉及入侵公司系统，但这些事件仍可能对企业和用户造成干扰。

在Bluesky的官方账号上，公司分享了问题的原因，并指出攻击“影响了我们的运营，用户在信息流、通知、对话线程和搜索功能上会遇到间歇性的服务中断”。

Bluesky表示，目前尚未发现任何未经授权访问私人数据的证据。

周四首次寻求评论时，Bluesky仅将我们引导至status.bsky.app页面和账号（@status.bsky.app）获取更新，公司并未提供修复的预计时间。

然而，该网络的状态页面目前无法正常工作。

Bluesky表示，将在周五东部时间下午1点之前发布关于攻击状态及其应对措施的进一步更新。

由于服务中断是间歇性的，Bluesky网站和应用程序有时会缓慢加载，有时则会显示错误信息。

例如，在应用程序中切换到特定信息流时，可能会显示一条信息：“此信息流当前流量过高，暂时不可用。请稍后再试。来自服务器的信息：请求频率过高。”

像“发现”（Discover）或官方Bluesky团队的信息流等热门信息流经常出现此类问题，即使用户的个人信息流仍能正常运行。

其他时候，例如尝试访问用户个人资料时，网站会显示错误信息，迫使用户刷新页面并重新尝试。

Bluesky协议工程师Bryan Newbold在周三凌晨3:46左右表示
_source.trans_title: Bluesky确认DDoS攻击是应用程序持续中断的原因

_source.content:
Many users are drawn to social media platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube to stay up to date on news.
However, people are increasingly complaining about misinformation and AI slop cluttering their feeds. Worries about trust have also grown, especially in light of
lawsuits against Meta
related to harming young people and concerns over the
ownership of American TikTok
. (Trust in traditional news outlets has also eroded: a Pew Research study from October found that just
56% of U.S. adults
say they have a lot of or some trust in national news media.)
Enter
SaySo
, a new short-form video app designed to deliver curated news from vetted creators and independent journalists. It launched for
iOS users
in the U.S. and Canada this month after a private beta that began in November.
The app aims to set itself apart from other platforms by offering a more intentional and personalized news experience that avoids endless scrolling.
One of SaySo’s standout features is Daily Digest. Upon creating a profile, users can choose topics of interest such as politics, social issues, public health, or crime, and the app curates a set of videos for them each day. This selection refreshes every 20 hours.
To explore a broader range of topics, there is an Explore page where users can discover additional content from different creators. SaySo also includes typical features such as the ability to follow others, like, save, comment, and share.
Notably, SaySo requires creators to include sources of information directly within their videos, aiming to build trust with users. The app also combines human and AI moderation with source validation to ensure content integrity.
“Content doesn’t auto-publish,” Dion Bailey, co-founder and CTO, explains to TechCrunch. “Everything goes through a moderation queue, so most problems are caught before they reach readers. If something slips through and gets flagged, we investigate, address it directly with the creator, and take it down if it crosses the line.”
Additionally, SaySo is developing a “community notes” feature, allowing users to participate in the accountability process through a crowdsourced fact-checking approach similar to that of
X
and
TikTok
.
At its launch, SaySo onboarded approximately 30 creators. Among them is Nico Agosta, who first gained attention with his “Stocking the Capitol” video series, where he dives into the financial dealings of U.S. Congress members. There’s also Dr. Victoria, who focuses on topics related to racial justice and social change, and Isabel Ravenna, an independent journalist with bylines in outlets like National Geographic.
On the question of creator pay, Ramin Beheshti, SaySo’s CEO and co-founder, says that “many [creators] have come on as founding partners and are receiving a stipend from day one. Over the coming months, we’ll be building out the full monetization infrastructure, and when that revenue flows, the vast majority goes directly to creators.” He declined to provide specifics on the monetization infrastructure or what the revenue split will be.
Beheshti previously served as chief product and tech officer at Dow Jones.
SaySo is the flagship app of Caliber, formerly known as The News Movement, which was founded in 2022 and rebranded in 2025 to focus on social, short-form journalism.
“We wanted to build a new breed of news product that helped people, rather than add to the familiar overwhelm so many of us experience,” says Beheshti. “Overlay that with what building Caliber has taught us about creators and the changing shape of modern media, and we believe we’ve unlocked something very special.”
Looking ahead, the company plans to launch SaySo in the U.K. in the summer, with further expansion into additional markets throughout this year and 2027.
_source.movement_title: SaySo：专注可信新闻的短视频应用
_source.movement_abstract: SaySo是一款新推出的短视频新闻应用，旨在解决社交媒体平台中虚假信息和AI低质量内容泛滥的问题。该应用于本月在美加地区上线iOS版本，此前已在11月完成封闭测试。SaySo通过人工与AI双重审核机制、内容来源标注及社区协作事实核查功能，构建可信新闻体系。其核心功能包括根据用户兴趣定制每日新闻摘要、探索页面推荐多样化内容，以及类似X和TikTok的社区笔记功能。目前已有约30位创作者入驻，涵盖政治、社会议题、公共卫生等领域的独立记者。SaySo母公司Caliber（原The News Movement）于2022年成立，2025年完成品牌重塑。CEO Ramin Beheshti表示未来将完善创作者收益体系，并计划于今年夏季登陆英国市场，2027年前拓展至更多地区。
_source.title: SaySo is a new short-form video app that aims to restore users’ trust in news
_source.trans_cont:
许多用户被TikTok、Instagram和YouTube等社交媒体平台吸引，以获取最新的新闻资讯。然而，人们越来越抱怨虚假信息和AI生成的垃圾内容充斥着他们的信息流。对信任度的担忧也日益加剧，尤其是在针对Meta的诉讼案件中，涉及对年轻人的伤害以及对美国TikTok所有权的担忧。（传统新闻机构的信任度也有所下降：一项10月份的皮尤研究中心调查显示，仅56%的美国成年人表示他们对全国性新闻媒体有相当多或某种程度的信任。）

SaySo应运而生，这是一款新推出的短视频应用，旨在为用户带来经过筛选的新闻内容，由经过认证的创作者和独立记者提供。该应用本月在美国和加拿大面向iOS用户正式上线，此前已于11月启动了私人测试版。

这款应用旨在通过提供更具目的性和个性化的新闻体验，区别于其他平台，避免无休止的滚动浏览。SaySo的一大亮点是“每日摘要”功能。用户在创建个人资料时可以选择感兴趣的话题，如政治、社会问题、公共卫生或犯罪，应用会为他们每天精选一组视频。这一选择每20小时更新一次。

若想探索更广泛的话题，用户可以进入“探索”页面，发现来自不同创作者的额外内容。SaySo还包含诸如关注他人、点赞、保存、评论和分享等常规功能。

值得注意的是，SaySo要求创作者在视频中直接包含信息来源，旨在与用户建立信任。应用还结合人工和AI审核，以及来源验证，以确保内容的可信度。

“内容不会自动发布，”SaySo联合创始人兼首席技术官迪恩·贝利向TechCrunch解释道。“所有内容都会经过审核队列，因此大多数问题在到达读者之前就会被发现。如果某些内容漏过并被标记，我们会进行调查，直接与创作者沟通，并在内容越界
_source.trans_title: SaySo是一款新的短视频应用，旨在恢复用户对新闻的信任
_source.evidence: 文章主要介绍了一款名为 SaySo 的新兴短视频新闻应用在美国和加拿大的发布及其功能特性（如人工与AI结合的审核机制、创作者生态等）。虽然文中提到了AI审核技术，但这属于商业产品的功能描述，并非认知域中针对特定目标的‘技术武器化’或‘深度伪造工具研发’。文章未涉及中国大陆的敌情事件（涉我事件），未涉及军事或认知域的演习训练（演习演训），未涉及认知作战力量的组建（力量发展），也未涉及具体的认知对抗行动（行动动向）或理论政策发布（理论政策）。该内容属于认知域背景下的商业/技术动态，但无法归入上述6类具体的作战或对抗标签，因此归类为[其他]。

Fortra has established a new Defense and Intelligence Unit (DIU), focused on delivering cyber capabilities to defense, intelligence, and critical infrastructure organizations.
The move comes as cyber threats against military systems and critical infrastructure continue to increase in scale and complexity, the company emphasized.
According to Fortra, the DIU is intended to address operational requirements in environments where networks may be classified, degraded, or disconnected.
“When you look across the world today, it’s clear that we are living in a time of rising geopolitical and cyber risks,” said John Grancarich, who has been appointed Executive VP and Head of Defense and Intelligence.
“With the launch of the DIU we are going all in on our mission of securing allied nations against cyber adversaries around the globe.”
Focus on Data Security
The DIU will focus on key technical areas relevant to defense operations and high-risk environments.
These include data discovery, classification, and protection aligned with defense requirements, as well as capabilities for securely transferring data across classified or disrupted networks.
The unit will also develop AI-driven tools to assess infrastructure resilience and identify vulnerabilities in operational settings.
In parallel, Fortra is working on deployable, enclave-ready architectures designed for mission-specific use, including forward- and restricted-access environments.
Execution will rely on partnerships with system integrators and technology providers, supported by personnel and facilities across North America and Europe.
These capabilities reflect the company’s broader approach to cybersecurity, which focuses on stopping attacks at every stage rather than reacting after a breach.
The model emphasizes early identification of vulnerabilities, blocking initial intrusion attempts, detecting malicious activity if access is gained, and limiting impact through data protection and user awareness measures.

_source.movement_title: Fortra成立防御与情报部门应对网络威胁
_source.movement_abstract: Fortra公司宣布成立防御与情报部门（DIU），专注于为国防、情报及关键基础设施组织提供网络安全能力。该部门旨在应对当前不断升级的网络攻击规模和复杂性，特别是在军事系统和关键基础设施领域。DIU将重点开发符合国防需求的数据发现、分类与保护技术，以及在加密或中断网络环境下实现安全数据传输的能力。同时，该部门将研发基于人工智能的工具，用于评估基础设施抗风险能力并识别运营环境中的漏洞。Fortra还计划与系统集成商及技术供应商合作，部署适用于特定任务的架构，覆盖前线及受限访问环境。公司强调其网络安全模型的核心是通过数据保护和用户意识措施，在攻击各阶段进行主动防御，而非事后响应。
_source.title: Fortra Launches Defense, Intelligence Unit for Advanced Cyber Capabilities
_source.trans_cont:
Fortra 已成立新的国防与情报部门（DIU），专注于为国防、情报及关键基础设施组织提供网络能力。
公司强调，这一举措正值针对军事系统和关键基础设施的网络威胁在规模和复杂性上持续增加之际。
根据 Fortra 的说法，DIU 的设立旨在应对在可能涉及机密、受损或断开网络环境中的运营需求。
“放眼当今世界，很明显我们正处在地缘政治和网络风险不断上升的时代，”被任命为执行副总裁兼国防与情报负责人约翰·格兰卡里奇表示。“通过启动 DIU，我们将全力推进保护盟国免受全球网络对手攻击的使命。”
聚焦数据安全
DIU 将专注于与国防行动和高风险环境相关的关键技术领域。
这些领域包括符合国防需求的数据发现、分类和保护，以及在机密或受损网络中安全传输数据的能力。
该部门还将开发基于人工智能的工具，以评估基础设施的韧性并在运营环境中识别漏洞。
同时，Fortra 正在开发可部署、具备隔离环境支持的架构，适用于特定任务需求，包括前线和受限访问环境。
执行将依赖与系统集成商和技术提供商的合作，由北美和欧洲的人员及设施提供支持。
这些能力体现了公司更广泛的网络安全方法，即在攻击的每个阶段阻止攻击，而非在发生入侵后进行反应。
该模式强调早期识别漏洞、阻止初始入侵尝试、在获得访问权限后检测恶意活动，并通过数据保护和用户意识措施限制影响。

(中央社台北17日綜合外電報導)路透社指出,中國軍隊去年12月在台灣周邊大規模演習,也同步透過智慧型手機螢幕展開心理攻勢,藉由「抖音」及YouTube等社群平台,利用台灣在地聲音對台發動資訊戰。
路透社報導,在中國短影片社群應用程式「抖音」上,中國共產黨旗下的一間新聞媒體發布一段51秒影片,內容為國民黨主席鄭麗文指控台灣總統賴清德引來中國侵略。
鄭麗文去年12月宣稱,賴總統因為追求台灣獨立,「要把這條死路給走到底,連累台灣2300萬人」。這段影片很快出現在臉書、YouTube等台灣流行的社群媒體平台。
根據5位台灣安全部門官員說法以及台灣資訊環境研究中心(IORG)提供給路透社的數據,中國官方媒體日益放大台灣內部批評民進黨的聲音,其中包括跟國民黨有關的網紅及政治人物。
根據這些數據和消息來源,中國會運用國民黨和其他反對派人物批評台灣政府的公開發言,並透過中國官媒及社群平台大量輸出反民進黨資訊。
這些影片隨後會轉傳,而且常被重新包裝發到台灣常用的社群平台,包括臉書、抖音、抖音海外版本TikTok與YouTube,有時還會加以修飾或以掩蓋中國介入的方式呈現。
雖然中國過去也曾利用台灣人物進行宣傳,但如今已大幅強化這種資訊戰手法,台灣安全部門官員指出,熟悉的聲音及口音會讓民眾覺得更可信。
這些官員強調,中國目標即是抹黑台灣政府。
在民進黨尋求追加400億美元國防預算的背景下,台灣資訊環境研究中心和台灣3位安全部門官員認為,前述行動似乎想說服台灣民眾:中國軍力相當強大,台灣再花大筆資金購買更多美國武器也是徒勞。
關於北京當局發動資訊戰,中國共產黨中央委員會台灣工作辦公室與國防部尚未回應路透社的置評請求。
台灣國防部向路透社表示,正透過強化軍方的媒體識讀和心理韌性,以應對中國大幅強化「認知作戰」。
台灣總統府指出,兩岸和平必須「建立在實力之上,而非對威權壓力讓步」。
臉書、TikTok和YouTube沒回應關於中國資訊戰的提問,抖音也未回覆路透社置評請求。
中國持續準備對台灣的軍事行動之際,資訊戰是北京當局在不動用武力之下削弱台灣策略的一環。
報導指出,在這方面,國民黨為中國提供一個有利突破口,這個台灣在野黨正試圖加強與北京的關係,以避免其所謂因為民進黨政府挑釁中國而加劇的危機。
鄭麗文本月稍早在北京會見中國國家主席習近平,習近平告訴她,國民黨與共產黨「要鞏固政治互信,保持良性互動,團結兩岸同胞,攜手共創祖國統一」。
國民黨透過聲明回覆路透社,鄭麗文訪問北京是履行競選承諾,並延續國共高層會晤的長期傳統,雖然國共兩黨存有許多分歧,但都認為應該透過對話解決歧見。
根據台灣資訊環境研究中心向路透社提供的數據,可看出中國這項行動的運作方式。這個公民組織由社會科學家與數據分析師組成,不屬於任何黨派,部分資金來自歐美政府以及台灣學術機構。
去年第4季有1076個中共官方媒體經營帳號在抖音發布約56萬支影片,其中約1萬8000支影片涉及台灣議題。
台灣資訊環境研究中心透過臉部辨識技術,在2730支影片中辨識出57位台灣人士,這項發現經他們的研究人員驗證,並由路透社審閱。
與前一年同期相比,含有台灣人士發言的影片數量去年10月至11月期間增至兩倍以上,每月總播放時間大幅增長164%至369分鐘。
值得注意的是,中國影片裡曝光度最高的前25位台灣人士中,有13人是國民黨相關人士,包括現任立委、黨代表和國民黨執政時期的前官員;另外兩人是支持與中國統一的小黨高層,還有10人是以批評執政黨民進黨聞名的網紅。
鄭麗文是中國影片中排名第一的台灣人物,她在68個抖音帳號發布的460支影片中出現,並創造500多萬次互動,包括按讚、留言和分享。
根據路透社,這些影片放大她呼籲兩岸和平、批評賴總統是外部勢力棋子,以及她認為民進黨台獨立場具有破壞性的說法。這些內容會先在中國官媒和社群平台播出,部分影片再重新包裝並發布至台灣的熱門平台。
國民黨透過聲明表示,鄭麗文的發言反映台灣人民對和平的主流期待,「即使中國官媒傾向納入更多台灣聲音,也是奠基於台灣本就存在的多元民意」。
多位網紅也被中國媒體大量引用,其中包括頗受年輕人歡迎的健身網紅「館長」陳之漢,以及5位以批評民進黨和台灣國防著名的退役高階軍官。
陳之漢在去年中國國慶日前夕於YouTube直播中祝賀「祖國生日快樂」,並稱兩岸人民是一家人。中國新聞社等中國官媒後來分享了這些片段。
陳之漢未回應路透社的置評請求。
在中國新聞社發布的另一支影片中,退役陸軍上校賴岳謙聲稱,中國無人機在去年12月軍演期間曾進入台灣且未被發現;他還暗示,中國可能在台獨領導人熟睡時對他們發動斬首攻擊。這支影片很快出現在臉書與YouTube上。
根據台灣資訊環境研究中心,中國無人機接近台灣的說法,最早是出現在共軍經營的社群媒體帳號所發布影片中。台灣國防部則否認中國無人機接近台灣的說法。
中國新聞社未回應路透社提問;賴岳謙也拒絕評論自己在中國官媒曝光一事。
台灣陸委會告訴路透社,政府希望這些退役軍官注意社會觀感,不要附和北京說詞,且莫忘他們曾宣示效忠台灣。
根據政治大學選舉研究中心今年1月發布的長期年度調查,自2020年以來,支持「無限期維持現狀」的比率攀升8個百分點至33.5%;支持「維持現狀但走向獨立」的比率下滑近4個百分點至21.9%。支持「儘快與中國統一」或「維持現狀但走向統一」的比率合計持穩於7%左右。
路透社報導提到,目前不清楚中國加強資訊戰是否正帶來衝擊。根據這份年度調查資料,自2024年以來,台灣民眾對統獨的立場並無明顯轉變。這段時間大致與台灣資訊環境研究中心觀察到資訊戰加劇的期間相符。
不過,美國智庫「德國馬歇爾基金會」(The German Marshall Fund)印太計畫主任葛來儀(Bonnie Glaser)表示,鋪天蓋地的訊息「創造出使中國更容易爭取支持的環境,因為其策略本質上是降低士氣、灌輸心理絕望感,說服民眾認為自主沒有未來,加入中國才是最佳選擇」。
台灣國安局今年1月報告指出,去年偵測到超過4.5萬組假社群帳號及230萬則與兩岸議題相關的假訊息。報告形容說,北京資訊戰目標是加劇台灣內部分裂、削弱民眾抵抗意志,以及爭取對中國立場的支持。
一名台灣國安官員表示:「他們想讓你懷疑軍方、懷疑台灣,讓你覺得如果戰爭爆發,沒有人會來幫你。」
台灣政府去年向各家庭普發的台灣全民安全指引手冊甚至預先指出,在兩岸緊張升高之際,任何聲稱台灣已投降的說法都應視為假訊息,顯示即使尚未開火,資訊戰正持續加劇。(編譯:陳彥鈞、洪培英、洪啓原)1150417
_source.movement_title: 中国对台信息战升级，利用国民党人物言论发动舆论攻势
_source.movement_abstract: 路透社报道指出，中国军方去年12月在台湾周边大规模演习期间，同步通过抖音、YouTube等社交平台发起信息战。中国官方媒体大量引用国民党主席郑丽文等台湾反对派人士的言论，强调民进党台独立场的破坏性，并试图削弱台湾民众对国防预算及自主未来的信心。台湾安全部门官员称，中国通过包装传播台湾内部批评声音，利用熟悉口音提升可信度，目标在于抹黑台湾政府。数据显示，去年第四季度约1076个中共官方媒体账号在抖音发布56万支影片，其中1.8万支涉及台湾议题，相关影片在台湾平台传播量显著增长。国民党回应称其发言反映台湾民众对和平的主流诉求。台湾国安局监测到4.5万组假账号及230万则两岸议题假消息，认为北京信息战旨在加剧台湾内部分裂。美国智库专家分析称，中国信息战策略通过海量信息灌输心理绝望感。台湾政府表示将强化媒体识读和心理韧性应对认知作战，并强调两岸和平应建立在实力基础上。
_source.title: 路透:中國藉台灣在地聲音 對台發動資訊戰
_source.trans_cont:
（中央社台北17日电）路透社指出，中国军队去年12月在台湾周边展开大规模演习，同时通过智能手机屏幕展开心理攻势，利用抖音及YouTube等社交媒体平台，借助台湾本地声音对台发动信息战。

路透社报道，在中国短视频社交应用“抖音”上，中国共产党旗下一家新闻媒体发布了一段51秒的视频，内容为国民党主席郑丽文指控台湾总统赖清德引来中国侵略。郑丽文去年12月宣称，赖总统因追求台湾独立，“要把这条死路给走到底，连累台湾2300万人”。这段视频很快出现在脸书、YouTube等台湾流行的社交媒体平台。

根据5位台湾安全部门官员的说法以及台湾资讯环境研究中心（IORG）提供给路透社的数据，中国官方媒体日益放大台湾内部批评民进党的声音，其中包括与国民党有关的网红及政治人物。根据这些数据和消息来源，中国会利用国民党和其他反对派人物批评台湾政府的公开言论，并通过中国官媒及社交媒体大量输出反民进党信息。

这些视频随后会被转传，并常被重新包装发到台湾常用的社交媒体平台，包括脸书、抖音、抖音海外版TikTok与YouTube，有时还会加以修饰或以掩盖中国介入的方式呈现。虽然中国过去也曾利用台湾人物进行宣传，但如今已大幅强化这种信息战手法。台湾安全部门官员指出，熟悉的声调及口音会让民众觉得更可信。

这些官员强调，中国的目标即是抹黑台湾政府。在民进党寻求追加400亿美元国防预算的背景下，台湾资讯环境研究中心和台湾3位安全部门官员认为，前述行动似乎想说服台湾民众：中国军力相当强大，台湾再花大笔资金购买更多美国武器也是徒劳。

关于北京当局发动信息战，中国共产党中央委员会台湾工作办公室与国防部尚未回应路透社的置评请求。台湾国防部向路透社表示，正通过强化军方的媒体识读和心理韧性，以应对中国大幅强化“认知作战”。台湾总统府指出，两岸和平必须“建立在实力之上，而非对威权压力让步”。

脸书、TikTok和YouTube未回应关于中国信息战的提问，抖音也未回复路透社置评请求。在中国持续准备对台湾的军事行动之际，信息战是北京当局在不动用武力之下削弱台湾策略的一环。

(中央社記者游堯茹維爾紐斯17日專電)愛沙尼亞警方近日表示,查出逾1600名青少年曾透過線上平台訂購網路攻擊服務,目標包括學校及教育網站,其中13名學童已被列為刑事案件嫌疑人遭傳喚調查,希望導正其行為,避免再犯。
愛沙尼亞公共廣播公司(ERR)16日報導,愛沙尼亞中央刑事警察局網路犯罪部門主管盧伊克(Jete Luik)表示,網路犯罪已逐漸「服務化」,部分網站提供多種攻擊方案供使用者選擇,其目的在於癱瘓特定機構或企業的線上服務,影響正常運作,常見攻擊目標包括銀行、醫院與政府機構。
盧伊克指出,相關攻擊多屬分散式阻斷服務(DDoS)攻擊,透過付費即可發動,使用者無須具備高深資訊技術能力。
根據報導,愛沙尼亞國家檢察官維特(Vahur Verte)指出,許多年輕人誤以為此類攻擊只是惡作劇,但實際上已構成犯罪行為,不僅干擾系統運作,也可能造成經濟損失並影響大量使用者。他強調,不論攻擊對象為醫療機構、大型企業或線上遊戲平台玩家,都屬違法。
根據ERR報導,全球21國執法機關在4月初聯手展開打擊行動,共關閉53個提供網路攻擊服務的網站。
愛沙尼亞警方指出,雖然沒有在境內查封相關平台,但確認有攻擊行為自愛沙尼亞發起,也有針對該國的攻擊案例。警方蒐集資料顯示,自2014年以來,攻擊目標包含遊戲平台、學校網站及電子校務系統等。
報導指出,警方已辨識出近1600個與愛沙尼亞相關的使用者帳號,部分僅註冊帳號,也有人實際訂購攻擊服務。當局將透過電子郵件寄發警告信,提醒相關使用者注意法律責任。
警方表示,多數涉案者為出於好奇的年輕網路使用者,誤以為網路行為具有匿名性,未意識到可能帶來的法律後果。
報導指出,目前有13人因涉嫌訂購攻擊服務,接獲傳喚並以嫌疑人身分接受調查。盧伊克表示,雖然案件已啟動刑事程序,但主要目的是導正其行為,避免再犯。
維特表示,他們將提供相關青少年與專業人士接觸機會,引導其將資訊技術能力運用於合法領域。若能從中學習並停止違法行為,未來可望免於刑事處罰。(編輯:張芷瑄)1150417
_source.movement_title: 爱沙尼亚查处青少年订购网络攻击服务案件
_source.movement_abstract: 爱沙尼亚警方近日发现1600余名青少年通过在线平台订购网络攻击服务，攻击目标涵盖学校、教育网站及游戏平台等。13名涉案青少年已被列为刑事案件嫌疑人并接受调查。中央刑事警察局网络犯罪部门主管卢伊克指出，网络攻击服务呈现'服务化'趋势，用户可通过付费选择攻击方案，常见目标包括银行、医院和政府机构，且多为DDoS攻击，无需高深技术。国家检察官维特强调此类行为已构成犯罪，可能造成经济损失并影响大量用户。全球21国执法机关于4月联合关闭53个提供网络攻击服务的网站，爱沙尼亚虽未查封境内平台，但确认存在针对本国的攻击案例。警方通过电子邮件向近1600个关联账号发送警告信，提醒其法律责任。涉案青少年多出于好奇，误以为网络行为匿名且无后果。警方表示将引导其技术能力转向合法领域，若停止违法行为可免于刑事处罚。
_source.title: 愛沙尼亞查青少年網攻案 13名學童遭傳喚
_source.trans_cont:
（中央社记者游尧茹维尔纽斯17日电）爱沙尼亚警方近日表示，已查明超过1600名青少年曾通过线上平台订购网络攻击服务，目标包括学校和教育网站，其中13名学生已被列为刑事案件嫌疑人并被传唤调查，希望纠正其行为，避免再次犯罪。

爱沙尼亚公共广播公司（ERR）16日报道，爱沙尼亚中央刑事警察局网络犯罪部门主管卢伊克（Jete Luik）表示，网络犯罪正逐渐“服务化”，部分网站提供多种攻击方案供用户选择，其目的在于瘫痪特定机构或企业的在线服务，影响正常运作，常见攻击目标包括银行、医院和政府机构。

卢伊克指出，相关攻击多为分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）攻击，通过付费即可发动，用户无需具备高深的信息技术能力。

据报道，爱沙尼亚国家检察官维特（Vahur Verte）指出，许多年轻人误以为此类攻击只是恶作剧，但实际上已构成犯罪行为，不仅干扰系统运作，也可能造成经济损失并影响大量用户。他强调，无论攻击对象是医疗机构、大型企业还是网络游戏平台玩家，都属于违法行为。

根据ERR报道，全球21国执法机关于4月初联合展开打击行动，共关闭了53个提供网络攻击服务的网站。

爱沙尼亚警方指出，虽然没有在境内查封相关平台，但确认有攻击行为从爱沙尼亚发起，也有针对该国的攻击案例。警方收集的数据显示，自2014年以来，攻击目标包括游戏平台、学校网站及电子校务系统等。

报道指出，警方已识别出近1600个与爱沙尼亚相关的用户账号，部分仅注册账号，也有人实际订购攻击服务。当局将通过电子邮件寄发警告信，提醒相关用户注意法律责任。

警方表示，多数涉案者为出于好奇的年轻网络用户，误以为网络行为具有匿名性，未意识到可能带来的法律后果。

报道指出，目前有13人因涉嫌订购攻击服务，接获传唤并以嫌疑人身份接受调查。卢伊克表示，虽然案件已启动刑事程序，但主要目的是纠正其行为，避免再次犯罪。

维特表示，他们将为相关青少年提供与专业人士接触的机会，引导其将信息技术能力用于合法领域。若能从中学习并停止违法行为，未来有望免于刑事处罚。（编辑：张芷瑄）
_source.trans_title: 爱沙尼亚调查青少年网络攻击案件 13名学生被传唤

_source.content:
(中央社記者何秀玲台北17日電)隨著人工智慧(AI)工具快速融入日常生活,詐騙與資安威脅也出現變化。資安業者指出,深偽(Deepfake)與生成式AI使詐騙手法更難辨識,且家庭成員間對AI風險的認知差異擴大,因此「家庭」逐漸成為資安防護的新場景。
趨勢科技近期宣布推出消費性事業群新品牌TrendLife,並觀察AI正改變家庭的數位使用型態,資安防護需求也從過去以個人為主,逐步延伸至家庭情境。
趨勢科技今天接受中央社記者採訪表示,面對AI帶來的資安衝擊,有兩個顯著趨勢與改變,其中之一是威脅型態出現質變。
趨勢科技表示,AI讓真偽界線變得模糊,詐騙手法更加多元且快速演化。從深偽技術生成的假名人投資影片、假檢警通話,到高度擬真的語音與影像,讓傳統辨識方式逐漸失效。AI工具也讓攻擊「規模化與產業化」,過去需大量人力的詐騙行為,現在可被快速複製與擴散。
另一項趨勢是家庭內部認知落差正擴大。趨勢科技指出,年輕世代在AI環境成長,雖然具備更高工具使用能力,但也可能減少獨立判斷的養成;而年長族群面對的是一個更複雜、由AI驅動的資訊環境,使得詐騙與錯誤資訊更難辨識。
趨勢科技指出,AI資安威脅已帶來許多具體的影響,包括詐騙手法更難辨識,如利用AI深偽技術製作假名人投資影片、假專家背書,或模擬檢警單位進行詐騙,這類案例在台灣持續發生,且成功率明顯提升。
此外,攻擊規模也快速擴大。AI讓詐騙內容可以被大量生成與複製,從訊息、語音到影像,都能快速客製化,形成更具效率的詐騙產業鏈。
趨勢科技表示,未來資安防護將從單一裝置或個人防護,轉向跨裝置、跨成員的整合型應用,並規劃在今年下半年推出以家庭為核心的AI工具。(編輯:楊蘭軒)1150417
_source.movement_title: AI诈骗手法升级 家庭级资安防护成新趋势
_source.movement_abstract: 随着人工智能工具融入日常生活，诈骗和信息安全威胁呈现新变化。趋势科技推出消费事业群新品牌TrendLife，指出AI正在改变家庭数字使用模式，安全防护需求从个人防护延伸至家庭场景。当前AI带来的安全冲击体现在两个方面：一是威胁形态发生质变，深伪技术和生成式AI使诈骗手法更难识别，包括假名人投资视频、假专家背书及模拟检警单位诈骗，且攻击呈现规模化和产业化特征；二是家庭内部认知差异扩大，年轻世代对AI工具使用熟练但独立判断能力下降，年长族群面临更复杂的AI信息环境，导致诈骗和错误信息更难辨识。趋势科技表示，AI技术已使诈骗内容能被快速生成和复制，形成高效产业链，未来防护将转向跨设备、跨成员的整合应用，并计划下半年推出以家庭为核心的AI防护工具。
_source.title: AI詐騙與深偽風險升溫 資安業者:家庭成防護新場景
_source.trans_cont:
（中央社记者何秀玲台北17日电）随着人工智能（AI）工具快速融入日常生活，诈骗与资安威胁也出现变化。资安业者指出，深伪（Deepfake）与生成式AI使诈骗手法更难辨识，且家庭成员间对AI风险的认知差异扩大，因此“家庭”逐渐成为资安防护的新场景。
趋势科技近期宣布推出消费性事业群新品牌TrendLife，并观察到AI正改变家庭的数字使用形态，资安防护需求也从过去以个人为主，逐步延伸至家庭情境。
趋势科技今天接受中央社记者采访表示，面对AI带来的资安冲击，有两个显著趋势与改变，其中之一是威胁形态出现质变。
趋势科技表示，AI让真假界限变得模糊，诈骗手法更加多元且快速演化。从深伪技术生成的假名人投资影片、假检警通话，到高度拟真的语音与影像，让传统辨识方式逐渐失效。AI工具也让攻击“规模化与产业化”，过去需要大量人力的诈骗行为，现在可被快速复制与扩散。
另一项趋势是家庭内部认知落差正扩大。趋势科技指出，年轻世代在AI环境中成长，虽然具备更高的工具使用能力，但也可能减少独立判断的养成；而年长族群面对的则是一个更复杂、由AI驱动的信息环境，使得诈骗与错误信息更难辨识。
趋势科技表示，AI资安威胁已带来许多具体的影响，包括诈骗手法更难辨识，如利用AI深伪技术制作假名人投资影片、假专家背书，或模拟检警单位进行诈骗，这类案例在台湾持续发生，且成功率明显提升。
此外，攻击规模也快速扩大。AI让诈骗内容可以被大量生成与复制，从讯息、语音到影像，都能快速客制化，形成更具效率的诈骗产业链。
趋势科技表示，未来资安防护将从单一装置或个人防护，转向跨装置、跨成员的整合型应用，并计划在今年下半年推出以家庭为核心的人工智能工具。（编辑：杨兰轩）1150417
_source.trans_title: AI诈骗与深度伪造风险加剧 安全厂商：家庭成为防诈新场景
_source.evidence: 文章主要报道了台湾资安厂商（趋势科技）关于AI诈骗与深伪技术风险的观察，指出诈骗手法因AI技术而升级，且家庭成为新的防护场景。虽然内容涉及AI技术（深伪）和诈骗行动，但文章本身是对一种社会现象、技术风险趋势的描述和厂商的市场观察，并未描述具体的敌对作战行动（排除[行动动向]），未涉及具体的部队/机构组建（排除[力量发展]），未涉及具体的武器化研发项目（排除[技术武器]），也未涉及中国大陆发布的理论政策（排除[理论政策]）。文章虽提及诈骗案例在台湾发生，但并未明确描述针对中国大陆的特定敌情攻击事件（排除[涉我事件]）。因此，该文章属于对认知域相关技术风险和社会现象的泛化讨论，无法归入上述6类具体标签，故归为[其他]。

That is more likely following Pashinyan’s recent visit to Moscow, during which Russian President Vladimir Putin complained about Armenia’s effective withdrawal from the Collective Security Treaty Organization (of which both countries are members) and about the treatment of pro-Russia Armenian politicians. Inevitably, though, turning election campaigns into a

Pashinyan (a reminder of the politician’s conflict with the leadership of the Armenian Apostolic Church).
Nevertheless, Pashinyan’s online activity enables him to retain the initiative. His primary message is that Civil Contract is the party of peace, while his opponents want war. He never tires of repeating that the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict is over, and an era of
has begun. But to keep it on track, the logic goes, Pashinyan must remain in government to deliver the normalization of relations with Armenia’s neighbors.
Pashinyan has also been stressing Armenian sovereignty—which means reducing the country’s dependence on
. Although he tries not to directly criticize the Kremlin, few are fooled by his caution.
Finally, Pashinyan’s campaign has highlighted integration with the EU. This resonates less with voters, though, because Armenians understand that even in a best-case scenario, it will take decades to achieve.
Pashinyan’s main rivals are from Armenia’s pro-Russia opposition, which is represented in the elections by the parties of three men: Russian-Armenian billionaire Samvel Karapetyan, former president Robert Kocharyan, and businessman Gagik Tsarukyan. Although they have much in common, they are in no hurry to enter into a coalition together—partly because of personal ambition, partly out of reluctance to share voters.
If all three groups did make it into parliament, they could theoretically rally behind a consensus candidate for prime minister. Something similar happened following last year’s mayoral elections in the northern Armenian city of Gyumri when all the opposition parties backed a pro-Russia candidate, Vardan Ghukasyan (although he was
a few months later on corruption charges).
The pro-Russia opposition hopes that a combination of Pashinyan’s unpopularity and support from Moscow could help it win. It’s undeniably true that many Armenians would vote for anyone just to be rid of Pashinyan, whom they see as a traitor and blame for the loss of Nagorno-Karabakh.
However, converting this frustration into an electoral victory will be challenging. For the moment, Karapetyan’s party (which was backed by Putin) is the most
of the three. But the tycoon is currently under house arrest (he was accused of plotting a coup last year), he does not have much experience of public politics, and under Armenian law his dual citizenship excludes him from becoming a parliamentary deputy (let alone prime minister).
Tsarukyan has always been cautious and avoided direct conflict with the authorities, and Kocharyan is widely disliked due to his track record in power: at the moment, just
of Armenians say they would vote for his party.
Pashinyan’s chances are further boosted by the fact that he faces hardly any competition from the country’s pro-EU political forces. In the past, pro-EU parties criticized the government for its ties to Moscow, but Pashinyan’s obvious desire to reduce dependence on Russia means there is now little difference between them.
The upcoming elections have turned Armenia into a
between Russia and the West for the first time. The Kremlin previously considered Armenia part of its sphere of influence, regardless of who was in charge. However, everything changed after Moscow’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, and Azerbaijan’s victory in Nagorno-Karabakh. Now, officials in Yerevan talk about “decolonization,” cooperation with Washington, and EU integration.
U.S. Vice President JD Vance visited Yerevan in February and gave his public
to Pashinyan. There was also an announcement of plans for multibillion-dollar U.S.
—in addition to the Trump Route for International Peace and Prosperity (
) linking Europe and Asia that will be built across Armenian territory as part of a peace deal with Baku.
In addition, the European Political Community Summit and the first ever EU-Armenia summit will be
in Yerevan in May. And Brussels has
to help Yerevan counter Russian hybrid warfare.
Pashinyan’s supporters, as well as Armenian civil society groups, have
Moscow of directing the country’s pro-Russia opposition, and there has been much
in the run-up to the June vote about information attacks and mobilizing Russian Armenians to vote. Critics of Pashinyan claim such dangers are being exaggerated to justify persecution of the opposition.
This situation is redolent of the buildup to
parliamentary elections in 2025. While Russia’s economic and media influence in Armenia is stronger than in Moldova, it is at least partly offset by the reputational damage Moscow suffered through failing to intervene on behalf of its official ally when Armenia lost Nagorno-Karabakh and during skirmishes on the Armenia-Azerbaijan border. As a result, even the pro-Russia opposition in Armenia seeks to downplay its links to Moscow.
It’s hard to deny that a victory for the pro-Russia opposition would mean Yerevan turning toward Moscow, and a halt to the peace process with Azerbaijan and Turkey. The opposition has already promised that if it comes to power, it will punish Pashinyan and his supporters for “surrendering” Nagorno-Karabakh.
While a win for the pro-Russia forces currently looks unlikely, there is a lot that could still change, such as the level of Russian interference, or the escalation of the war in the Middle East. As Pashinyan has linked a Civil Contract win to the ongoing peace process, if Armenia’s former regional enemies were to turn their backs on negotiations, it would put him in a difficult position. Admittedly, neither Baku nor Ankara wants to see Yerevan become a Russian proxy, so they will likely refrain from any surprise moves until after the election.
_source.movement_title: 亚美尼亚议会选举：帕希尼扬政党或胜出 亲俄反对派成主要挑战
_source.movement_abstract: 亚美尼亚总理帕希尼扬领导的公民契约党有望赢得6月7日议会选举，但当前仅获少数民众支持（约三分之一选民尚未决定）。帕希尼扬近期访俄期间，与普京就亚美尼亚退出集体安全条约组织及亲俄政治人物待遇问题发生争议，其团队以民主和网络自由回应。社交媒体成为其主要竞选工具，通过创意视频强化和平主张，但相关争议事件（如地铁冲突）也引发批评。亲俄反对派由三位候选人代表，虽存在共同诉求却因个人野心和选票分配难以联合。帕希尼扬强调减少对俄依赖和欧盟一体化，获得美国副总统万斯等西方政要支持，并推动国际和平项目。俄方此前视亚美尼亚为势力范围，但因未能在纳卡冲突中提供援助导致信誉受损，反对派亦试图淡化与俄关系。若亲俄阵营胜选将中断与阿塞拜疆、土耳其的和平进程，但当前选举结果仍受俄干预力度、中东局势等变数影响。

_source.title: Is Frustration With Armenia’s Pashinyan Enough to Bring the Pro-Russia Opposition to Power?
_source.trans_cont:
亚美尼亚总理尼科尔·帕希尼扬的“公民合同”党看起来将在6月7日的议会选举中获胜，然而只有少数亚美尼亚人支持该党，而且未来几个月情况可能会发生很大变化（约三分之一的选民尚未决定立场）。如果克里姆林宫决定加大选举干预力度，选举结果也将更加难以预测。
这更有可能发生，因为帕希尼扬最近访问莫斯科期间，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京抱怨亚美尼亚实际上已从集体安全条约组织（两国均为成员）中退出，并抱怨亲俄亚美尼亚政党的待遇。帕希尼扬则以简短但紧张的方式回应了关于亚美尼亚民主和在线自由的言论。
事实上，社交媒体已成为帕希尼扬的主要竞选工具。他的帖子在最近几个月特别引人注目，现在有网络迷因流传，显示总理在听俄罗斯摇滚明星泽姆菲拉唱歌时，坐在公交车上，以及在公交车上吃着亚美尼亚薄饼等食物。后者非常成功，他随后又发布了类似的视频，展示自己吃其他食物。
然而，将竞选活动变成一场网络大战也有其不利的一面。帕希尼扬在与来自纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫的难民在埃里温地铁上发生争执后受到严厉批评，该难民指责他向阿塞拜疆投降。此外，还有另一件不愉快的事件，一名在埃里温教堂参加礼拜的信徒公开指责帕希尼扬（这提醒人们这位政客与亚美尼亚使徒教会领导层之间的冲突）。
尽管如此，帕希尼扬的在线活动使他能够保持主动。他的主要信息是“公民合同”党是和平的政党，而他的对手则想要战争。他不断重复纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫冲突已经结束，和平时代已经到来。但为了保持这一进程，逻辑上讲，帕希尼扬必须继续执政，以实现与亚美尼亚邻国关系的正常化。
帕希尼扬还强调亚美尼亚的主权，这意味着减少国家对俄罗斯的依赖。尽管他试图不直接批评克里姆林宫，但很少有人被他的谨慎所欺骗。
最后，帕希尼扬的竞选活动突出了与欧盟的融合。然而，这在选民中反响不大，因为亚美尼亚人明白，即使在最好的情况下，实现这一目标也需要几十年时间。
帕希尼扬的主要对手来自亚美尼亚亲俄反对派，该反对派在选举中由三个人的政党代表：俄罗斯-亚美尼亚亿万富翁萨姆韦尔·卡拉佩特扬、前总统罗伯特·科查良和商人加吉克·察鲁基扬。虽然他们有很多共同点，但他们并不急于组成联盟——部分原因是个人野心，部分是不愿与选民分享。
如果这三个团体都进入议会，理论上他们可以支持一个共识候选人担任总理。类似的情况发生在去年北部亚美尼亚城市久姆里市长选举后，所有反对党都支持亲俄候选人瓦尔丹·古卡西扬（尽管几个月后他因腐败指控被起诉）。
亲俄反对派希望利用帕希尼扬的不受欢迎程度和莫斯科的支持来赢得选举。毫无疑问，许多亚美尼亚人会投票给任何人，只要能摆脱帕希尼扬，他们认为帕希尼扬是叛徒，并要为失去纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫负责。
然而，将这种不满转化为选举胜利将是一个挑战。目前，卡拉佩特扬的政党（得到了普京的支持）是这三个中最有希望的。但这位富豪目前处于家中监禁状态（他去年被指控策划政变），他缺乏公共政治经验，而且根据亚美尼亚法律，他的双重国籍使他无法成为议会代表（更不用说总理了）。
察鲁基扬一直谨慎行事，避免与当局发生直接冲突，而科查良则因执政期间的表现而广受厌恶。目前，只有少数亚美尼亚人表示会投票给他所属的政党。
帕希尼扬的胜算还因他几乎不与亚美尼亚亲欧盟政治力量竞争而进一步提升。过去，亲欧盟政党批评政府与莫斯科的联系，但帕希尼扬明显希望减少对俄罗斯的依赖，这意味着现在两者之间几乎没有区别。
即将到来的选举使亚美尼亚首次成为俄罗斯与西方之间的战场。克里姆林宫此前认为亚美尼亚是其影响力范围的一部分，无论谁掌权。然而，一切都因莫斯科对乌克兰的全面入侵和阿塞拜疆在纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫的胜利而改变。现在，叶利斯纳官员谈论“去殖民化”、与华盛顿合作以及与欧盟的融合。

_source.content:
The US military’s Psychological Operations (PSYOP) challenge is not primarily one of capability development, but rather of targeting methodology. This article proposes a decision-centric framework that integrates existing capabilities around adversary decision points, decision criteria, and information inputs to achieve more coherent operational effects.
The United States military has
a formidable arsenal of information-related capabilities over the past 15 years. From sophisticated cyber and electronic warfare tools to refined psychological operations, the joint force possesses an impressive array of technical means. However, these capabilities are often employed in isolation, constrained by domain-specific authorities and organizational stovepipes, rather than integrated to achieve decisive effects on adversary behavior.
The fundamental challenge facing PSYOP is not capability development, but rather the lack of a unifying framework for employing these capabilities in concert. At its core, PSYOP should be understood as the deliberate shaping of adversary decisions: not in the abstract, but at specific moments, under specific conditions, and through specific information inputs.
This article proposes a simplified framework for PSYOP planning: identify decision points, understand decision criteria, and manipulate the information that feeds those criteria. While not entirely novel, this approach offers a practical method for integrating disparate capabilities and demonstrating how psychological operations contribute to operational outcomes.
Every military operation, at every level of war, is defined by
. Some are deliberate and visible: committing reserves, initiating attacks, or withdrawing forces. Others are subtle or even unconscious: hesitating, delaying, misprioritizing, or choosing inaction.
These moments, when an adversary must decide, represent critical points of leverage for psychological warfare.
Decision points exist not only at the individual level but within organizational systems. A battalion staff deciding whether to reposition, a higher headquarters determining escalation thresholds, or political leadership weighing strategic risk all represent distinct decision points within a broader network. Effective PSYOP requires identifying which level to target and why, because the information that influences a formation making a collective decision may differ significantly from what matters to its commander.
Contemporary PSYOP planning sometimes treats adversaries as either rational actors who follow doctrine or irrational actors driven by emotion. This binary framing is problematic. What appears irrational from an external perspective is often internally consistent, shaped by different incentives, cultural assumptions, or threat perceptions. An actor driven by ideology, religious conviction, or personal grievance operates according to predictable patterns within their own logic.
Dismissing an adversary as irrational often reflects incomplete intelligence work rather than genuine unpredictability. Even when decision-making is primarily affective rather than calculated, emotional triggers can be identified and mapped.
Effective PSYOP must begin by identifying where decisions occur within adversary organizations and which of those decisions offer the greatest operational leverage.
Once decision points are identified, planners must determine what drives adversary decision-making. Decision criteria encompass the factors an adversary uses, consciously or unconsciously, to select courses of action. These may include, but are not limited to, doctrine, standard operating procedures, available intelligence, perceived risks, cultural norms, past experience, or emotional factors such as fear, organizational pride, or perceived urgency.
Understanding decision criteria requires more than traditional intelligence analysis. It demands engagement with adversary doctrine, organizational culture, and individual psychology in combination. The formal criteria embedded in adversary doctrine may differ significantly from the actual criteria commanders apply under operational pressure. A doctrinal analysis might indicate that a unit will defend a position until sustainment falls below a defined threshold. The actual commander might hold past that threshold due to personal determination, political considerations, or unit cohesion. Both sets of criteria are real, and both affect behavior. Planners who model only one dimension risk operational surprise.
At higher organizational levels, decision criteria become institutional. Organizations develop shared assumptions, standard operating procedures, and implicit biases that shape information interpretation. Over time, these form a collective organizational psychology distinct from, though related to, individual psychology. Psychological warfare that targets only one dimension operates at reduced effectiveness.
Many psychological operations fall short because messages, narratives, and signals are developed without a clear understanding of the decision criteria they are meant to influence. Without that understanding, even technically successful operations may fail to produce meaningful behavioral effects.
Adversary decisions depend on the quality and interpretation of available information. Adversaries rely on multiple inputs: sensors, intelligence reports, communications, media, and direct observations. These inputs are not consumed directly by decision-makers; they are filtered, translated, and interpreted through organizational and cognitive processes before reaching the point of decision.
Information passes from sensor to decision point through multiple translation layers, each subject to distortion, bias, delay, and information loss. This creates opportunities for intervention. The path between observed reality and decision can be conceptualized as running through three translation layers: the sensor that observes, the conduit that transmits the observation, and the interpreter who processes it for decision-makers. Each layer presents targeting opportunities.
Practitioners can deceive sensors, corrupt or intercept transmission conduits, or shape the interpretive context. The translation layer often proves most decisive. An adversary may possess accurate data yet make poor decisions if that data is misinterpreted, deprioritized, or overwhelmed by competing inputs. Conversely, incomplete or even incorrect data can support effective decisions if it aligns with expectations and is trusted by decision-makers.
In environments of increasing data volume and complexity, the ability to influence information interpretation may prove more valuable than the ability to collect or deny information outright. This manipulation operates bidirectionally; protecting friendly information through operational security and deception is equally important. Forces that understand information warfare vulnerabilities in adversary systems will better recognize their own susceptibilities.
The objective is not simply introducing false information, but rather shaping information inputs to affect adversary decision criteria at operationally significant moments.
Information operates on different timescales, and verification requirements vary accordingly.
Tactical decisions demand actionable information: data sufficient to support immediate action, with the understanding that situational clarity will improve over time.
Strategic decisions require deeper understanding: synthesis of information over time that reveals underlying causation, not merely observable events.
Both tactical and strategic assessments depend on historical reference points that anchor interpretation. In an era of synthetic media and artificially generated content, protecting these reference anchors represents a strategic imperative. The practitioner’s task is matching confidence levels to operational risk and understanding which temporal framework applies to specific decisions.
If PSYOP fundamentally concerns shaping adversary decisions, current organizational approaches are often
. US PSYOP capabilities tend to be organized around functional domains: cyber operations, electronic warfare, or other specific capabilities, rather than around the decisions they seek to influence. This produces fragmented efforts that may achieve domain-specific effects while failing to generate coherent impacts on adversary behavior.
A decision-centric approach offers a framework for capability integration. Rather than asking what a specific platform or capability can accomplish, planners should begin by asking: What decision are we attempting to influence? What criteria drive that decision? What information feeds those criteria, and where along the information chain is it most vulnerable to intervention? From this foundation, capabilities can be applied in combination, targeting different points along the information chain toward unified effects.
This approach does not necessarily require new authorities or technologies. It requires reconceptualizing the fundamental unit of analysis in PSYOP planning, shifting focus from capabilities and platforms to adversary decision processes.
PSYOP is frequently characterized as complex, abstract, and difficult to operationalize. In practice, it can be reduced to a more straightforward framework: understand when adversaries make decisions, understand how those decisions are made, then shape the information that informs them, whether at the sensor, in transmission, or in interpretation.
As the Army continues to transform its information forces to operate in
, demonstrating how these capabilities contribute to operational outcomes becomes increasingly important. The foundation for this demonstration begins with a clear analytical question: what decision are we targeting? Subsequent planning follows from that initial question.
The primary challenge facing US Psychological Operations is not capability development, but rather operational focus. By organizing PSYOP efforts around adversary decision processes rather than friendly capabilities and platforms, the joint force can more effectively translate technical capacity into decisive operational effects.
_source.movement_title: 美军心理战需重构决策导向规划框架
_source.movement_abstract: 美国军方心理战（PSYOP）面临的主要挑战并非技术能力发展，而是缺乏统一的目标方法论。文章提出以决策为中心的框架，强调通过识别对手的决策节点、理解其决策标准、操控信息输入来实现作战效果整合。当前美军虽具备先进的网络战、电子战和心理战技术，但各领域能力分散使用，未能形成协同效应。心理战需针对不同层级（个人、组织系统）的决策点进行差异化分析，既要考虑对手的正式准则，也要关注其实际决策中的非理性因素（如个人意志、文化背景）。信息输入在传感器、传输渠道和解读过程三个层级中存在可干预空间，尤其在信息解读层的操控对决策影响最大。作者指出，应重构心理战规划的基本分析单位，从聚焦己方技术平台转向研究对手的决策流程。通过匹配不同决策层级的信息时效性需求（战术层面需即时信息，战略层面需长期分析），并保护对手的信息参考基准，才能提升心理战效果。文章强调，美军需转变组织方式，将心理战能力围绕目标决策过程整合，而非各自为战。
_source.title: Targeting Decisions: A Simpler Framework for Information Warfare
_source.trans_cont:
美国军方的心理战（PSYOP）挑战并不主要在于能力发展，而在于目标方法。本文提出一个以决策为中心的框架，将现有能力整合到对手的决策点、决策标准和信息输入中，以实现更一致的作战效果。

过去15年，美国军队在信息相关能力方面拥有强大的武器库。从复杂的网络和电子战工具到精炼的心理战手段，联合部队拥有令人印象深刻的技战术手段。然而，这些能力往往被孤立使用，受限于特定领域的权限和组织壁垒，而不是整合以对对手行为产生决定性影响。

心理战面临的基本挑战不是能力发展，而是缺乏一个统一的框架来协同使用这些能力。从根本上说，心理战应被理解为有意地塑造对手的决策：不是抽象地，而是在特定时刻、特定条件下，通过特定的信息输入。

本文提出一个简化心理战规划框架：识别决策点，理解决策标准，操纵影响这些标准的信息。虽然这种方法并非完全新颖，但它提供了一种实用的方法，将不同的能力整合起来，并展示心理战如何影响作战结果。

每一项军事行动，无论是在哪个战争层次，都由
定义。有些是故意且明显的：调动预备队、发起攻击或撤退部队。有些则是微妙甚至无意识的：犹豫、拖延、优先事项错误或选择不作为。

当对手必须做出决策时，这些时刻代表了心理战的关键杠杆点。

决策点不仅存在于个人层面，也存在于组织系统中。一个营级参谋部决定是否重新部署，一个上级指挥机构确定升级阈值，或政治领导层权衡战略风险，都代表了更广泛网络中的不同决策点。有效的心理战需要确定应针对哪个层面以及原因，因为影响一个集体决策单位的信息可能与影响其指挥官的信息大不相同。

当代心理战规划有时将对手视为要么遵循教条的理性行为者，要么由情绪驱动的非理性行为者。这种二元框架是有问题的。从外部看来似乎非理性的行为，往往在内部是自洽的，受到不同的激励、文化假设或威胁认知的影响。一个受意识形态、宗教信仰或个人怨恨驱动的行为者，其行为在自己的逻辑框架内是可预测的。

将对手视为非理性往往反映的是情报工作的不完整，而不是真正的不可预测性。即使决策主要由情感驱动而非理性计算，情感触发点也可以被识别和映射。

有效的心理战必须首先确定对手组织中的决策发生在哪里，以及哪些决策提供了最大的作战杠杆。

一旦确定了决策点，规划者必须确定影响对手决策的因素。决策标准包括对手在选择行动方案时，有意识或无意识使用的影响因素。这些因素可能包括但不限于：教条、标准操作程序、可用情报、感知风险、文化规范、过去经验或情感因素，如恐惧、组织自豪感或感知的紧迫性。

理解决策标准需要的不仅仅是传统的情报分析。它需要结合对手的教条、组织文化和个体心理进行互动。对手教条中嵌入的正式标准可能与实际指挥官在作战压力下应用的标准有显著差异。教条分析可能表明一个单位会防守一个位置直到补给低于某个定义的阈值。而实际指挥官可能在超过该阈值后仍坚持，这可能是出于个人决心、政治考虑或单位凝聚力。这两套标准都是真实的，都会影响行为。只建模其中一方面的规划者可能会面临作战意外。

在更高层级的组织中，决策标准变得制度化。组织发展出共享的假设、标准操作程序和隐含的偏见，这些影响信息的解释。随着时间的推移，这些形成了与个体心理相关但又不同的集体组织心理。只针对某一维度的心理战效果会大打折扣。

许多心理战行动之所以失败，是因为信息、叙事和信号的开发缺乏对它们旨在影响的决策标准的清晰理解。缺乏这种理解，即使技术上成功，也可能无法产生有意义的行为影响。

对手的决策依赖于可用信息的质量和解释。对手依赖多种输入：传感器、情报报告、通信、媒体和直接观察。这些输入并不直接由决策者消费；它们通过组织和认知过程被过滤、翻译和解释，才到达决策点。

信息从传感器传递到决策点，经过多个翻译层，每个层都可能受到扭曲、偏见、延迟和信息丢失的影响。这为干预提供了机会。从观察到现实与决策之间的路径可以被概念化为经过三个翻译层：观察的传感器、传输观察的渠道以及处理信息供决策者使用的解释者。每一层都提供了针对的机会。

实践者可以欺骗传感器、破坏或拦截传输渠道，或塑造解释的背景。翻译层往往是最关键的。对手可能拥有准确的数据，但由于数据被误解、优先级被降低或被其他输入所淹没，仍可能做出错误的决策。
_source.trans_title: 目标决策：信息战的简化框架
_source.evidence: 文章主要探讨了美军心理战（PSYOP）的规划方法论，提出了一种以‘决策点’为核心的简化框架，旨在整合现有的信息战能力以影响敌方决策。文章重点在于理论框架的构建、作战概念的阐述以及方法论的改进，而非具体的作战行动、部队组建、技术研发或针对中国的特定事件。因此，该文章属于认知域领域的理论、战略框架类内容。

(中央社記者溫貴香台北17日電)總統賴清德將率團訪問非洲友邦史瓦帝尼。涉外人士表示,台灣協助推動史瓦帝尼台灣產業創新園區,未來將做為台商布局全球、連結非洲市場的重要據點,總統此行將聽取「台灣產業創新園區」與「戰略儲油槽」簡報備受關注。
總統賴清德將於22日至26日率團訪問友邦史瓦帝尼。外交部次長吳志中日前表示,元首外交行程主要包含「官式行程」、「雙邊合作」、「慶典活動」3部份;官式行程部分,將會晤史王恩史瓦帝三世(Mswati III)並舉行雙邊會談,與史國簽署聯合公報、見證兩國外長簽署「中華民國(台灣)政府與史瓦帝尼王國政府關務互助協定」及拜會王母恩彤碧(Ntombi Tfwala)等。
總統訪問史瓦帝尼期間,將聽取「台灣產業創新園區」及「戰略儲油槽」簡報與見證台商簽署「投資意向書」,同時將視察駐史醫療團智慧醫療門診及出席婦女創業小額信貸循環基金成果展等活動。
總統也將出席史王登基40週年暨58歲華誕雙慶典、史國國宴、史國「國際會議中心」(ICC)開幕式及花園派對等慶典活動。
台灣和史瓦帝尼推動雙邊合作成果顯著,在農業方面,「台灣非洲蔬菜倡議」提升包括史瓦帝尼在內的非洲各國蔬菜生產能力,改善糧食多樣性,促進當地民眾健康,豐富其飲食文化。教育方面,光是2025年就有超過600名史國學生來台學習,多所台灣大學也都與史國大學簽署學術交流協議。
涉外人士表示,台灣與史瓦帝尼雙邊合作還包括公衛醫療、婦女創業,以及資通訊及經貿合作等4大領域。在公衛方面,台灣醫療團長年在史國提供醫療服務幫助偏鄉民眾,今年台灣醫療團更搬遷至曼齊尼政府醫院,建立「台灣智慧醫療專區」示範區,導入智慧醫療與先進設備。
婦女創業部分,涉外人士說,台灣協助史國設立「婦女創業小額信貸循環基金」,幫助當地農村婦女取得創業啟動資金,成功協助當地婦女達成經濟獨立,實質翻轉家庭生活,更有計畫受益人為了感念台灣的幫助,將新生兒命名為「Taiwan」。
經貿合作方面,台史雙方簽訂「台史經濟合作協定」,台灣提供史國部分產品優惠關稅待遇,史方也給予台商更優惠投資保障及待遇,實踐互惠共榮願景。此外,涉外人士表示,台灣協助推動史瓦帝尼台灣產業創新園區,未來也將作為台商布局全球、連結非洲市場的重要據點。
涉外人士表示,值得注意的是,台灣擁有領先世界的半導體及資通訊產業,同時長年面對各種境外錯假資訊侵擾,台灣也分享經驗與技術給史國,協助史國建置5G基地台、導入智慧監控系統,雙邊並簽訂「合作防制資訊操弄及促進資訊完整性瞭解備忘錄」,以強化社會韌性、共同抵禦假訊息。(編輯:翟思嘉)1150417
_source.movement_title: 台湾总统赖清德访问史瓦帝尼 推动产业医疗等领域合作
_source.movement_abstract: 台湾总统赖清德将于22日至26日率团访问友邦史瓦帝尼，期间将举行双边会晤、签署联合公报及见证两国签署关务互助协定等官方活动。访问重点包括听取「台湾产业创新园区」及「战略储油槽」简报，视察驻史医疗团智慧医疗门诊，并出席妇女创业小额信贷循环基金成果展。双方在农业领域实施「台湾非洲蔬菜倡议」提升粮食多样性，教育方面2025年已有超600名史国学生来台学习，多所台湾大学与史国大学签署学术交流协议。医疗合作方面，台湾医疗团已在曼齐尼政府医院建立智慧医疗专区。妇女创业项目通过小额信贷基金帮助当地农村妇女实现经济独立，部分受益人将新生儿命名为「Taiwan」。经贸领域签署经济合作协定，台湾给予史国产品优惠关税，史国则提供台商更优惠投资待遇。双方还合作建设5G基地台、智慧监控系统，并签署防制信息操弄备忘录，强化社会韧性。

_source.trans_cont:
（中央社记者温贵香台北17日电）总统赖清德将率团访问非洲友邦斯威士兰。涉外人士表示，台湾协助推动斯威士兰台湾产业创新园区，未来将成为台商布局全球、连接非洲市场的重要据点，总统此行将听取「台湾产业创新园区」与「战略储油槽」简报备受关注。

总统赖清德将于22日至26日率团访问友邦斯威士兰。外交部次长吴志中日前表示，元首外交行程主要包括「官方行程」、「双边合作」、「庆典活动」三部分；官方行程部分，将晤见斯威士兰国王姆斯瓦蒂三世（Mswati III）并举行双边会谈，与斯国签署联合公报、见证两国外长签署「中华民国（台湾）政府与斯威士兰王国政府关务互助协定」及拜会王后恩彤碧（Ntombi Tfwala）等。

总统访问斯威士兰期间，将听取「台湾产业创新园区」及「战略储油槽」简报与见证台商签署「投资意向书」，同时将视察驻斯医疗团智慧医疗门诊及出席妇女创业小额贷款循环基金成果展等活动。

总统也将出席斯王登基40周年暨58岁华诞双庆典、斯国国宴、斯国「国际会议中心」（ICC）开幕式及花园派对等庆典活动。

台湾与斯威士兰双边合作成果显著，在农业方面，「台湾非洲蔬菜倡议」提升包括斯威士兰在内的非洲各国蔬菜生产能力，改善粮食多样性，促进当地民众健康，丰富其饮食文化。教育方面，仅2025年就有超过600名斯国学生来台学习，多所台湾大学也都与斯国大学签署学术交流协议。

涉外人士表示，台湾与斯威士兰双边合作还包括公共卫生医疗、妇女创业，以及资通讯及经贸合作等四大领域。在公共卫生方面，台湾医疗团长期在斯国

(中央社記者戴雅真東京17日專電)日本京都府南丹市11歲男童死亡案引發高度關注,但隨案件發展,網路上關於嫌犯身分的各類謠言同步擴散。對此,日本警方今天出面澄清,強調包括國籍、年齡等流傳資訊皆「毫無根據」,予以否認。
37歲的安達優季因涉嫌將11歲繼子的遺體棄置於南丹市山區,已被依涉嫌遺棄屍體罪逮捕。他在偵訊中供稱殺害男童並獨自棄屍。
案件曝光後迅速引發日本及海外媒體關注,然而在社群平台如臉書、Threads及X上,也同步出現大量未經查證的訊息。網路上先是流傳安達為中國籍,隨後又稱其為歸化日本籍的台灣人,甚至連年齡、職業與居住情況等細節,也出現多個版本。
部分台灣媒體未經查證即引用網路說法,甚至聲稱引用不存在的日本媒體報導。相關內容再被翻譯成日文後回流日本社群,導致錯誤資訊擴散,甚至衍生陰謀論。
每日新聞報導,早在安達遭逮捕前,社群上就已有「犯人是24歲」等貼文被大量轉傳,即使在嫌疑人於16日被逮捕後,關於他是特定國籍,以及與男童沒有同住等各種缺乏根據的資訊,仍持續擴散。對此,辦案相關人士已經明確予以否認。
此外,疑似利用生成式AI製作的安達優季及男童的圖片也在網路上流傳。

_source.movement_abstract: 日本京都府南丹市11岁男童死亡案引发社会关注，37岁嫌疑人安达优季因涉嫌遗弃尸体被捕，其在侦讯中承认杀害继子并独自处理尸体。案件曝光后，网络社交平台出现大量未经核实的谣言，包括安达为中国人、归化台湾籍者等不实国籍信息，以及年龄、职业、居住情况等多版本传闻。部分台湾媒体未核实信息便引用网络说法，甚至编造日本媒体不存在的报道，导致错误信息通过日文翻译回流日本社群，衍生阴谋论。日本警方明确表示所有网络流传信息均无根据，并予以否认。此外，疑似利用生成式AI制作的嫌疑人与男童图片也在网络传播。案件相关人士指出，即便在嫌疑人16日被捕后，仍有大量缺乏依据的谣言持续扩散。
