(中央社華盛頓16日綜合外電報導)美國總統川普今天表示,將提名疫情期間擔任副醫務總監的史瓦茲(Erica Schwartz)出任「美國疾病管制暨預防中心」(CDC)主任,近來此機構面臨多次主管人事動盪。
路透社報導,史瓦茲曾在川普第一任期參與聯邦對抗COVID-19(2019冠狀病毒疾病)工作,協助協調全國防疫準備與公衛措施。
對陷入爭議的疾病管制暨預防中心,史瓦茲被視為是傾向傳統的選擇。白宮正試圖將政策重心轉向降低藥價與食品安全等較受歡迎議題,而非衛生部長小羅勃甘迺迪(Robert F. Kennedy Jr.)具爭議的疫苗政策。
共和黨此舉亦是為11月期中選舉所面臨的艱困情勢作準備。小羅勃甘迺迪今天在國會聽證會上,對於疫苗相關問題大多予以迴避。
史瓦茲若獲准出任,將領導位於亞特蘭大的疾病管制暨預防中心,此機構負責監測與處理國內外公共衛生威脅,中心主任傳統上對美國疫苗政策擁有最終決定權。
史瓦茲將向長期質疑疫苗安全的小羅勃甘迺迪負責,小羅勃甘迺迪對疫苗的立場與既有科學共識相左。
川普去年8月因前中心主任莫納雷斯(Susan Monarez)反對小羅勃甘迺迪規劃的疫苗政策調整,而將其解職。
史瓦茲對疫苗並沒有明顯公開的立場,但她曾獲部分批評小羅勃甘迺迪疫苗政策的前公衛官員肯定。
民調顯示,多數選民不支持小羅勃甘迺迪改革兒童疫苗接種時程的作法。
消息人士指出,在小羅勃甘迺迪任命多名具爭議政治背景人士,削弱民眾對疫苗的信任之後,白宮尋求由較傳統人選出任相關要職。(編譯:屈享平)1150417
_source.movement_title: 特朗普提名史瓦兹接任CDC主任应对疫苗政策争议
_source.movement_abstract: 美国总统特朗普宣布提名疫情期间担任副医务总监的史瓦兹（Erica Schwartz）出任美国疾病管制暨预防中心（CDC）主任。该机构近期因卫生部长小罗伯特·甘迺迪的争议性疫苗政策引发人事动荡。史瓦兹曾在特朗普第一任期参与联邦抗疫工作，被视为传统派选择。白宫试图通过人事调整将政策重心转向降低药价和食品安全等议题，以应对中期选举压力。小甘迺迪在国会听证会上回避疫苗相关问题，其质疑疫苗安全的立场与科学共识相左。特朗普去年8月因前任CDC主任莫纳雷斯反对小甘迺迪的疫苗政策调整而将其解职。史瓦兹虽未公开表态疫苗问题，但获得部分反对小甘迺迪政策的前公共卫生官员认可。民调显示多数选民不支持小甘迺迪改革儿童疫苗接种时程的方案。白宫消息人士指出，小甘迺迪任命多名争议政治背景人士已削弱民众对疫苗的信任，因此寻求由传统人选接任关键职位以重建公信力。
_source.title: 傾向回歸傳統公衛路線 川普擬提名史瓦茲掌CDC
_source.trans_cont:
（中央社华盛顿16日电）美国总统特朗普今天表示，将提名在疫情期间担任副医务总监的施瓦茨（Erica Schwartz）出任“美国疾病管制暨预防中心”（CDC）主任，该机构近期经历多次高层人事变动。
路透社报道，施瓦茨曾在特朗普第一任期参与联邦抗疫工作，协助协调全国防疫准备与公共卫生措施。
对于陷入争议的疾病管制暨预防中心，施瓦茨被视为传统派代表。白宫正试图将政策重心转向降低药价与食品安全等更受民众欢迎的议题，而非卫生部长小罗伯特·肯尼迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）颇具争议的疫苗政策。
共和党此举亦为应对11月期中选举的艰难形势做准备。小罗伯特·肯尼迪今日在国会听证会上，对疫苗相关问题大多避而不谈。
若施瓦茨获准接任，将领导位于亚特兰大的疾病管制暨预防中心，该机构负责监测与应对国内外公共卫生威胁，中心主任传统上对美国疫苗政策拥有最终决定权。
施瓦茨将向长期质疑疫苗安全的小罗伯特·肯尼迪负责，其疫苗立场与现有科学共识相左。
特朗普去年8月因前中心主任莫纳雷斯（Susan Monarez）反对小罗伯特·肯尼迪规划的疫苗政策调整，而将其解职。
施瓦茨对疫苗并无明显公开立场，但她曾获得部分批评小罗伯特·肯尼迪疫苗政策的前公共卫生官员肯定。
民调显示，多数选民不支持小罗伯特·肯尼迪改革儿童疫苗接种时间表的做法。
消息人士指出，在小罗伯特·肯尼迪任命多名具有争议政治背景人士、削弱民众对疫苗信任之后，白宫寻求由较传统人选担任相关要职。（编译：屈享平）

Taipei, April 15 (CNA) Former Philippine Army vice commander Leodevic B. Guinid, in a recent interview, called for regional interoperability mechanisms for the evacuation of international noncombatants in the event of a Chinese attack against Taiwan.
Speaking to local media on Saturday, Guinid recommended a scenario-based preparedness program wherein stakeholders identify the worst-case scenario for evacuating noncombatants.
This would include evacuating Filipinos from Taiwan and China, as well as Taiwanese, Americans, and residents of other countries living in Taiwan, said Guinid, who was in Taipei for a security forum held by the Formosa Republican Association.
In such a scenario, the Philippines must be prepared to accept thousands of its evacuated citizens in Luzon, given its proximity to Taiwan, Guinid said, but an operation on that scale would require international assistance.
"The Philippines cannot do it alone. I believe it should be a regional interoperability measure," Guinid said.
On what Taiwan could learn from the Philippines' tactics to counter China's illegal, coercive, aggressive and deceptive (ICAD) activities against Philippine vessels in the South China Sea, Guinid recommended countering illegal activities through legal avenues, responding to coercion with temperance and combating deception with transparency.
"If it's illegal, we do it legally," he said, citing Manila's resorting to the arbitration mechanisms under the United Nations in the face of China's claims to Philippine-controlled islands in the South China Sea.
"They do it coercively. We temper our activities. We do not act aggressively," Guinid said.
"Lastly, they do it deceptively, we do it transparently" by bringing international media to the forefront "to see what's really happening," he said.
Guinid further suggested that Taipei and Manila strengthen both formal and informal information sharing, given their shared interests and common threats.
Meanwhile, he added, the Philippines has been educating citizens about the nature of China's ICAD activities in the South China Sea, its interests in the region, and its desire to become a regional hegemon to challenge the United States.
Asked what he saw as the most important element for Taiwan to counter Chinese aggression, Guinid said it is the resolve of its people, especially amid China's cognitive warfare against the Taiwanese people.
"There will be weapons, of course, but if the people are united to deter aggression, then I believe [Taiwan] will win," he said. "It's not only the problem of Taiwan, but also the Philippines."
China could shape the mindset of Taiwanese and Filipinos with its "aggressive" cognitive warfare whereby it manipulates information in mainstream and social media, Guinid added.
"We have to counter and provide our own citizens with the right result and the right mindset," he said.
_source.movement_title: 菲律宾前陆军副司令建议台菲建立区域非战斗人员撤离协同机制
_source.movement_abstract: 【台湾中央社4月15日报道】菲律宾前陆军副司令雷奥德维克·B·古伊尼德（Leodevic B. Guinid）于台北出席安全论坛期间接受媒体采访，提出在台海发生针对台湾的军事冲突情境下，台菲应建立区域非战斗人员撤离协同机制。古伊尼德建议制定基于最坏情境的预案，涵盖撤离在台菲律宾公民、台湾居民、美国公民及其他国家居民。他指出，鉴于菲律宾吕宋岛与台湾的地理邻近性，菲律宾需具备接收数千名撤离公民的能力，但此类大规模行动需国际协助，无法单独完成。古伊尼德强调，台湾可借鉴菲律宾应对中国在南海非法、胁迫、侵略及欺骗（ICAD）活动的战术，包括通过法律途径应对非法行为、以克制回应胁迫、以透明对抗欺骗。他建议台菲加强正式与非正式信息共享，共同应对中国认知战。古伊尼德指出，中国通过主流及社交媒体操纵信息，影响台湾与菲律宾民众认知，台菲需向本国公民提供正确信息以塑造正确认知。他强调，台湾抵御侵略的关键在于民众决心，若民众团结一致，台湾将能获胜，此问题不仅关乎台湾，亦涉及菲律宾利益。
_source.title: Interoperability crucial for Taiwan evacuation: Ex-Philippine Army official|English News | 僑務電子報

台北，4月15日（CNA）前菲律宾军队副指挥官莱奥德维克·B·圭尼德在最近的一次采访中呼吁建立区域互操作机制，以应对中国对台湾发动攻击时国际非战斗人员的撤离。  
周六，圭尼德在接受当地媒体采访时表示，建议制定基于情景的准备计划，让相关方识别出撤离非战斗人员的最坏情况。  
他说，这将包括撤离在台湾的菲律宾人和中国人，以及台湾居民、美国人和其他国家的居民。圭尼德当时正在台北参加由福尔摩沙共和党协会举办的安全论坛。  
在这样的情况下，鉴于菲律宾与中国台湾地区地理位置接近，菲律宾必须做好准备接收数千名撤离的本国公民前往吕宋岛，圭尼德表示，但如此规模的行动需要国际援助。  
“菲律宾不能独自完成这件事。我认为这应该是一个区域互操作措施，”圭尼德说。  
在谈及台湾可以从菲律宾应对中国在南海对菲律宾船只进行非法、胁迫性、侵略性和欺骗性（ICAD）活动的战术中学习什么时，圭尼德建议通过法律途径应对非法活动，以克制回应胁迫，并以透明度对抗欺骗。  
“如果非法，我们就依法处理，”他提到马尼拉在面对中国对菲律宾控制的南海岛屿的主张时，诉诸联合国仲裁机制。  
“他们采取胁迫手段，我们则克制行动，不采取侵略性行为，”圭尼德说。  
“最后，他们采取欺骗手段，我们则采取透明的方式，”他补充道，“通过邀请国际媒体在场，让人们看到真正发生的事情。”  
圭尼德还建议，鉴于双方有共同利益和共同威胁，台北和马尼拉应加强正式和非正式的信息共享。  
同时，他提到菲律宾一直在教育公民了解中国在南海的ICAD活动性质、其在该地区的利益以及其挑战美国成为区域霸权的意图。  
当被问及他认为台湾应对中国侵略最重要的要素时，圭尼德表示，这是台湾人民的决心，尤其是在中国对台湾人民进行认知战的背景下。  
“当然会有武器，但如果人民团结一致以遏制侵略，我相信台湾会赢，”他说，“这不仅是台湾的问题，也是菲律宾的问题。”  
圭尼德补充说，中国可以通过其“侵略性”的认知战影响台湾和菲律宾人民的思维方式，通过操控主流媒体和社交媒体上的信息。  
“我们必须进行对抗，并向本国公民提供正确的结果和正确的思维方式，”他说。
_source.trans_title: 台湾疏散行动关键在于互操作性：前菲律宾军方官员 | 英语新闻 | 侨务电子报
_source.evidence: 文章核心内容是菲律宾前军方官员在公开场合讨论针对中国大陆（涉我）的潜在军事冲突场景（如攻击台湾），并详细阐述了中国在认知域（Cognitive Warfare）的所谓'ICAD'（非法、胁迫、侵略、欺骗）活动及其对菲律宾和台湾民众心态的影响。虽然涉及认知战概念，但文章并非描述中国自身的理论发布、技术武器研发或机构组建，而是外部势力对中国认知域行动的描述、评估及应对策略。根据定义，[涉我事件]涵盖'涉及中国大陆（作为被攻击对象或相关方，非发起方）的敌情事件'，此处菲律宾官员将中国描述为认知战发起方并讨论应对，属于典型的涉我敌情/认知对抗事件。

(中央社記者吳柏緯布魯塞爾16日專電)歐洲安全暨合作組織(OSCE)針對剛落幕的匈牙利國會大選提出選舉觀察初步報告指出,雖然公民積極參與、選戰激烈,但執政黨透過模糊國家與政黨的界線製造優勢,使候選人間的競爭並不公平。
匈牙利12日舉行國會大選,政壇新秀馬格雅(Peter Magyar)所屬的尊重與自由黨(Tisza)取得超過2/3絕對多數席次,擊敗執政16年的奧班(Viktor Orban)所屬青年民主黨(Fidesz)。
歐安組織旗下的民主體制與人權辦公室(ODIHR)日前派出選舉觀察團赴匈牙利,並在選舉結束後發布一份選舉觀察報告。
報告提到,在這次的選舉中,公民參與極為踴躍,投票率創下歷史新高。然而,選舉競爭環境並不公平,執政黨憑藉著模糊國家與政黨界線的方式從中獲得優勢。雖然候選人基本上能自由進行競選活動,但競選期間充斥著執政黨分裂社會與散播恐懼的修辭。
文中強調,行政資源廣泛濫用、政府宣傳、媒體與新聞報導偏袒執政黨,以及競選財務規範存在嚴重缺失,進一步削弱了候選人之間的機會平等。
歐安組織特別協調員兼短期觀察團團長坎丹尼揚(Sargis Khandanyan)說,對於熱烈參與這場選舉的公民印象深刻,證明了選民並沒有因為執政黨的分裂性、煽動性修辭以及職權濫用,阻止他們參與投票。雖然執政黨利用政府權力使天平向其傾斜,但選戰過程仍具備競爭性,是一場激烈的選戰。
歐洲理事會議員大會(PACE)代表團團長伊斯班(Pablo Hispan)指出,極高的投票率證明,恐嚇、威脅與脅迫無法壓制人民的民主意志。這是民主的強力回擊,也反映了公民社會與獨立媒體在維持監督、問責及創造政治改變條件等領域,扮演著不可或缺的角色。
民主體制與人權辦公室代表團團長墨菲(Eoghan Murphy)表示,雖然競選活動十分活絡,候選人可以自由競選,但選舉框架並不能確保候選人享有公平的競爭環境。
針對匈牙利的媒體環境,報告指出雖在形式上多元,實際上則嚴重失衡。相較於資源豐厚且強大的親政府媒體,獨立新聞業處於明顯的結構性弱勢。記者面臨資訊受限與充滿壓力的工作環境,甚至出現肢體衝突與網路威脅,令人擔憂。民主體制與人權辦公室所做的社群媒體監測發現,有人利用生成式人工智慧(AI)與操縱性內容,對內進行假訊息宣傳並藉此抹黑政敵。
報告也點出了多項缺失,現任全國選舉委員會主要由執政黨選出或任命的成員組成,影響了其在幾項關鍵競選相關事務決策上的公正性與獨立性;此外,幾乎沒有採取任何努力以增加女性的政治參與,導致女性代表嚴重不足。
雖然從上一次的選舉以來,匈牙利的法律框架經歷了一系列的修改,但報告指出,仍未達到歐安組織承諾和其他國際民主選舉的標準。(編輯:陳慧萍)1150417
_source.movement_title: 欧安组织报告：匈牙利国会选举存在竞争不公
_source.movement_abstract: 欧安组织发布的匈牙利国会选举观察报告指出，尽管选民参与积极、投票率创新高，但执政党通过模糊国家与政党界限、滥用行政资源、政府宣传及媒体偏袒等手段获取优势，导致候选人竞争环境不公。青年民主党在执政16年后首次败选，尊重与自由党获得绝对多数席位。报告特别提到，选举期间存在分裂社会言论、竞选财务规范缺失、独立媒体处于结构性弱势等问题。民主体制与人权办公室监测发现，有人利用生成式人工智能和操纵性内容进行内部假消息宣传。此外，现任全国选举委员会成员多由执政党任命，影响决策公正性；女性政治参与度仍严重不足。欧安组织协调员强调，选战过程虽具竞争性，但选举框架未能保障公平竞争环境，法律体系未达国际民主标准。
_source.title: 歐安組織觀選報告:匈牙利選戰激烈但競爭不公平
_source.trans_cont:
（中央社记者吴柏纬布鲁塞尔16日电）欧洲安全与合作组织（OSCE）针对刚刚结束的匈牙利国会大选发布选举观察初步报告指出，尽管公民积极参与、选战激烈，但执政党通过模糊国家与政党的界限制造优势，使候选人之间的竞争并不公平。

匈牙利12日举行国会大选，政坛新秀马格雅（Peter Magyar）所属的尊重与自由党（Tisza）获得超过2/3的绝对多数席次，击败执政16年的奥班（Viktor Orban）所属的青年民主党（Fidesz）。

欧安组织下属的民主制度与人权办公室（ODIHR）日前派出选举观察团前往匈牙利，并在选举结束后发布一份选举观察报告。

报告指出，此次选举中，公民参与极为踊跃，投票率创下历史新高。然而，选举竞争环境并不公平，执政党凭借模糊国家与政党的界限从中获得优势。虽然候选人基本上能自由进行竞选活动，但竞选期间充斥着执政党分裂社会与散播恐惧的修辞。

文中强调，行政资源被广泛滥用、政府宣传、媒体与新闻报道偏袒执政党，以及竞选财务规范存在严重缺失，进一步削弱了候选人之间的机会平等。

欧安组织特别协调员兼短期观察团团长坎丹尼扬（Sargis Khandanyan）表示，对于热烈参与这场选举的公民印象深刻，证明选民并没有因为执政党的分裂性、煽动性修辞以及职权滥用，阻止他们参与投票。虽然执政党利用政府权力使天平向其倾斜，但选战过程仍具备竞争性，是一场激烈的选战。

欧洲理事会议会大会（PACE）代表团团长伊斯班（Pablo Hispan）指出，极高的投票率证明，恐吓、威胁与胁迫无法压制人民的民主意志。这是民主的强力回击，也反映了公民社会与独立媒体在维持监督、问责及创造政治改变条件等领域，扮演着不可或缺的角色。

民主制度与人权办公室代表团团长墨菲（Eoghan Murphy）表示，虽然竞选活动十分活跃，候选人可以自由竞选，但选举框架并不能确保候选人享有公平的竞争环境。

针对匈牙利的媒体环境，报告指出虽然形式上多元，实际上则严重失衡。相较于资源丰富且强大的亲政府媒体，独立新闻业处于明显的结构性弱势。记者面临信息受限与充满压力的工作环境，甚至出现肢体冲突与网络威胁，令人担忧。民主制度与人权办公室进行的社交媒体监测发现，有人利用生成式人工智能（AI）与操控性内容，在国内进行虚假信息宣传并借此抹黑政敌。

报告也指出了多项缺失，现任全国选举委员会主要由执政党选出或任命的成员组成，影响了其在几项关键竞选相关事务决策上的公正性与独立性；此外，几乎没有采取任何努力以增加女性的政治参与，导致女性代表严重不足。

虽然从上一次的选举以来，匈牙利的法律框架经历了一系列修改，但报告指出，仍未达到欧安组织承诺和其他国际民主选举的标准。（编辑：陈慧萍）
_source.trans_title: 欧安组织观察团报告：匈牙利选举激烈但竞争不公正
_source.evidence: 文章主要报道了欧洲安全与合作组织（OSCE）发布的关于匈牙利国会大选的观察报告，指出选举过程中存在不公平竞争、执政党滥用行政资源、媒体偏袒以及利用生成式AI进行假讯息宣传等问题。虽然文中提到了利用AI进行认知操纵（涉及技术武器概念），但文章的核心事件是‘选举观察报告’这一事实，且事件发生地在匈牙利，并非中国大陆。根据标签定义，[涉我事件]要求涉及中国大陆作为被攻击对象或相关方，此处不符；[行动动向]通常指具体的作战或对抗行动，此处为选举观察；[技术武器]侧重于技术研发或武器化行动，此处仅为选举中的手段描述。由于文章描述的是国际组织对第三国（匈牙利）选举的评估，属于认知域相关但无法归入针对中国的具体事件、中国自身的行动、力量建设或政策发布，因此归类为[其他]。

_source.content:
Many Ukrainians welcomed the overwhelming election defeat of Viktor Orbán in neighboring Hungary last weekend. It is easy to understand why. For years, Orbán’s government had served as a pro-Russian voice within NATO and the European Union, while also consistently obstructing Ukraine’s Euro-Atlantic integration and blocking efforts to back the Ukrainian war effort.
There is now guarded optimism in Kyiv that Orbán’s departure will mean more European support for Ukraine in the fight against Russia, along with a clearer pathway toward the country’s eventual EU membership. These hopes are shared in numerous European capitals. However, a potential new obstacle is now looming on the horizon. With Bulgaria set to vote on April 19 in the country’s parliamentary elections, there is a chance that Russia may soon secure a new ally in Brussels.
If current polling data proves accurate, Bulgaria’s pro-Russian former president Rumen Radev could replace Orbán within the European Union as the bloc’s strongest anti-Ukrainian voice and defender of Russian interests. As president of Bulgaria from 2017 until his resignation earlier this year to run for parliament, Radev condemned EU sanctions against Russia and opposed efforts by the Bulgarian defense industry to supply Ukraine with ammunition.
A former air force general and Communist Party member, Radev has been no friend of United States either. In June 2019, he vetoed the Bulgarian government’s acquisition of sixteen F-16 fighter jets from the US. The veto was so unpopular that parliament overrode it. The deal went forward, but critics saw the incident as evidence of Radev’s anti-American position.
Since stepping down from the presidency, Radev has continued to question his country’s support for Ukraine. In March 2026, caretaker Bulgarian Prime Minister Andrey Gyurov traveled to Kyiv and concluded a ten-year bilateral security agreement similar to those signed by 28 other nations. Radev used the agreement to attack Gyurov in an apparent bid to curry favor with Russian-leaning Bulgarian voters.
This week’s Bulgarian parliamentary election will be the country’s eighth since November 2021. Bulgarian voter sympathies are finely balanced, with around one-third favoring Russia and one-third leaning toward Europe, leading to slim majorities and weak coalitions that tend to rapidly unravel. Radev’s nine years as president mean he is widely viewed as a stability candidate in a time of prolonged political turmoil.
As the current election campaign comes to an end, Radev’s Progressive Bulgaria political party is leading in the polls with around 30 percent. If this translates into votes, he will be in a position to form a new administration together with some smaller pro-Russian parties.
A Radev-led government would be bad news for Ukraine and would represent a significant win for Russia. In the short term, this would likely mean an end to Bulgarian ammunition supplies to Ukraine, forcing NATO to seek other sources. Meanwhile, the US-backed northern corridor for energy supplies to Eastern Europe would lose out in favor of Turk Stream, the last major energy pipeline bringing Russian gas to Europe.
In a broader context, a Bulgaria led by Radev could potentially replace Hungary as Putin’s proxy within the EU and NATO. This would admittedly be something of a downgrade for the Kremlin, as Radev’s influence would be nowhere near that of Viktor Orbán, at least initially. Nevertheless, there is a very real chance that just days after the Hungarian election removed Russia’s main European ally, a new pro-Kremlin government could take office in Bulgaria, presenting Brussels with a similar set of challenges.
The outcome of Sunday’s vote remains in the balance and will depend heavily on voter turnout. Many Bulgarians have chosen to stay at home during recent elections amid widespread public frustration with the country’s political climate. If this pattern repeats on April 19, it will favor Radev and other pro-Kremlin political forces. However, a higher turnout could lead to the election of a pro-Western government.
Greater public engagement is certainly possible. Last December, hundreds of thousands of Bulgarians took to the streets to
against the 2026 state budget amid accusations of widespread corruption, leading to the resignation of the government. Russia will be hoping there is no repeat of this protest mood on Sunday.

_source.movement_title: 保加利亚议会选举或成俄罗斯新盟友
_source.movement_abstract: 匈牙利前总理欧尔班在邻国选举中惨败引发乌克兰及多个欧洲国家对俄罗斯影响力的担忧。欧尔班政府长期在北约和欧盟内支持俄罗斯，阻碍乌克兰欧洲一体化进程。保加利亚即将举行议会选举，若现任执政党候选人拉德夫胜选，可能接替欧尔班成为欧盟内俄罗斯利益的主要代言人。拉德夫曾作为保加利亚总统反对对俄制裁和向乌提供军援，2019年否决美国F-16战机采购案。当前民调显示其领导的政党支持率约30%，若联合其他亲俄小党组阁，将终结保加利亚对乌军援并影响北约能源走廊布局。保加利亚政治倾向呈现三成亲俄、三成亲欧格局，选举结果高度依赖投票率。2026年12月民众曾因腐败问题大规模抗议，迫使政府下台。此次选举若延续低投票率趋势，将利好亲俄势力；若高投票率则可能选出亲西方政府。俄罗斯正密切关注选举动向，希望避免保加利亚重演近期抗议事件。
_source.post_location: 华盛顿特区西北L街1400号
_source.title: Could Bulgaria replace Hungary as Putin’s proxy inside the EU?
_source.trans_cont:
许多乌克兰人欢迎邻国匈牙利总理维克托·欧尔班在上周末的大选中遭遇压倒性失败。这很容易理解。多年来，欧尔班政府在北约和欧盟内部充当亲俄的声音，同时一贯阻碍乌克兰的欧亚一体化进程，并阻止支持乌克兰对抗俄罗斯的行动。

基辅现在谨慎地抱有希望，认为欧尔班的下台将意味着乌克兰在对抗俄罗斯的战斗中获得更多欧洲支持，同时为该国最终加入欧盟铺平道路。这些希望在众多欧洲首都也得到了共鸣。然而，一个新的潜在障碍正在地平线上浮现。随着保加利亚计划于4月19日举行议会选举，俄罗斯可能很快在布鲁塞尔获得新的盟友。

如果目前的民意调查数据准确，保加利亚亲俄前总统鲁门·拉德夫可能会在欧盟内部取代欧尔班，成为该地区最强烈的反乌克兰声音和俄罗斯利益的捍卫者。在2017年至今年早些时候辞职参选议会期间担任保加利亚总统的拉德夫曾谴责对俄罗斯实施的欧盟制裁，并反对保加利亚国防工业向乌克兰提供弹药。

作为一名前空军将军和共产党成员，拉德夫对美国也并不友好。2019年6月，他否决了保加利亚政府从美国购买16架F-16战斗机的计划。这一否决非常不得人心，议会最终推翻了这一决定。交易最终得以进行，但批评者认为这一事件证明了拉德夫的反美立场。

在卸任总统后，拉德夫继续质疑保加利亚对乌克兰的支持。2026年3月，临时政府总理安德里·吉尤罗夫访问基辅，并签署了一项为期十年的双边安全协议，类似于其他28个国家签署的协议。拉德夫利用这项协议对吉尤罗夫进行攻击，似乎是为了取悦倾向俄罗斯的保加利亚选民。

本周的保加利亚议会选举将是自2021年11月以来的第八次选举。保加利亚选民的态度非常微妙，大约三分之一支持俄罗斯，三分之一倾向欧洲，导致多数席位微弱和脆弱的联盟，这些联盟往往迅速瓦解。拉德夫担任总统的九年使他被视为在长期政治动荡时期稳定候选人的代表。

随着当前的选举竞选活动接近尾声，拉德夫领导的进步保加利亚政党在民调中领先，约有30%的支持率。如果这一支持率转化为选票，他将能够与一些较小的亲俄政党一起组建新政府。

由拉德夫领导的政府对乌克兰来说将是坏消息，也将是俄罗斯的重大胜利。短期内，这很可能会导致保加利亚停止向乌克兰提供弹药，迫使北约寻找其他来源。与此同时，美国支持的通往东欧的能源供应北走廊将让位于最后一条主要将俄罗斯天然气输送到欧洲的输气管道——土耳其流。

从更广泛的角度来看，由拉德夫领导的保加利亚可能取代匈牙利，成为普京在欧盟和北约内部的代理人。这无疑对克里姆林宫来说是个降级，因为拉德夫的影响力至少在初期远不及维克托·欧尔班。然而，也存在非常现实的可能性，就在匈牙利选举移除了俄罗斯在欧洲的主要盟友后，几天内保加利亚可能会出现一个新的亲克里姆林宫政府，给布鲁塞尔带来类似的挑战。

周日的投票结果仍处于平衡状态，将很大程度上取决于选民的投票率。许多保加利亚人最近的选举中选择留在家中，由于公众对国家政治环境的广泛不满。如果4月19日再次出现这种模式，将有利于拉德夫和其他亲俄政治力量。然而，更高的投票率可能导致亲西方政府的选举。

更大的公众参与是完全可能的。去年12月，数十万保加利亚人走上街头抗议2026年国家预算，指责广泛腐败，导致政府辞职。俄罗斯希望周日不会再次出现这种抗议情绪。

图片：即将卸任的保加利亚总统鲁门·拉德夫在索非亚向支持者挥手告别，正式卸任总统职务。2026年1月23日。（路透社/斯蒂扬·内诺夫）
_source.trans_title: 保加利亚能否取代匈牙利成为普京在欧盟内的代理人？

Young men are more concerned with religion than women in the same age group, according to new polling data from Gallup released on Thursday.
The survey found that 42 percent of adult men between 18 and 29 years old indicated that religion is “very important” in their lives during telephone surveys conducted between 2024 and 2025. Only 29 percent of women in this age range said the same.
The numbers among young male U.S. adults constitute a 14-point increase from Gallup’s results between 2022 and 2023, indicating a growing number of religious interest from this demographic.
Additionally, young women used to be more engaged in religion several years ago, according to Gallup data from 2022 to 2023. Thirty-two percent of women and 28 percent of men said religion was “very important” to them that year.
A significant number of President Trump’s supporters are white Christians.
According to a Pew Research Center poll released before the 2024 election, 82 percent of white evangelical voters expressed support for Trump over former Vice President Kamala Harris. Additionally, 61 percent of white Catholics supported Trump over Harris.
Eighty-six percent of Black Protestants and 65 percent of Hispanic Catholics backed the Democratic candidate in 2024. Jewish voters also largely favored Harris, with 65 percent expressing support for the candidate ahead of the general election, according to the Pew survey.
This support among white Christian voters has held since the 2024 election, with two-thirds of white evangelicals saying Trump defends people with religious beliefs similar to theirs, according to a Pew poll released on Thursday.
The president recently sparked backlash from Christians on both sides of the aisle after he posted an AI-generated image on Truth Social that appeared to depict him as Jesus. Trump later took down the post, saying he believed it portrayed him as a doctor.
Former GOP Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene (Ga.) criticized Trump and those defending the picture in a Thursday post on the social platform X.
“Trump knows what he is doing,” the former Trump ally wrote. “He knows what he posted. He knows how to manipulate his followers. And he’s not sorry, he never apologized. Instead he lied, and said he was a doctor, which is also absurd.”
Since posting and deleting the original picture, Trump has continued to double down. On Wednesday, he reposted another AI-created photo that depicted him being embraced by Jesus.
“The Radical Left Lunatics might not like this, but I think it is quite nice!!!” Trump wrote on Truth Social.
Some Republican strategists have expressed concerns that these posts and his criticism of the leader of the Catholic Church could distract from the issue of affordability that GOP candidates are hoping to convey to voters ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
Mick Mulvaney, Trump’s former chief of staff during his first term, said the post will not help Republican turnout at the polls this November.
“The midterms are all about turnout,” Mulvaney said. “Republicans need Trump voters to show up in November.  I’m not sure any Republicans think the ‘Jesus/doctor’ post thing encourages people to get to vote GOP.”
The new Gallup poll surveyed 145 U.S. women and 295 men between the ages of 18 and 29 from 2024 and 2025. The margin of error ranges from approximately 7 to 10 percentage points for this age group.

_source.movement_abstract: 盖洛普最新民调显示，2024-2025年间美国18-29岁男性中有42%认为宗教在生命中\"非常重要\"，较2022-2023年增长14个百分点，同期女性比例为29%。2022-2023年数据显示该年龄段女性宗教参与度曾高于男性。皮尤研究中心调查显示，82%白人福音派选民和61%白人天主教选民支持特朗普，但非裔新教徒和拉美裔天主教徒多数支持民主党候选人。特朗普近期在Truth Social发布AI生成的\"耶稣医生\"图像引发基督教群体争议，前共和党众议员玛乔丽·泰勒·格林批评其刻意操控选民。特朗普随后又发布另一张AI图像显示自己与耶稣拥抱，并称这是对激进左派的回应。共和党策略师担忧此类行为可能影响中期选举选民参与度，前白宫首席副官米克·穆尔范尼指出该类帖子不利于共和党选票动员。盖洛普最新民调覆盖2024-2025年间295名男性和145名女性，误差范围约7-10个百分点。
_source.title: More young men than women say religion is important to them: Gallup
_source.trans_cont:
根据盖洛普周四发布的最新民意调查数据，年轻男性比同龄女性更关注宗教。调查显示，在2024年至2025年间进行的电话调查中，18至29岁男性中有42%表示宗教对他们生活“非常重要”，而同年龄段女性中只有29%持相同看法。年轻美国男性中的这一比例比盖洛普2022年至2023年的调查结果上升了14个百分点，表明这一群体对宗教的兴趣正在增长。

此外，根据盖洛普2022年至2023年的数据，年轻女性曾比男性更积极参与宗教活动。当年，32%的女性和28%的男性表示宗教对他们“非常重要”。特朗普的大量支持者是白人基督徒。根据皮尤研究中心在2024年大选前发布的调查，82%的白人福音派选民表示支持特朗普，而非总统候选人卡玛拉·哈里斯。此外，61%的白人天主教徒也支持特朗普。

2024年，86%的非裔基督徒和65%的拉丁裔天主教徒支持民主党候选人。根据皮尤调查，犹太选民也大多支持哈里斯，有65%的选民在大选前表示支持该候选人。自2024年大选以来，白人基督徒选民对特朗普的支持持续存在，根据周四发布的皮尤调查，三分之二的白人福音派表示特朗普捍卫与他们宗教信仰相似的人。

总统最近因在Truth Social上发布了一张人工智能生成的图片引发基督徒的批评，该图片似乎将他描绘成耶稣。特朗普随后删除了该帖子，称他相信图片将他描绘成医生。前共和党众议员玛乔丽·泰勒·格林（佐治亚州）在社交平台X上批评了特朗普及其支持者。

“特朗普清楚自己在做什么，”这位前特朗普盟友写道，“他清楚自己发布了什么内容，知道如何操纵追随者。他从不道歉，反而撒谎称自己是医生，这同样荒谬。”在发布并删除原始图片后，特朗普继续强化这一言论。周三，他重新发布了一张人工智能生成的图片，显示他被耶稣拥抱。

“激进左翼疯子可能不喜欢这个，但我认为这非常不错！！！”特朗普在Truth Social上写道。一些共和党策略师表示，这些帖子及其对天主教会领袖的批评可能会分散选民对党派候选人希望传达的可负担性问题的注意力。特朗普第一任期间的首席顾问米克·穆尔万尼表示，这一帖子不会帮助共和党在11月的选举中吸引更多选民。

Bluesky’s website and app are still
struggling
on Thursday after experiencing service interruptions that COO Rose Wang
attributed
to a denial-of-service attack.
According to the social network’s
status page
, the issues began around 2:42 a.m. ET time on Thursday and have continued since.
Currently, the Bluesky site and app will load at times, slowly, and other times will throw error messages.
For instance, switching to a particular feed within the app displays a message that says “This feed is currently receiving high traffic and is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later. Message from server: Rate Limit Exceeded.”
Popular feeds like Discover or the official Bluesky Team’s feed are seeing this problem, though users’ own personal feeds may launch.
Other times, like when trying to visit a user’s profile, the site will just display an error message, forcing you to refresh and try again.
Bluesky protocol engineer Bryan Newbold remarked
around
3:46 a.m. ET, “oof, our services are getting pretty hard tonight.”
The company has not officially shared what’s causing the slowdown or provided an estimated time for a fix.
Bluesky has not yet responded to a request for comment.
The service disruptions are impacting Bluesky, but other communities running their own infrastructure on the underlying protocol that powers the decentralized social network appear to be functioning for the time being.
_source.movement_title: Bluesky服务持续中断 COO称遭DDoS攻击
_source.movement_abstract: Bluesky的网站和应用程序在周四持续遭遇服务中断，首席运营官Rose Wang将其归咎于拒绝服务攻击。根据社交平台状态页面显示，问题始于周四凌晨2:42（美国东部时间）后持续存在。目前该平台时而缓慢加载，时而弹出错误提示，例如切换特定信息流时显示'当前流量过高导致暂时不可用'。Discover等热门信息流及官方Bluesky团队的信息流均受影响，但部分用户个人信息流仍可访问。当尝试查看用户资料时，网站常直接显示错误信息，需刷新重试。协议工程师Bryan Newbold在3:46（美国东部时间）表示'今晚我们的服务压力很大'。公司尚未正式说明服务延迟的具体原因，也未提供修复时间预估，且未回应媒体的置评请求。值得注意的是，尽管Bluesky自身服务受限，但基于其底层协议运行的其他去中心化社区基础设施目前仍保持正常运作。
_source.title: It’s not just you — Bluesky is (sorta) down
_source.trans_cont: 蓝 sky 的网站和应用程序在周四仍然面临困难，此前经历了服务中断，首席运营官王若雪将其归因于拒绝服务攻击。根据该社交网络的 状态页面，这些问题始于周四凌晨2:42东部时间，并且持续至今。目前，蓝 sky 网站和应用程序有时会缓慢加载，有时则会显示错误信息。例如，在应用程序中切换到特定的动态流时，会显示一条信息：“此动态流当前流量过高，暂时不可用。请稍后再试。来自服务器的信息：请求频率过高。”像“发现”或官方蓝 sky 团队的动态流等热门动态流正在遇到此问题，但用户自己的个人动态流可能仍可启动。有时，比如尝试访问用户的个人资料时，网站只会显示错误信息，迫使用户刷新页面并重新尝试。蓝 sky 协议工程师布莱恩·纽布洛德在凌晨3:46东部时间左右表示：“天啊，我们的服务今晚真的有点吃力。”该公司尚未正式公布导致速度变慢的原因，也未提供修复的预计时间。蓝 sky 目前尚未回应评论请求。服务中断影响了蓝 sky，但其他运行在该去中心化社交网络底层协议上的社区似乎目前仍在正常运作。

Throwback Thursday returns to the
archives to revisit a foundational question that continues to shape modern conflict: what motivates individuals to fight for their country? In
(2018), Virgilijus Rutkauskas examines the social, political, and psychological drivers behind national resistance in the Baltics, offering a framework for understanding how states generate resilience against external aggression.
Rather than treating willingness to fight as an abstract concept, Rutkauskas identifies concrete drivers rooted in institutional trust and individual characteristics. Quantitative analysis across Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania shows that “national pride, confidence in government and the armed forces, and financial satisfaction” are among the most significant predictors of willingness to fight. The findings demonstrate that willingness to fight varies across demographic and socio-economic lines, including age, gender, employment, education, and place of residence, reinforcing that societal cohesion is uneven and must be actively cultivated. Rutkauskas illustrates each Baltic state’s willingness to fight based on those factors, as seen below in the case for Estonia.
Rutkauskas also highlights that willingness to fight fluctuates over time in response to political stability, economic conditions, and external threats, noting sharp increases following events such as Russia’s annexation of Crimea. As a result, the article concludes that willingness to fight is not static but a strategic variable and a “primary target for special operation forces” through information, psychological, and civil affairs activities that shape legitimacy, identity, and trust before conflict begins.
These findings carry direct implications for how military planners and policymakers approach national defense and partner force development. If willingness to fight functions as both a predictor of resistance and a target for adversary influence, then it must be treated as a center of gravity at the societal level rather than a secondary consideration to material capability. Rutkauskas’ framework suggests that efforts to strengthen resilience must extend beyond force structure and training to include deliberate investments in national identity, public trust, and perceptions of government and military legitimacy. This requires integrating civil affairs, psychological operations, and strategic communication into broader campaign design to influence the underlying drivers of willingness to fight.
The ongoing war in Ukraine provides a contemporary validation of these findings.
noted that the
remains the decisive factor in war despite being consistently undervalued in military planning. And Ukrainian’s will to resist Russia since 2022 demonstrates how legitimacy, identity, and threat perception translate into battlefield effectiveness, with early polling showing roughly
willing to fight until victory and
rejecting territorial concessions despite the costs of war. This dynamic also helps explain Russian miscalculation, as highlighted in “
which argues that Moscow underestimated Ukrainian will to resist while overestimating the effectiveness of its own coercive strategy. Despite these early assessments, however, more recent data reflects the strain of prolonged conflict, including
and growing openness to negotiations among Ukrainians.
The contrast with the United States underscores how willingness to fight depends on deeper societal conditions rather than material strength alone. As detailed in the Center for a New American Security’s report,
, the US faces a sustained decline in willingness to serve, with youth propensity falling from 16 percent in 2003 to roughly 10 percent in 2022 alongside a shrinking pool of eligible recruits, reflecting broader issues such as declining social capital and a widening civil-military gap.
The military has enjoyed a much higher degree of trust from the general public than the government overall between 1975–2023. However, since 2009, the percentage of Americans who place high confidence in the military has declined steadily from a high of 82 percent to a low of 60 percent
At the same time, civil-military relations scholar, Heidi Urben, argues in
that the relationship between the military and society has experienced “a slow, steady normative degradation,” driven by increasing politicization and weakening shared understanding of the military’s role. Together, these trends suggest that in the absence of an existential threat, willingness to serve and fight becomes contingent on trust, legitimacy, and national identity, reinforcing Rutkauskas’ central insight that these societal factors constitute a critical foundation of military effectiveness that must be actively sustained over time.
_source.movement_title: 战斗意愿的社会驱动因素及战略影响研究
_source.movement_abstract: 2018年，Virgilijus Rutkauskas通过量化分析揭示了立陶宛地区民众愿意为国家战斗的三大核心因素：国家自豪感、政府与军队信任度以及经济满意度。研究指出，战斗意愿受年龄、性别、职业、教育程度和居住地等人口统计因素显著影响，社会凝聚力需主动培育。文章强调战斗意愿具有动态性，会随政治稳定、经济状况和外部威胁变化，俄罗斯吞并克里米亚后该意愿显著上升。乌克兰战争印证了这一结论，尽管民众持续抵抗，但长期冲突导致支持率下降。美国案例显示，即使拥有强大军事力量，其年轻人服役意愿从2003年16%降至2022年10%，军民信任差距扩大反映社会凝聚力衰退。研究认为，战斗意愿作为战略变量，应通过信息作战、心理战和民事行动等手段，系统性维护国家认同、政府合法性及社会信任，而非仅依赖军事装备。
_source.title: Throwback Thursday: The Will to Fight in Modern War
_source.trans_cont:
周四回顾栏目回到档案中，重新审视一个持续塑造现代冲突的基础性问题：是什么激励个人为自己的国家而战？在《2018年》中，维吉利尤斯·鲁特卡乌斯卡斯研究了波罗的海国家的民族抵抗背后的社交、政治和心理动因，提供了一个理解国家如何在外部侵略面前产生韧性的框架。
鲁特卡乌斯卡斯并未将战斗意愿视为一个抽象概念，而是识别出根植于制度信任和个体特征的具体动因。对爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和立陶宛的定量分析表明，“民族自豪感、对政府和武装部队的信心以及经济满意度”是预测战斗意愿的最重要因素之一。研究结果表明，战斗意愿在人口统计和社会经济层面存在差异，包括年龄、性别、就业状况、教育水平和居住地，这强化了社会凝聚力的不均衡性，必须积极培育。鲁特卡乌斯卡斯根据这些因素展示了每个波罗的海国家的战斗意愿，如下以爱沙尼亚为例。
鲁特卡乌斯卡斯还指出，战斗意愿会随时间波动，以政治稳定、经济状况和外部威胁为响应，例如俄罗斯吞并克里米亚后，战斗意愿显著上升。因此，文章得出结论，战斗意愿并非静态，而是一个战略变量，是“特种作战部队的主要目标”，通过信息、心理和民事事务活动，在冲突开始前塑造合法性、身份认同和信任。
这些发现对军事规划者和政策制定者如何应对国家防御和伙伴部队发展具有直接意义。如果战斗意愿既是抵抗的预测因素，也是对手影响的目标，那么它必须被视为社会层面的核心要素，而不仅仅是物质能力的次要考虑。鲁特卡乌斯卡斯的框架表明，增强韧性的工作必须超越军事结构和训练，还包括对国家认同、公众信任和政府及军队合法性的有意投资。这要求将民事事务、心理战和战略传播整合到更广泛的战役设计中，以影响战斗意愿的潜在动因。
乌克兰的持续战争为这些发现提供了当代验证。
注意到尽管在军事规划中一直被低估，但民众意愿仍然是战争中的决定性因素。自2022年以来，乌克兰人抵抗俄罗斯的意愿展示了合法性、身份认同和威胁感知如何转化为战场上的有效性，早期民意调查显示约
愿意战斗直至胜利，并
拒绝领土让步，尽管战争成本高昂。这种动态也解释了俄罗斯的误判，正如《
》所指出的，莫斯科低估了乌克兰的抵抗意愿，同时高估了自身强制战略的有效性。然而，尽管有这些早期评估，最近的数据反映了长期冲突带来的压力，包括
以及乌克兰人日益增长的谈判意愿。
与美国的对比突显了战斗意愿取决于更深层次的社会条件，而不仅仅是物质力量。正如新美国安全中心的报告《
》所详细说明的，美国面临持续下降的服役意愿，年轻人的服役意愿从2003年的16%下降到2022年的约10%，同时合格招募者的数量也在减少，反映了更广泛的问题，如社会资本下降和军民关系的扩大。
在1975年至2023年间，公众对军队的信任程度远高于对政府整体的信任。然而，自2009年以来，认为军队值得高度信任的美国人比例稳步下降，从高点82%降至低点60%。
与此同时，军事与社会关系学者海迪·厄本在《
》中指出，军队与社会之间的关系经历了“缓慢而持续的规范性退化”，这由日益增加的政治化和对军队角色的共同理解减弱所驱动。这些趋势共同表明，在缺乏存在性威胁的情况下，服役和战斗的意愿取决于信任、合法性以及国家认同，这强化了鲁特卡乌斯卡斯的核心观点，即这些社会因素构成了军事效能的关键基础，必须在时间中积极维持。
_source.trans_title: 周四回顾：现代战争中的战斗意志

Google said Thursday it blocked a record 8.3 billion ads globally in 2025 — up from
5.1 billion the year before
. But the company suspended far fewer advertiser accounts than that surge might suggest, raising questions about how it polices its platform.
The search giant attributed the disparity to its growing use of AI, particularly its Gemini models — Google’s family of AI systems — which Google says allow it to detect and block policy-violating ads earlier and with greater precision. Its AI-driven systems caught more than 99% of such ads last year before they were shown to users, the company said.
Both findings come from Google’s 2025 Ads Safety Report and together reflect a broader change in enforcement. While more problematic ads are being stopped, fewer advertiser accounts are being suspended — indicating a transition from banning bad actors outright to blocking individual ads on a case-by-case basis.
Google said the rise in blocked ads also reflects the growing use of generative AI by scammers to produce deceptive content at scale, with its Gemini models helping detect patterns across large campaigns and block them earlier.
The shift also mirrors a wider push by Google to integrate its Gemini models
more deeply into its core products
and infrastructure,
including advertising
, where the company is increasingly using AI to automate campaign creation, detect policy violations, and respond to emerging threats in real time.
Among the blocked ads and suspended accounts, 602 million ads and 4 million advertiser accounts were linked to scams, the company said.
Google removed over 1.7 billion ads and suspended 3.3 million advertiser accounts in the U.S. in 2025, with ad network abuse, misrepresentation, and sexual content among the most common violations. In India, Google’s largest market by users, it blocked 483.7 million ads — nearly double the previous year — even as account suspensions fell to 1.7 million from 2.9 million, with trademarks, financial services, and copyright issues among the top violations.
At a virtual briefing, Keerat Sharma, VP and general manager of ads privacy and safety at Google, told reporters the company has shifted toward more targeted, AI-driven enforcement “at a much more granular level, on a creative level, as opposed to using a much more blunt instrument, like advertiser suspensions.” He added that the approach has helped reduce incorrect suspensions by 80% year over year.
Google’s layered defenses, including advertiser verification (a process that requires businesses to confirm their identity before running ads), are designed to prevent bad actors from creating accounts in the first place, Sharma said, adding that this has contributed to the decline in suspensions.
The numbers, Sharma said, are likely to fluctuate over time as Google rolls out new defenses and bad actors adapt, with the company aiming to stop harmful ads as early in the pipeline as possible.
_source.movement_title: 谷歌2025年拦截广告创新高 AI技术降低账户暂停率
_source.movement_abstract: 2025年，谷歌全球拦截广告数量达83亿条，较2024年增长62.7%。但同期仅暂停330万广告商账户，较拦截量增长幅度显著降低。公司表示，这一差异主要源于Gemini系列AI模型的深度应用，其通过提升广告违规检测的精准度和时效性，将99%以上的违规广告在展示前拦截。数据显示，AI驱动策略使错误暂停率同比下降80%，并实现从全面封禁违规账户向逐条拦截问题广告的精细化转型。其中602万条拦截广告与诈骗相关，美国市场共移除17亿条广告并暂停330万账户，印度市场拦截广告量同比翻倍至48370万条但账户暂停数下降41.4%。谷歌广告与隐私安全副总裁Keerat Sharma强调，通过广告商身份验证等防御体系，公司致力于在广告投放早期阶段阻止有害内容，并预计随着防御系统更新和违规行为演变，相关数据将动态调整。
_source.title: Google is now targeting bad ads over bad actors
_source.trans_cont:
谷歌周四表示，2025年全球共阻止了创纪录的83亿美元广告——比前一年的51亿美元有所增加。但该公司暂停的广告商账户数量远少于这一增长幅度，这引发了人们对它如何管理平台的疑问。

这家搜索引擎巨头将这一差异归因于其日益增长的AI使用，特别是其Gemini模型——谷歌的AI系统家族。谷歌称，这些模型使其能够更早、更精确地检测并阻止违反政策的广告。该公司表示，去年其AI驱动的系统在广告展示给用户之前就拦截了超过99%的此类广告。

这两项发现均来自谷歌2025年广告安全报告，共同反映了执法方式的更广泛变化。虽然越来越多的问题广告被阻止，但被暂停的广告商账户却更少，这表明从直接封禁不良行为者向按个案阻止个别广告的转变。

谷歌表示，阻止广告数量的增加也反映了诈骗分子越来越多地使用生成式AI来大规模制作欺骗性内容。其Gemini模型有助于在大规模活动中识别模式并提前阻止这些广告。

这一转变也反映了谷歌更广泛的努力，即将其Gemini模型更深入地整合到其核心产品和基础设施中，包括广告领域，该公司正越来越多地利用AI来自动化广告活动创建、检测政策违规行为，并实时应对新兴威胁。

在被阻止的广告和被暂停的账户中，谷歌表示，有6.02亿条广告和400万个广告商账户与诈骗有关。

2025年，谷歌在美国移除了超过17亿条广告并暂停了330万个广告商账户，其中广告网络滥用、虚假陈述和色情内容是最常见的违规行为。在印度，谷歌最大的用户市场，它阻止了4.837亿条广告——几乎是前一年的两倍，尽管被暂停的账户数量从290万个降至170万个，其中商标、金融服务和版权问题是最常见的违规行为。

在一次虚拟简报会上，谷歌广告隐私与安全部门的副总裁兼总经理Keerat Sharma告诉记者，公司已转向更加有针对性、由AI驱动的执法方式，“在更细粒度的层面，比如创意层面，而不是使用更粗暴的工具，比如暂停广告商账户。”他补充说，这种方法使错误暂停的数量同比减少了80%。

Sharma表示，谷歌的多层次防御措施，包括广告商验证（要求企业在投放广告前确认身份的过程），旨在防止不良行为者创建账户，这有助于减少账户暂停的数量。

Sharma表示，这些数字会随着时间的推移而波动，因为谷歌推出新的防御措施，而不良行为者也在不断适应，公司旨在尽可能早地在广告流程中阻止有害广告。
_source.trans_title: 谷歌现在开始针对不良广告而非不良行为者

Vanda Felbab-Brown, El Centro Fellow and Director of the Initiative on Nonstate Armed Actors at the
, and Diana Paz García, Senior Research Assistant at the Strobe Talbott Center for Security, Strategy, and Technology, examine the evolving crime-terrorism nexus in
The authors argue that emerging technologies are reshaping how nonstate armed actors generate revenue and project power, emphasizing that “new technologies...are eroding the traditional benefits and reasons for holding territory.” Technological transformation among Transnational Criminal Organizations (TCOs) and extremist networks is a global trend, but it carries direct implications for cartel activity in Mexico and across Latin America, where groups such as the Sinaloa Cartel rely on synthetic drug production, AI-enabled fraud, and cryptocurrency laundering to reduce dependence on physical terrain while expanding their transnational operations.
“New technologies, such as synthetic drugs production, digital payment systems, AI, and networked devices, are eroding the traditional benefits and reasons for holding territory, especially its role in generating revenue. AI-enabled scams, online fraud schemes, ransomware operations, and cryptocurrency-based laundering can now yield earnings larger than the taxation of legal or illegal economies.... Increasingly effective 3D printing and other forms of additive manufacturing will reduce the need to procure weapons from the illicit international market... offering advantages like self-sufficiency and simplified logistics.”
“Remote platforms, including inexpensive aerial drones—whether military-grade drones leaking from wars or modified commercial models—are making it possible to carry out killings and assassinations from great distances in criminal contexts, not just in wars or insurgencies. Nor will violence be limited to kamikaze drones dropping from the sky onto targeted government officials or noncompliant extortion victims. With a few keystrokes, attackers can compromise critical infrastructure... Turning ordinary household systems into instruments of lethal harm will vastly expand the tactical options and target sets for terrorists and criminals... The territorial model of terrorist finance and criminal governance has been highly labor-intensive... As everyday objects are turned into explosives and drones are used for killings and territorial control, the number of hitmen and rank-and-file combatants will shrink radically.”
“AI systems and other technologies will allow groups to expand their operations without having to enlarge their workforce. A small number of people running automated scams, deepfake-enabled identity fraud, and algorithmic phishing can impact millions of victims at minimal cost... Paradoxically, this shift toward learner criminal operations will occur just as broad segments of the population, including many middle-class professionals, will likely face job losses driven by AI adoption.”
The cumulative effect of these shifts points to a global reconfiguration of how transnational criminal and terrorist networks define and contest power. While technology reduces dependence on territory and labor, it does not altogether eliminate the strategic value of physical space or human networks. Instead, it focuses on protecting key geographic nodes and critical data infrastructure/ecosystems that support digital and kinetic operations. For cartels in particular, this evolution suggests a hybrid model in which localized territorial control seeks outsized influence and impact through diffuse, technology-enabled revenue generation and the projection of violence across borders.
For some militant groups, having a rebel state with large land and people to control is their primary goal and infuses their identity... having access to a physical haven beyond the reach of law enforcement—such as territory shielded by a rival state—will continue to offer significant advantages... The world’s littorals will rise in importance. That doesn’t mean that nonstate armed actors will constantly need to possess long coastlines, but they will benefit from frequent access points... [and] remote violence and digital crime, like the overall digital economy, will depend on physical materials, data centers, and energy flows. Localities rich in critical minerals, rare earth elements, water, energy production, and data infrastructure will be priority targets for a wide range of actors.
Data, and the ability to protect or exploit it, will become the most important asset. The capacity to collect information, break into rivals’ systems, and shield one’s own data from hostile breaches will define advantage... Instead of controlling large territories and managing populations at scale, militants’ and criminals’ offensive and defensive operations will increasingly revolve around dominating digital infrastructure and manipulating information flows.
For SOCSOUTH and USSOCOM, these trends demand a recalibration of how USSOF conceptualize foreign internal defense, intelligence gathering, and operational design in the Western Hemisphere. TCOs and extremist networks will continue to leverage technology to generate revenue, project power, and evade state control, which further weakens partnered nation governance capacity and legitimacy, risking the shift toward criminalized state structures if left unaddressed.
Source:
As Felbab-Brown and Paz García assess, “the fight between security services and illicit actors will pivot toward a contest over data control in a complex, crowded, and highly transparent battlefield,” where actors that can manipulate or exploit information gain decisive advantages. Cartel adaptation through low-signature, technology-enabled operations undermines approaches that prioritize territorial disruption and leadership targeting alone. USSOF must therefore bolster partner resilience by enabling their ability to operate in contested information environments, secure critical infrastructure, and counter technologically enabled coercion. The operational environment will reward forces that can identify and disrupt dispersed, multidomain threats within in a long-running competition in which advantage favors to those who can outpace its adversaries in technological adaptation.
_source.movement_title: 技术重塑跨国犯罪与恐怖主义网络的权力结构
_source.movement_abstract: 文章分析了非国家武装行为体利用新兴技术改变犯罪与恐怖主义模式的趋势。作者指出，合成毒品生产、数字货币洗钱、AI诈骗等技术手段使犯罪组织减少对传统领土的依赖，转而通过跨国数字运营获取更高收益。3D打印等技术降低了武器获取门槛，无人机远程攻击和网络武器使暴力手段突破地域限制。数据安全成为核心战略资源，掌握信息收集与防护能力可决定竞争优势。针对墨西哥及拉美地区，贩毒集团已形成技术驱动的混合模式，通过本地化控制与数字手段结合扩大影响力。文章建议特种作战部队需调整策略，强化合作伙伴在信息环境、关键基础设施和数字对抗方面的能力，以应对分散化、多域化的威胁。
_source.title: The New Battlespace: Cartels, Technology, and the Future of SOF in the Americas
_source.trans_cont:
范达·费尔巴布-布朗是该中心的高级研究员，也是非国家武装行为倡议的主任，而迪安娜·帕斯·加西亚是斯特罗布·塔尔博特安全、战略与技术中心的高级研究助理。他们研究了犯罪与恐怖主义之间日益演变的关系。

作者认为，新兴技术正在重塑非国家武装行为体如何获取收入和展示力量，强调“新技术……正在削弱传统上持有领土的好处和理由。”跨国犯罪组织（TCOs）和极端分子网络的技术变革是一个全球趋势，但这一趋势对墨西哥及整个拉丁美洲的贩毒集团活动具有直接的影响，这些集团如锡那罗亚贩毒集团依赖合成毒品生产、人工智能驱动的欺诈和加密货币洗钱来减少对实体领土的依赖，同时扩大其跨国活动。

“新技术，如合成毒品生产、数字支付系统、人工智能和联网设备，正在削弱传统上持有领土的好处和理由，特别是其在产生收入方面的作用。人工智能驱动的诈骗、在线欺诈计划、勒索软件操作和基于加密货币的洗钱现在可以带来比合法或非法经济税收更高的收益……日益有效的3D打印和其他形式的增材制造将减少从非法国际市场上采购武器的必要性……提供诸如自给自足和简化后勤等优势。”

“远程平台，包括价格低廉的空中无人机——无论是从战争中泄漏出来的军用无人机还是改装的商用型号——都使得在犯罪情境下从远距离进行谋杀和暗杀成为可能，而不仅仅是在战争或叛乱中。暴力也不再局限于从空中投放的自杀式无人机攻击目标政府官员或不合作的勒索受害者。只需几个按键，攻击者就可以破坏关键基础设施……将普通家庭系统转化为致命伤害的工具将极大地扩展恐怖分子和罪犯的战术选择和目标范围……恐怖主义融资和犯罪治理的领土模式高度依赖人力……随着日常物品被转化为爆炸物，无人机被用于谋杀和领土控制，雇佣杀手和一线战斗人员的数量将大幅减少。”

“人工智能系统和其他技术将使团体能够在不扩大其员工规模的情况下扩展其活动。一小群人运行自动化诈骗、深度伪造身份欺诈和算法钓鱼，可以以极低的成本影响数百万受害者……悖论的是，这种向学习型犯罪活动的转变将发生在许多中产阶级专业人士可能因人工智能的采用而面临失业的时期。”

这些转变的累积效应表明，跨国犯罪和恐怖主义网络在全球范围内重新定义和争夺权力的方式。尽管技术减少了对领土和劳动力的依赖，但它并未完全消除物理空间或人类网络的战略价值。相反，它关注于保护关键的地理节点和支撑数字及动能行动的关键数据基础设施/生态系统。对于贩毒集团而言，这种演变表明了一种混合模式，其中本地化的领土控制通过分散、技术驱动的收入生成和跨境暴力投射来寻求巨大的影响力和影响。

对某些激进组织而言，拥有一个拥有大量土地和人口的叛乱国家是其主要目标，并赋予其身份……拥有一个法律执法机构无法触及的物理避难所——如由敌对国家保护的领土——将继续提供显著优势……世界沿海地区的重要性将上升。这并不意味着非国家武装行为体必须持续拥有漫长的海岸线，但它们将受益于频繁的进入点……此外，远程暴力和数字犯罪，像整个数字经济一样，将依赖于物理材料、数据中心和能源流动。富含关键矿物、稀土元素、水、能源生产和数据基础设施的地区将成为各种行为体的优先目标。

数据，以及保护或利用数据的能力，将成为最重要的资产。收集信息、入侵竞争对手系统并保护自己的数据免受敌对攻击的能力将定义优势……相反，激进组织和罪犯的进攻和防御行动将越来越多地围绕着控制数字基础设施和操纵信息流动展开。

对SOCSOUTH和USSOCOM而言，这些趋势要求重新思考USSOF如何在西半球概念化外国内部防御、情报收集和行动设计。跨国犯罪组织和极端分子网络将继续利用技术来获取收入、展示力量并逃避国家控制，这进一步削弱了合作伙伴国家的治理能力与合法性，如果不加以解决，可能会导致向犯罪化国家结构的转变。

来源：

正如费尔巴布-布朗和帕斯·加西亚所评估的，“安全机构与非法行为体之间的斗争将转向一个复杂、拥挤且高度透明的战场上的数据控制竞赛”，在这个战场上，能够操纵或利用信息的行为体将获得决定性优势。贩毒集团通过低信号、技术驱动的行动进行适应，削弱了那些仅优先考虑领土破坏和领导层打击的策略。因此，USSOF必须通过增强合作伙伴在争议性信息环境中的运作能力、保护关键基础设施和对抗技术驱动的胁迫来加强合作伙伴的韧性。行动环境将奖励那些能够在长期竞争中以技术适应速度超越对手的部队
_source.trans_title: 新的作战空间：贩毒集团、技术与美洲特种作战部队的未来
_source.evidence: 文章核心内容探讨了新兴技术（如AI、3D打印、无人机、加密货币等）如何被跨国犯罪组织（如贩毒集团）和恐怖网络利用，以改变其运作模式、收入来源及暴力投射能力。文中详细描述了这些技术如何被转化为具体的攻击手段（如AI诈骗、无人机暗杀、网络攻击基础设施），属于认知域中关于技术如何被武器化、工具化以服务于非国家行为体的对抗行动。虽然文章涉及战略分析，但其核心落脚点在于‘技术’作为‘武器/工具’的具体应用及其带来的战术变革，而非单纯的理论政策发布或部队组建。因此，最匹配的标签是‘技术武器’。

(中央社記者楊堯茹台北16日電)網路討論群組引述南非媒體Swaziland News,稱台灣駐史瓦帝尼王國大使梁洪昇涉腐敗案件。外交部今天澄清相關爆料子虛烏有,將就相關假訊息在網路平台散布的情形向警方報案,並全力捍衛外交部及第一線人員的清譽。
外交部晚間發布新聞稿指出,網路討論群組近日引述Swaziland News報導,指控台灣駐史瓦帝尼王國大使梁洪昇涉及多起腐敗案件,外交部特此澄清說明,相關爆料子虛烏有、內容毫無事實基礎,亦未提出任何具體證據,屬典型錯假訊息操作。
外交部強調,梁洪昇自到任以來,積極深化台史邦誼、推動雙邊關係,與史國王室及政府互動良好,成果有目共睹,因而成為有心人士鎖定攻擊的對象。
外交部說明,經查,總部位於南非的Swaziland News是一家接受中國資助並具特定政治立場的媒體,該媒體立場鮮明,除長期批評史國王室及政府施政外,也持續在國際間散布貶抑台灣主權、破壞台史邦誼的錯假訊息。
外交部表示,過去賴總統在2023年副總統任內訪問巴拉圭期間,即曾出現有心人士刻意散布假訊息混淆台灣民眾視聽、刻意攻擊政府外交作為的情形。相關案例顯示有境外勢力系統性操縱假訊息,意圖破壞台灣外交關係。
外交部呼籲,務必提高警覺,切勿輕信或轉傳此類攻擊國家外交關係、傷害第一線外交人員的錯假訊息。外交部也將就相關假訊息在網路平台散布的情形向警方報案,並全力捍衛外交部及第一線人員的清譽,盼各界共同守護台灣對外關係與國家利益。(編輯:林興盟)1150416
_source.movement_title: 台外交部澄清驻史大使涉腐指控属境外势力假消息
_source.movement_abstract: 台湾外交部针对网络讨论群组引述南非媒体Swaziland News指控台湾驻史瓦帝尼王国大使梁洪昇涉腐案一事发表声明，明确表示相关爆料毫无事实依据，属于系统性假消息操作。外交部指出该媒体长期接受中国资助且具特定政治立场，曾多次散布贬低台湾主权的言论。同时强调梁大使任职期间积极促进台史关系，成果显著。此外，外交部提及2023年赖清德副總統访问巴拉圭期间亦出现境外势力操弄假消息攻击台湾外交的案例，已就网络平台散布的假消息向警方报案，并呼吁民众勿轻信或传播此类信息，共同维护台湾对外关系与国家利益。
_source.title: 外交部:南非媒體誣指台灣大使腐敗 已就網路散布假訊息報案

（中央社记者杨尧茹台北16日电）网络讨论群组引用南非媒体斯威士兰新闻称，台湾驻史瓦帝尼王国大使梁洪昇涉及腐败案件。外交部今日澄清相关爆料纯属虚构，将就相关假讯息在网络平台散布情形向警方报案，并全力捍卫外交部及一线人员的清誉。

外交部晚间发布新闻稿指出，网络讨论群组近日引用斯威士兰新闻报道，指控台湾驻史瓦帝尼王国大使梁洪昇涉及多起腐败案件，外交部特此澄清说明，相关爆料纯属虚构、内容毫无事实基础，亦未提出任何具体证据，属典型虚假讯息操作。

外交部强调，梁洪昇自到任以来，积极深化台史邦谊、推动双边关系，与史国王室及政府互动良好，成果有目共睹，因而成为有心人士锁定攻击的对象。

外交部说明，经查，总部位于南非的斯威士兰新闻是一家接受中国资助并具特定政治立场的媒体，该媒体立场鲜明，除长期批评史国王室及政府施政外，也持续在国际间散布贬抑台湾主权、破坏台史邦谊的虚假讯息。

外交部表示，过去赖总统在2023年副总统任内访问巴拉圭期间，即曾出现有心人士刻意散布假讯息混淆台湾民众视听、刻意攻击政府外交作为的情形。相关案例显示有境外势力系统性操作假讯息，意图破坏台湾外交关系。

外交部呼吁，务必提高警觉，切勿轻信或转传此类攻击国家外交关系、伤害一线外交人员的虚假讯息。外交部也将就相关假讯息在网络平台散布情形向警方报案，并全力捍卫外交部及一线人员的清誉，盼各界共同守护台湾对外关系与国家利益。（编辑：林兴盟）1150416
_source.trans_title: 外交部：南非媒体诬指台湾大使腐败 已就网络散布假消息报案

(中央社記者曾依璇巴黎16日專電)台灣網路資訊中心董事長黃勝雄在葡萄牙一場海纜安全座談會中,提醒留意中俄水下能力的軍民融合戰略。美國駐葡大使艾里格說,供應鏈須排除不可信廠商,以防惡意監控及破壞。
葡美發展基金會(FLAD)與美國駐葡萄牙大使館本月13日在里斯本舉辦「深海連結:海底電纜的貿易、競爭、安全及合作」座談會,邀請黃勝雄、資訊科技業協會(ITIC)電信政策主任納古斯(Olivia Negus)、大西洋中心(Atlantic Center)協調人暨海軍少將布拉岡薩(Nuno António de Noronha Bragança)與談。
台灣駐葡萄牙代表張亞光應邀出席,艾里格(John J. Arrigo)致詞時特別為代表處的合作夥伴關係向她致謝。
艾里格說,身為大使,他在葡萄牙的首要任務是保護美國公民,其次是強化國防合作,平衡貿易,對抗來自中國及其他地方的惡意影響,而有關海纜議題的討論正好涵蓋這些方向。
他指出,海纜承載全球95%的數據流量,舉凡發送郵件、刷卡消費、瀏覽社群平台都要透過海纜,而葡萄牙的地理位置特別重要,因為75%的大西洋海纜穿過葡萄牙水域,全球約1/4的海纜透過葡萄牙相互連接,使葡萄牙成為歐洲、甚至全球數位經濟的關鍵。
他說,正因如此,這條數位經濟供應鏈必須排除不可信任的廠商,以防惡意分子監控通訊、竊取智慧財產權及破壞資料傳輸。
黃勝雄分享台灣作為亞洲太平洋地區數位樞紐,長期在灰色地帶威脅下累積的經驗,指出掌握數據的重要性,有數據才有證據,進而歸因究責。
他說,海纜若故障,不僅意味著失去網路通訊,也失去對軍事系統的指揮和控制,衛星能確保的流量有限,必須決定優先順序以便最有效利用;此外還須思考國際合作框架、區域修復聯盟等問題,畢竟海底環境遼闊又複雜,沒有任何一國能單獨保障其安全。
黃勝雄指出,中國與俄羅斯擁有水下基礎設施、數據、技術和作業能力,這些資產可輕易轉換成戰略用途,「我們必須留意這種軍民融合戰略,因為這不僅可能破壞基礎設施,也可能損及國家安全」。
他表示,台灣也在探索多元通訊途徑,例如是否可能利用無人機搭載5G(第5代行動通訊技術)中繼器;目前有類似應用,是在地震等天災緊急情況發生時,以直升機搭載設備到特定地區提供訊號。
納古斯說,產業界希望與政策制定者合作以促進海纜安全和韌性,協助實現國家安全和經濟安全目標,而支持這些目標的最佳方式,就是鋪設更多海纜,「提高海纜冗餘性(redundancy),才能降低任何單一海纜中斷造成的風險」。「冗餘」意指增加替代路徑以提高可靠程度。
她建議建立一套穩定的監管許可制度;另外,許多海纜事故是基於船錨或漁船問題等意外,需要制定錨泊規範、培訓漁船船員、要求使用船隻追蹤系統、實施有力執法機制等措施來減少這類事故,之後「才能縮減惡意分子能操作的灰色地帶」。
布拉岡薩提到,科學研究船隻航經葡萄牙領海須取得許可,穿越經濟海域也須通知,但有些沒這麼做,因此有必要持續提升海域意識,決策速度也必須加快。(編輯:陳承功)1150416
_source.movement_title: 葡萄牙海缆安全座谈会警示中俄军民融合战略风险
_source.movement_abstract: 在葡萄牙举办的「深海連結:海底電纜的貿易、競爭、安全及合作」座談會中，台灣網路資訊中心董事長黃勝雄與美國駐葡大使艾里格共同提醒關注中俄水下能力的軍民融合戰略對海纜安全的威脅。艾里格強調，葡萄牙地理位置關鍵，75%大西洋海纜穿過其水域，需排除不可信廠商以保障數位經濟供應鏈安全。黃勝雄指出海纜故障可能導致軍事指揮失控，並分享台灣在灰色地帶威脅下的經驗，建議探索無人機搭載5G中繼器等多元通訊途徑。ITIC電信政策主任納古斯提出增加海纜冗餘性以降低風險，並呼籲建立監管許可制度與提升漁船安全意識。大西洋中心協調人布拉岡薩補充需加強海域監管與決策效率，因應科研船隻違規航行問題。各方均認為國際合作與區域修復聯盟對應對海纜安全挑戰至關重要。
_source.title: 台美葡海纜安全座談 黃勝雄示警中俄軍民融合戰略
_source.trans_cont:
（中央社记者曾依璇巴黎16日电）台湾网络资讯中心董事长黄胜雄在葡萄牙一场海底光缆安全座谈会上，提醒注意中俄水下能力的军民融合战略。美国驻葡大使艾里格表示，供应链必须排除不可信厂商，以防范恶意监控及破坏。

葡美发展基金会（FLAD）与美国驻葡萄牙大使馆13日在里斯本举办「深海链接：海底电缆的贸易、竞争、安全及合作」座谈会，邀请黄胜雄、资讯科技业协会（ITIC）电信政策主任纳古斯（Olivia Negus）、大西洋中心协调人暨海军少将布拉冈萨（Nuno António de Noronha Bragança）共同与谈。

台湾驻葡萄牙代表张亚光受邀出席，艾里格致词时特别向代表处的合作伙伴关系致谢。

艾里格表示，身为大使，他在葡萄牙的首要任务是保护美国公民，其次强化国防合作、平衡贸易、对抗来自中国及其他地区的恶意影响，而有关海底电缆议题的讨论正好涵盖这些方向。

他指出，海底电缆承载全球95%的数据流量，发送邮件、刷卡消费、浏览社群平台等都需通过海底电缆，葡萄牙的地理位置尤其重要，因为75%的大西洋海底电缆穿过葡萄牙水域，全球约四分之一的海底电缆通过葡萄牙相互连接，使葡萄牙成为欧洲乃至全球数位经济的关键节点。

他表示，正因如此，这条数位经济供应链必须排除不可信任的厂商，以防范恶意分子监控通讯、窃取智慧财产权及破坏数据传输。

黄胜雄分享台湾作为亚太地区数位枢纽，在长期灰色地带威胁下累积的经验，指出掌握数据的重要性，有数据才有证据，进而归因究责。

他提到，海底电缆若发生故障，不仅意味着失去网络通讯，也失去对军事系统的指挥和控制，卫星能确保的流量有限，必须决定优先顺序以便最有效利用；此外还需思考国际合作框架、区域修复联盟等问题，毕竟海底环境辽阔复杂，没有任何一国能单独保障其安全。

黄胜雄指出，中国与俄罗斯拥有水下基础设施、数据、技术及作业能力，这些资产可轻易转换为战略用途，「我们必须留意这种军民融合战略，因为这不仅可能破坏基础设施，也可能损害国家安全」。

他表示，台湾也在探索多元通讯途径，例如是否可能利用无人机搭载5G（第五代行动通讯技术）中继器；目前有类似应用，是在地震等天灾紧急情况发生时，以直升机搭载设备到特定地区提供讯号。

_source.evidence: 文章主要报道了台美葡三方在葡萄牙举办的关于海底电缆安全的座谈会。核心内容涉及美国大使及台湾专家黄胜雄等人对中俄（特别是中国）水下能力、军民融合战略的警示，以及关于供应链安全、国际监管框架、冗余性建设等政策建议的讨论。虽然文中提到了‘军民融合战略’这一概念，但文章本身并非中国发布的新政策或理论框架，而是外部势力（美、台）针对中国战略的讨论和警示。同时，文章并未描述具体的作战行动、部队组建或武器研发。根据标签定义，[涉我事件]指涉及中国大陆作为被攻击对象或相关方的敌情事件。文中美国大使明确提到‘对抗来自中国及其他地方的恶意影响’，黄胜雄也专门警示‘中俄军民融合战略’，这属于外部势力针对中国战略意图的研判和敌情分析，符合‘涉我事件’中关于敌情事件的定义。虽然涉及政策讨论，但核心在于针对中国的战略警示，而非单纯的政策发布。

The contemporary battlespace is undergoing a profound transformation in its fundamental logic. As highlighted by Bill Gertz in a recent
article reporting on Pentagon initiatives toward cognitive warfare, the United States (US) is actively exploring capabilities designed to “subdue the enemy without fighting”, emphasizing non-kinetic means that directly target human cognition as both the terrain and objective of conflict.  This is not simply an evolution in tactics or the use of emergent technology. Rather, cognitive warfare represents a decisive shift in engagement that leverages information to inform, deceive, and thereby influence the underlying neural processes that are involved in thought, emotion, and behavior (viz- functions that when taken together can be considered constitute the “mind”). In this sense, the battlespace now extends into the neurobiological substrates of the human brain~mind to affect the psychosocial dynamics of targeted individuals and collectives.
To be sure, using techniques to affect the “mind” of the adversary is not new to military missions. Traditional information operations (IO) and psychological operations (PSYOPS) have sought to shape perceptions and influence decision-making. But cognitive warfare moves beyond the control of information flows to target
. As current doctrine and analysis suggest, the objective is “not
individuals think, but rather,
they think”. This distinction is critical. Whereas IO and PSYOPS aim to alter beliefs or attitudes, cognitive warfare focuses upon affecting perception, judgment, emotional valence, and ultimately decision-making and actions. It is therefore more accurately understood as an operationalization of (sensory,
perceptual, cognitive, behavioral and social) neurosciences within executable tactics and strategic power domains. The goal is to degrade the adversary’s ability to perceive reality accurately, to reason effectively, and to act coherently, thereby eroding the foundational elements of organized execution of force and/or resistance.
To appreciate the implications of cognitive warfare, it is important to recognize that the human brain has become both a target and vector of these
. Advances in neuroscience, data analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI) enable increasingly precise mapping of cognitive vulnerabilities, ranging from bias and heuristics to stress responses and social identity dynamics. Cognitive warfare exploits these vulnerabilities through tactics that use information (i.e.- whether true, false, or ambiguous) to induce specific neural and psychological effects. These may include:
•
, toward degrading information processing and decision-making capacity
•
, which biases judgment under conditions of uncertainty and/or fear
•
to alter perception of veridicality, legitimacy, trust, and authority
•
to influence actions at both individual and group levels.
Such approaches can be engaged both singularly and in combination to concomitantly influence thinking, feeling, and behavior, often producing cascading effects in and across social systems. Thus, I’ve argued that cognitive warfare is inherently bio-psycho-social in its foci, mechanisms and outcomes.
A defining feature of cognitive warfare is the ability to generate both individual-level and collective-level effects. At the individual level, targeted cognitive operations can impair attention, distort perception, and bias decision-making in ways that can manifest as degraded situational awareness, compromised judgment, and/or reduced morale and will to fight. For military and political leaders, this may lead to flawed assessments and suboptimal choices.
At the collective level, the effects can be even more consequential. By shaping collective narratives and exploiting social distinctions, cognitive warfare can undermine trust in institutions, fracture social cohesion, and impair the collective will necessary for coordinated action. In the extreme, it can induce cognitive disintegration, wherein
a group becomes unable to generate consensus and sustain effective collaboration required for coordinated activity or governance.
Such outcomes can directly affect the exercise and sustenance of power. Military capability is contingent upon the cognitive and social integrity of both the force and the society it serves. By targeting these dimensions, cognitive warfare seeks to disrupt an adversary’s ability to mobilize, coordinate, and sustain operations; without necessarily engaging in kinetic conflict.
It is essential to distinguish between the
of war (viz.- enduring aspects of exercised power, combativeness, uncertainty, and political purpose), and the
of war, which reflects how these elements are expressed in a given era. Cognitive warfare does not change the nature of war, but I posit that it profoundly alters its character. Historically, shifts in the character of war have been driven by technological innovation (e.g. -the longbow, gunpowder, mechanization, aircraft; nuclear weapons, and most recently, cyber capabilities). Each introduced new ways of projecting power, operationalizing tactics, and achieving strategic objectives. Cognitive warfare represents the next inflection point.
This shift has several implications:
1.
Cognitive operations can be conducted continuously, below the threshold of armed conflict, and covertly or clandestinely, making it difficult to define and delineate if and when “warfare” begins or ends.
2.
The battlespace now includes military forces and targetable civilian populations, accessible and engaged via information ecosystems and social networks.
3.
The sources and mechanisms of cognitive attacks are often difficult to identify, complicating deterrence and response (see also 1, above, and 4, below).
4.
Success is being measured less by physical destruction, and more by the ability to shape perceptions, decisions, and behaviors. This can complicate questions of both “directness” of attribution (i.e.- how much of changes in cognition, emotion and behavior could be explicitly “due” to a particular cognitive engagement), and even if/when attribution is possible, what constitutes proportionality of response.
As noted in other analyses of cognitive warfare (see, for example, several notable essays that have recently been published in the
) and as reported in Gertz’s piece in the
, the objective is to achieve strategic effect(s) by influencing cognition and behavior, thereby enabling adversaries to “subdue” targets and gain (and retain) advantage without resorting to overt force. In these ways, cognitive warfare can be metaphorically likened more to the game of
, rather than
.
In this light, I posit that the iterative engagement of cognitive warfare will necessitate re-evaluation of doctrine, training, and force design in and along four principal dimensions.
First, there is a need to integrate cognitive considerations to operational planning. This includes a more thorough understanding the cognitive terrain and its cultural, psychological, and informational factors that shape how individuals and groups perceive and respond to events.
Second, forces must develop both defensive and offensive cognitive capabilities. Defensive capabilities involve resilience to protect US and allied personnel and populations from cognitive manipulation and ensure the integrity of decision-making processes. Offensive capabilities involve developing and exercising capabilities to influence adversaries’ cognition in ways that support strategic objectives.
Third, any genuine effort toward such enterprise will require interdisciplinary expertise. Cognitive warfare entails the intersection of neuroscience, psychology, data science, AI/cybertechnology and military strategic planning and operational execution. Effective engagement in the cognitive domain will necessitate collaboration across these fields, as well as the prudent integration of emergent technologies and methods (e.g.- quantum sensing and computing; terrestrial and space-based unmanned ISR and informational delivery platforms).
Last, but certainly not least, ethical considerations and concerns arising in and from cognitive engagement(s) must be addressed. The ability to influence cognition raises questions about “
, and the
These issues must be carefully regarded to ensure that the pursuit of strategic advantage does not undermine the values that US military forces are sworn to uphold and defend.
Cognitive warfare represents a paradigmatic shift in the character of engagement that redefines the battlespace, the objectives of conflict, and the means by which power can be exercised. By leveraging information to influence the neural processes underlying thought, emotion, and behavior, it enables the generation of biological, psychological, and social effects that can disrupt an adversary’s capabilities, and lead to cascading destructive manifestations in individual collective, populational scales and in military, socio-economic, and political spheres. Thus, the implications are clear that near-term future conflicts will not be decided solely by who controls territory or annihilates assets, but by who can most effectively shape the cognitive realm in which decisions are made and actions are executed.
As we have previously asserted, and the
article further supports, the pursuit of such capabilities is
. For the Department of War, the imperative is to recognize that the mind is no longer merely a component of the warfighter; rather it is ever more becoming a central milieu, and viable target, of modern conflict. Mastery of this domain will be essential to maintaining strategic advantage in an era defined by the contest for cognition, and the control of those who are cogitating.
The views and opinions presented in this essay are those of the author and do not necessarily reflect those of the United States government, Department of War or the National Defense University.
_source.movement_title: 美国推进认知战战略将人类思维过程作为核心作战目标
_source.movement_abstract: 美国国防部近期提出认知战概念，将人类思维、情感及行为过程确立为现代冲突的核心战场与目标。该战略旨在通过非动能手段，利用信息影响对手神经生物学基础及心理社会动态，从而在不进行直接军事对抗的情况下削弱敌方作战能力。与传统信息作战和心理战不同，认知战不仅关注信息流动，更侧重于改变对手感知现实、理性推理及连贯行动的能力。借助神经科学、数据分析及人工智能技术，认知战可精准映射认知脆弱性，通过真实、虚假或模糊信息诱导特定神经与心理效应，包括降低信息处理能力、扭曲判断、削弱信任及改变个体与群体行为。在个体层面，认知战可导致态势感知下降、判断力受损及士气低落；在集体层面，可破坏社会凝聚力、瓦解机构信任并导致认知解体，使群体无法达成共识或维持有效协作。该战略转变要求重新评估作战条令、训练及力量设计，需整合神经科学、心理学、数据科学及军事战略等多学科专业知识，并建立防御与进攻双重能力。同时，必须审慎处理认知干预引发的伦理问题，确保战略优势追求不违背核心价值观。认知战标志着战争形态的根本性转变，未来冲突胜负将取决于谁能更有效地塑造认知领域及控制决策过程。
_source.title: Cognitive Warfare and the Changing Character of Engagement: A Neurostrategic Perspective
_source.trans_cont:
现代战场正在经历其基本逻辑的根本性转变。正如比尔·杰茨（Bill Gertz）在一篇报道美国国防部关于认知战争倡议的最新文章中所强调的，美国正在积极研究旨在“不战而屈人之兵”的能力，强调非动能手段，这些手段直接针对人类认知，将其作为冲突的领域和目标。这不仅仅是战术或新兴技术使用的演变。相反，认知战争代表了一种决定性的参与方式转变，它利用信息来告知、欺骗，从而影响思维、情感和行为（即这些功能综合起来可被视为“心智”）。从这个意义上说，战场现在扩展到了人类大脑-心智的神经生物学基础，以影响目标个体和群体的心理社会动态。

当然，使用技术来影响敌人的“心智”并不是军事任务的新事物。传统的信息行动（IO）和心理战（PSYOPS）旨在塑造认知并影响决策。但认知战争超越了对信息流动的控制，直接针对。根据当前的理论和分析，目标是“不是改变个体如何思考，而是改变他们思考的内容”。这一区别至关重要。虽然IO和PSYOPS旨在改变信念或态度，但认知战争则聚焦于影响感知、判断、情感价值，最终影响决策和行为。因此，它更准确地被理解为在可执行的战术和战略权力领域内对（感官、感知、认知、行为和社会）神经科学的运用。目标是削弱对手准确感知现实、有效推理和协调行动的能力，从而削弱组织执行力量和/或抵抗的基础元素。

要理解认知战争的影响，重要的是认识到人类大脑已成为这些行动的目标和传播媒介。神经科学、数据分析和人工智能（AI）的进步使得对认知脆弱性的精确映射成为可能，范围从偏见和启发式思维到压力反应和社会认同动态。认知战争通过使用信息（即无论其是否真实、虚假或模糊）来诱导特定的神经和心理效果来利用这些脆弱性。这些可能包括：

• 降低信息处理和决策能力
• 在不确定和/或恐惧条件下偏斜判断
• 改变对真实性、合法性、信任和权威的感知
• 影响个体和群体层面的行为

这些方法可以单独或结合使用，同时影响思维、情感和行为，常常在社会系统内和跨系统产生连锁效应。因此，我认为认知战争本质上是生物-心理-社会的，其关注点、机制和结果都是如此。

认知战争的一个显著特征是其能够产生个体层面和集体层面的影响。在个体层面，针对的认知行动可以损害注意力、扭曲感知，并以削弱情境意识、损害判断和/或降低战斗意志的方式偏斜决策。对于军事和政治领导人来说，这可能导致错误的评估和次优的选择。

在集体层面，其影响可能更加深远。通过塑造集体叙事并利用社会差异，认知战争可以削弱对制度的信任，破坏社会凝聚力，并损害协调行动所需的集体意志。在极端情况下，它可能导致认知解体，即一个群体无法产生共识并维持协调活动或治理所需的高效合作。

这些结果可以直接影响权力的行使和维持。军事能力依赖于力量和其服务社会的认知和社会完整性。通过针对这些维度，认知战争旨在破坏对手动员、协调和维持行动的能力，而无需进行动能冲突。

有必要区分战争的“本质”（即持久的权力、战斗性、不确定性以及政治目的）和战争的“表现形式”，后者反映了这些要素在一个特定时代的表达方式。认知战争并未改变战争的本质，但我认为它深刻地改变了战争的性质。历史上，战争性质的转变是由技术创新推动的（例如——长弓、火药、机械化、飞机；核武器，以及最近的网络能力）。每种技术都引入了新的力量投射方式、战术操作方式和战略目标实现方式。认知战争代表了下一个转折点。

这一转变有以下几个影响：

1. 认知行动可以持续进行，低于武装冲突的阈值，并且秘密或隐蔽地进行，使得难以界定和区分战争何时开始或结束。
2. 战场现在包括军事力量和可针对的平民人口，这些可以通过信息生态系统和社会网络进行访问和互动。
3. 认知攻击的来源和机制往往难以识别，这使得威慑和响应变得复杂（参见上面第1点和下面第4点）。
4. 成功的衡量标准不再主要基于物理破坏，而是更多地基于塑造认知、决策和行为的能力。这可能使“直接归因”的问题变得复杂（即——认知、情感和行为变化中有多少可以明确归因于特定的认知行动），甚至如果/当归因可能时，什么构成响应的适当性。

正如其他对认知战争的分析（例如，最近发表在《》上的几篇著名文章）以及杰茨在《》上的报道所指出的，目标是通过影响认知和行为来实现战略效果，从而使对手“不战而屈人之兵”，并获得（并保持）优势，而无需诉诸于明显的武力。在这种意义上，认知战争可以被比喻为更像是一种游戏，而不是另一种。

在这种背景下，我认为认知战争的持续参与将需要对理论、训练和力量设计进行重新评估，这涉及四个主要维度。

首先，需要将认知因素纳入作战计划。这包括更深入地理解认知地形及其文化、心理和信息因素，这些因素塑造了个人和群体如何感知和回应事件。

其次，力量必须发展防御性和进攻性的认知能力。防御性能力包括增强对美国及其盟国人员和人口的认知操纵的抵抗力，并确保决策过程的完整性。进攻性能力包括发展和运用影响对手认知的能力，以支持战略目标。

第三，任何真正致力于这一领域的努力都需要跨学科专业知识。认知战争涉及神经科学、心理学、数据科学、AI/网络技术以及军事战略规划和作战执行的交叉。在认知领域有效参与将需要这些领域之间的合作，以及对新兴技术和方法（例如——量子传感和计算；地面和空间无人侦察与监视平台以及信息传递平台）的谨慎整合。

最后，但同样重要的是，必须解决认知参与中和由此产生的伦理问题和关注。影响认知的能力引发了关于“”和“”的问题。这些问题必须谨慎对待，以确保追求战略优势不会损害美国军队誓言捍卫和保护的价值观。

认知战争代表了参与性质的范式转变，重新定义了战场、冲突的目标以及权力行使的方式。通过利用信息来影响思维、情感和行为背后的神经过程，它能够产生生物、心理和社会效应，从而破坏对手的能力，并在个体、集体、人口层面以及军事、社会经济和政治领域引发连锁性的破坏性表现。因此，其影响是明确的：近期的冲突将不再仅由谁控制领土或摧毁资产决定，而是由谁能够最有效地塑造决策和行动发生认知领域决定。正如我们之前所声明的，且《》一文进一步支持，追求这些能力是。对于国防部而言，关键在于认识到心智不再是战斗人员的组成部分，而是现代冲突日益成为核心环境和可行目标。掌握这一领域将是维持战略优势的关键，特别是在以认知竞争和控制思考者为特征的时代。本文的观点和意见仅代表作者个人，不一定反映美国政府、国防部或国防大学的观点。

_source.evidence: 文章主要探讨了‘认知战’（Cognitive Warfare）作为一种新的战争形态和战略概念，详细阐述了其定义、理论基础（神经战略视角）、与传统信息作战的区别、对战争性质的改变以及未来的战略影响。文中虽然提到了美国五角大楼的探索（Pentagon initiatives）和AI等技术的应用，但核心内容是对这一‘理论框架’和‘战略范式’的深度分析，而非报道具体的作战行动、部队组建、特定演习或单一武器研发。文章旨在构建和阐述认知战的理论体系及其对军事战略的影响，符合‘理论政策’标签中关于‘理论、战略框架’的定义。

During the Korean War, Brig Gen Crawford F. Sams serves as Chief, Health and Welfare, United Nations Command, Korea, and commanded the United Nations Public Health and Welfare Detachment.
(Photo Credit: U.S Army Photo)
VIEW ORIGINAL
Col. (Ret.) Ralph Puckett, Jr. earns the Medal of Honor while serving as a 1st Lt. with the Eighth U.S. Army Rangers in Korea in Nov. 1950.
(Photo Credit: U.S Army Photo)
VIEW ORIGINAL
American advisors in the 8240th Army Unit (AU) wore this unofficial shoulder patch of two designs. One of those patches, that of the United Nations Partisan Forces, Korea, is pictured here.
(Photo Credit: U,S Army Photo)
VIEW ORIGINAL
The U.S. Army John F. Kennedy Special Warfare Center and School at Fort Liberty, NC, was first established in April 1952 as the Psychological Warfare Center. Its distinctive unit insignia, pictured here, was approved on Nov. 28, 1952.
(Photo Credit: U.S Army Photo)
VIEW ORIGINAL
When war unexpectedly erupted on the Korean Peninsula in 1950, the U.S. Army scrambled to recreate the special operations capabilities it had disbanded after World War II. Fortunately, the spirit of innovation and adaptability that characterized Army Special Operations Forces (ARSOF) in WWII lived on through the veterans of that war and was harnessed to great effect during the Korean War. By the end of that conflict, seventy years ago this month, numerous ARSOF units, institutions, and capabilities had been added to the Army’s arsenal, many of which persist to this day.
The Korean War unfolded in five distinct phases, the first of which began when the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) military, seeking to unite Korea under communist rule, invaded its southern neighbor, the Republic of Korea, on June 25, 1950. U.S.-led United Nations (UN) forces rushed to the defense of South Korea, forming a defensive perimeter in the southeast corner of the peninsula, around the port city of Pusan (now Busan). This critical location allowed the outnumbered U.S. forces and their partners to funnel reinforcements and materiel into the fight.
During the chaotic early days of the war, Army leaders, both in Washington, D.C. and in Korea, began rebuilding special operations capabilities that had been neglected since the end of WWII. In early July 1950, the General Headquarters (GHQ), U.S. Far East Command (FECOM), formed a provisional Raider Company to conduct commando-type operations behind enemy lines. The following month, the Eighth U.S. Army (EUSA) followed suit, establishing a Ranger Training Center at Kijang, near Pusan, to prepare a Ranger Company for missions similar to those carried out by the GHQ Raiders.
Meanwhile, FECOM faced a major humanitarian crisis among Korean civilians who had fled to Pusan to escape advancing North Korean forces. In Sept. 1950, Gen. Douglas A. MacArthur, FECOM Commander, ordered his chief of Public Health and Welfare, Brig. Gen. Crawford F. Sams, to organize a 60-man Civil Affairs (CA) unit to address the immediate problem of disease within the refugee population. This was among the first CA efforts during the war. Many more would follow.
Stateside, Gen. J. Lawton Collins, U.S. Army Chief of Staff, initiated an effort that led to the creation of the Ranger Training Center (RTC) at Fort Benning, Georgia (known as Fort Moore since 2023), in Sept. 1950. The RTC immediately set about training Ranger Infantry Companies (Airborne), or RICAs, six of which deployed to Korea, beginning in Dec. 1950. Gen. Collins also created the psywar Division under the Army G-3, placing Brig. Gen. Robert A. McClure, a WWII psywar veteran, in charge of rebuilding the Army’s neglected Psywar capability. The only active Army psywar unit in the interwar period, the Tactical Information Detachment, arrived in Korea in Oct. 1950, and was soon redesignated as the 1st Loudspeaker and Leaflet (L&L) Company.
By that point, the war in Korea had entered its second phase, the UN counteroffensive, which began with a daring amphibious assault at Inchon, near the South Korean capital of Seoul, on Sept. 15, 1950. After liberating the capital, UN forces moved north of the 38th parallel, seizing Pyongyang, the North Korean capital. Continuing northward, UN forces neared the Yalu River, which separated North Korea from the People’s Republic of China (PRC), within a month of the Inchon landings. A UN victory seemed within reach and, with it, unification of the Korean peninsula under a non-communist government.
However, hopes for an early end to the war were dashed in late Oct. 1950, when the Communist Chinese People’s Liberation Army crossed the Yalu River into North Korea. With this, the war entered its third phase. The unanticipated Chinese Communist intervention prompted outnumbered UN forces to retreat below the 38th parallel and communist forces recaptured Seoul in early January 1951, bringing the war’s third phase to an end.
Aided by newly arrived RICAs from Fort Benning, UN forces went back on the offensive in early 1951 with the goal of regaining control of Seoul and driving the combined communist forces of China and North Korea north of the 38th parallel. This constituted the fourth phase of the war, during which UN forces successfully reclaimed Seoul in April 1951.
Several key ARSOF milestones occurred during this period. First, the EUSA established a Guerrilla Command to train and coordinate the activities of North Korean anti-communist partisans. Second, Brig. Gen. McClure, took charge of the newly established Office of the Chief of Psychological Warfare (OCPW). Third, the Army established a Military Government School at Fort Gordon, Georgia (known as Fort Eisenhower since 2023), to train Civil Affairs soldiers. Then, in March 1951, the 2nd and 4th RICAs participated in the first-ever combat airborne assault by an Army Ranger unit (Operation TOMAHAWK).
As the front lines stabilized in the late spring of 1951, the war entered its fifth and final phase, which could best be characterized as a stalemate along the prewar border between North and South Korea, with limited territorial gains made by either side. This remained the case until July 27, 1953, when the UN Command, DPRK, and PRC signed an armistice at Panmunjom, South Korea, after two years of negotiation.
Army Special Operations continued to evolve during the final two years of the war. The small CA element created by Brig. Gen. Sams in 1950 grew into the Korea Civil Assistance Command. The tactically focused 1st L&L Company was joined in late 1951 by the 1st Radio Broadcasting and Leaflet Group, a strategic psywar unit headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, that directly supported broadcasting operations on the peninsula. Back in the States, Brig. Gen. McClure and his OCPW staff took actions that led to the establishment of the Psychological Warfare Center at Fort Bragg, North Carolina (known as Fort Liberty since 2023), in April 1952 as the Army’s proponent for psywar and unconventional warfare (UW). Two months later, OCPW efforts to establish a permanent UW capability bore fruit with the activation of 10th Special Forces Group, commanded by Col. Aaron Bank. The first of 99 Special Forces-trained soldiers deployed to Korea in February 1953 as individual augmentees to the 8240th Army Unit (one of the various names for Eighth Army’s longstanding guerrilla command).
The Korean War has been called the “Forgotten War,” falling as it did between World War II and the Vietnam War. However, it was truly a foundational period for ARSOF. Starting with almost nothing, the Army rebuilt effective Ranger, unconventional warfare, psywar, and Civil Affairs capabilities over the course of the three-year conflict, adapting and evolving them as the situation demanded.
By the time the armistice was signed, the Army had its first man, train, and equip headquarters for unconventional warfare and psywar. Now known as the U.S. Army John F. Kennedy Special Warfare Center and School, it has been in continuous operation since its founding in 1952. The U.S. Army Civil Affairs School that first opened at Fort Gordon in early 1951 was brought under the Special Warfare Center and School in 1971. Army Special Forces, first chartered in 1952, recently celebrated seventy-one years of uninterrupted service to the nation. Although all Korean War Ranger Companies were disbanded by war’s end, the Ranger Training Center founded in 1950 continued on, first as the Ranger Training Command, and now as the Airborne and Ranger Training Brigade at Fort Moore, Georgia.
Visit ARSOF in the Korean War: 25 June 1950 -- 27 July 1953 (arsof-history.org) to learn more about this pivotal period in Army Special Operations history.
_source.movement_title: 美军在朝鲜战争期间重建特种作战体系并确立心理战与民事行动能力
_source.movement_abstract: 【美国陆军网站2026年6月报道】1950年6月朝鲜战争爆发后，美国陆军迅速重建二战后解散的特种作战能力。战争初期，远东司令部组建游骑兵连，第八集团军设立游骑兵训练中心，并在釜山附近开展敌后作战训练。1950年9月，道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟将军命令克劳福德·F·萨姆斯少将组建60人民事事务单位应对难民危机。同年，陆军参谋长J·劳顿·柯林斯将军在佐治亚州本宁堡建立游骑兵训练中心，训练空降游骑兵步兵连，其中六个连队于1950年12月部署至朝鲜。罗伯特·A·麦克卢尔少将负责重建心理战能力，战术信息分队于1950年10月抵达朝鲜，后改组为第一扬声器与传单连。1951年，美军在仁川登陆后进入反攻阶段，中国军队于1950年10月介入，战争进入相持阶段。1951年，第八集团军建立游击司令部协调朝鲜反共游击队活动，麦克卢尔少将接管心理战主任办公室，陆军在佐治亚州戈登堡设立军事政府学校培训民事事务士兵。1952年4月，心理战中心在北卡罗来纳州布拉格堡成立，两个月后第十特种作战群激活，首批99名特种作战士兵于1953年2月部署至朝鲜。1953年7月27日，联合国军、朝鲜民主主义人民共和国和中华人民共和国在板门店签署停战协定。朝鲜战争期间，美军重建了游骑兵、非常规战争、心理战和民事事务能力，约翰·F·肯尼迪特种作战中心与学校自1952年成立以来持续运作至今。
_source.title: Army Special Operations in the “Forgotten War”: Commemorating the 70th Anniversary of the Korean Armistice
_source.trans_cont:
brig gen robert a. mcclure 增强了他作为“美国陆军特种作战之父”的声誉。在韩战期间，他担任陆军心理战主任，建立了心理战中心，并推动了第10特种部队群的组建。
（照片来源：美国陆军照片）
查看原始图片
在韩战期间，brig gen crawford f. sams 担任联合国军司令部卫生与福利部门负责人，并指挥联合国公共卫生与福利分遣队。
（照片来源：美国陆军照片）
查看原始图片
退役上校 Ralph Puckett, Jr. 在1950年11月于第八美国陆军游骑兵部队服役时获得荣誉勋章。
（照片来源：美国陆军照片）
查看原始图片
第八二四〇陆军单位（AU）的美国顾问们佩戴了这种非正式的肩章，设计有两种样式。其中一种是联合国游击队部队（韩国）的肩章，如图所示。
（照片来源：美国陆军照片）
查看原始图片
位于北卡罗来纳州利伯蒂堡的美国陆军约翰·f·肯尼迪特种作战中心和学校，最初于1952年4月成立为心理战中心。其独特的单位徽章如图所示，于1952年11月28日获得批准。
（照片来源：美国陆军照片）
查看原始图片
当1950年战争意外爆发在朝鲜半岛时，美国陆军匆忙重建在二战后解散的特种作战能力。幸运的是，二战期间陆军特种作战部队（ARSOF）所体现出的创新和适应精神，通过战争老兵得以延续，并在韩战中发挥了巨大作用。到战争结束时，也就是七十年前的这个月，许多ARSOF单位、机构和能力已被加入陆军的武器库，其中许多至今仍然存在。
韩战分为五个不同的阶段，第一阶段始于1950年6月25日，朝鲜民主人民共和国（DPRK）军队为了统一朝鲜，实行共产主义统治，入侵其南方邻国，大韩民国（ROK）。以美国为首的联合国（UN）部队迅速奔赴韩国进行防御，形成半岛东南角的防御圈，围绕着釜山港（现称釜山）。这个关键位置使数量上处于劣势的美军及其盟友能够将增援部队和物资运送到前线。
在战争初期混乱的日子里，华盛顿特区和韩国的陆军领导开始重建二战后被忽视的特种作战能力。1950年7月初，美国远东司令部（FECOM）的总指挥部（GHQ）成立了一支临时的突击队，执行敌后特种作战任务。一个月后，第八美国陆军（EUSA）也采取了类似行动，在釜山附近的龟尾建立了一所游骑兵训练中心，为执行类似GHQ突击队任务的游骑兵小队做准备。
与此同时，FECOM面临着因北韩军队推进而逃往釜山的韩国平民所引发的重大人道主义危机。1950年9月，FECOM指挥官道格拉斯·A·麦克阿瑟将军命令其公共卫生与福利主任、少将克劳福德·F·萨姆斯组织一支60人的民事事务（CA）单位，以解决难民群体中的疾病问题。这是战争中首批CA行动之一，之后还有更多。
在国内，美国陆军参谋长J·劳顿·柯林斯将军于1950年9月启动了一项行动，最终促成了在佐治亚州本宁堡（现称摩尔堡）建立游骑兵训练中心（RTC）。RTC立即开始培训游骑兵步兵连（空降），即RICAs，其中六支于1950年12月部署到韩国。柯林斯将军还创建了陆军G-3下属的心理战部门，并任命二战心理战老兵罗伯特·A·麦克克莱尔少将负责重建被忽视的心理战能力。战间期唯一活跃的陆军心理战单位战术信息分遣队于1950年10月抵达韩国，并很快被重新指定为第1号扩音器与传单（L&L）连。
到那时，朝鲜战争已进入第二阶段，即联合国的反攻阶段，该阶段于1950年9月15日开始，以在首尔附近的仁川进行大胆的两栖攻击为标志。解放首都后，联合国部队向北推进至38线，占领了平壤，即北韩首都。继续向北推进，联合国部队在仁川登陆一个月内接近了将北韩与中华人民共和国（PRC）分隔开的鸭绿江。联合国胜利似乎触手可及，随之而来的将是朝鲜半岛在非共产主义政府下的统一。
然而，1950年10月下旬，共产主义中国解放军越过鸭绿江进入北韩，使希望战争早日结束的希望破灭。战争由此进入第三阶段。出乎意料的中国共产党干预迫使人数处于劣势的联合国部队撤退至38线以下，而共产党部队于1951年初重新占领首尔，结束了战争的第三阶段。
在新抵达的本宁堡RICAs的帮助下，联合国部队于1951年初重新发起进攻，目标是夺回首尔并迫使中国和北韩的联合共产党部队撤退至38线以北。这构成了战争的第四阶段，期间联合国部队于1951年4月成功夺回首尔。
在此期间，发生了几个关键的ARSOF里程碑。首先，第八美国陆军建立了游击指挥部，以培训和协调北韩反共游击队的行动。其次，麦克克莱尔少将接管了新成立的心理战主任办公室（OCPW）。第三，陆军在佐治亚州戈登堡（现称艾森豪威尔堡）建立了军事政府学校，以培训民事事务士兵。随后，在1951年3月，第2和第4 RICAs参与了陆军游骑兵部队首次战斗空降行动（“战斧”行动）。
随着1951年晚春前线局势趋于稳定，战争进入第五也是最后的阶段，这一阶段最显著的特征是朝鲜南北边境的僵持局面，双方在领土上都只取得有限的进展。这种情况一直持续到1953年7月27日，联合国军、朝鲜人民军和中华人民共和国在韩国板门店签署了停战协定，经过两年的谈判。
战争最后两年，陆军特种作战继续发展。1950年萨姆斯少将创建的小型民事事务单位发展成为韩国民事援助指挥部。战术导向的第1号扩音器与传单连于1951年底加入了总部位于日本东京的战略心理战单位——第1号无线电广播与传单小组，该单位直接支持半岛的广播行动。在国内，麦克克莱尔少将及其OCPW团队采取了行动，于1952年4月在北卡罗来纳州布拉格堡（现称利伯蒂堡）建立了心理战中心，作为陆军心理战和非常规作战（UW）的倡导者。两个月后，OCPW为建立永久的非常规作战能力的努力取得了成果，第10特种部队群被激活，由阿伦·班克上校指挥。首批99名特种部队训练士兵于1953年2月作为个人增援人员部署到第八二四〇陆军单位（第八军长期游击指挥部的众多名称之一）。
韩战被称为“被遗忘的战争”，因为它介于二战和越战之间。然而，它确实是ARSOF的奠基时期。从几乎一无所有开始，陆军在为期三年的战争中重建了有效的游骑兵、非常规作战、心理战和民事事务能力，并根据形势需求不断适应和演变。
停战协定签署时，陆军已拥有第一个人员、训练和装备的非常规作战和心理战总部。现在被称为美国陆军约翰·f·肯尼迪特种作战中心和学校，自1952年成立以来一直持续运作。1951年初首次在戈登堡开放的美国陆军民事事务学校于1971年被纳入特种作战中心和学校。陆军特种部队自1952年成立以来，最近庆祝了71年的不间断服务。尽管所有韩战游骑兵连在战争结束时都被解散，但1950年成立的游骑兵训练中心继续存在，最初作为游骑兵训练指挥部，现在则成为位于佐治亚州摩尔堡的空降和游骑兵训练旅。
访问韩战中的ARSOF：1950年6月25日 - 1953年7月27日（arsof-history.org），了解更多关于陆军特种作战历史这一关键时期的详细信息。
_source.trans_title: “被遗忘的战争”中的陆军特种作战：纪念朝鲜停战70周年

Wednesday, July 23, 2025  10:00 am
222 Russell Senate Office Building
Event Type:
Hearing
The PRC has escalated its use of covert, coercive, and extraterritorial tactics against Taiwan and its supporters, threatening the island’s democracy, creating skepticism and distrust in U.S.-Taiwan relations, and using intimidation, lawfare, and propaganda operations to shape global narratives on Taiwan’s status. This hearing will spotlight the Chinese Communist Party’s expanding campaign of political warfare and repression targeting Taiwan and the Taiwanese diaspora globally. Through expert testimony, the Commission will explore policy options to counter these malign activities, reinforce U.S. support for Taiwan’s democracy, and advance legislative initiatives like the Stand with Taiwan Act and the Transnational Repression Policy Act.
This hearing will address four dimensions of the PRC’s strategy: (1) extraterritorial implications of the PRC’s 2024 “22 Articles” under the Anti-Secession Law, which criminalizes advocacy for Taiwanese independence; (2) political and cognitive warfare operations targeting Taiwan; (3) efforts to silence, censor, or intimidate members of the Taiwanese diaspora; and (4) the PRC’s global campaign to shape the legal and academic narrative on Taiwan’s status. Expert witnesses will analyze these tactics and provide policy recommendations to enhance Taiwan’s resilience to the PRC's malign influence activities and address transnational repression in the United States and globally.
The hearing will be livestreamed on the CECC’s YouTube channel.

_source.movement_abstract: 【美国国会-行政部门中国委员会网站2025年7月23日报道】美国国会-行政部门中国委员会于2025年7月23日召开听证会，分析中华人民共和国对台湾及全球台湾侨民实施的隐蔽胁迫、跨国镇压及认知作战策略。听证会聚焦四个维度：一是2024年《反分裂国家法》'22条'的域外适用及其对台湾独立主张的刑事化；二是针对台湾的政治与认知作战行动；三是压制、审查或恐吓全球台湾侨民的行动；四是塑造台湾地位法律与学术叙事的全球运动。与会专家包括台湾立法委员范云、美国海军退役少将迈克·斯图德曼、詹姆斯敦基金会总裁彼得·马蒂斯、美国企业研究所研究员奥德里·黄、南加州大学助理教授约翰·多森及全球台湾研究所霍华德·沈等。听证会旨在探讨应对中国恶意活动的政策选项，强化美国对台湾民主的支持，并推动《与台湾站在一起法案》及《跨国镇压政策法案》等立法倡议。

听证会
中华人民共和国已加大对台湾及其支持者的隐蔽、强制性和越界手段的使用，威胁台湾的民主制度，削弱美台关系中的信任与合作，并通过恐吓、法律战和宣传行动塑造全球对台湾地位的叙事。本次听证会将聚焦中国共产党日益扩大的针对台湾及全球台湾侨民的政治战和压制行动。通过专家证词，委员会将探讨应对这些有害行为的政策选项，强化美国对台湾民主的支持，并推进《支持台湾法案》和《跨国镇压政策法案》等立法倡议。
本次听证会将从四个方面分析中国策略：（1）中国2024年《反分裂国家法》中“22条”对台湾独立倡导行为的刑事化及其越界影响；（2）针对台湾的政治与认知战行动；（3）压制、审查或恐吓台湾侨民的举措；（4）中国在全球范围内塑造台湾地位法律与学术叙事的行动。专家证人将分析这些手段，并提出政策建议，以增强台湾对中方有害影响的抵御能力，并应对美国及全球范围内的跨国镇压行为。
听证会将通过国会-中国委员会的YouTube频道进行直播。
