Hims & Hers, the telehealth company that sells weight-loss drugs and sexual health prescriptions, has confirmed a data breach affecting its third-party customer service platform.
The healthcare company said in a
data breach notice
filed with the California attorney general’s office on Thursday that the hackers stole data about user requests sent to the company’s customer support team. The company said hackers broke into its third-party ticketing system between February 4 and February 7 and stole reams of support tickets, which contained personal information submitted by customers.
The data breach notice said the hackers took customer names and contact information, as well as other unspecified personal data that Hims & Hers left redacted in the letter.
Although the company says customer medical records were not affected by the breach, the nature of customer support systems means that the data may contain sensitive information about a person’s account, personal information, and healthcare.
It’s not yet known how many individuals had personal information compromised in the hack. Under California law, companies are required to disclose data breaches involving 500 or more state residents.
Jake Martin, a spokesperson for Hims & Hers, told TechCrunch in a statement the company was hit by a social engineering attack, in which hackers trick employees into granting access to their systems. The spokesperson said the stolen data “primarily included customer names and email addresses.” The company did not say what specific types of data were taken, when asked by TechCrunch.
The company would not say if it has received any communication from the hackers, such as a demand for money.
In recent months, customer support and ticketing systems have become rich targets for financially motivated hackers, who have raided databases containing customer information and extorted companies into paying a ransom.
Last year, Discord had
a data breach
that affected its customer support ticketing system and exposed the government-issued IDs of around 70,000 people who had submitted their driver’s licenses and passports to the company to verify their age.
_source.movement_title: Hims & Hers客服平台遭数据泄露 7万用户信息或外泄
_source.movement_abstract: 美国远程医疗公司Hims & Hers确认其第三方客服平台发生数据泄露事件。根据向加州总检察长办公室提交的通知，黑客于2月4日至7日期间入侵其客服票务系统，窃取了包含客户姓名、联系方式等个人信息的大量支持工单。尽管公司声明客户医疗记录未受影响，但客服系统可能涉及账户、个人及医疗健康等敏感信息。公司发言人表示此次攻击属于社会工程学攻击，主要泄露内容为姓名和邮箱，但未透露具体数据类型及受影响人数。加州法律规定涉及500名以上居民的数据泄露需强制披露。近几个月来，客服系统已成为黑客的重要目标，去年Discord曾因类似攻击导致约7万名用户的身份信息泄露。目前尚不清楚黑客是否提出赎金要求。
_source.title: Telehealth giant Hims & Hers says its customer support system was hacked
_source.trans_cont:
Hims & Hers这家提供减肥药物和性健康处方的远程医疗公司确认，其第三方客户服务平台遭遇了数据泄露。该公司周四向加州总检察长办公室提交的一份数据泄露通知中表示，黑客窃取了用户发送给公司客服团队的请求数据。公司称，黑客在2月4日至7日期间入侵了其第三方工单系统，并窃取了大量支持工单，其中包含客户提交的个人信息。

数据泄露通知中提到，黑客获取了客户姓名和联系方式，以及其他未具体说明的个人数据，这些数据在信件中被该公司进行了遮蔽。

尽管公司表示客户的医疗记录未受到此次泄露的影响，但客户支持系统的性质意味着这些数据可能包含有关个人账户、个人信息和医疗健康方面的敏感信息。

目前尚不清楚有多少人的个人信息在此次黑客攻击中被泄露。根据加州法律，公司若涉及500名或更多州居民的数据泄露，必须进行披露。

Hims & Hers的发言人杰克·马丁在一份声明中告诉TechCrunch，该公司遭遇了一次社会工程攻击，黑客通过欺骗员工获得系统访问权限。发言人表示，被盗数据“主要包括客户姓名和电子邮件地址”。当被TechCrunch询问具体被盗数据类型时，公司并未作出回答。

公司并未透露是否已收到黑客的任何信息，例如索要钱财的要求。

最近几个月，客户支持和工单系统已成为以财务动机为目标的黑客的热门攻击对象，他们入侵包含客户信息的数据库，并勒索公司支付赎金。

去年，Discord发生了一次数据泄露，影响了其客户支持工单系统，泄露了约7万名用户提交驾照和护照以验证年龄的政府发放的身份证信息。
_source.trans_title: 知名远程医疗公司Hims & Hers称其客户支持系统遭到黑客攻击

_source.content:
A new podcast episode featuring former CIA senior operations officer
Sean Wiswesser
takes a closer look at the structure, history, and evolving tactics of Russian intelligence services and their role in global security challenges.
In a conversation with host Francis Gorman, Wiswesser draws on nearly three decades of experience in the intelligence community to examine how Russian intelligence functions as a central pillar of state power, with roots tracing back to the Cheka and KGB and extending to today’s FSB, SVR, and GRU.
The episode highlights how Russian intelligence operations extend beyond traditional espionage, incorporating cyber activity, disinformation campaigns, and broader hybrid warfare tactics aimed at influencing and destabilizing Western societies. As Wiswesser notes, “What they were doing in 2016 was attacking our democracy and attacking the very concept of free and fair elections.”
A key theme is how these efforts are designed less to support a single outcome and more to fracture trust within democratic systems. “Their goal was to sow discord, distrust, and animosity in the American public,” he says.
Wiswesser also describes Russian intelligence as deeply embedded in the country’s governing structure, emphasizing continuity from Soviet-era institutions to today’s leadership. “Putin is who we thought he was. He’s a Chekist,” he says, underscoring the influence of intelligence culture on modern Russian statecraft.
The discussion also distinguishes between the Russian government and its people, framing the broader challenge as one rooted in state-driven intelligence activity rather than a societal conflict. “We’re not at war with the Russian people. We’re in an undeclared secret war with the Russian intelligence services,” Wiswesser says.
The episode aligns with themes explored in Wiswesser’s forthcoming book, which examines Russian intelligence tradecraft, tactics, and long-standing operational methods, and highlights the evolving nature of competition between states in the information and cyber domains.
_source.movement_title: 前CIA官员解析俄罗斯情报机构及对西方社会的影响
_source.movement_abstract: 前美国中央情报局高级行动官员肖恩·维斯韦瑟在播客中深入解析俄罗斯情报机构的结构、历史及战术演变。他指出俄罗斯情报体系（包括联邦安全局、对外情报局、总参谋部情报总局）作为国家权力核心，其行动已超越传统间谍活动，涵盖网络攻击、虚假信息活动和混合战争等手段，旨在破坏西方社会民主制度。维斯韦瑟强调2016年俄罗斯情报部门通过干预选举动摇民主根基，其战略目标并非推动特定政治结果，而是制造社会分裂与信任危机。他同时指出普京作为契卡背景的\"情报官员\"，延续了苏联时期情报机构对国家治理的深刻影响，并强调当前与俄罗斯情报部门的隐性对抗本质，而非与俄罗斯民众的冲突。相关内容与其即将出版的专著《俄罗斯情报战术与国家间信息竞争》主题一致，聚焦情报战在信息与网络领域的演变。
_source.title: Podcast Explores Russian Intelligence and Hybrid Threats Facing Western Democracies
_source.trans_cont:
一档新播客节目邀请前美国中央情报局高级行动官员肖恩·维斯韦瑟尔，深入探讨俄罗斯情报机构的结构、历史及不断演变的战术，以及它们在全球安全挑战中的作用。在与主持人弗朗西斯·戈尔曼的对话中，维斯韦瑟尔结合了近三十年在情报界的经验，分析了俄罗斯情报机构如何作为国家权力的核心支柱，其根源可追溯至契卡和克格勃，延续至今的FSB、SVR和GRU。

本期节目强调，俄罗斯情报行动不仅限于传统间谍活动，还涵盖网络活动、虚假信息宣传以及更广泛的混合战争战术，旨在影响和破坏西方社会。正如维斯韦瑟尔指出的那样：“他们在2016年所做的，是攻击我们的民主制度，攻击自由和公正选举的概念。”

一个关键主题是，这些行动的目的并非支持单一结果，而是旨在破坏民主体系内的信任。“他们的目标是煽动美国公众的分歧、不信任和敌意，”他说。

维斯韦瑟尔还描述了俄罗斯情报机构深深植根于国家治理体系之中，强调从苏联时期机构到当今领导层的延续性。“普京就是我们所认为的那个人。他是个契卡人，”他说道，强调情报文化对现代俄罗斯国家治理的影响。

讨论还区分了俄罗斯政府与俄罗斯人民，将更广泛挑战归因于国家驱动的情报活动，而非社会冲突。“我们不是与俄罗斯人民作战，而是与俄罗斯情报机构进行一场未公开的秘密战争，”维斯韦瑟尔说。

本期节目与维斯韦瑟尔即将出版的新书主题相呼应，该书探讨了俄罗斯情报技巧、战术及长期运作方式，并突显了国家间在信息和网络领域竞争的不断演变。
_source.trans_title: 播客探讨俄罗斯情报及混合威胁对西方民主国家的影响

Summary
Chinese media shows images of coast guard holding flag on sandbar
Philippines says its visit showed reef is unoccupied
China says it wants to ensure Sandy Cay remains uninhabited
Malaysia, Philippines, Vietnam, Taiwan, China hold multiple features in archipelago
MANILA, April 28 (Reuters) - The Philippines said on Monday there was no truth to news reports that Beijing has seized control of a disputed reef in the South China Sea, after its personnel landed on the unoccupied sandbars and found no Chinese presence there.
Chinese state broadcaster CCTV on Friday said its coast guard had landed on Sandy Cay as part of maritime control operations to exercise its sovereignty. It did not say China was occupying the feature.
Sign up
here.
CCTV showed pictures of four coast guard personnel in black combat gear holding a Chinese flag after arriving on Sandy Cay on an inflatable dinghy.
Philippine National Security Council spokesperson Jonathan Malaya on Monday said news reports of China seizing Sandy Cay were false as a Philippine team had visited the sandbars on Sunday and found nobody there.
"We are here to debunk that and to assure the public that we have not lost the Pagasa Cays," Malaya said, using the Filipino name for the sandbars, calling the reports "irresponsible".
A map showing the locationn of Sandy Cay in the South China Sea.
STRATEGIC SPRATLYS
Ties between China and the U.S. ally the Philippines are significantly strained amid heated spats over disputed parts of the South China Sea, where Beijing has deployed an armada of coast guard to reinforce its claim to sovereignty over almost the entire waterway.
The Philippines is vexed by what it calls Beijing's "aggressive" conduct and the permanent presence in its exclusive economic zone of Chinese coast guard and what Manila considers a militia of fishing vessels under its control.
Sandy Cay is close to Thitu Island, the largest and most strategically important of the nine features the Philippines occupies in the Spratly archipelago, where
Malaysia, Vietnam, Taiwan and China also have a presence
, opens new tab
collectively on dozens of features ranging from reefs and rocks to islands, natural and artificial.
China's manmade islands include runways, ports and missile systems.
The Philippines on Sunday said it observed near Thitu Island what it called the illegal presence of Chinese coast guard and militia vessels.
China's foreign ministry said on Monday it "resolutely upholds the seriousness" of a 2002 declaration with its Southeast Asian neighbours on conduct in the South China Sea, which included not occupying more uninhabited features after Malaya reminded Beijing it was bound by it.
China's moves were "aimed at countering illegal actions, such as the Philippines' unlawful occupation of the reef and other infringing and provocative activities, to firmly safeguard national territorial sovereignty, ensure that (Sandy Cay reef) remains uninhabited and without facilities," said its spokesperson Guo Jiakun.
The latest trading of barbs comes as both the Philippines and China accuse each other of
espionage
and disinformation, further fuelling diplomatic tensions.
The Philippines is investigating allegations by its security council that Chinese state-sponsored groups may be attempting to
influence the outcome of next moth's mid-term election
, which Beijing has rejected.
Reporting by Karen Lema; Additional reporting by Ethan Wang; Editing by John Mair, Martin Petty

_source.movement_title: 中菲南海桑迪礁主权争议升级 双方互指非法行为
_source.movement_abstract: 据路透社4月28日报道，菲律宾否认中国占领南海桑迪礁，称其人员于4月27日登岛时未发现中国存在。中国央视此前发布海警登岛持旗画面，强调此举为维护主权并确保桑迪礁保持无人状态。桑迪礁位于菲律宾实际控制的赤道礁附近，该地区存在中国、马来西亚、越南、台湾等多方声索。菲律宾指控中国在专属经济区长期部署海警船及渔船编队，中国则指责菲律宾非法占据礁盘并实施挑衅行为。双方近期围绕南海问题互相指责，菲律宾正调查中国可能干预中期选举的指控，中国拒绝相关说法。中国外交部表示将坚定维护2002年《南海各方行为宣言》的严肃性，强调行动旨在反制非法行为并确保桑迪礁无设施化。
_source.title: Philippines says China has not seized disputed South China Sea reef
_source.trans_cont:
摘要
中国媒体展示海岸警卫队在沙洲上举着旗帜的画面
菲律宾称其访问显示该礁石无人居住
中国称希望确保桑德岛保持无人居住
马来西亚、菲律宾、越南、台湾和中国在群岛中拥有多个据点
马尼拉，4月28日（路透社）——菲律宾周一表示，有关北京已控制南海争议礁石的报道毫无根据，因为其人员登上了无人居住的沙洲，并未发现中国存在。
中国国家电视台（CCTV）周五表示，其海岸警卫队人员登上了桑德岛，作为海上控制行动的一部分，以行使主权。但并未表示中国正在占据该岛。
注册
此处。
CCTV展示了四名身着黑色作战服的海岸警卫队人员在充气艇上抵达桑德岛后，举着中国国旗的画面。
菲律宾国家安全顾问发言人乔纳森·马利亚周一表示，有关中国占领桑德岛的报道是虚假的，因为菲律宾团队周日访问了这些沙洲，发现那里没有人。
“我们在这里是为了驳斥这些谣言，并向公众保证我们并未失去帕加萨沙洲，”马利亚说，他使用了菲律宾人对这些沙洲的称呼，并称这些报道是“不负责任的”。
一张显示桑德岛在南海位置的地图。
战略南沙群岛
中国与美国盟友菲律宾的关系因南海争议地区的激烈争端而显著紧张，北京已派遣大量海岸警卫队加强其对几乎整个海域的主权主张。
菲律宾对北京所谓的“侵略性”行为感到不满，特别是中国海岸警卫队在菲律宾专属经济区的永久存在，以及马尼拉认为受其控制的渔船武装集团。
桑德岛靠近蒂图岛，这是菲律宾在南沙群岛占据的九个据点中最大且最重要的一个，马来西亚、越南、台湾和中国也在该群岛中拥有据点，共同控制数十个从礁石、岩石到岛屿的自然和人工岛屿。
中国的有人工岛包括跑道、港口和导弹系统。
菲律宾周日表示，它在蒂图岛附近观察到中国海岸警卫队和武装渔船的非法存在。
中国外交部周一表示，它“坚决维护”2002年与东南亚邻国在南海行为准则上的声明的严肃性，其中包括在马利亚提醒北京遵守该声明后，不占据更多的无人居住的据点。
中国发言人郭家昆表示，中国的行动“旨在应对非法行为，如菲律宾非法占据礁石和其他侵犯和挑衅行为，以坚定捍卫国家领土主权，确保（桑德岛礁）保持无人居住和无设施。”
最新的一轮互相指责发生在中国和菲律宾互相指责对方进行间谍活动和散布虚假信息之际，进一步加剧了外交紧张局势。
菲律宾正在调查其安全理事会关于中国国家支持的团体可能试图影响下个月中期选举结果的指控，北京对此予以否认。

MANILA, Feb 7 (Reuters) - As frontrunner in the Philippines' presidential race, the son of late dictator Ferdinand Marcos appears poised to complete a remarkable rebranding of the family name 36 years after a "people power" uprising ended his father's autocratic rule.
With official campaigning beginning on Tuesday, Ferdinand Marcos Jr., 64, holds a double-digit lead in the polls, three months ahead of the May 9 elections.
Sign up
here.
His push for the presidency has been aided by what political analysts say has been a decades-long public relations effort to alter public perception of his family and supporters. Critics accuse the Marcoses of attempting to rewrite history.
"What we are witnessing right now is nothing short of a counter-revolution," said Richard Heydarian, an author and academic who specialises in politics.
"The Marcoses are here to erase the 1986 (people power) revolution, and to restore the glory and fully rehabilitate the image of the Marcos regime."
Since the family's return from exile in the 1990s, Marcos has served as governor and congressman of the northern Ilocos Norte province, his father's bailiwick, before winning a seat in the Senate in 2010.
His sister is a senator and a former governor and former congresswoman, and his mother, Imelda, who ran unsuccessfully for president in 1992, was elected to Congress for four terms.
The return of a Marcos to Malacanang, the presidential palace, is unthinkable for millions of Filipinos, but over half the country's more than 60 million voters are 40 or under, and did not live through the Marcos regime and its oppression and plunder.
Ferdinand Marcos Sr., with Imelda by his side, was president for nearly two decades, ruling as a dictator before he was ousted in the "people power" uprising in 1986 that has become renowned around the world.
Marcos Sr. and Imelda, known for her vast collection of artwork, jewellery and shoes, were accused of amassing more than $10 billion while he was in office.
During his rule, 70,000 people were imprisoned, 34,000 were tortured, and 3,240 were killed, according to Amnesty International.
More than 11,100 victims of human rights abuses during the Marcos regime were paid compensation using millions from Marcos Swiss bank accounts, part of the family's ill-gotten wealth recovered by the government.
Among them was Loretta Ann Rosales, a political activist who was tortured and sexually abused during the Marcos regime and is now one of several complainants seeking to bar Marcos Jr. from the presidential race.
"We thought we had gotten rid of the Marcoses," said Rosales, who is also a former chairperson of the human rights commission. "I want him disqualified."
'LACK LEADERSHIP'
Marcos Jr. has questioned the Amnesty data and rejected long-standing narratives of oppression and failed government in his father's rule. He and his family have shunned questions about past atrocities and instead touted what their supporters claim as a 'golden age'.
The younger Marcos, also known as Bongbong, did not comment for this story. He has in the past spoken highly of his father, calling him his "idol", while expressing admiration for his "style of work", his qualities as a strong leader, and his "love for the Filipino" people, traits he said he has inherited.
"He had a very clear understanding of what needed to be done and how to do it, and that I think was his best quality as a leader," Bongbong Marcos said in a YouTube interview last year. "The problem we have now is we lack leadership."
The YouTube interview titled 'The Greatest Lesson Bongbong Marcos Learned From His Father' has been viewed 13 million times since it aired in September.
"He is doing very well because we have this pandemic of disinformation," said Victor Manhit, an analyst with the Stratbase think tank. "He has been dominating political discourse in social media."
Fact-checking organisation Vera Files said in a December report that Marcos was the "top beneficiary" of disinformation online to spruce up his image while discrediting rivals ahead of the start of the official campaign period.
"Because you are surrounded on social media by the same account saying the same things about Marcos (Sr.) being a good leader - benevolent, revolutionary, all those narratives - even if it sounds bananas and not grounded on facts, you are more likely to believe it is true," said Marie Fatima Gaw, communications research professor at the University of the Philippines.
Marcos has said he does not engage in negative campaigning.
He lost the 2016 vice presidential race to human rights lawyer Leni Robredo, who is also contesting the presidency, along with boxing superstar Manny Pacquiao, Manila Mayor Francisco Domagoso, and senator Panfilo Lacson, among others.
For Raphie Respicio, 48, a tricycle driver and tour guide in the Marcos family bastion in Ilocos Norte, no amount of criticism against Marcos will weaken his support for the former senator.
"He has done plenty of things here ... and he helped tricycle drivers earn a living through tourism," Respicio said. "We are 100% for Bongbong."
Reporting by Karen Lema; Additional reporting by Neil Jerome Morales; Editing by Raju Gopalakrishnan

_source.movement_abstract: 菲律宾总统候选人费迪南德·马科斯（小马科斯）在选举中领先，其家族自20世纪90年代以来通过长期公关活动重塑公众形象。小马科斯家族曾因1986年人民力量革命失去政权，但近年来通过政治职位积累影响力。其母伊梅尔达曾多次参选，其姐伊梅亦为参议员。反对者认为小马科斯家族试图抹除历史记忆，尤其针对其父独裁统治期间的迫害行为。国际特赦组织数据显示，老马科斯执政期间约有3,240人死亡，政府从瑞士银行账户追回的赃款用于赔偿受害者。小马科斯否认负面历史指控，称其父为\"偶像\"，并强调继承其领导才能。分析认为社交媒体上的虚假信息助长了其声望，但支持者仍坚定。本次选举将于5月9日举行，主要对手包括人权律师罗布雷多、拳王帕奎奥等。

马尼拉，2月7日（路透社）——作为菲律宾总统大选的领跑者，这位已故独裁者费迪南德·马科斯的儿子似乎正准备完成对家族名字的重新塑造，这距离1986年一场"人民力量"起义结束其父亲的独裁统治已过去36年。
随着官方竞选活动于周二开始，64岁的费迪南德·马科斯 Jr.在民调中领先优势超过两位数，比5月9日的选举提前三个月。
在此处注册。
他的总统竞选得到了政治分析人士所说的数十年来的公共关系努力的支持，旨在改变公众对他的家族和支持者的看法。批评者指责马科斯家族试图改写历史。
"我们现在所看到的，无异于一场反革命，"专注于政治的作者和学者理查德·海德里安说。
"马科斯家族的目标是抹去1986年（人民力量）革命，恢复马科斯政权的辉煌，并全面恢复其形象。"
自1990年代家族从流亡中返回以来，马科斯曾担任北部伊洛克诺省的州长和国会议员，该省是其父亲的势力范围，之后于2010年赢得参议院席位。
他的妹妹是参议员，曾任州长和国会议员，他的母亲伊梅尔达曾在1992年竞选总统但未成功，后来当选国会四届议员。
对于数百万菲律宾人来说，马科斯家族成员重返马卡坦格（总统府）是不可想象的，但该国超过6000万选民中，有一半以上年龄在40岁以下，他们并未经历过马科斯政权及其压迫和掠夺。
费迪南德·马科斯 Sr.与伊梅尔达在一起，担任总统近二十年，以独裁者身份统治，直到1986年"人民力量"起义将其推翻，这场起义在全球闻名。
马科斯 Sr.和伊梅尔达，以她庞大的艺术品、珠宝和鞋子收藏而闻名，被指控在任期间积累了超过100亿美元。
据大赦国际称，在他的统治期间，有7万人被监禁，3.4万人遭受酷刑，3240人死亡。
超过11100名马科斯政权时期的人权受害者，通过从马科斯瑞士银行账户中提取的数百万美元得到了赔偿，这是政府追回的家族非法所得的一部分。
其中一人是洛雷塔·安·罗萨莱斯，一位政治活动家，曾在马科斯政权期间遭受酷刑和性虐待，现在是几位要求禁止马科斯 Jr.参选总统的投诉人之一。
"我们认为已经摆脱了马科斯家族，"罗萨莱斯同时也是前人权委员会主席说，"我希望他被取消资格。"
"缺乏领导力"
马科斯 Jr.质疑大赦国际的数据，并拒绝其父亲统治时期长期存在的压迫和政府失败的叙述。他和他的家人回避了过去暴行的问题，转而宣传支持者所说的"黄金时代"。
这位年轻的马科斯，也被称为邦邦，对此文未作评论。他过去曾高度评价他的父亲，称其为自己的"偶像"，并表达对父亲"工作方式"、作为强大领导者的品质以及对"菲律宾人"的"爱"的钦佩，称这些是他继承的特质。
"他非常清楚需要做什么以及如何去做，我认为这是他作为领导者的最佳品质，"邦邦·马科斯在去年的一次YouTube采访中说。"我们目前的问题是我们缺乏领导力。"
自9月播出以来，名为《邦邦·马科斯从父亲那里学到的最重要的教训》的YouTube采访已获得1300万次观看。
"他表现很好，因为我们有信息混乱的疫情，"战略智库Stratbase的分析师维克多·马尼特说，"他在社交媒体上主导了政治讨论。"

JCHK為CYBERCOM採用的首個標準化工具套件,可望顯著提升官兵作業效率,應對潛在網攻威脅。(DVIDS)
〔記者吳哲宇/綜合報導〕隨著網路戰威脅持續升高,美軍正加速強化前線網路防禦能力。美國國防供應商Parsons於3月30日向美國網路司令部(CYBERCOM)交付首批名為「聯合網路獵殺套件」(JCHK)的全新網路防禦裝備,整合與標準化美軍數位作戰平臺,進一步強化資安戰力。
軍聞網站「Breaking Defense」報導,網路司令部接裝的4套JCHK,是由Parsons子公司Sealing Technologies開發的新型防禦性網路套件,首度為專責網路作戰的CYBERCOM提供標準化裝備,其體積如手提箱,可隨部隊快速部署至現場,特別適用於無法遠端監控的封閉或受限網路環境,使網路防禦行動從後端監控延伸至前線實地作業。
請繼續往下閱讀...
報導指出,JCHK整合高儲存容量、高速運算與人工智慧分析功能,專門用於偵測與分析難以識別的國家級網路威脅。該系統亦將用於「前進獵捕」(hunt forward)任務,亦即在外國合作夥伴要求下,協助其網路系統搜索並清除敵方駭客潛伏。
此外,過去美軍各軍種網路部隊裝備不一,導致訓練與維保效率低落。此次導入標準化套件,將有助於統一裝備體系,提升整體作戰與後勤效率,並讓資源集中投入威脅偵測與技術升級。
Parsons國防暨情報部門總裁庫申表示,鑑於非所有網路都能透過遠端進行監控,例如五角大廈與盟邦部分網路並未與外部連接,在無法即時存取狀況下,必須派員至現場才能展開搜索並排除威脅;JCHK擁有緊湊外型優勢,還具備優異儲存空間與分析速度,搭載人工智慧(AI)技術,能讓CYBERCOM旗下防禦團隊迅速應對入侵事件。
先前在五角大廈「國防創新小組」(DIU)居中協調下,Parsons與CYBERCOM已簽署低速初始生產(LRIP)合約,將為高優先級別第一線部隊提供數十套JCHK,後續雙方在2月簽訂價值5億美元(約新臺幣161億元)、為期3年全速量產(FRP)協議,預計今年底前交付74套。
報導並指出,除網路司令部外,美國其他政府機構亦對該系統展現興趣,未來不排除擴大至跨部門使用,形成統一的網路防禦平台。

_source.movement_title: 美军网络司令部首获标准化JCHK工具套件 提升前线防御效率
_source.movement_abstract: 美国网络司令部(CYBERCOM)已接收由国防供应商Parsons子公司开发的首批「联合网络猎杀套件」(JCHK)。该套件作为CYBERCOM首个标准化网络防御装备，具备便携性与高效运算能力，专为应对无法远程监控的封闭网络环境设计。JCHK整合高存储容量、高速运算及人工智能分析功能，可快速部署至前线执行威胁检测与清除任务，尤其适用于国家级网络威胁的识别。系统将支持「前进去猎捕」行动，协助盟友排查潜伏网络攻击。此前美軍各军种网络部队装备差异导致训练与维护效率低下，此次标准化部署将统一装备体系，提升作战与后勤协同效率。Parsons已签订5亿美元三年期全速生产协议，计划年底前交付74套JCHK。除CYBERCOM外，其他政府机构亦表现出对该系统的使用兴趣，未来可能扩展为跨部门统一网络防御平台。

(中央社記者丘德真雪梨5日專電)澳洲國防部委託澳洲戰略政策研究所(ASPI)執行,由台裔學者郭美芬等國防專家共同撰寫研究報告指出,澳洲對台灣政策不僅是「地緣政治競合」考量,應該正視澳、台及印太地區的「民主韌性夥伴關係」。
澳洲戰略政策研究所10月31日發表報告「
」(Australian public and institutional responses to Taiwan Strait crises)指出,台海危機將對澳洲的經濟安全、社會穩定與民主韌性產生深遠影響。
報告呼籲,澳洲應正視台灣的政治與社會主體性,並透過深化台澳關係來強化印太地區的民主聯結與危機因應能力。
該報告為國防部戰略政策補助計畫(Strategic Policy Grant Program 2024-085)項目;四位共同撰寫人分別是麥考瑞大學(Macquarie University)講師郭美芬(Mei-fen Kuo)、旋賓科技大學(Swinburne University of Technology)中國問題專家費茲傑羅(John Fitzgerald)、塔斯馬尼亞大學(University of Tasmania)國際關係專家哈里森(Mark Harrison)、澳洲戰略政策研究所分析師厄崔爾(Nathan Attrill),以及前澳洲內政部副部長、現任澳洲戰略政策研究所分資深研究員阿布隆(Marc Ablong)。
報告指出,澳洲長期以來將台海議題視為「美中競爭」的延伸,忽視台灣作為民主夥伴在地緣政治與價值外交中的關鍵角色。
報告又指出,這種「以中國為中心」的視角導致政策討論偏狹,缺乏針對台灣內部社會、經濟及安全架構的深層理解。
報告提醒,若台海情勢惡化,澳洲將面臨晶片、能源、醫療用品與航運的嚴重中斷,其衝擊將遠超傳統國防範疇。
報告又提醒,澳洲的戰略準備不能再僅限於聯盟層面,而是應該建立與台灣更具制度性與社會連結的合作網絡。
報告提到,台灣與澳洲在防疫經驗、科技產業及民間交流方面的合作基礎,為雙方強化社會韌性提供了具體路徑。
報告認為,台灣的公民社會能量與開放民主經驗,正是澳洲在應對認知戰與社會分化挑戰時的重要借鏡。
報告建議,儘管顧及「一中政策」,澳洲還是應該尋求更積極的「對台理解與接觸政策」(policy of understanding and engagement with Taiwan),並且要將台灣視為印太安全與民主治理的「戰略社會夥伴」(strategic societal partner)。
報告指未來澳洲可以從三方面深化台、澳合作,分別是政策層面:建立常態化的台澳戰略與風險評估對話機制;教育與研究層面:擴充台灣研究(Taiwan Studies)與跨領域風險管理教育;以及社會層面:強化與台灣社群、學者及公民團體的合作,以共同面對地區民主與安全挑戰。(編輯:陳承功)1141105
_source.movement_title: 澳智库报告建议深化台澳民主伙伴关系以应对台海危机
_source.movement_abstract: 【台湾中央社11月5日报道】台湾中央社11月5日报道，澳大利亚国防部委托澳大利亚战略政策研究所（ASPI）执行研究项目，由郭美芬等四位学者共同撰写报告，指出澳大利亚应正视台湾在印太地区地缘政治与民主韧性中的关键角色。报告认为，当前澳方政策过度聚焦美中竞争，忽视台湾作为民主伙伴的主体性，导致对台海危机可能引发的经济、社会及供应链冲击评估不足。报告警告，若台海局势恶化，澳大利亚将面临芯片、能源、医疗用品及航运中断的严重风险。报告建议澳大利亚调整对台政策，从联盟层面转向建立更具制度性与社会性的合作网络，将台湾视为印太安全与民主治理的战略社会伙伴。报告提出三方面深化合作路径：政策层面建立常态化战略与风险评估对话机制；教育与研究层面扩充台湾研究与跨领域风险管理教育；社会层面强化与台湾社群、学者及公民团体的合作，共同应对认知战与社会分化挑战。
_source.title: 台裔學者參與澳洲國防報告 學者:台海不是他國問題
_source.trans_cont:
（法新社记者丘德真悉尼5日电）澳大利亚国防部委托澳大利亚战略政策研究所（ASPI）执行，由台裔学者郭美芬等国防专家共同撰写的研究报告指出，澳大利亚对台湾政策不仅涉及“地缘政治竞合”考量，更应重视澳、台及印太地区的“民主韧性伙伴关系”。  
澳大利亚战略政策研究所10月31日发表报告《澳大利亚公众与机构对台海危机的反应》指出，台海危机将对澳大利亚的经济安全、社会稳定与民主韧性产生深远影响。  
报告呼吁，澳大利亚应正视台湾的政治与社会主体性，并通过深化台澳关系来强化印太地区的民主联结与危机应对能力。  
该报告为国防部战略政策补助计划（Strategic Policy Grant Program 2024-085）项目；四位共同撰写人分别为麦考瑞大学（Macquarie University）讲师郭美芬（Mei-fen Kuo）、斯威本科技大学（Swinburne University of Technology）中国问题专家费兹杰罗（John Fitzgerald）、塔斯马尼亚大学（University of Tasmania）国际关系专家哈里森（Mark Harrison）、澳大利亚战略政策研究所分析师厄崔尔（Nathan Attrill），以及前澳大利亚内政部副部长、现任澳大利亚战略政策研究所资深研究员阿布隆（Marc Ablong）。  
报告指出，澳大利亚长期以来将台海议题视为“美中竞争”的延伸，忽视台湾作为民主伙伴在地缘政治与价值外交中的关键角色。  
报告又指出，这种“以中国为中心”的视角导致政策讨论偏狭，缺乏对台湾内部社会、经济及安全架构的深层理解。  
报告提醒，若台海情势恶化，澳大利亚将面临芯片、能源、医疗用品与航运的严重中断，其冲击将远超传统国防范畴。  
报告又提醒，澳大利亚的战略准备不能再仅限于联盟层面，而应建立与台湾更具制度性与社会联结的合作网络。  
报告提到，台湾与澳大利亚在防疫经验、科技产业及民间交流方面的合作基础，为双方强化社会韧性提供了具体路径。  
报告认为，台湾的公民社会能量与开放民主经验，正是澳大利亚在应对认知战与社会分化挑战时的重要借鉴。  
报告建议，尽管顾及“一中政策”，澳大利亚仍应寻求更积极的“对台理解与接触政策”（对台理解与接触政策），并将台湾视为印太安全与民主治理的“战略社会伙伴”（战略社会伙伴）。  
报告指出，未来澳大利亚可从三个方面深化台澳合作，分别为政策层面：建立常态化的台澳战略与风险评估对话机制；教育与研究层面：拓展台湾研究（台湾研究）与跨领域风险管理教育；以及社会层面：强化与台湾社群、学者及公民团体的合作，以共同应对地区民主与安全挑战。（编辑：陈承功）1141105
_source.trans_title: 台裔学者参与澳洲国防报告 学者：台海不是他国问题
_source.evidence: 文章核心内容是澳洲战略政策研究所（ASPI）发布的一份关于台海危机对澳洲影响的研究报告。报告分析了台海局势对澳洲经济、社会及民主韧性的潜在威胁，并提出了具体的政策建议，呼吁澳洲政府调整对台政策，建立更紧密的‘战略社会伙伴’关系，深化在政策、教育及社会层面的合作。虽然报告涉及台海（涉我）议题，但其本质是一份智库发布的政策分析与建议文件，属于战略框架和理论探讨范畴，而非具体的敌对行动、军事演习、部队组建或武器研发。根据标签定义，涉及‘理论、政策、法规、战略框架’的内容应归类为[理论政策]。

_source.content:
Apple has pushed a security update to older iPhones and iPads that protects against a leaked set of powerful hacking tools capable of stealing data from a person’s device.
The tech giant said on Wednesday that it
released iOS 18.7.7 and iPadOS 18.7.7
to allow a broader range of devices to “receive important security protections from web attacks called DarkSword.”
DarkSword is a hacking toolkit that can be used to break into Apple devices running iOS 18.4 through 18.7 simply by a user visiting a website that hosts the malicious code, such as legitimate websites that have themselves been breached. The exploits steal a person’s device data, including their messages, browser histories, location data, and cryptocurrency, and upload the data to a server hosted by the hackers.
The tools have already been seen in certain attacks targeting users in China, Malaysia, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Ukraine. But now
that the tools have been published online
, security researchers warn that
anyone can use
these hacking tools to target people running older versions of Apple’s mobile software.
Apple says users running its latest software, iOS 26, were protected weeks ago. The company has also released a new update to iOS 18 users with iPhones and iPads that are unable to run iOS 26 software.
But with Wednesday’s update, Apple has now provided DarkSword fixes for the millions of users with unpatched devices that are capable of updating to iOS 26 but who have chosen not to update. Some users have opted not to update to avoid the software’s new “liquid glass” interface that
has drawn user complaints
.
Wired reported earlier on Wednesday that Apple was preparing to
release the update
.
Apple customers who have switched on automatic software updates should receive the new software. Apple said its optional security protections feature, Lockdown Mode, also defends against DarkSword attacks. The company
told TechCrunch last week
that it is unaware of any successful government spyware attack against an Apple device running Lockdown Mode.
_source.movement_title: 苹果为旧版iOS设备修复DarkSword漏洞安全更新
_source.movement_abstract: 苹果公司周三发布iOS 18.7.7和iPadOS 18.7.7安全更新，修复名为DarkSword的漏洞攻击工具。该工具可通过恶意网站窃取用户消息、浏览器历史、位置数据和加密货币等信息，此前已在中国、马来西亚、土耳其、沙特阿拉伯和乌克兰等国的定向攻击中被使用。此次更新为无法升级至最新iOS 26版本的设备提供防护，部分用户因拒绝使用iOS 26的新\"液态玻璃\"界面而选择停留在旧系统。安全专家警告，由于攻击工具已在线公开，任何未及时更新的iOS 18.4-18.7设备均面临风险。苹果表示最新iOS 26版本数周前已内置防护，同时强调其可选的\"锁定模式\"能有效防御DarkSword攻击，目前尚未发现该模式下的设备遭受政府监控软件攻击的案例。
_source.title: Apple releases security fix for older iPhones and iPads to protect against DarkSword attacks
_source.trans_cont:
苹果公司向较旧的iPhone和iPad推送了一项安全更新，以防范一组泄露的强力黑客工具，这些工具能够从用户的设备中窃取数据。  
这家科技巨头周三表示，已发布iOS 18.7.7和iPadOS 18.7.7，以让更广泛的设备“接收来自称为DarkSword的网络攻击的重要安全保护”。  
DarkSword是一种黑客工具包，用户只需访问一个托管恶意代码的网站（例如本身已被入侵的合法网站），就可以入侵运行iOS 18.4至18.7的苹果设备。这些漏洞会窃取用户的设备数据，包括消息、浏览器历史记录、位置数据和加密货币，并将这些数据上传到黑客托管的服务器上。  
这些工具已经出现在针对中国、马来西亚、土耳其、沙特阿拉伯和乌克兰等国用户的某些攻击中。但现在，随着这些工具在线发布，安全研究人员警告称，任何人都可以使用这些黑客工具来针对运行苹果旧版移动软件的用户。  
苹果表示，运行其最新软件iOS 26的用户早在几周前就已经受到保护。该公司还为无法运行iOS 26软件的iPhone和iPad用户发布了新的更新。  
但随着周三的更新，苹果现在为数百万台未修补且能够升级到iOS 26但用户选择不升级的设备提供了DarkSword的修复方案。一些用户选择不升级，以避免软件新的“液态玻璃”界面，该界面已引发用户投诉。  
《连线》杂志周三早些时候报道，苹果正在准备发布该更新。  
已开启自动软件更新的苹果用户将收到新软件。苹果表示，其可选的安全保护功能“锁定模式”也能防御DarkSword攻击。该公司上周告诉TechCrunch，目前尚不清楚有任何成功针对运行锁定模式的苹果设备的政府间谍软件攻击。
_source.trans_title: 苹果发布安全修复程序，保护旧款iPhone和iPad免受DarkSword攻击

_source.content:
American toy-making giant Hasbro has confirmed a cyberattack, and the company says it may take “several weeks” before the incident is resolved.
The owner of properties including Transformers, Peppa Pig, and Dungeons & Dragons said in a
legally required disclosure
with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday that it detected an intrusion on March 28, which prompted the company to take down some of its systems.
Hasbro said it has implemented and continues to roll out business continuity plans to allow it to “take orders, ship product and conduct other key operations while it resolves this situation.”
Parts of Hasbro’s website appeared down as of Wednesday, when checked by TechCrunch. One error message said the site was “currently undergoing maintenance.”
The company said it has called cybersecurity professionals to help, but noted that it was continuing to “implement measures to secure its business operations,” suggesting that the hackers may still be in the company’s systems.
It’s not known what specific kind of cyberattack, such as ransomware, was detected.
When reached by TechCrunch, Hasbro spokesperson Andrea Snyder reiterated much of the SEC filing and said the company had “taken swift action to protect our systems and data,” but would not answer questions about the nature of the cyberattack, or if the company has had any communication from the hackers, such as a demand for money.
Hackers increasingly target large companies to steal data and extort corporate victims for ransom, but also cause disruption to operations that can have lasting financial damage. A cyberattack at Jaguar Land Rover in 2025
stalled car-making production lines for months
, prompting the U.K. government to step in
with a $1.5 billion bailout guarantee
to prevent the company and its supply chain from going under.
In its public notice to investors, Hasbro warned of delays, citing the need to run these interim measures for “several weeks before the situation is fully resolved.”
The company said it was not immediately known if any data was stolen, and that its investigation is ongoing to determine the full scope of the breach.
Hasbro is one of America’s longest-running makers of toys and entertainment products, and has more than 5,000 employees. The company also holds the intellectual property rights of major toy, game, and consumer brands, including Monopoly, My Little Pony, and Magic: The Gathering.
Updated to include Hasbro spokesperson comment.

and know more about its data breach? Contact this reporter via encrypted message at zackwhittaker.1337 on Signal.
_source.movement_title: 孩之宝遭网络攻击 部分系统瘫痪或需数周恢复
_source.movement_abstract: 美国玩具巨头孩之宝确认遭遇网络攻击，3月28日发现系统入侵事件后已启动应急计划。公司表示部分网站目前显示维护状态，正在与网络安全专家合作保障业务连续性，但未透露攻击类型及数据泄露情况。根据美国证券交易委员会披露，业务恢复可能需要数周时间。此前2025年捷豹路虎遭网络攻击导致生产线停滞数月，英国政府介入提供15亿美元担保。目前孩之宝仍在调查事件影响范围，已通知投资者可能面临运营延迟。该公司拥有5000多名员工，旗下IP包括变形金刚、小猪佩奇等知名品牌。
_source.title: Hasbro says it was hacked, and may take ‘several weeks’ to recover
_source.trans_cont: 美国玩具制造巨头孩之宝确认遭遇了网络攻击，公司表示，此次事件可能需要“几周时间”才能解决。孩之宝拥有包括变形金刚、小猪佩奇和龙与地下城等在内的多个品牌，该公司周三向美国证券交易委员会提交了法律要求的披露文件，称其于3月28日检测到入侵行为，因此公司不得不关闭部分系统。孩之宝表示，已实施并继续推出业务连续性计划，以确保其在解决此问题期间仍能“接收订单、发货和进行其他关键业务操作”。据TechCrunch周三检查，孩之宝网站的部分内容出现故障，其中一条错误信息称网站“正在接受维护”。公司表示已联系网络安全专家协助，但同时指出仍在“实施措施以保障其业务运营”，暗示黑客可能仍留在公司系统中。目前尚不清楚具体遭遇了哪种类型的网络攻击，例如勒索软件。当TechCrunch联系孩之宝发言人安德里亚·辛德勒时，她重申了SEC文件中的大部分内容，并表示公司已“迅速采取行动保护我们的系统和数据”，但未回答有关网络攻击性质或公司是否与黑客有过沟通（如要求付款）的问题。黑客越来越多地针对大型公司窃取数据，并勒索企业受害者，同时也会造成运营中断，带来长期的经济损失。2025年捷豹路虎遭遇网络攻击，导致汽车生产线停工数月，促使英国政府介入，提供15亿美元的纾困担保，以防止该公司及其供应链倒闭。在向投资者发布的公开声明中，孩之宝警告称可能会有延误，因为需要执行这些临时措施，直到“情况完全解决”。“目前尚不清楚是否有数据被盗，公司仍在调查以确定此次泄露的全部范围。”孩之宝是美国历史最悠久的玩具和娱乐产品制造商之一，拥有超过5000名员工。公司还拥有包括大富翁、我的小马驹和万智牌等主要玩具、游戏和消费品品牌的知识产权。更新内容包括孩之宝发言人评论。你是否在孩之宝工作，并了解更多信息？可通过Signal上的加密消息联系这位记者，用户名为zackwhittaker.1337。
_source.trans_title: 孩之宝称其遭到黑客攻击，可能需要“数周时间”才能恢复

Taiwan scholars say China lacks the capability to replicate the U.S. military operation that captured Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, dismissing online speculation that Beijing might attempt a similar strike against Taiwan.
Cognitive warfare expert and Chung Yuan Christian University adjunct associate professor Liu Wen-bin (劉文斌) categorically rejected the idea that today's Venezuela could be tomorrow's Taiwan.
Liu said that China simply does not possess the capacity to execute the kind of precise decapitation operation the U.S. demonstrated. He noted the U.S. deployed 150 aircraft in coordinated waves during the Venezuela operation—a level of precision currently unmatched globally.
Liu said cross-strait relations cannot be equated with U.S.-Venezuela relations. International incidents each have their own independence and particularity. He suggested that China itself should be concerned. If the U.S. launched a similar operation against China, could Beijing defend against it?
New School for Democracy standing director Tseng Chien-yuan (曾建元) agreed, emphasizing that the military gap across the Taiwan Strait is not as vast as that between the U.S. and Venezuela. Tseng said Taiwan's national defense and air defense systems are robust. If China wants to conduct a decapitation operation against Taiwan, it would have to think very carefully. Taiwan is not entirely in a passive defensive position—we also have retaliatory capabilities.
Tseng argued that regime preservation remains Beijing's primary objective. He said China would not risk losing its regime just to launch a surprise attack on Taiwan. Instead, it will continue to create cross-strait tensions to consolidate its domestic ruling authority and maximize political benefits.
Both scholars emphasized Taiwan should focus on maintaining sufficient defensive capabilities rather than following panic narratives online.
_source.movement_title: 台湾学者评估中国缺乏复制美国委内瑞拉斩首行动能力
_source.movement_abstract: 【台湾中央社报道】台湾中原大学兼任副教授刘文斌与新民主学校主任曾建元针对美国在委内瑞拉实施针对总统马杜罗的斩首行动发表评论。刘文斌指出，中国目前不具备执行此类高精度斩首行动的能力，美国在该行动中部署150架次飞机进行协同波次打击，其精确度全球无双。他强调两岸关系与美国委内瑞拉关系性质不同，中国自身应关注若美国对中国实施类似行动时的防御能力。曾建元认为，台湾海峡军事差距远小于美国与委内瑞拉之间差距，台湾国防与防空体系健全，具备反击能力，非完全被动防御。他指出，政权存续是北京首要目标，中国不会为突袭台湾而冒政权风险，更倾向于制造两岸紧张以巩固国内统治权威。两位学者建议台湾应聚焦维持充足防御能力，避免受网络恐慌叙事影响。
_source.title: WATCH: Scholars say China lacks capability to replicate US Venezuela strike on Taiwan
_source.trans_cont: 台湾学者表示，中国缺乏复制美国在委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗行动中所展现的军事能力，驳斥了网络上关于北京可能对台湾采取类似行动的猜测。认知战专家、中正大学兼任助理教授刘文斌（刘文斌）明确表示，今天的委内瑞拉并不等于明天的台湾。刘文斌指出，中国目前不具备执行美国所展示的那种精准斩首行动的能力。他提到，在委内瑞拉行动中，美国部署了150架飞机进行协调波次行动，这种精确度目前是全球独一无二的。刘文斌强调，两岸关系不能等同于美委关系，国际事件各有其独立性和特殊性。他建议中国自身也应有所警惕，如果美国对华采取类似行动，北京能否有效防御？新学校民主研究所常任董事曾建元（曾建元）表示赞同，他强调台湾海峡的军事差距并不像美委之间那样巨大。曾建元指出，台湾的国防和防空体系相当稳固。如果中国想要对台湾实施斩首行动，必须慎重考虑。台湾并非完全处于被动防御地位，我们也有反击能力。曾建元认为，政权存续仍是北京的首要目标。他表示，中国不会为了对台发动突袭而冒险失去政权，相反，中国将继续制造两岸紧张局势，以巩固国内统治权威并最大化政治利益。两位学者均强调，台湾应专注于维持足够的防御能力，而非跟随网络上的恐慌叙事。
_source.trans_title: 观察：学者称中国缺乏能力在台湾复制美国对委内瑞拉的袭击

內政部政務次長馬士元接受本報專訪說明,「全社會韌性」是為因應現代多樣化威脅的防衛概念,強調社會整體的協調運作。 (資料照)
賴清德總統去年六月宣布成立「全社會防衛韌性委員會」,迄今已召開兩次會議,提出五大主軸、四大韌性提升目標。內政部政務次長馬士元接受本報專訪說明,「全社會韌性」是為因應現代多樣化威脅的防衛概念,強調社會整體的協調運作,若比喻為人體健康,相較於傳統防衛概念,不能只看心臟、頭腦好不好,比如面對如「超級細菌」假訊息等威脅,若和過去一樣忽視,傷害可能很快就會擴及全身。
如人體健康 不能只看單一器官好不好
馬士元直言,現代社會中,若有人仍以過去的「古典」觀念看待安全與防衛,例如以弓箭對抗現代海盜,或單純以發傳單應對詐騙集團,就無法瞭解台灣如今所面臨的高度不對等威脅。他強調,隨著現代威脅漸趨多元化,單靠警力解決治安、靠國防解決安全問題的美好年代已經過去了,整體社會的動員才是關鍵,全社會韌性也是各界須正視的議題。
請繼續往下閱讀...
賴清德去年底於全社會防衛韌性委員會第二次委員會議,提出「民力訓練暨運用」、「戰略物資盤整暨維生配送」、「能源及關鍵基礎設施維運」、「社福醫療及避難設施整備」及「資通、運輸及金融網絡安全」等五大主軸,以及全面提升國防、民生、災防、民主四大韌性。
馬士元表示,每個時代政府面臨的挑戰有所不同,應對的方法也需隨之調整,全社會韌性即是過去十年間,逐漸興起的重要議題。他以人體健康比喻全社會韌性,強調健康並非僅靠心臟、頭腦等單一器官運作,而是整體協調的結果。全社會韌性也是一個整體概念,各層面穩定運作,才能構築真正的安全。
資訊化時代 傳統安全框架已不敷使用
馬指出,傳統的安全觀念多集中於國防與軍事對抗,但資訊化時代來臨,當社會的資訊使用方式改變,或輿論影響的模式發生變化,國家安全就不能再侷限於軍事層面。特別是在全球化的背景下,生產、消費、能源及通信的連結性更強,國家安全成為跨國且區域性的議題,傳統安全的框架已不敷使用。
對於現代社會面臨的新型態威脅,馬士元說明,例如,認知作戰、灰色地帶行動及假訊息等,這些威脅在古代可能僅是一個王國邊界的局部干擾,但如今透過科技和資訊傳播,已演變成可能動搖國本的挑戰。
他舉例指出,若一個國家如人體破了一個小洞,以前可能擦一擦就沒事,但透過現代化通訊技術則極有可能迅速擴大,如同「超級細菌」般迅速侵蝕整個系統,對社會整體運作,造成致命威脅的困境。

_source.movement_title: 台湾内政部阐释全社会韧性概念应对现代多元化威胁
_source.movement_abstract: 【台湾中央社报道】台湾内政部政务次长马士元接受专访，阐释赖清德总统于去年六月成立的“全社会防卫韧性委员会”运作情况。该委员会迄今已召开两次会议，提出民力训练运用、战略物资盘整、能源及关键基础设施维运、社福医疗及避难设施整备、资通运输及金融网络安全等五大主轴，旨在全面提升国防、民生、灾防、民主四大韧性目标。马士元指出，传统安全框架聚焦国防军事，已无法应对资讯化时代认知作战、灰色地带行动及假讯息等多元化威胁。他以人体健康为喻，强调现代社会安全不能仅依赖单一器官（如心脏、头脑）运作，而需整体协调。面对如“超级细菌”般的假讯息威胁，若忽视局部干扰，将迅速侵蚀整个系统。马士元强调，单靠警力或国防已无法解决当前高度不对称威胁，必须通过全社会动员与协调运作，构建整体韧性以应对现代安全挑战。
_source.title: 馬士元︰全社會防衛韌性 因應現代多樣化威脅
_source.trans_cont:
内政部政务次长马士元接受本报专访说明，“全社会韧性”是应对现代多样化威胁的防卫概念，强调社会整体的协调运作。（资料照片）
总统赖清德去年六月宣布成立“全社会防卫韧性委员会”，至今已召开两次会议，提出五大主轴、四大韧性提升目标。内政部政务次长马士元接受本报专访说明，“全社会韧性”是应对现代多样化威胁的防卫概念，强调社会整体的协调运作，若比喻为人体健康，相较于传统防卫概念，不能只看心脏、头脑好不好，例如面对如“超级细菌”假讯息等威胁，若和过去一样忽视，伤害可能很快就会影响全身。
如同人体健康 不能只看单一器官好不好
马士元直言，在现代社会中，若有人仍以过去的“古典”观念看待安全与防卫，例如用弓箭对抗现代海盗，或单纯发传单应对诈骗集团，就无法了解台湾如今所面临的高度不对等威胁。他强调，随着现代威胁日趋多元化，单靠警力解决治安、靠国防解决安全问题的美好年代已经过去了，整体社会的动员才是关键，全社会韧性也是各界须正视的议题。
请继续阅读...
赖清德去年底在全社会防卫韧性委员会第二次委员会议中，提出“民力训练暨运用”、“战略物资盘点暨维生配送”、“能源及关键基础设施维运”、“社福医疗及避难设施整备”及“资通、运输及金融网络安全”等五大主轴，以及全面提升国防、民生、灾防、民主四大韧性。
马士元表示，每个时代政府面临的挑战有所不同，应对的方法也需随之调整，全社会韧性即是过去十年间逐渐兴起的重要议题。他以人体健康比喻全社会韧性，强调健康并非仅靠心脏、头脑等单一器官运作，而是整体协调的结果。全社会韧性也是一个整体概念，各层面稳定运作，才能构筑真正的安全。
信息化时代 传统安全框架已不敷使用
马指出，传统的安全观念多集中于国防与军事对抗，但信息化时代来临，当社会的信息使用方式改变，或舆论影响的模式发生变化，国家安全就不能再局限于军事层面。特别是在全球化的背景下，生产、消费、能源及通信的连结性更强，国家安全成为跨国且区域性的议题，传统安全的框架已不敷使用。
对于现代社会面临的新型威胁，马士元说明，例如认知作战、灰色地带行动及假讯息等，这些威胁在古代可能仅是一个王国边界的局部干扰，但如今透过科技和信息传播，已演变成可能动摇国本的挑战。
他举例指出，若一个国家如人体破了一个小洞，以前可能擦一擦就没事，但透过现代化通讯技术则极有可能迅速扩大，如同“超级细菌”般迅速侵蚀整个系统，对社会整体运作，造成致命威胁的困境。

_source.content:
Deploying ground forces without defined political objectives leads to failure.
America is weighing the deployment of land forces onto Iranian territory – a move that would dramatically escalate the war and risk drawing it into a prolonged conflict. While this conflict is not Iraq, Afghanistan, Vietnam or any number of previous wars, history offers a guide on employing ground forces. They can be extraordinarily decisive when used at scale, for the right mission and with a clear political objective. But, without these things, land operations can result in tactical catastrophe, the death of soldiers and marines, and overall political failure in war.
All strategies start with a diagnosis of the problem to be solved. Any consideration of land force operations in Iran – and in any war – must begin with the following question: “What problem will land forces solve?”
The political objectives of employing land forces are several. First, the American president will want Iran to see US troops on the ground as a profound statement about US will. He will want them to know that he is not giving up and walking away from the war. Second, Trump will use land forces as a statement of commitment to regional allies: America is not abandoning you. And finally, the commitment of land forces will aim to solve an ongoing political quandary for Trump: how to bring the Iranians to the table, quickly, for diplomatic negotiations that can end the war.
What might be America’s military objectives? Securing Iran’s enriched nuclear material will be a high priority – a mission that both American and Israeli ground forces have rehearsed for years, although rehearsals do not guarantee success or casualty-free operations.
Another priority will be to re-open the Strait of Hormuz. Not only is the shipping restriction having a profound impact on the global economy, but it is also being used by Iran as a symbol of American weakness in its cognitive warfare. The US mission might also be to seize ground objectives – including refineries, bases, islands – that provide America with enhanced leverage in diplomatic negotiations. Most of these operations would best be described as raids and could last from hours to days. Maybe.
In war, the enemy gets a vote. What might Iran’s political goals be for their own employment of land forces?
The Iranians, who have shown a deft hand at political manoeuvring and cognitive warfare since the war began, will probably prioritise above all else the killing and capturing of American soldiers. They probably assess that this will substantially erode the American population’s support for the war. But they will also use it to signal to the Iranian people – and regional nations – that the will of the Iranian regime is unbreakable, and that they are comfortable killing anyone who challenges them.
Clearly, the Iranians will want to take back any Iranian territory seized by the Americans. However, they will understand that killing Americans is far more important, and that in due course the Americans will leave anyway. Seizing back their own territory will thus be a lesser military goal for the Iranians.
U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth during a press briefing about Operation Epic Fury at the Pentagon, Washington DC (Madelyn Keech/DoW Photo)
We should expect that the Iranians will be assisted by Russia in any ground fight against American forces. There are already multiple reports of Russian intelligence being provided to Iran. If Iran seeks Russian help in killing American soldiers and marines, the Russians are likely to be willing partners. They hate America for helping Ukraine kill hundreds of thousands of Russians. Russia is keen for payback and understands that there is a minimal price to be paid. When asked whether Russian assistance would affect his view of the bilateral relationship, US President Donald Trump drew a comparison to US intelligence support for Ukraine, saying “they’d say we do it against them”.
A final consideration for the employment of land forces in Iran is terrain. Every soldier understands the profound impact of terrain (and climate) on their success or failure. Iran, to make an obvious point, is a pretty big country with a substantial land force, including its army and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. While the size of Iran might allow American forces, with their greater operational manoeuvre capacity, more freedom of action, it also means that supporting them if something goes wrong is much harder.
Another point about terrain is the length of the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian shoreline is almost 200 kilometres long. The Iranians only need to be able to interfere with maritime traffic from a single point. America needs to keep the whole strait open. This is a mission requiring far larger air and land forces than those already announced for deployment to the region.
The commitment of American ground forces in Iran faces unclear political objectives compounded by Iranian resistance, difficult terrain, and the spectre of Russian assistance. More than any other environment, land operations are characterised by uncertainty, fear, friction and surprise. In his brilliant book, Military Strategy, Rear Admiral J.C. Wylie wrote that “the ultimate determinant in war is the man on the scene with a gun”. This is a statement about will. Ultimately, while air and naval operations may have an impact on the will of an adversary, only land combat can break an enemy’s will. The danger for Trump is this: by deploying small-scale forces on limited raids that fail to achieve his political goals, he risks breaking not Iran’s will, but his own.
Mick Ryan is a Senior Fellow for Military Studies in the Lowy Institute’s International Security Program. Mick spent 35 years in the Australian Army and had the honour of commanding soldiers at multiple levels.
This article appeared originally at Lowy Institute's the interpreter.
_source.movement_title: 美国评估伊朗地面军事行动风险及政治目标与俄方介入影响
_source.movement_abstract: 【澳大利亚洛伊研究所网站2026年6月报道】澳大利亚洛伊研究所高级研究员米克·瑞安分析指出，美国在缺乏明确政治目标的情况下向伊朗领土部署地面部队将导致战略失败。文章指出，美国若部署地面部队，其政治目标包括展示国家意志、向地区盟友传递承诺信号以及迫使伊朗重返谈判桌。军事目标可能包括控制伊朗浓缩核材料、重新开放霍尔木兹海峡以及夺取炼油厂、基地等关键地面目标以获取外交谈判筹码。伊朗方面将优先通过杀伤和俘获美军士兵来削弱美国国内战争支持，并以此向国内及地区国家展示政权不可动摇的意志。伊朗可能获得俄罗斯情报及军事协助，俄罗斯出于对美报复心理可能愿意参与对抗。伊朗地形广阔且霍尔木兹海峡海岸线长达200公里，增加了美军作战难度及后勤支援风险。文章强调，地面作战充满不确定性，若小规模突袭未能实现政治目标，将导致美国自身意志崩溃而非击溃伊朗。
_source.title: Iran: A Land War Illusion
_source.trans_cont:
部署地面部队而没有明确的政治目标会导致失败。
美国正在权衡将地面部队部署到伊朗领土上——这将使战争急剧升级，并可能使战争演变为一场长期冲突。尽管这场冲突不同于伊拉克、阿富汗、越南或以往的任何战争，但历史为使用地面部队提供了指导。当大规模使用、针对正确的任务并具有明确的政治目标时，地面部队可以发挥决定性作用。但如果没有这些要素，地面作战可能导致战术灾难、士兵和海军陆战队员的死亡，以及战争中的整体政治失败。
所有战略都始于对要解决的问题的诊断。任何考虑在伊朗或任何战争中使用地面部队的行动，都必须从以下问题开始：“地面部队将解决什么问题？”
使用地面部队的政治目标有几个。首先，美国总统希望伊朗看到美军地面部队，这将传达美国的坚定意志。他希望伊朗人知道他不会放弃并离开战争。其次，特朗普将利用地面部队向地区盟友表明美国不会抛弃他们。最后，地面部队的投入旨在解决特朗普面临的一个持续的政治难题：如何迅速让伊朗人坐下来进行谈判，以结束战争。
美国的军事目标可能包括确保伊朗的浓缩核材料，这将是一个优先事项——美国和以色列地面部队已经演练了多年，尽管演练并不保证成功或零伤亡。
另一个优先事项是重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。不仅航运限制对全球经济产生了深远影响，而且伊朗还利用这一限制作为其认知战中美国软弱的象征。美国的任务可能还包括夺取一些地面目标——包括炼油厂、基地和岛屿——这些目标能增强美国在外交谈判中的筹码。这些行动大多可以被描述为突袭，持续时间可能从几小时到几天不等。
在战争中，敌人也有投票权。伊朗在使用地面部队时可能有哪些政治目标？
自战争开始以来，伊朗在政治博弈和认知战方面表现得非常老练，他们很可能首先优先考虑的是杀害和俘获美军士兵。他们可能评估这将大大削弱美国民众对战争的支持。但同时，他们也将借此向伊朗人民和地区国家表明，伊朗政权的意志不可动摇，他们愿意杀死任何挑战他们的人。
显然，伊朗希望夺回被美军占领的任何伊朗领土。然而，他们明白杀害美军更为重要，而且最终美军也会离开。因此，夺回自己的领土对伊朗来说将是一个次要的军事目标。
美国战争部长彼得·赫格赛特在五角大楼举行的关于“雷霆怒火行动”的简报会上（马德琳·基奇/美国国防部照片）
我们可以预期，伊朗在与美军的地面战斗中将得到俄罗斯的帮助。已有多个报告称俄罗斯向伊朗提供了情报。如果伊朗寻求俄罗斯帮助杀害美军士兵和海军陆战队员，俄罗斯很可能会成为愿意的合作伙伴。他们憎恨美国帮助乌克兰杀害数十万俄罗斯人。俄罗斯渴望报复，并明白需要付出的代价是微小的。当被问及俄罗斯的帮助是否会影响他对双边关系的看法时，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将美国对乌克兰的情报支持与之相比，说“他们会说我们是针对他们的”。
在伊朗使用地面部队的最后一点考虑是地形。每个士兵都明白地形（以及气候）对其成功或失败有深远影响。伊朗，显而易见，是一个相当大的国家，拥有庞大的地面部队，包括其军队和伊斯兰革命卫队。虽然伊朗的规模可能允许美军凭借更强的作战机动能力拥有更多的行动自由，但这也意味着如果出现问题，支持美军将更加困难。
关于地形的另一个点是霍尔木兹海峡的长度。伊朗的海岸线几乎有200公里长。伊朗只需在单一地点就能干扰海上交通。美国需要保持整个海峡的畅通。这是一项需要比目前宣布部署到该地区的更大规模的空军和地面部队的任务。
美军在伊朗的地面部队投入面临模糊的政治目标、伊朗的抵抗、困难的地形以及俄罗斯援助的阴影。在所有环境中，地面作战最显著的特点是不确定性、恐惧、摩擦和意外。在《军事战略》一书中，海军少将J.C. 威利写道：“战争的最终决定因素是现场握枪的人。” 这是关于意志的陈述。最终，虽然空战和海军作战可能影响敌人的意志，但只有地面战斗才能打破敌人的意志。特朗普面临的危险是：通过部署规模有限、未能实现其政治目标的小规模部队进行有限突袭，他可能会打破的不是伊朗的意志，而是他自己的意志。
米克·瑞安是洛伊研究所国际安全计划的高级研究员。米克在澳大利亚军队服役了35年，并曾荣幸地在多个级别指挥士兵。
本文最初发表于洛伊研究所的《解读者》。
_source.trans_title: 伊朗：一场陆地战争的幻觉

_source.content:
Mercor
, a popular AI recruiting startup, has confirmed a security incident linked to a supply chain attack involving the open-source project LiteLLM.
The AI startup told TechCrunch on Tuesday that it was “one of thousands of companies” affected by a recent compromise of LiteLLM’s project, which was linked to a hacking group called TeamPCP. Confirmation of the incident comes as extortion hacking group Lapsus$ claimed it had targeted Mercor and gained access to its data.
It’s not immediately clear how the Lapsus$ gang obtained the stolen data from Mercor as part of TeamPCP’s cyberattack.
Founded in 2023, Mercor works with companies including OpenAI and Anthropic to train AI models by contracting specialized domain experts such as scientists, doctors, and lawyers from markets including India. The startup says it facilitates more than $2 million in daily payouts and was
valued at $10 billion
following a $350 million Series C round led by Felicis Ventures in October 2025.
Mercor spokesperson Heidi Hagberg confirmed to TechCrunch that the company had “moved promptly” to contain and remediate the security incident.
“We are conducting a thorough investigation supported by leading third-party forensics experts,” said Hagberg. “We will continue to communicate with our customers and contractors directly as appropriate and devote the resources necessary to resolving the matter as soon as possible.”
Earlier, Lapsus$ claimed responsibility for the apparent data breach on its leak site and shared a sample of data allegedly taken from Mercor, which TechCrunch reviewed. The sample included material referencing Slack data and what appeared to be ticketing data, as well as two videos purportedly showing conversations between Mercor’s AI systems and contractors on its platform.
Hagberg declined to answer follow-up questions on whether the incident was connected to claims by Lapsus$, or whether any customer or contractor data had been accessed, exfiltrated, or misused.
The compromise of LiteLLM
originally surfaced
last week after malicious code was discovered in a package associated with the Y Combinator-backed startup’s open-source project. While the malicious code was identified and removed within hours, the incident drew scrutiny due to LiteLLM’s widespread use around the internet, with the library downloaded millions of times per day, per security firm Snyk. The incident also prompted LiteLLM to make changes to its compliance processes, including
shifting from controversial startup Delve
to Vanta for compliance certifications.
It remains unclear how many companies were affected by the LiteLLM-related incident or whether any data exposure occurred, as investigations continue.
_source.movement_title: Mercor遭LiteLLM供应链攻击事件引关注
_source.movement_abstract: 人工智能招聘初创公司Mercor确认遭遇与开源项目LiteLLM相关的供应链攻击事件。该公司表示其是受LiteLLM项目最近被TeamPCP黑客组织入侵影响的数千家企业之一。勒索黑客组织Lapsus$声称已针对Mercor实施攻击并获取数据，但具体数据窃取方式尚未明确。Mercor发言人Heidi Hagberg确认公司已迅速采取措施控制并修复该安全事件，并委托第三方专家展开调查。此前Lapsus$在其泄密网站声称对此次数据泄露负责，展示了据称从Mercor获取的Slack数据、工单数据及平台对话视频样本。LiteLLM的恶意代码事件上周首次曝光，该项目每日被下载数百万次。目前尚不清楚有多少企业受到影响或是否发生数据泄露，调查仍在进行中。
_source.title: Mercor says it was hit by cyberattack tied to compromise of open-source LiteLLM project
_source.trans_cont:
Mercor是一家受欢迎的人工智能招聘初创公司，已确认一起与供应链攻击相关的安全事件，该攻击涉及开源项目LiteLLM。这家人工智能初创公司周二告诉TechCrunch，它“是数千家公司之一”，受到了LiteLLM项目最近被入侵的影响，该入侵与一个名为TeamPCP的黑客组织有关。此次事件的确认正值勒索黑客组织Lapsus$声称其已针对Mercor并获取了其数据。目前尚不清楚Lapsus$团伙是如何在TeamPCP的网络攻击中从Mercor获取被盗数据的。

Mercor成立于2023年，与包括OpenAI和Anthropic在内的公司合作，通过雇佣来自印度等市场的科学家、医生和律师等专业领域专家来训练人工智能模型。该公司表示，其每天支付的金额超过200万美元，并在2025年10月由Felicis Ventures牵头完成3.5亿美元的C轮融资后，估值达到100亿美元。

Mercor发言人Heidi Hagberg向TechCrunch确认，公司已“迅速采取行动”以控制和解决此次安全事件。“我们正在由领先的第三方取证专家支持进行彻底调查，”Hagberg表示，“我们将根据情况直接与客户和承包商沟通，并投入必要的资源尽快解决此事。”

此前，Lapsus$在其泄露网站上声称对这次数据泄露事件负责，并分享了一部分据称是从Mercor获取的数据样本，TechCrunch对此进行了审查。样本中包含涉及Slack数据和似乎为工单数据的材料，以及两段据称显示Mercor人工智能系统与其平台上的承包商之间对话的视频。

Hagberg拒绝回答后续问题，即此次事件是否与Lapsus$的声明有关，或是否有客户或承包商的数据被访问、外泄或被滥用。

LiteLLM的漏洞最初是在上周被发现的，当时在与Y Combinator支持的初创公司相关的开源项目包中发现了恶意代码。虽然恶意代码在数小时内被识别并移除，但由于LiteLLM在互联网上的广泛使用，该事件引起了关注。根据安全公司Snyk的数据，该库每天被下载数百万次。此次事件还促使LiteLLM对其合规流程进行了调整，包括从有争议的初创公司Delve转向Vanta进行合规认证。

目前尚不清楚有多少家公司受到了与LiteLLM相关的事件影响，或者是否发生了数据泄露，因为调查仍在进行中。
_source.trans_title: Mercor称其遭到了与开源LiteLLM项目漏洞相关的网络攻击

_source.content:
Social media platforms hosted by Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube, could face court enforcement in Australia for allegedly not fully complying with the country’s ban on the platforms for those under 16, the country’s digital safety watchdog said in a new report published Thursday.
The compliance report, the first of its kind since the platform ban took effect, detailed how Australia’s eSafety Commissioner Julie Inman Grant has “significant concerns” about the compliance of Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok and YouTube with the ban, which began last December
The ban, which was imposed on 10 platforms, is the world’s first social media ban for kids younger than 16. Aside from those being investigated, the other platforms subject to the ban include Kick, Reddit, Threads, X and Twitch. These platforms face fines up to 49.5 million Australian dollars ($32.99 million) if they do not take steps to remove the accounts of those under 16.
A press release on the report said the commissioner saw “some progress” in the first three months, but multiple “poor practices” remain regarding compliance. These include prompting kids to attempt age assurance even when their declared age is under 16 and allowing children under 16 to repeatedly try the same age assurance method to get a 16+ result.
Grant further found the platforms failed to provide “accessible or effective pathways” for age-restricted accounts, and did not have sufficient ways to prevent under 16 accounts from being created.
Notifications were sent to the platforms, along with a warning about potential enforcement action.
“While social media platforms have taken some initial action, I am concerned through our compliance monitoring that some may not be doing enough to comply with Australian law,” Grant said in the release. “As a result, we are now moving into an enforcement stance.
The commissioner acknowledged change takes time, but argued the platforms are able to “comply today” and expect companies to do so.
When reached for comment, a spokesperson for Meta said the company is “committed” to complying with Australia’s social media ban and “working constructively with eSafety and the government.”
“We’ve also been clear that accurately determining age online is a challenge for the whole industry, particularly at the age‐16 boundary where the government’s own age assurance technology trial noted ‘natural error margins,’” the spokesperson added, adding the company will “keep investing in enforcement to detect and remove under-16 accounts and support parents, while advocating for a system that’s workable in practice and delivers better safety outcomes.”
The issue of age verification is also a hot topic in the U.S., where the large technology companies also disagree on how to verify age. Meta argues the onus is on the app store and operating system to verify users’ ages, while app store hosts like Google say the onus is on both the stores and developers.
The Associated Press contributed reporting.
_source.movement_title: 澳大利亚对Meta等社交平台启动强制措施
_source.movement_abstract: 澳大利亚电子安全监管机构发布报告称，Meta、TikTok、Snapchat和YouTube等社交平台可能面临法院强制措施，因其未充分遵守该国针对16岁以下用户的社交媒体禁令。这是禁令生效以来首次发布的合规报告，涉及10个受禁令约束的平台，包括Facebook、Instagram、Kick、Reddit等，罚款上限达4950万澳元（约3299万美元）。报告指出，平台存在多项违规行为，如在用户声明年龄未满16岁时仍提示其进行年龄验证，允许未成年人多次尝试同一验证方法以获取16岁以上结果，且未能提供有效途径处理年龄受限账户或阻止未成年人创建账户。电子安全专员Julie Inman Grant表示，尽管平台已采取初步措施，但合规力度不足，监管机构将进入强制执行阶段。Meta回应称致力于遵守禁令，并强调年龄验证存在行业性技术挑战，主张责任应由应用商店和操作系统承担。美国同样面临年龄验证争议，Meta与谷歌等公司对责任归属存在分歧。
_source.title: Social media giants not fully complying with child account ban, Australia alleges
_source.trans_cont:
澳大利亚数字安全监管机构表示，由Meta、TikTok、Snapchat和YouTube等公司运营的社交媒体平台可能面临法院强制执行，因为它们涉嫌未能完全遵守该国对16岁以下用户实施的平台禁令。该机构周四发布的一份新报告指出，这是自平台禁令实施以来的首份合规报告，详细说明了澳大利亚电子安全专员朱莉·因曼·格兰特对Facebook、Instagram、Snapchat、TikTok和YouTube等平台是否遵守禁令表示“有重大担忧”。

这项禁令针对10个平台，是全球首个针对16岁以下儿童的社交媒体禁令。除了正在调查的平台外，其他受禁令影响的平台还包括Kick、Reddit、Threads、X和Twitch。如果这些平台未能采取措施删除16岁以下用户的账户，将面临高达4950万澳大利亚元（约合3299万美元）的罚款。

报告中的一份声明指出，专员在前三个月看到了“一些进展”，但仍有多个“不良做法”存在。其中包括在用户声明年龄低于16岁时仍促使儿童尝试年龄验证，以及允许16岁以下用户反复使用相同的年龄验证方法以获得16岁以上的结果。

格兰特还发现，这些平台未能为年龄受限账户提供“可访问或有效的途径”，也没有足够的方法防止16岁以下账户的创建。通知已发送给相关平台，并附有潜在执法行动的警告。

格兰特在声明中表示：“尽管社交媒体平台已采取了一些初步行动，但我通过合规监测发现，有些平台可能并未充分遵守澳大利亚法律。因此，我们现在将采取执法立场。”

专员承认改变需要时间，但认为这些平台“今天就能遵守”，并期望公司做到这一点。

当被要求发表评论时，Meta的一位发言人表示，公司“致力于遵守澳大利亚的社交媒体禁令，并与eSafety和政府进行建设性合作”。

发言人还补充说：“我们已经明确指出，准确在线验证年龄对整个行业来说都是一个挑战，尤其是在16岁这个年龄界限上，政府自己的年龄验证技术试验也指出存在‘自然误差范围’。”发言人表示，公司将“继续投资于执法，以检测和删除16岁以下账户，支持家长，同时倡导一个在实践中可行、能带来更好安全成果的系统。”

年龄验证问题也是美国的热门话题，大型科技公司之间也对如何验证年龄存在分歧。Meta认为，应由应用商店和操作系统来验证用户的年龄，而像谷歌这样的应用商店运营商则认为责任应由商店和开发者共同承担。

本文部分内容由美联社提供。
_source.trans_title: 澳大利亚指责社交媒体巨头未完全遵守儿童账户禁令

WASHINGTON, March 31 (Reuters) - U.S. diplomats should use social media platform X and partner with military psychological operations units in an effort to "counter foreign anti-American propaganda," Secretary of State Marco ​Rubio said in a cable reviewed by Reuters.
The cable, whose existence was first ‌reported by The Guardian, was devoted to ways to expose foreign influence operations and falsehoods that "pose a direct threat to U.S. national security and fuel hostility toward American interests."
Sign up
here.
The missive told diplomats to "coordinate with interagency ​partners as appropriate," singling out the Pentagon's Psychological Operations, formerly known as Military Information ​Support Operations (MISO).
The cable did not elaborate, but MISO and its successor have ⁠traditionally aimed to sway enemy soldiers on the battlefield. MISO was behind U.S. propaganda efforts ​against Islamic State in Syria, including an incident in which tens of thousands of graphic cartoon-style ​leaflets showing recruits being shoved into a meatgrinder were
air-dropped over the group's area of operations
in 2015.
Military psyop deployments have in the past led to friction with U.S. diplomats. Under the first Trump administration, the ​Pentagon's psyops teams used bogus social media accounts to spread doubts about China's COVID-19 vaccine ​over the objections of State Department officials,
Reuters has previously reported
.
The Pentagon did not immediately return a message seeking ‌comment ⁠on Rubio's cable or the nature of its psyops units' potential collaboration with diplomats.
The cable also urged diplomats to elevate trustworthy information and expose fakes by making use of tools such as the crowdsourced commentary function - dubbed "community notes" - on Elon Musk's social media platform X, as well ​as other, unspecified artificial ​intelligence tools.
X and its ⁠owner, xAI, did not immediately reply to requests for comment. X has been routinely criticized for allowing disinformation to flourish after Musk
gutted the ​site's moderation and safety teams
following his 2022 takeover of what ​was then ⁠known as Twitter. X says the platform is designed to prioritize free speech, and that "community notes" are preferable to centralized moderation.
Musk is a powerful Trump ally and
his site has become a key node
⁠for ​pro-Trump social media influencers. xAI was last month acquired by ​Musk's rocket company SpaceX ahead of what is expected to be
a landmark Wall Street debut
, one that places X ​and the defense contractor under the same corporate roof.
Reporting by Raphael Satter, Editing by Rosalba O'Brien

_source.content:
Iran’s influence is often measured in missiles, militias, and military reach. But this framing misses a more enduring and dangerous reality: Iran is not only exporting weapons; it is exporting and sustaining a martyrdom narrative.
Which is more dangerous: a ballistic missile or the narrative that convinces someone to become one? Or when that narrative evolves into a self-sustaining system capable of producing violence on its own?
At the core of this strategy lies a powerful ideological mechanism that transforms belief into violent action. This is not just persuasion—it is linguistic masking. Coded religious language and symbolic references obscure political intent, gradually replacing individual judgment with what feels like sacred duty. Historical grievances are reframed as ongoing moral obligations, embedding contemporary violence within a sacred continuum of justice and sacrifice.
The foundation of this narrative can be traced to the memory of Karbala and the martyrdom of Husayn ibn Ali in 680 CE. For centuries, this event has symbolized sacrifice in the face of injustice. Today, it is being strategically reactivated. Through sermons, ritual commemorations such as Ashura, and sophisticated digital campaigns, this history is reframed as a living mandate. Individuals—particularly youth—are positioned not as passive observers, but as heirs to a sacred struggle.
This is where the mechanism I describe as the “Killing Vessel” becomes critical. Individuals are not simply persuaded—they are reshaped at the level of identity, cognition, and behavior. The body becomes a vessel of violence—a site where power over life and death is performed. The narrative itself functions like a living system: self-sustaining and adaptive, capable of absorbing individual sacrifice to ensure its own survival. Symbolic and religiously framed grievances—humiliation, marginalization, and perceived injustice—are absorbed into a larger moral universe centered on martyrdom. Within this framework, violence becomes both a moral and religious duty.
This process does not occur in isolation. It is reinforced through repetition, symbolism, and community. Ritual practices normalize suffering and valorize endurance. Visual propaganda and coded language deepen emotional attachment. Social media and AI amplify these messages across borders, ensuring constant exposure and reinforcement. Over time, individuals internalize a worldview in which self-sacrifice is not loss, but fulfillment.
Conventional counterterrorism aims to “decapitate” leadership structures. But within this system, such losses often function as a form of programmed sacrifice—what biologists call apoptosis—in which the death of individual components strengthens the larger organism rather than weakens it. In this logic, martyrdom is not a loss; it is a signal that reinforces and expands the system.
In the aftermath of recent escalations, we are already seeing how this narrative adapts in real time. Digital ecosystems—including AI-generated content and coordinated messaging—are transforming localized events into a living Karbala: a symbolic battle between the sacred and the oppressed, continuously reframed against perceived enemies. In this borderless symbolic space, martyrdom is reconstructed and amplified, allowing the narrative to extend beyond geography, embedding itself within diaspora communities and online networks far from the original conflict.
The implications extend far beyond the Middle East. These narratives are no longer geographically contained. Through transnational networks, diaspora communities, and digital platforms, they operate as a living system—adapting to new contexts while maintaining their core structure. What emerges is not always centralized or directed. Instead, we see the rise of self-mobilized individuals, loosely connected actors, and sympathizers who operate within the logic of the martyrdom narrative without requiring direct command.
For the United States and its allies, this presents a profound challenge. Traditional counterterrorism frameworks are designed to detect organizations, disrupt financing, and neutralize operational cells. But narrative-driven radicalization operates differently. It is diffuse, adaptive, and deeply embedded in identity formation—making it far more difficult to detect and disrupt. It often relies on coded messaging, concealment practices, and symbolic cues that evade conventional monitoring.
Yet policy responses continue to underestimate this dimension. Iran’s strategy is often reduced to proxy warfare, overlooking the ideological infrastructure that sustains it. This is a critical gap. Without addressing the narrative mechanisms that legitimize and reproduce violence, efforts to counter these threats will remain incomplete.
What is needed is a shift in perspective. Narrative must be treated not as secondary propaganda, but as a primary instrument of statecraft. Policy must move beyond simply countering messages. It must disrupt the mechanism itself—identifying how symbolic cues, coded language, and emotional triggers convert belief into violent identity. This requires investing in culturally informed analysis, integrating narrative intelligence into security frameworks, and targeting the pathways through which individuals are transformed into vessels of violence.
The battlefield is no longer defined solely by territory; it is defined by the architecture of meaning within the martyrdom narrative.
_source.movement_title: 伊朗通过殉道叙事构建意识形态暴力体系
_source.movement_abstract: 文章分析了伊朗通过输出武器和构建殉道叙事实现影响力的策略。其核心在于利用宗教语言和历史符号（如卡巴拉战役和阿舒拉仪式）重构身份认同，将个体转化为暴力载体。这种意识形态机制通过重复、象征和社区强化形成自我延续的系统，使暴力行为被神化为道德义务。数字平台、社交媒体和AI技术加速了该叙事的跨国传播，尤其在海外社区和网络空间中持续扩展。传统反恐手段难以应对此类非组织化的、以叙事驱动的激进化，需将叙事分析纳入安全框架，针对象征符号、编码语言和情感触发机制进行干预。当前政策对伊朗意识形态基础设施的忽视构成关键漏洞，应从单纯反制信息转向瓦解其叙事机制本身，以应对日益扩散的威胁。
_source.title: The Killing Vessel: Iran’s Narrative Strategy and the Hidden Threat to the United States
_source.trans_cont:
伊朗的影响力常常通过导弹、民兵组织和军事能力来衡量。但这种框架忽视了一个更加持久且危险的现实：伊朗不仅在出口武器，它还在传播和维持一种殉道的叙事。哪一种更加危险：弹道导弹，还是那种能说服某人成为殉道者的叙事？或者当这种叙事演变为一个自我维持的系统，能够独立产生暴力时？
这种战略的核心是一种强大的意识形态机制，它将信仰转化为暴力行为。这不仅仅是说服，而是一种语言的伪装。经过编码的宗教语言和象征性参照掩盖了政治意图，逐渐取代个人判断，使人们感觉这是神圣的职责。历史上的不满被重新定义为持续的道德义务，将当代暴力嵌入到正义与牺牲的神圣连续体中。
这一叙事的基础可以追溯到卡尔巴拉的记忆以及公元680年侯赛因·本·阿里殉难的事件。几个世纪以来，这一事件象征着面对不公时的牺牲。今天，这一历史被战略性地重新激活。通过布道、纪念仪式如阿舒拉节，以及复杂的数字宣传活动，这一历史被重新诠释为一种活生生的命令。个人——特别是年轻人——被定位为不仅是被动的观察者，而是神圣斗争的继承者。
这就是我所描述的“杀人容器”机制变得关键的地方。人们不仅仅是被说服，而是其身份、认知和行为被重塑。身体成为暴力的容器——一个行使生杀大权的场所。这一叙事本身就像一个活生生的系统：自我维持和适应性，能够吸收个体的牺牲以确保自身的生存。象征性和宗教框架下的不满——羞辱、边缘化和感知到的不公——被纳入以殉道为中心的更大道德宇宙中。在这一框架内，暴力成为一种道德和宗教义务。
这一过程并非孤立发生。它通过重复、象征和社区得到强化。仪式实践使苦难正常化，使忍耐被赋予价值。视觉宣传和编码语言加深了情感联系。社交媒体和人工智能则跨越国界放大这些信息，确保持续的暴露和强化。随着时间的推移，个人会内化一种世界观，其中自我牺牲不是损失，而是实现。
传统的反恐行动旨在“斩首”领导结构。但在这一系统中，这样的损失往往被视为一种计划中的牺牲——生物学家称之为细胞凋亡——个体的死亡反而强化了更大的整体，而非削弱它。在这种逻辑中，殉道不是损失，而是一种信号，强化并扩展了这一系统。
在最近局势升级之后，我们已经看到这一叙事如何实时适应。数字生态系统——包括人工智能生成的内容和协调的信息传播——将局部事件转化为一个活生生的卡尔巴拉：一个神圣与受压迫者之间的象征性战斗，不断以感知到的敌人为背景重新定义。在这一无边界的象征空间中，殉道被重构和放大，使叙事超越地理限制，嵌入到远离原始冲突的海外社区和在线网络中。
这些影响远远超出了中东地区。这些叙事不再局限于地理范围。通过跨国网络、海外社区和数字平台，它们运作如同一个活生生的系统——适应新的环境，同时保持其核心结构。所出现的并不总是集中或有明确方向的。相反，我们看到的是自我动员的个人、松散联系的行动者和同情者，他们按照殉道叙事的逻辑行动，而无需直接命令。
对于美国及其盟友来说，这提出了一个深刻的挑战。传统的反恐框架旨在检测组织、破坏资金来源并中和行动单元。但以叙事驱动的极端主义则不同。它分散、适应性强，并深深植根于身份的形成中——这使得它更难以被发现和破坏。它通常依赖于编码信息、隐藏行为和象征性线索，这些都逃避了常规的监控。
然而，政策应对仍然低估了这一维度。伊朗的战略常常被简化为代理人战争，忽视了维持其运作的意识形态基础设施。这是一个关键的漏洞。如果不解决那些合法化并再生产暴力的叙事机制，应对这些威胁的努力将始终不完整。
所需的是视角的转变。叙事不应被视为次要的宣传手段，而应被视为国家行为的主要工具。政策不应仅仅针对信息进行反击，而应破坏这一机制本身——识别象征性线索、编码语言和情感触发点如何将信仰转化为暴力身份。这要求投资于文化敏感的分析，将叙事情报整合进安全框架，并针对那些将个人转化为暴力容器的路径进行干预。
战场不再仅仅由领土定义；它由殉道叙事中的意义架构所定义。
_source.trans_title: 《杀戮容器：伊朗的叙事策略与对美国的隐秘威胁》
_source.evidence: 文章核心在于分析伊朗如何利用‘殉道叙事’（Martyrdom Narrative）作为一种战略工具，通过意识形态机制、宗教符号和数字传播（包括AI生成内容）将个体转化为暴力载体。文章详细阐述了这种叙事如何作为一种‘认知武器’或‘心理战机制’运作，强调其自我维持、适应性强且难以被传统反恐手段识别的特性。虽然文章提到了AI技术，但重点不在于技术研发本身，而在于叙事作为一种‘武器化’的战略手段及其运作机理。文章并未描述具体的针对中国的敌情事件（排除涉我事件），也不是关于中国自身的演习、建军或政策发布。文章主要探讨的是一种认知域的战略理论、机制分析以及对抗策略的缺失，属于对认知战理论、战略框架和对抗机制的深度剖析。根据标签定义，[理论政策]涵盖‘提出的理论、政策、法规、战略框架等’，本文正是对一种特定的认知战战略框架（Killing Vessel Narrative Strategy）及其理论机制的阐述。

_source.content:
As the world’s attention is fixed on the fast-moving conflict in Iran, my first instinct as a homeland security practitioner was to look here at home. In moments of major geopolitical upheaval, the question is never just what happens there; it is how adversaries may move to create effects here. And in light of the Iran war, the operative question is whether Iran poses an imminent threat to the United States. If we evaluate intent, capability, and opportunity the way practitioners must, the answer is yes.
Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and its external operations arm, the Qods Force (QF), have already demonstrated activity inside the United States (U.S.) across the two vectors that matter most: physical operations and cyber intrusions. Conflict shortens decision cycles, compresses restraint, and raises risk tolerance, increasing the likelihood of near-term activity against U.S. civilians and essential services. These concerns are grounded in public indictments, federal statements, and documented behavior.
IRGC‐QF, in Plain Terms
The Qods Force is the IRGC’s external operations unit responsible for covert action abroad, including intelligence support, targeted violence, and missions designed to advance Iran’s strategic objectives. U.S. government designations tie Qods Force elements to assassinations, sabotage, paramilitary guidance, and lethal plotting. This is a unit built for extraterritorial action. In the current conflict, it is the component most relevant to U.S. homeland risk because it is designed to conduct asymmetric operations beyond Iran’s borders.
Physical: the civilian fallout is not hypothetical
Iran’s willingness to commission violence on U.S. soil is well established. In 2011, federal prosecutors charged conspirators tied to the Qods Force for plotting to assassinate the Saudi ambassador in Washington, D.C., and envisioning a mass casualty attack in a crowded Georgetown restaurant. What was equally alarming about this plot is that the Qods Force was attempting to work with a Mexican drug cartel to help carry out the brazen assassination.  It was a stark demonstration of state‐directed intent, and a reminder that everyday American spaces, not fortified targets, are the most vulnerable.
More recently, between 2021 and 2022, federal indictments and convictions exposed IRGC‐directed operations targeting U.S.‐based dissident Masih Alinejad. First, actors attempted to kidnap her for rendition. When that plan failed, they progressed to a murder‐for‐hire scheme using criminal proxies. These operations unfolded in residential neighborhoods, the kind of spaces where neighbors walk dogs, children ride scooters, and ordinary life happens. These are plots that endanger not just a single individual, but the entire ecosystem of bystanders and responders around them.
In 2022, the Department of Justice charged an IRGC member with attempting to orchestrate the killing of former National Security Adviser John Bolton, explicitly citing retaliation for the strike that killed Qods Force commander Qassem Soleimani. Federal authorities also charged an IRGC-directed asset and two U.S. accomplices in a murder-for-hire plot targeting then President-elect Donald Trump. With Trump now the sitting President, this constitutes an attempted plot against a current head of state. We must treat that as an operational signal, not rhetorical noise.
Cyber: the fastest path to civilian disruption and fear
Iran’s cyber operations have already imposed real-world consequences. In 2012 and 2013, IRGC-linked actors executed sustained DDoS attacks on major U.S. banks, resulting in significant disruption and a federal indictment of seven individuals. In 2013, Iranian actors infiltrated the control system of New York’s Bowman Avenue Dam, a symbolic test of U.S. critical infrastructure access. In 2021, the FBI publicly disclosed it had thwarted an Iran-backed attempt to hack Boston Children’s Hospital, an attack Director Christopher Wray described as one of the most despicable he had seen. This was not a theoretical cyber conflict; it was an attempt to harm a children’s hospital.
By late 2023 and early 2024, IRGC-affiliated CyberAv3ngers actors were compromising internet-exposed Unitronics devices across the U.S. water and wastewater sectors. The incident in Aliquippa, Pennsylvania, turned abstract fears into immediate operational disruption. The message is unmistakable: Iran is willing to touch the systems that deliver drinking water, manage wastewater, and support basic community functions.
Capacity at the wrong place and time
At the precise moment when Iran-focused analysis, disruption, and counterintelligence work should be surging, national security personnel across agencies have been diverted into other enforcement missions through broad reassignments of already overstretched investigative resources.  These shifts thin the expertise, national security investigative bandwidth, and analytic continuity needed to stay ahead of a fast-moving threat landscape. The recent resignation of the NCTC director amid the Iran war and the firing of FBI personnel with Iran-related expertise compound the problem. When institutional memory and subject matter depth walk out the door, gaps emerge. And adversaries look for gaps.
Recent signals: a warning pattern, not panic
Signals always precede attacks. The United States has recently seen a cluster of them: charges against IRGC-linked actors targeting U.S. officials; public reporting on retaliatory rhetoric tied to the Iran war; media coverage of bounty offers; and FBI testimony outlining how Iran’s Axis of Resistance posture elevates homeland risk during conflict spikes abroad. This pattern does not indicate inevitability, but it does indicate intent and a willingness to test opportunities.
Bottom line
The Qods Force record, from physical plots in ordinary places to cyber intrusions into essential services, is clear. These activities map onto the spaces where Americans live, work, receive care, and expect normalcy. In a compressed conflict environment, homeland risk is not hypothetical. It is present, immediate, and evolving. The United States must refocus and surge analytic, operational, and counterintelligence resources back toward the Iran problem set before intent becomes impact in both the physical world and the digital domain.
_source.movement_title: 伊朗圣城旅对美本土威胁分析：实体与网络攻击风险并存
_source.movement_abstract: 文章分析了伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队下属圣城旅对美国本土构成的威胁。圣城旅长期在美国境内实施实体和网络攻击，包括2011年策划暗杀沙特大使及针对美国民众的袭击，2021-2022年针对异见人士马西·阿利尼亚德的绑架和雇凶杀人计划，以及2022年针对前国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿和总统特朗普的暗杀企图。在网络领域，圣城旅曾对美国银行、纽约鲍曼大道水坝、波士顿儿童医院等关键基础设施实施攻击，并在2023-2024年入侵水务系统。当前美国国家安全机构因资源分散面临应对能力下降，需重新聚焦伊朗威胁。近期针对伊朗关联人员的起诉、报复性言论和悬赏信息等信号表明，伊朗正在测试攻击机会，威胁已从理论变为现实。
_source.title: The Iran Threat is Already Here
_source.trans_cont:
随着世界关注伊朗快速发展的冲突，作为一名国土安全实践者，我的第一反应是关注我们国家内部的情况。在重大的地缘政治动荡时刻，问题从来不只是那里会发生什么，而是对手可能如何行动以在此地产生影响。鉴于伊朗战争，关键问题是伊朗是否对美国构成迫近的威胁。如果我们像实践者必须做的那样评估意图、能力和机会，答案是肯定的。

伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）及其对外行动部门——圣城部队（Qods Force，简称QF），已经在两个最重要的方面在美国境内展示了其活动：实体行动和网络入侵。冲突缩短了决策周期，压缩了克制，提高了风险承受能力，增加了近期针对美国平民和关键服务的活动可能性。这些担忧基于公开指控、联邦声明和已记录的行为。

圣城部队，简明解释
圣城部队是IRGC的对外行动单位，负责在国外进行秘密行动，包括情报支持、有针对性的暴力行动以及旨在推进伊朗战略目标的任务。美国政府的指定将圣城部队的某些成员与暗杀、破坏、准军事指导和致命阴谋联系起来。这是一个专为境外行动而设计的单位。在当前的冲突中，它是与美国国土安全风险最相关的部分，因为它专门从事伊朗国界以外的不对称行动。

实体行动：平民后果并非假设
伊朗愿意在美国领土上发动暴力行动是众所周知的。2011年，联邦检察官指控与圣城部队有关的阴谋者，他们计划暗杀华盛顿特区的沙特大使，并设想在拥挤的乔治城餐厅发动造成大量伤亡的袭击。这个阴谋令人担忧的另一点是，圣城部队试图与墨西哥贩毒集团合作，协助实施这一大胆的暗杀行动。这是一次明显的国家主导意图的展示，也提醒我们，日常的美国空间，而不是加固的目标，是最脆弱的。

最近，2021年至2022年间，联邦起诉和定罪揭露了IRGC针对美国境内持不同政见者马西赫·阿利内贾德的行动。首先，行动者试图绑架她进行引渡。当这个计划失败后，他们转而使用犯罪代理进行雇凶杀人。这些行动发生在住宅区，邻居遛狗、孩子们骑滑板车、普通生活发生的地方。这些阴谋不仅危及个人，还危及周围的旁观者和救援人员。

2022年，司法部指控一名IRGC成员试图策划杀害前国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿，明确指出这是对击毙圣城部队指挥官卡西姆·苏莱曼尼的报复。联邦当局还指控一名IRGC相关资产和两名美国共犯，策划针对当时当选总统唐纳德·特朗普的雇凶杀人。随着特朗普现在成为现任总统，这构成了针对现任国家元首的企图。我们必须将此视为一个行动信号，而不是修辞噪音。

网络：最快到达平民混乱和恐惧的途径
伊朗的网络行动已经造成了现实后果。2012年和2013年，与IRGC有关的行动者对主要美国银行实施了持续的DDoS攻击，导致重大中断，并对七名个人提起联邦起诉。2013年，伊朗行动者入侵了纽约鲍曼大道水坝的控制系统，这是对美国关键基础设施访问的象征性测试。2021年，FBI公开披露挫败了一次由伊朗支持的黑客攻击波士顿儿童医院的企图，该攻击被局长克里斯托弗·瓦雷描述为他见过最令人憎恶的攻击之一。这不是一场理论上的网络冲突，而是一次企图伤害儿童医院的行动。

到2023年底和2024年初，与IRGC有关的CyberAv3ngers行动者正在入侵美国水和污水处理部门的互联网暴露设备。宾夕法尼亚州阿里奎帕的事件将抽象的恐惧转化为即时的行动中断。信息非常明确：伊朗愿意触碰提供饮用水、管理污水处理和支撑基本社区功能的系统。

在错误的时间和地点拥有能力
在伊朗相关分析、干扰和反间谍工作应该激增的时刻，各机构的国家安全人员却因广泛的人事调动而被分散到其他执法任务中，这些调动已经过度紧张的调查资源。这些变化削弱了所需的专业知识、国家安全调查带宽和分析连续性，以应对快速变化的威胁环境。最近，伊朗战争期间国家反恐中心（NCTC）主任的辞职以及FBI拥有伊朗相关专业知识的人员被解雇加剧了这一问题。当机构记忆和专业知识深度离开时，就会出现漏洞。而对手则会寻找这些漏洞。

近期信号：一种警告模式，而非恐慌
信号总是先于攻击。美国最近看到了一系列信号：针对美国官员的与IRGC有关的行动者的指控；与伊朗战争相关的
_source.trans_title: 伊朗威胁已经来临
